name: A Crystalline Prophecy
steps: Requires level 10 or higher, and the server must have A Crystalline Prophecy enabled.
Enter Lower Jeuno; a cutscene plays automatically.
Watch the cutscene to the end to complete the mission.
Reward: the next mission, 'The Echo Awakens', unlocks.

name: The Echo Awakens
steps: Not playable on this server yet: the script only advances the log to Gatherer of Light I and has a TODO where the zones, NPCs and cutscenes should be.

name: Gatherer Of Light I
steps: Not playable on this server yet: the script has no zones, NPCs or cutscenes (only a TODO), so nothing you do completes it. Gatherer of Light II is listed as the next mission but cannot be reached in play.

name: Gatherer Of Light II
steps: Not playable on this server yet: the script only advances the log to Those Who Lurk in Shadows I and has a TODO where the zones, NPCs and cutscenes should be.

name: Those Who Lurk In Shadows I
steps: Not playable on this server yet: the script only advances the log to Those Who Lurk in Shadows II and has a TODO where the zones, NPCs and cutscenes should be.

name: Those Who Lurk In Shadows II
steps: Not playable on this server yet: the script has no zones, NPCs or cutscenes (only a TODO), so nothing you do completes it. Those Who Lurk in Shadows III is listed as the next mission but cannot be reached in play.

name: Those Who Lurk In Shadows III
steps: Not playable on this server yet: the script only advances the log to Remember Me in Your Dreams and has a TODO where the zones, NPCs and cutscenes should be.

name: Remember Me In Your Dreams
steps: Not playable on this server yet: the script only advances the log to Born of Her Nightmares and has a TODO where the zones, NPCs and cutscenes should be.

name: Born Of Her Nightmares
steps: Not playable on this server yet: the script has no zones, NPCs or cutscenes (only a TODO), so nothing you do completes it. Banishing the Echo is listed as the next mission but cannot be reached in play.

name: Banishing The Echo
steps: Not playable on this server yet: the script only advances the log to Ode of Life Bestowing and has a TODO where the zones, NPCs and cutscenes should be.

name: Ode Of Life Bestowing
steps: Not playable on this server yet: the script only advances the log to A Crystalline Prophecy Fin and has a TODO where the zones, NPCs and cutscenes should be.

name: A Crystalline Prophecy Fin
steps: Not playable on this server yet: this final mission's script has an empty reward table and a TODO where the zones, NPCs and cutscenes should be.

name: Rumors from the West
steps: Every character starts with this mission (Seekers of Adoulin must be enabled on the server). Watch your new-character opening cutscene first.
Optional: the first time you enter Northern San d'Oria, Bastok Markets or Windurst Woods (outside your Mog House), an extra story cutscene plays.
Go to Lower Jeuno and talk to Darcia (near -36, -15).
In the cutscene, choose to accept the work: you receive the key item Geomagnetron and the mission moves to The Geomagnetron.
Alternative: if you carry 1,000,000 gil, pick the option to pay instead. Darcia takes the gil, gives you the Adoulinian Charter Permit and skips you straight to Onward to Adoulin.
Reward: key item Geomagnetron (or the Adoulinian Charter Permit if you paid); next mission The Geomagnetron.

name: The Geomagnetron
steps: Requires the key item Geomagnetron from Rumors from the West.

Go to a dungeon that has a Geomagnetic Fount and examine it: Gusgen Mines, Ordelle's Caves, King Ranperre's Tomb, Dangruf Wadi, Palborough Mines, Inner/Outer Horutoto Ruins, Maze of Shakhrami, Crawlers' Nest and others.
When the message says your Geomagnetron has been attuned to a geomagnetic fount, your device is charged.
Return to Lower Jeuno and talk to Darcia (near -36, -15) to watch the cutscene.
Skip option: talking to Darcia before attuning lets you pay 1,000,000 gil to finish now and get the Adoulinian Charter Permit.
Reward: key items Geomagnetron (returned) and Adoulinian Charter Permit; next mission Onward to Adoulin.

name: Onward to Adoulin
steps: Requires the Adoulinian Charter Permit from The Geomagnetron.
In Lower Jeuno, examine the Waypoint (near -35, -31).
In the menu, choose the option to travel: you are sent to Ceizak Battlegrounds.
A cutscene plays when you arrive in Ceizak Battlegrounds and the mission completes.
Reward: next mission Heartwings and the Kindhearted.

name: Heartwings and the Kindhearted
steps: Travel from Ceizak Battlegrounds into the city of Western Adoulin.
A cutscene plays as you enter Western Adoulin and the mission completes.
Reward: next mission Pioneer Registration.

name: Pioneer Registration
steps: In Western Adoulin, talk to Brenton (near -86, 18) to register as a pioneer and watch the cutscene.
You receive the key item Pioneer's Badge.

After this, several Western Adoulin NPCs (Berstrogus, Chanteillie, Clemmar, Dangueubert, Nikkhail, Nylene, Quam Jitahr, Rising Solstice, Ruth, Shipilolo) have new introduction scenes; Dangueubert can send you to Mog Garden.
Reward: 1,000 bayld, key items Pioneer's Badge and Map of Adoulin; next mission Life on the Frontier.

name: Life on the Frontier
steps: Cannot be finished on this server: Brenton in Western Adoulin only starts it after an imprimatur check whose spent count is hardcoded to 0 (TODO), so the check always fails; it would give Dinner Invitation and unlock Meeting of the Minds.

name: Meeting of the Minds
steps: Requires the key item Dinner Invitation from Life on the Frontier.
Go to Eastern Adoulin and find Ploh Trishbahk (near 101, -64).
Talk to him between 15:00 and 22:00 Vana'diel time (game clock). At other hours he only gives a short greeting.
Watch the dinner cutscene; the Dinner Invitation is used up.
Reward: next mission Arciela Appears Again.

name: Arciela Appears Again
steps: Requires Adoulin fame level 5. The script's imprimatur check is unfinished (TODO), so fame alone decides it.
In Western Adoulin, talk to Levil (near -87, 13) and watch the cutscene; the mission completes.
Reward: next mission Budding Prospects.

name: Budding Prospects
steps: Start the Adoulin quest Flavors of Our Lives: talk to Berghent near the Big Bridge in Western Adoulin (J-9) and accept.
Talk to Masad inside the Mummers' Coalition in Western Adoulin (near -28, -92). This starts a 1-day wait.
Talk to Dewalt inside the Couriers' Coalition in Western Adoulin (near -23, 28) to advance the quest.
Wait until the next Vana'diel day and change areas at least once.
Return to Masad and watch the cutscene. Masad also works at any time if you have already finished Flavors of Our Lives.
Reward: next mission The Light Shining in Your Eyes.

name: The Light Shining in Your Eyes
steps: In Western Adoulin, talk to Levil (near -87, 13) and watch the cutscene.
Reward: next mission The Heirloom.

name: The Heirloom
steps: Go to Eastern Adoulin and walk to the area near Ploh Trishbahk (near 101, -64). A cutscene starts automatically.
Talking to Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a reminder.
Reward: next mission An Aimless Journey.

name: An Aimless Journey
steps: Travel to Cirdas Caverns.
Walk to the area near the Ergon Locus (near -140, 60). A cutscene starts automatically and the mission completes.
Reward: next mission Ortharsyne.

name: Ortharsyne
steps: Enter Yorcia Weald U (zone 264, the version reached in this mission's story). A cutscene plays as you arrive and the mission completes.
Reward: next mission In the Presence of Royalty.

name: In the Presence of Royalty
steps: Go to Yorcia Weald and examine the ??? at the Ergon Locus (near 442, -224) to get the key item Yorcia's Tear. Getting it by harvesting with a sickle is not implemented yet (TODO).
With Yorcia's Tear, go to the Pellucid Afflusion in Yorcia Weald (near -175, 388) and examine it to watch the cutscene.
The next mission, The Twin World Trees, begins after the next Vana'diel day.
Reward: key item Rosulatia's Pome, title Queen's Confidante; next mission The Twin World Trees.

name: The Twin World Trees
steps: Requires Seekers of Adoulin mission In the Presence of Royalty to be complete; it starts a timer, so wait until the next Vana'diel day.
Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a reminder scene.
In Eastern Adoulin, walk to Oscairn at the Peacekeeper Coalition (around !pos -80 0 31); stepping within about 7 yalms of him plays the cutscene.
Watch the cutscene to the end to complete the mission.
Reward: next mission, Honor and Audacity, unlocks.

name: Honor and Audacity
steps: Travel to the Rala Waterways zone. (Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a hint here.)
A cutscene plays as soon as you enter Rala Waterways. Watch it to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, The Watergarden Coliseum, unlocks.

name: The Watergarden Coliseum
steps: In Rala Waterways, find Yeggha Dolashi in the eastern part of the zone.
Talk to Yeggha Dolashi and watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Friction and Fissures, unlocks. It can be continued after the next Vana'diel day.

name: Friction and Fissures
steps: Wait until the next Vana'diel day after finishing The Watergarden Coliseum. Until then, Levil only gives a hint.
Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin and watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, The Celennia Memorial Library, unlocks.

name: The Celennia Memorial Library
steps: Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint to visit the library.
Go to the Celennia Memorial Library and talk to Yefafa.
Examine the 'History' book next to Yefafa and let it show you the password. This counts as the step being done.
Go back to Levil in Western Adoulin and watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, For Whom Do We Toil?, unlocks.

name: For Whom Do We Toil?
steps: Enter Rala Waterways. A cutscene plays as you arrive.
Optional: talk to Wegellion in Eastern Adoulin for a cutscene.
In Rala Waterways, go west to Sluice Gate #6 and examine it.
When the gate asks for the password, enter HGSI both times. That finishes the mission.
Each wrong password counts as one miss. After 3 misses, reread 'History' in the Celennia Memorial Library and wait one Vana'diel day before trying again.
If the scene asks whether it will help and you answer 'Of course it won't help', examine Sluice Gate #6 again to finish.
Reward: Key Item Note Detailing Seditious Plans; the next mission, Aiming for Ygnas, unlocks.

name: Aiming for Ygnas
steps: Go to Eastern Adoulin and find Ploh Trishbahk on the lower level of the city.
Talk to Ploh Trishbahk and watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Calamity in the Kitchen, unlocks.

name: Calamity in the Kitchen
steps: Go to Rala Waterways and find Chalvava in the southwest part of the zone.
Talk to Chalvava and agree to help when asked. Choosing the other answer does not finish the mission.
If you declined, talk to Chalvava again and agree this time.
Reward: Key Item Box of Adoulinian Tomatoes; the next mission, Arciela's Promise, unlocks.

name: Arciela's Promise
steps: Optional: talk to Chalvava in Rala Waterways for a short scene.
Go to Eastern Adoulin and talk to Ploh Trishbahk on the lower level of the city.
Watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Predators and Prey, unlocks.

name: Predators and Prey
steps: Go to Rala Waterways and head west to Sluice Gate #6.
Examine Sluice Gate #6 and watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Behind the Sluices, unlocks.

name: Behind the Sluices
steps: In Rala Waterways, examine the Storage Container in the central part of the zone to get Key Item Waterway Facility Crank.
Go west to Sluice Gate #6 and examine it. Watch the cutscene.
Examine Sluice Gate #6 again and confirm that you want to go through.
Examine the Antiquated Sluice Gate next to it to enter the battle area (Rala Waterways [U]). This uses up the Waterway Facility Crank.
Fight alongside Arciela and defeat all 4 enemies: The Keeper, Mistdagger and two named The Briars. Arciela needs healing.
If you lose, you are returned to the Antiquated Sluice Gate.
After you win, a cutscene plays when you return to Rala Waterways. Watch it to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, The Leafkin Monarch, unlocks. Note: the server's battle script still has unfinished parts, so this fight may not behave as intended.

name: The Leafkin Monarch
steps: Go to Eastern Adoulin and walk to the area near Ploh Trishbahk on the lower level. A cutscene starts automatically.
Watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Yggdrasil, unlocks. It can be continued after the next Vana'diel day.

name: Yggdrasil
steps: Requires Adoulin fame level 4. The server does not track the imprimatur requirement yet, so it uses fame level alone. Also wait one Vana'diel day after The Leafkin Monarch.
Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin. If you don't qualify yet, he only gives a hint.
In the cutscene, choose to accept. If you decline, talk to Levil again and accept.
Reward: the next mission, Return of the Exorcist, unlocks.

name: Return of the Exorcist
steps: Go to Western Adoulin and walk to the scripted area near Levil. A cutscene starts automatically.
Watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, The Merciless One, unlocks.

name: The Merciless One
steps: Go to Eastern Adoulin and walk into the city's scripted area. A cutscene starts automatically. (Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a hint.)
Watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, A Curse from the Past, unlocks.

name: A Curse from the Past
steps: Optional: talk to Ploh Trishbahk on the lower level of Eastern Adoulin for a cutscene about the task.
Talk to Rigobertine in Eastern Adoulin to get Key Item Eternal Flame.
In Western Adoulin, examine Fontis Xanira (a fountain) to get Key Item Vial of Untainted Holy Water.
In Western Adoulin, examine the Sunrise Beacon to get Key Item Piece of a Stone Wall.
Return to Eastern Adoulin and talk to Erminold on the lower level. Watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: Key Item Weather Vane Wings; the next mission, The Purgation, unlocks.

name: The Purgation
steps: Go to Eastern Adoulin and walk into the scripted area near Erminold on the lower level. A cutscene starts automatically.
Watch the cutscene to finish the mission. You lose Key Items Eternal Flame, Vial of Untainted Holy Water, Piece of a Stone Wall and Weather Vane Wings.
Reward: the next mission, The Key, unlocks. It can be continued after the next Vana'diel day.

name: The Key
steps: Wait until the next Vana'diel day after The Purgation. Until then, Levil only gives a hint.
Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin and watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, The Princess's Dilemma, unlocks.

name: The Princess's Dilemma
steps: Requires being on Seekers of Adoulin mission The Princess's Dilemma.
Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a reminder scene.
Enter Celennia Memorial Library; a cutscene plays as you arrive.

In the cutscene the mission completes only on one specific answer (script option value 2; the script does not say which on-screen choice that is). If it ends without completing, zone out and back in to retry.
Reward: next mission, Dark Clouds Ahead, unlocks.

name: Dark Clouds Ahead
steps: Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin and watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, The Smallest of Favors, unlocks. It can be continued after the next Vana'diel day.

name: The Smallest of Favors
steps: Requires finishing Dark Clouds Ahead; you must then wait until the next Vana'diel day (Levil in Western Adoulin only repeats a hint until then).
After the wait, leave Western Adoulin on foot through its exit into Ceizak Battlegrounds (the script notes Waypoint teleports should not count).
Watch the cutscene that plays as you enter Ceizak Battlegrounds.
Reward: the mission advances to Summoned by Spirits.

name: Summoned by Spirits
steps: Start right after The Smallest of Favors; Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a reminder.
Enter the Celennia Memorial Library and watch the cutscene that plays on arrival.
Reward: the mission advances to Evil Entities.

name: Evil Entities
steps: Start right after Summoned by Spirits; Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a reminder.
Go to Ceizak Battlegrounds and talk to Elmric to watch the cutscene.
Reward: the mission advances to Adoulin Calling.

name: Adoulin Calling
steps: Start right after Evil Entities; Elmric in Ceizak Battlegrounds and Levil in Western Adoulin only give reminders.
Go to Eastern Adoulin and examine the Boarding House door (around !pos -41 0 -38) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: the mission advances to The Disappearance of Nyline.

name: The Disappearance of Nyline
steps: Start right after Adoulin Calling. Optionally examine the Boarding House door in Eastern Adoulin (around !pos -41 0 -38) for a scene.
Travel to Foret de Hennetiel and walk to the Ergon Locus area (around !pos 530 158 18).
Watch the cutscene that plays when you step into that area.
Reward: the mission advances to Shared Consciousness.

name: Shared Consciousness
steps: Start right after The Disappearance of Nyline; Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a reminder.
Go to Eastern Adoulin and examine the Boarding House door (around !pos -41 0 -38) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: 1,000 EXP, 1,000 bayld, the title Sunshine Cadet; the mission advances to Clear Skies (which needs a one-day wait).

name: The Disappearance of Nyline
steps: Start after Shared Consciousness, then wait until the next Vana'diel day (about one real hour); before then Levil only repeats a hint.
Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin (around !pos -87 3 12) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: 100 bayld; the mission advances to The Man in Black.

name: The Man in Black
steps: Start right after Clear Skies. Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a reminder cutscene; Masad in Western Adoulin runs the mission.
If you already hold the key item Card: Jailer Teodor, talk to Masad: a cutscene plays and the mission jumps straight to An Extraordinary Gentleman. Otherwise read on.
Talk to Masad in Western Adoulin to start a dice game against Teodor. Each Shoot adds a die roll (1 to 6) to your total; Stay ends your turn.
Keep your total at 11 or less: a total over 11 is a bust and counts as 0. When both you and Teodor have stayed, the higher total wins the round; equal totals tie.
Once per round you may use one trick: Peek, Switcharoo (swap one of your dice with one of his) or Crooked Die (reroll one of his dice). Teodor can also use Switcharoo or Crooked Die on you.
Play rounds until the event ends. The script does not judge the session itself; it only reads how the event finishes.
If the event finishes with result 0 (the game's winning ending), a further cutscene plays and the mission skips To the Victor and moves to An Extraordinary Gentleman.
Any other finish moves you on to To the Victor, where you can challenge Masad again.
Reward: the mission advances to To the Victor (or to An Extraordinary Gentleman on a win).

name: To the Victor
steps: Start after The Man in Black if you did not beat Teodor there; Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a reminder.
Talk to Masad in Western Adoulin to play the dice-card game against Teodor again (Shoot, Stay, and one trick per round).
Win the game; a loss just lets you talk to Masad and try again (if you hold the key item Card: Jailer Teodor, talking to Masad finishes it directly).
Watch the victory cutscene.
Reward: the title Boomy and Busty; the mission advances to An Extraordinary Gentleman.

name: An Extraordinary Gentleman
steps: Start right after To the Victor (or a win in The Man in Black).
Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin (around !pos -87 3 12) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: the mission advances to The Order's Treasures.

name: The Order's Treasures
steps: Start right after An Extraordinary Gentleman; Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a reminder.
Enter the Celennia Memorial Library and watch the cutscene that plays on arrival.
Reward: the mission advances to August's Heirloom.

name: August's Heirloom
steps: Start right after The Order's Treasures; Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a reminder.
Go to Eastern Adoulin and talk to Ploh Trishbahk at the castle gate (around !pos 100 -40 -63) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: the mission advances to Beauty and the Beast.

name: Beauty and the Beast
steps: Start right after August's Heirloom; Ploh Trishbahk in Eastern Adoulin gives a hint, Levil in Western Adoulin a reminder.
Travel to Ceizak Battlegrounds and examine the Signs of a Struggle to watch the cutscene.
Reward: key item Pristine Hair Ribbon; the mission advances to Wildcat with a Gold Pelt.

name: Wildcat with a Gold Pelt
steps: Start right after Beauty and the Beast; Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a reminder.
Go to Eastern Adoulin and walk up to the castle gate area near Ploh Trishbahk (around !pos 100 -40 -63).
Watch the cutscene that plays when you enter that area.
Reward: the mission advances to In Search of Arciela.

name: In Search of Arciela
steps: Start right after Wildcat with a Gold Pelt. Optionally talk to Ploh Trishbahk at the Eastern Adoulin castle gate for a one-time scene.
Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin (around !pos -87 3 12) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: the mission advances to Looking for Leads.

name: Looking for Leads
steps: Start right after In Search of Arciela; Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a reminder.
Go to Eastern Adoulin and walk to the Scouts' Coalition area near Wegellion (around !pos -94 0 -51).
Watch the cutscene that plays when you enter that area.
Reward: key item Tintinnabulum; the mission advances to Drifting Northwest.

name: Drifting Northwest
steps: Start right after Looking for Leads with the key item Tintinnabulum; Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a reminder.
Travel to Kamihr Drifts and watch the cutscene that plays as you enter (the Tintinnabulum is used up).
Reward: the mission advances to Kumhau, the Flashfrost Naakual.

name: Kumhau, the Flashfrost Naakual
steps: Start right after Drifting Northwest.
Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin (around !pos -87 3 12) for a cutscene.
Go to Kamihr Drifts and examine the Crawling Cave (around !pos -349 40 -379); after the scene you are moved to Ceizak Battlegrounds.
Watch the cutscene in Ceizak Battlegrounds; afterwards you are moved back to Kamihr Drifts.
Watch the final cutscene as you arrive in Kamihr Drifts.
Reward: key item Aureate Ball of Fur; the mission advances to Soul Siphon.

name: Soul Siphon
steps: Start right after Kumhau, the Flashfrost Naakual; Levil in Western Adoulin only gives a reminder.
In Kamihr Drifts, examine the Hollowed Pathway (around !pos 215 39 -446) and choose the first option to go in; you are moved to Cirdas Caverns.
Watch the cutscene in Cirdas Caverns; afterwards you are moved back to Kamihr Drifts, and the mission completes on arrival.
Reward: the mission advances to Stonewalled.

name: Stonewalled
steps: Cannot be finished on this server: the Cirdas Caverns U fight has no instance set up and nothing in the script lets you enter it. You will stay stuck on this mission.
What exists: start right after Soul Siphon. Levil in Western Adoulin gives a reminder. If you lost the key item Aureate Ball of Fur, examine the Crawling Cave in Kamihr Drifts to get it back.
The script header points to the Hollowed Pathway in Kamihr Drifts as the entrance, but this mission has no handler there, so examining it does nothing for Stonewalled.
Planned after the fight (cannot happen yet): you are moved to Cirdas Caverns, watch a cutscene, then return to Kamihr Drifts.
Reward (per script, unreachable): key item Soul Siphon; the mission advances to Salvation.

name: Salvation
steps: Requires the Soul Siphon key item (received at the end of the previous mission, Stonewalled).
Go to Kamihr Drifts and examine the Crawling Cave.
In the cutscene, choose the third option to use the Soul Siphon; the other choices do not finish the mission.
The Soul Siphon key item is consumed. Wait until the next Vana'diel day before continuing to Glimmer of Portent.
Reward: the next mission, Glimmer of Portent.

name: Glimmer of Portent
steps: Wait until a new Vana'diel day has started since you finished Salvation.
Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin and watch the cutscene. If he only gives his usual line, the day has not passed yet.
Choose the first option at the end of the cutscene to complete the mission.
Reward: the next mission, ...Into the Fire.

name: ...Into the Fire
steps: Talk to Kipligg in Western Adoulin and watch the cutscene.
Reward: the next mission, Melvien de Malecroix.

name: Melvien de Malecroix
steps: In Western Adoulin, you can talk to Kipligg for a reminder of what to do.
Examine the Port Storage in Western Adoulin and watch the cutscene.
The cutscene names one material set that you must bring back (picked at random): 5 Eft Skin, 4 Lock of Manticore Hair, 1 Buffalo Horn, 1 Square of Manticore Leather or 1 Square of Buffalo Leather.
Reward: the next mission, Courier Catastrophe.

name: Courier Catastrophe
steps: Examine the Port Storage in Western Adoulin to see which set you were given: 5 Eft Skin, 4 Lock of Manticore Hair, 1 Buffalo Horn, 1 Square of Manticore Leather or 1 Square of Buffalo Leather.
Obtain exactly that set (this mission's script does not say where).
Trade exactly those items to the Port Storage in Western Adoulin and watch the cutscene. The items are used up.
Reward: the next mission, Done and Delivered.

name: Done and Delivered
steps: Talk to Kipligg in Western Adoulin and watch the cutscene.
Reward: the next mission, Ministerial Whispers.

name: Ministerial Whispers
steps: Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin and watch the cutscene.
Afterward, wait until the next Vana'diel day and change zones before starting the next mission.
Reward: 500 bayld and the next mission, A Day in the Life of a Pioneer.

name: A Day in the Life of a Pioneer
steps: Requires that a new Vana'diel day has started since Ministerial Whispers, and that you have changed zones since then.
Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin and watch the cutscene. If he only gives his usual line, wait longer or change zones first.
Reward: the next mission, Lighting the Way.

name: Lighting the Way
steps: Go to Kamihr Drifts and examine the Alpine Trail (the script's comment places it near !pos -13 -1 488).
In the cutscene menu, choose the option to climb or go up the trail. If you decline, nothing changes; examine the trail again. Agreeing moves you to Mount Kamihr.
Watch the cutscene that plays when you arrive in Mount Kamihr. Afterward you are sent back to Kamihr Drifts.
The mission completes when you arrive back in Kamihr Drifts.
Reward: the title Knower of Untruths and the next mission, Sajj'aka.

name: Sajj'aka
steps: Go to the Celennia Memorial Library. A cutscene plays automatically when you enter.
Watch the whole cutscene to complete the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Studying Up.

name: Studying Up
steps: Go to Kamihr Drifts and examine the Alpine Trail.
Pick the first option to go up the trail. You are moved to Mount Kamihr.
Watch the cutscene in Mount Kamihr. Afterward you are sent back to Kamihr Drifts.
The mission completes when you arrive back in Kamihr Drifts.
Reward: the next mission, A Vow of Truth.

name: A Vow of Truth
steps: Go to Woh Gates. A cutscene plays automatically when you enter.
Watch the whole cutscene to complete the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Darrcuiln.

name: Darrcuiln
steps: In Woh Gates, find the Darkened Crevice and examine it.
Watch the whole cutscene to complete the mission.
Reward: the key item Tuft of Golden Fur and the next mission, The Gates.

name: The Gates
steps: Requires the key item Tuft of Golden Fur. If you lost it, examine the Large Animal Track in Woh Gates to get it back.
Clear the battle in Cirdas Caverns U. This server's mission script has only a TODO for this fight and does not say how to enter it, and the instance itself has no script.
After you win, you are moved back to Woh Gates, where a cutscene plays when you arrive. Watch it to complete the mission.
Reward: the title Ulbukan Understudy and the next mission, Morimar.

name: Morimar
steps: Go to Kamihr Drifts and examine the Alpine Trail (the script's comment places it near !pos -13 -1 488).
In the cutscene menu, choose the option to climb or go up the trail. If you decline, nothing changes; examine the trail again. Agreeing moves you to Mount Kamihr.
Watch the cutscene that plays when you arrive in Mount Kamihr. It completes the mission, and you are sent back to Kamihr Drifts.
Reward: the key item Sajj'aka's Protective Ward and the next mission, A New Force Arises.

name: A New Force Arises
steps: Go to Outer Ra'Kaznar and examine the door marked _7mw (near position 197, 58, -20) to get the key item Sunkissed Scale.
In Outer Ra'Kaznar, examine Effigy of Sealing 1 (near -496, -178, 336) to get the key item Moontouched Scale.
In Outer Ra'Kaznar, examine Effigy of Sealing 2 (near -424, -178, -376) to get the key item Starblessed Scale.
Optional: with only 1 or 2 scales, entering the Celennia Memorial Library or using the Alpine Trail shows story cutscenes. They do not count toward completing the mission.
With all three scales, go to Kamihr Drifts, examine the Alpine Trail, and pick the first option to go to Mount Kamihr.
Watch the cutscene in Mount Kamihr. All three scales are used up and you are sent back to Kamihr Drifts.
Reward: the key item World Tree Sapling and the next mission, The Sacred Sapling.

name: The Sacred Sapling
steps: Talk to Ploh Trishbahk in Eastern Adoulin and watch the cutscene.
Reward: the next mission, Tree Grafting.

name: Tree Grafting
steps: Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin and watch the cutscene.
Reward: the next mission, A Shrouded Canopy.

name: A Shrouded Canopy
steps: Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a cutscene about where to go next.
Go to Leafallia. A cutscene plays automatically when you enter.
Watch the whole cutscene to complete the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Leafallia.

name: Leafallia
steps: In Leafallia, find the Aged Stump and examine it.
Watch the whole cutscene to complete the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Rosulatia's Promise.

name: Rosulatia's Promise
steps: Have the Seekers of Adoulin mission Rosulatia's Promise active. The script checks nothing else.
Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a reminder scene.
Travel to Leafallia and examine the Heroic Footprints to watch the cutscene.
When the scene ends, the World Tree Sapling key item is taken from you if you have it.
Reward: the mission completes and The Lightsland begins.

name: The Lightsland
steps: Have mission The Lightsland active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin or the Heroic Footprints in Leafallia for reminder scenes.
Go to Eastern Adoulin and talk to Ploh Trishbahk to watch the cutscene.
At the end, choose one necklace: Adoulin's Refuge, Ygnas's Resolve, or Arciela's Grace. You get 500 EXP from this scene either way.
If your inventory was full, free a slot and talk to Ploh Trishbahk again to choose your necklace.
Reward: your chosen necklace and 500 EXP; The Light of Dawn Comes from the East begins (it needs a one Vana'diel day wait).

name: The Light of Dawn Comes from the East
steps: Finish The Lightsland first, then wait until the next Vana'diel day (about 1 hour real time).
Talk to Levil in Western Adoulin. If you only see a short scene, the wait is not over yet.
Watch the cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and Cries from the Deep begins.

name: Cries from the Deep
steps: Have the mission Cries from the Deep active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
In Eastern Adoulin, walk up to Ploh Trishbahk at the castle gate. A cutscene starts on its own once you are within a few steps of him.
After the scene you are moved back beside Ploh Trishbahk, and a second cutscene plays on its own as you arrive. If you miss it, it plays the next time you enter Eastern Adoulin.
Reward: the mission completes and Seeds of Doubt begins.

name: Seeds of Doubt
steps: Have mission Seeds of Doubt active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
Optional: talk to Ploh Trishbahk in Eastern Adoulin for a cutscene.
Travel to Rala Waterways and talk to Chalvava to watch the cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and The Tomatoes of Wrath begins.

name: The Tomatoes of Wrath
steps: Have mission The Tomatoes of Wrath active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
Optional: talk to Chalvava in Rala Waterways for a cutscene. You only get it once.
Go to Eastern Adoulin and talk to Ploh Trishbahk to watch the cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and A Grave Mistake begins.

name: A Grave Mistake
steps: Have mission A Grave Mistake active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
In Rala Waterways, talk to Sainene to watch a cutscene.
In Rala Waterways, examine the Stout Weir to watch a cutscene and get the key item Broken Fuse.
In Rala Waterways, examine the Waterways Overlook. You will see a short message.
Once all three are done in any order, return to Eastern Adoulin and talk to Ploh Trishbahk. The Broken Fuse is taken from you.
Reward: the mission completes and An Emergency Convocation begins. You must change zones before you can continue.

name: An Emergency Convocation
steps: Have mission An Emergency Convocation active. If you just finished A Grave Mistake, leave the area and come back first.
Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
In Eastern Adoulin, talk to Ploh Trishbahk to watch a cutscene. You are then moved and a second scene plays.
A third cutscene then plays automatically in Eastern Adoulin.
Reward: the mission completes and Balamor, The Deathborne Xol begins (it needs a one Vana'diel day wait).

name: Balamor, The Deathborne Xol
steps: Finish An Emergency Convocation first, then wait until the next Vana'diel day (about 1 hour real time).
Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
In Eastern Adoulin, talk to Ploh Trishbahk. If the scene is short, the wait is not over yet.
Watch the cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and Anagnorisis begins.

name: Anagnorisis
steps: Have the mission Anagnorisis active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
Check whether you own a necklace from The Lightsland (Adoulin's Refuge, Ygnas's Resolve, or Arciela's Grace) anywhere: inventory, Mog Safe, satchel, or wardrobe.
If you own one: move it into your main inventory and trade that 1 necklace to Ploh Trishbahk at the castle gate in Eastern Adoulin, then watch the cutscene. You give up the necklace.
Warning: while you own one of those necklaces, just talking to Ploh Trishbahk plays a scene that does NOT finish the mission. Only the trade finishes it.
If you own none of those necklaces: talk to Ploh Trishbahk in Eastern Adoulin and watch the cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and Just the Thing begins.

name: Just the Thing
steps: Have mission Just the Thing active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
Go to Celennia Memorial Library and talk to Andreine to watch the cutscene.
Reward: key item Suffering Saccariferous (spelled 'Suffering Saccharifeous' in game data). Sugarcoated Salvation begins.

name: Sugarcoated Salvation
steps: Have mission Sugarcoated Salvation active and the key item from Just the Thing. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin or Andreine in Celennia Memorial Library for hints.
Go to Eastern Adoulin and talk to Ploh Trishbahk to watch the cutscene. The key item from Just the Thing is taken from you.
Reward: key item Sepulcher Ensign. Arciela's Resolve begins.

name: Arciela's Resolve
steps: Have mission Arciela's Resolve active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin or Ploh Trishbahk in Eastern Adoulin for scenes.
Travel to Rala Waterways and examine the Royal Sepulcher to watch the cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and Balamor's Ruse begins.

name: Balamor's Ruse
steps: Have mission Balamor's Ruse active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
In Rala Waterways, defeat Duskbringer Bats, New Moon Bats, Skittering Spiders, Spoutdrenched Toads or Waterway Pugils. Each kill has about a 20% chance to give you key item Consummate Simulacrum.
Clear the battle in Rala Waterways (U). The script says this area is not fully done, so how to enter it is unclear.
After you win, you return to Rala Waterways and a cutscene plays on its own.
Reward: the mission completes and The Charlatan begins.

name: The Charlatan
steps: Have mission The Charlatan active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
In Eastern Adoulin, talk to Ploh Trishbahk to watch the cutscene. You get 500 EXP from this scene.
At the end, choose one necklace: Adoulin's Refuge +1, Ygnas's Resolve +1, or Arciela's Grace +1.
If your inventory was full, free a slot and talk to Ploh Trishbahk again to choose your necklace.
Reward: your chosen +1 necklace and 500 EXP; Royal Blessings begins.

name: Royal Blessings
steps: Have mission Royal Blessings active. You do not need to wait.
Go to Western Adoulin and talk to Levil to watch the cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and Arboreal Rumors begins.

name: Arboreal Rumors
steps: Have mission Arboreal Rumors active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
In Eastern Adoulin, talk to Ploh Trishbahk to watch the cutscene.
Reward: key item Hastily Scribbled Note. Arciela's Missive begins.

name: Arciela's Missive
steps: Have mission Arciela's Missive active and the key item Hastily Scribbled Note. Look at the note in your Key Items menu so it counts as seen.
Optional: talk to Ploh Trishbahk in Eastern Adoulin for a one-time scene.
In Western Adoulin, examine the Sunrise Beacon to watch the cutscene. The Hastily Scribbled Note is taken from you.
Reward: the mission completes and Heroes, Unite! begins.

name: Heroes, Unite!
steps: Have mission Heroes, Unite! active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
Travel to Kamihr Drifts and examine the Alpine Trail. Pick the option to go ahead (option 1).
You are taken to Mount Kamihr and a cutscene plays.
You are returned to Kamihr Drifts and the mission completes when you arrive.
Reward: the mission completes and A Portent Most Ominous begins.

name: A Portent Most Ominous
steps: Have mission A Portent Most Ominous active. Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
Travel to Leafallia and examine the Aged Stump to watch the cutscene.
Reward: key items Sky Blue Pome and Sun Yellow Pome. Yggdrasil Beckons begins.

name: Yggdrasil Beckons
steps: Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for the mission briefing.
Go to Leafallia and examine the Aged Stump to receive the key items Sky Blue Pome and Sun Yellow Pome.
In Yorcia Weald, examine the Wavering Flux and watch the cutscene; this leads to the Yorcia Weald U fight (comments point to Ashrakk).
Win the Yorcia Weald U fight. You are sent back to Yorcia Weald, and a cutscene gives you Ashrakk's Blood Sigil. Note: the instance itself is not implemented in this script (TODO).
In Cirdas Caverns, examine the Wavering Flux and watch the cutscene; this leads to the Cirdas Caverns U fight (comments point to Dhokmak).
Win the Cirdas Caverns U fight. You are sent back to Cirdas Caverns, and a cutscene gives you Dhokmak's Blood Sigil. This instance is also not implemented (TODO).
Once you have both Blood Sigils, the mission completes and the next one, Returning to the Trees, begins.

name: Returning to the Trees
steps: Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for directions.
Travel to Leafallia. A cutscene plays as you enter.
The cutscene completes the mission. Next mission: The Key to the Turris.

name: The Key to the Turris
steps: Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for directions.
Go to Ra'Kaznar Turris and examine the Ominous Postern. After its cutscene you are moved to Kamihr Drifts.
A cutscene plays on arrival in Kamihr Drifts and completes the mission. Next mission: Teodor's Summons.

name: Teodor's Summons
steps: Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for directions.
In Kamihr Drifts, examine the Alpine Trail (around x -13, z 489). In the cutscene, choose the option to go ahead.
You are moved to Mount Kamihr, where a cutscene plays. When the cutscene asks, choose the first option.
When it ends you return to Kamihr Drifts and the mission is complete.
Reward: key item Ash Runic Board. Next mission: The Seventh Guardian.

name: The Seventh Guardian
steps: Optional: talk to Levil in Western Adoulin for a hint.
Go to Rala Waterways and talk to Yeggha Dolashi (around x 260, z 60). Watch the cutscene.
The cutscene completes the mission. Next mission: Watery Grave.

name: Watery Grave
steps: Go to Rala Waterways. If you lost the Ash Runic Board, entering the zone gives it back (once the Vana'diel day has turned).
Win the Rala Waterways U battle. Note: this instance is not implemented in the script (TODO); it only handles the return after a win.
Back in Rala Waterways, a cutscene plays on zone-in. You lose the Blank Ash Runic Board.
Reward: key items Aged Undying Naakual Crest, Teodor's Blood Sigil and Crystallized Psyche. Next mission: Blood for Blood.

name: Blood for Blood
steps: Go to Ra'Kaznar Turris and examine the Ominous Postern (around x 118, z 20).
Watch the cutscene; it completes the mission. Next mission: Reckoning.

name: Reckoning
steps: If you lack the key item Crystallized Psyche, enter Ra'Kaznar Inner Court once; zoning in gives it to you.
In Ra'Kaznar Turris, go to the Ominous Postern (around x 118, z 20) and start the battle there.
Win the battle. Note: no battlefield script exists for this fight in this server, so the mission script only assumes a win (TODO).
After the win you are moved within Ra'Kaznar Turris; zone in again and a cutscene plays that completes the mission.
Reward: key item Awakened Crystallized Psyche. Next mission: Abomination.

name: Abomination
steps: Enter Ra'Kaznar Inner Court from Ra'Kaznar Turris. If you lack Awakened Crystallized Psyche, entering the zone gives it to you.
Win the battle in Ra'Kaznar Inner Court. Note: no battlefield script exists for it, so the script only assumes a win (TODO).
After the win you return to Ra'Kaznar Turris, where a cutscene plays. You are then moved to Ceizak Battlegrounds.
A final cutscene plays on arrival in Ceizak Battlegrounds and completes the mission. Next mission: Undying Light.

name: Undying Light
steps: From Ceizak Battlegrounds, walk through the gate into Western Adoulin. Do not warp: the cutscene only plays when you arrive on foot from Ceizak.
Watch the cutscene that plays on arrival.
Go to Eastern Adoulin and talk to Ploh Trishbahk (around x 100, z -64) for a cutscene.
A second cutscene follows and completes the mission. The Light Within then starts, but only after the next Vana'diel day begins.

name: The Light Within
steps: Wait until the Vana'diel day after you finished Undying Light.
Enter Ceizak Battlegrounds for a cutscene. You lose Pristine Hair Ribbon, receive Arciela's Skirt and are moved to Leafallia.
A cutscene plays in Leafallia, then you are sent back to Ceizak Battlegrounds.
Go to Eastern Adoulin and talk to Ploh Trishbahk (around x 100, z -64).
Pick one of the 12 rings offered. You can postpone the choice and talk to him again later.
Reward: your chosen ring (Adoulin, Woltaris, Weatherspoon, Janniston, Renaye, Gorney, Haverton, Karieyh, Vocane, Thurandaut, Shneddick or Orvail Ring), plus Councilor's Garb and Councilor's Cuffs.

name: A Moogle Kupo d'Etat
steps: Requires level 10, A Moogle Kupo d'Etat enabled on the server, and having already seen the Mog House introduction scene.
Enter your Mog House in your home nation and talk to the Moogle to see the cutscene; this completes the mission.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, Drenched! It Began with a Raindrop.

name: Drenched! It Began with a Raindrop
steps: Obtain 1 Orcish Plate Armor, 1 Quadav Backscale and 1 Yagudo Caulk (this mission's script does not say where).
Go to your Mog House in your home nation and trade exactly those three items to the Moogle.
Watch the cutscene; the items are taken and the mission completes.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, Hasten! In a Jam in Jeuno?

name: Hasten! In a Jam in Jeuno?
steps: Go to Upper Jeuno and examine the Inconspicuous Door.
Watch the cutscene; the mission completes.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, Welcome! To My Decrepit Domicile.

name: Welcome! To My Decrepit Domicile
steps: Use HELM (Mining, Logging, Harvesting) in outdoor or city areas of the original regions; each try has a 5% chance to give a mission key item.
Get the Sturdy Metal Strip (from Mining) and take it to the Inconspicuous Door in Upper Jeuno.
Get the Piece of Rugged Tree Bark (from Logging) and take it to the Inconspicuous Door.
Get the Savory Lamb Roast (from Harvesting) and take it to the Inconspicuous Door; this cutscene completes the mission.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, Curses! A Horrifically Harrowing Hex.

name: Curses! A Horrifically Harrowing Hex
steps: Go to Windurst Walls and talk to Shantotto.
Watch the cutscene; the mission completes.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, An Errand! The Professor's Price.

name: An Errand! The Professor's Price
steps: Talk to Shantotto in Windurst Walls to hear the errand.
In Outer Horutoto Ruins, defeat Cardian monsters (e.g. Six of Swords, Three of Cups, Ten of Batons, Five of Coins) for a chance at Orb of Swords/Cups/Batons/Coins; bigger parties raise the chance.
With at least one orb, examine the ??? (qm1) in Outer Horutoto Ruins and choose to fight. More orbs mean fewer Cardians (15, 10 with 3 orbs, 5 with 4).
Defeat all the Cardians without going more than 35 yalms from the ???; you get Ripe Starfruit and Peach Coral Key.
Bring 5,000 gil and talk to Shantotto; choose to pay. Declining means you must zone before asking again.
Talk to Shantotto again for the cutscene, then examine the Inconspicuous Door in Upper Jeuno; it tells you which zone to dig in for the next mission.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, Shock! Arrant Abuse of Authority.

name: Shock! Arrant Abuse of Authority
steps: Examine the Inconspicuous Door in Upper Jeuno for a reminder of your assigned digging zone (one of 13 zones such as La Theine Plateau or Valkurm Dunes).
Ride a chocobo to that zone and chocobo-dig; messages say which compass direction to go and how close you are.
Dig within about 5 yalms of the hidden spot to get the Moldy Worm-Eaten Chest. The spot moves each time you enter the zone.
Return to the Inconspicuous Door in Upper Jeuno with the chest for the cutscene; the mission completes.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, Lender Beware! Read the Fine Print.

name: Lender Beware! Read the Fine Print
steps: Go to Sea Serpent Grotto and examine the Shady Sconce (near !pos -179.6 24.1 274.1) to start the cutscene.
The cutscene must end with the choice the server reads as option value 1 to move on. If you finish with any other choice, nothing advances: examine the Shady Sconce again and choose differently.
Still in Sea Serpent Grotto, examine the Waterfall Basin (near !pos 104.9 0.5 -114.2) and watch the cutscene.
Travel to Upper Jeuno and examine the Inconspicuous Door (near !pos -15 1.3 68) to watch the final cutscene and finish the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Rescue! A Moogle's Labor of Love, opens.

name: Rescue! A Moogle's Labor of Love
steps: Go to Quicksand Caves and talk to the Goblin Geologist; he marks 9 spots (having the Map of the Quicksand Caves helps you see them).
Find and examine the ??? at each marked spot in Quicksand Caves to collect all nine stones (Stone of Surya through Stone of Ketu).
Talk to the Goblin Geologist again; he takes the stones and gives the Navaratna Talisman.
Go to the Chamber of Oracles and examine the Shimmering Circle; the cutscene completes the mission.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, Roar! A Cat Burglar Bares Her Fangs.

name: Roar! A Cat Burglar Bares Her Fangs
steps: Note: this script is a copy of the previous mission (same NPCs and cutscenes), so the real story steps are probably not implemented.
Go to Sea Serpent Grotto and examine the Shady Sconce; pick the second option (option 1).
In Sea Serpent Grotto, examine the Waterfall Basin.
Examine the Inconspicuous Door in Upper Jeuno; the cutscene completes the mission.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, Relief! A Triumphant Return.

name: Relief! A Triumphant Return
steps: Go to Upper Jeuno and examine the Inconspicuous Door.
Watch the cutscene; the mission completes.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, Joy! Summoned to a Fabulous Fete.

name: Joy! Summoned to a Fabulous Fete
steps: Travel to Castle Zvahl Baileys and enter the zone; a cutscene plays on arrival and completes the mission.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, A Challenge! You Could Be a Winner.

name: A Challenge! You Could Be a Winner
steps: In Castle Zvahl Baileys, examine the Shadowy Pillar to start the challenge.
In Beaucedine Glacier, examine the Lonely Evergreen and accept (option 1). Without zoning, get the Map of the Northlands Area, then ask the Goblin Grenadier for the number puzzle.
Examine the six Pips (NW, W, SW, NE, E, SE) to solve it, then answer the Grenadier (2 hints max; a wrong answer resets it). Pocket Mogbomb is the prize.
Bring the Pocket Mogbomb to the Lonely Evergreen for the Trivia Challenge Kupon.
In Xarcabard, examine Option One/Two/Three and answer the trivia about your character within 3 minutes for the Gauntlet Challenge Kupon.
At the Castle Zvahl Baileys Shadowy Pillar, start the run (you get Sneak, Invisible, Deodorize and a level restriction). Reach the Flame of Fate within 8 minutes for the Festival Souvenir Kupon.
In Castle Zvahl Keep, examine the Ominous Pillar to learn which moogle to find, then examine the matching Craggy Pillar to get the Mega Bonanza Kupon.
In the Throne Room, examine the door (_4l1); the cutscene completes the mission.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, Smash! A Malevolent Menace.

name: Smash! A Malevolent Menace
steps: Requires the mission Smash! A Malevolent Menace to be your current A Moogle Kupo d'Etat mission.
Go to Upper Jeuno and examine the Inconspicuous Door. Watch the cutscene to the end and the mission is complete.
Reward: this script lists no reward (no items, title or next mission).

name: A Shantotto Ascension
steps: Requires level 10 (and the server must have A Shantotto Ascension turned on).
Walk from Windurst Waters or Windurst Woods into Windurst Walls to start the cutscenes, and watch both.
Reward: the next mission, Burgeoning Dread, opens.

name: A Shantotto Ascension
steps: Leave Windurst on foot, not mounted. Go from Windurst Woods into East Sarutabaruta, or from Windurst Waters or Port Windurst into West Sarutabaruta.
Watch the cutscene. It names one Enfeeblement Kit (Poison, Blindness, Sleep or Silence), chosen at random. Note which one it is.
Reward: the next mission, That Which Curdles Blood, opens.

name: That Which Curdles Blood
steps: Note which Enfeeblement Kit you were assigned: a cutscene at the end of the last mission picks one at random (Poison, Blindness, Sleep or Silence). Only that kit is accepted.
Obtain your assigned Enfeeblement Kit (this mission's script does not say where).
Optional hints: Kuroido-Moido in Port Windurst, Faulpie in Southern San d'Oria and Abd-al-Raziq in Bastok Mines each describe materials for your kit.
Go to Qufim Island and trade 1 of your assigned Enfeeblement Kit to Trodden Snow (around !pos -20 -17 104).
BLOCKED: on this server the trade check is written wrong and errors out, so the cutscene never plays and the mission cannot be finished here.
Reward (if the trade worked): key items Domina's Scarlet, Cerulean, Emerald, Amber, Violet and Azure Seals; next mission Sugar-Coated Directive opens.

name: A Shantotto Ascension
steps: Visit at least 3 of the 6 Cloisters, each with its seal: Flames (Scarlet), Frost (Azure), Gales (Emerald), Storms (Violet), Tides (Cerulean), Tremors (Amber).
At each Cloister, click the Protocrystal entrance once. A message says a power blocks the seal.
Click the entrance again to enter the battle 'Sugar-Coated Directive' (up to 6 players, trusts allowed, level cap 99, 30 minutes). Your seal is kept.
Defeat all 3 Primes of that Cloister's avatar (e.g. 3 Ifrit Prime at Flames, 3 Shiva Prime at Frost).
After winning, click the entrance again to attach the seal. You receive that color's Counterseal.
With 3 or more Counterseals, go to Qufim Island and talk to Trodden Snow (around !pos -20 -17 104). All seals and counterseals are then removed.
Reward: gil based on counterseals (3 = 3,000, 4 = 10,000, 5 = 30,000, 6 = 50,000); next mission Enemy of the Empire I opens.

name: A Shantotto Ascension
steps: Go to Norg and talk to Andrause (around !pos 23 -5 19). He names 3 random monsters to photograph (such as Bigclaw, Sahagin types, Pugils, Crabs, Bats or Leeches).
Buy a Soultrapper and 12 Blank Soul Plates from Andrause for 800 gil (have more than 800). If you get no Blank Soul Plates on the first talk, talk to him again and buy from that menu.
Equip the Soultrapper and use it on each named monster to make a Soul Plate of it. You can buy plates again after JST midnight.
Trade the Soul Plates to Andrause one at a time (1 per trade). A wrong monster's plate is refused. Talk to him to hear which monsters are still needed.
After the 3rd correct plate, the mission completes.
Reward: key item Black Book; next mission Enemy of the Empire II opens.

name: Enemy Of The Empire II
steps: This server's script for this mission is empty (TODO: no zones or NPC interactions), so it cannot be completed here yet.

name: Sugar-Coated Subterfuge
steps: This server's script for this mission is empty (TODO: no zones or NPC interactions), so it cannot be completed here yet.

name: Shantotto In Chains
steps: This server's script for this mission is empty (TODO: no zones or NPC interactions), so it cannot be completed here yet.

name: Fountain Of Trouble
steps: This server's script for this mission is empty (TODO: no zones or NPC interactions), so it cannot be completed here yet.

name: Battaru Royale
steps: Not playable yet: this server's script for A Shantotto Ascension mission 10 has no NPCs, zones or events (marked TODO); it only unlocks Romancing The Clone when finished.

name: Romancing The Clone
steps: Not playable yet: this server's script for A Shantotto Ascension mission 11 has no NPCs, zones or events (marked TODO); it only unlocks Sisters In Arms when finished.

name: Sisters In Arms
steps: Not playable yet: this server's script for A Shantotto Ascension mission 12 has no NPCs, zones or events (marked TODO); it only unlocks Project Shantottofication when finished.

name: Project Shantottofication
steps: Not playable yet: this server's script for A Shantotto Ascension mission 13 has no NPCs, zones or events (marked TODO); it only unlocks An Uneasy Peace when finished.

name: An Uneasy Peace
steps: Not playable yet: this server's script for A Shantotto Ascension mission 14 has no NPCs, zones or events (marked TODO); it only unlocks A Shantotto Ascension Fin when finished.

name: A Shantotto Ascension Fin
steps: Not playable yet: this server's script for the final A Shantotto Ascension mission has no NPCs, zones, events or rewards (marked TODO).

name: The Zeruhn Report
steps: Talk to a Bastok gate guard (Argus in Port Bastok, Cleades in Bastok Markets, Malduc in the Metalworks or Rashid in Bastok Mines) and accept The Zeruhn Report.
Go to Zeruhn Mines and talk to Makarim (around !pos -58 8 -333) to get the Zeruhn Report key item.
Return to the Metalworks and talk to Naji to hand in the report.
Reward: none listed in the script; the mission is completed.

name: A Geological Survey
steps: Talk to a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Malduc or Rashid) and pick A Geological Survey from the mission list.
Talk to Cid in the Metalworks to get the Blue Acidity Tester key item.
Go to Dangruf Wadi and walk into one of the geysers at (I-8), (H-8) or (J-3). The tester turns into the Red Acidity Tester key item.
Return to Cid in the Metalworks to finish.
Reward: none listed in the script; the mission is completed.

name: Fetichism
steps: Talk to a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Malduc or Rashid) and pick Fetichism from the mission list.
Obtain 1 each of Quadav Fetich Head, Quadav Fetich Torso, Quadav Fetich Arms and Quadav Fetich Legs (this mission's script does not say where).
Trade all four pieces together to any Bastok gate guard to finish. The mission can be repeated.
Reward: 1,000 gil, Rank 2 and 200 rank points.

name: The Crystal Line
steps: Talk to a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Malduc or Rashid) and pick The Crystal Line from the mission list.
Talk to Cid in the Metalworks and accept (first option); he gives you a random elemental crystal.
Obtain 1 Faded Crystal (this mission's script does not say where).
Trade the Faded Crystal to Cid and accept (first option) to get the C. L. Report key item.
Talk to Ayame in the Metalworks to hand in the report and finish. Talking to Naji first gives an extra cutscene.
Reward: 200 rank points.

name: Wading Beasts
steps: Talk to a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Malduc or Rashid) and pick Wading Beasts from the mission list.
Obtain 1 Lizard Egg (this mission's script does not say where).
Trade the Lizard Egg to Alois in the Metalworks to finish. The mission can be repeated.
Reward: 250 rank points.

name: The Emissary
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'The Emissary' from a Bastok gate guard: Argus (Port Bastok), Cleades (Bastok Markets), Rashid (Bastok Mines) or Malduc (Metalworks).
Talk to Naji in Metalworks; after the cutscene you receive the key item Letter to the Consuls (Bastok).
Pick your first embassy: talk to Baraka in Northern San d'Oria to start the San d'Oria leg, OR talk to Melek in Port Windurst to start the Windurst leg.
Finish that leg (see 'The Emissary San d'Oria' or 'The Emissary Windurst'); it hands you back to this mission.
Start the other leg: if you did San d'Oria first, talk to Melek in Port Windurst; if you did Windurst first, talk to Helaku in Northern San d'Oria and accept (first option). The letter is taken.
Finish the second leg (part 2) to receive the key item Kindred Report.
Return to Naji in Metalworks and watch the cutscene to complete the mission (Kindred Report is taken).
Reward: 3,000 gil, key item Adventurer's Certificate, Rank 3, title Certified Adventurer.

name: The Emissary San d'Oria
steps: Requires 'The Emissary' started with Naji's letter; this leg begins when you talk to Baraka in Northern San d'Oria.
Talk to Helaku in Northern San d'Oria and watch the cutscene.
Go to Chateau d'Oraguille (San d'Oria) and talk to Halver for a cutscene (may also receive Cipher of Halver's Alter Ego if trust quests are on).
Travel to Ghelsba Outpost and defeat Warchief Vatgit.
Return to Helaku in Northern San d'Oria and watch the cutscene; this leg is done and you are back on 'The Emissary'.
Next: go to Port Windurst and talk to Melek to begin the Windurst part 2 leg.
Reward: none for this leg itself (the reward comes when 'The Emissary' is completed).

name: The Emissary Windurst
steps: Requires 'The Emissary' started with Naji's letter; this leg begins when you talk to Melek in Port Windurst.
Enter Heavens Tower (Windurst Walls) to trigger a cutscene.
Talk to Kupipi in Heavens Tower; you receive the key item Sword Offering (and possibly Cipher of Semih's Alter Ego if trust quests are on).
Talk to Gold Skull in Port Windurst; he swaps your sword, giving you the key item Dull Sword.
Travel to Giddeus and talk to Uu Zhoumo (near position -179, 16, 155); he rejects the sword and asks for an Aspir Knife.
Obtain 1 Aspir Knife (this mission's script does not say where) and trade it to Uu Zhoumo in Giddeus.
Return to Melek in Port Windurst and watch the cutscene; this leg is done and you are back on 'The Emissary'.
Next: go to Northern San d'Oria and talk to Helaku to begin the San d'Oria part 2 leg.
Reward: none for this leg itself (the reward comes when 'The Emissary' is completed).

name: The Emissary San d'Oria
steps: Requires the Windurst leg already done; talk to Helaku in Northern San d'Oria and accept (first option) to start this leg.
Go to Chateau d'Oraguille and talk to Halver for a cutscene.
Travel to Horlais Peak and enter the battlefield at the Burning Circle: level cap 25, up to 6 players, 15 minutes. Defeat Dread Dragon and Spotter.
After winning you receive the key item Kindred Crest.
Return to Helaku in Northern San d'Oria; he takes the crest and gives you the key item Kindred Report.
Go back to Naji in Metalworks (Bastok) to finish 'The Emissary'.
Reward: key item Kindred Report (mission rewards come on completing 'The Emissary').

name: The Emissary Windurst
steps: Requires the San d'Oria leg already done; talk to Melek in Port Windurst to start this leg (Letter to the Consuls is taken).
Talk to Kupipi in Heavens Tower (Windurst Walls); you receive the key item Dark Key.
Travel to Balga's Dais and enter the battlefield at the Burning Circle: level cap 25, up to 6 players, 15 minutes. Defeat Black Dragon and Searcher.
After winning you receive the key item Kindred Crest (the Dark Key is used up).
Optionally report to Kupipi in Heavens Tower, then return to Melek in Port Windurst; he gives you the key item Kindred Report.
Go back to Naji in Metalworks (Bastok) to finish 'The Emissary'.
Reward: key item Kindred Report (mission rewards come on completing 'The Emissary').

name: The Four Musketeers
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'The Four Musketeers' from a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc).
Talk to Iron Eater in Metalworks and agree (first option) in the cutscene.
Travel through Pashhow Marshlands and enter Beadeaux; a cutscene plays on entry.
Inside Beadeaux, defeat 20 Copper Quadav.
Leave Beadeaux into Pashhow Marshlands; the cutscene on zoning completes the mission.
Reward: 350 rank points.

name: To the Forsaken Mines
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'To the Forsaken Mines' from a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc).
Optional: talk to Davyad in Bastok Mines for hints.
Obtain 1 Slice of Hare Meat (this mission's script does not say where).
Go to Gusgen Mines, find the ??? with fresh monster tracks (near position 206, -60, -101) and trade it the Slice of Hare Meat.
Defeat Blind Moby, which appears; obtain 1 Glocolite (the script does not say how; presumably from this fight).
Trade the Glocolite to any Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc) to complete the mission.
Reward: 400 rank points.

name: Jeuno
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'Jeuno' from a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc).
Talk to Lucius in Metalworks; you receive the key item Letter to the Ambassador.
Travel to Ru'Lude Gardens (Jeuno) and talk to Goggehn at the Bastok embassy; he takes the letter.
Obtain a Delkfutt Key (this mission's script does not say where).
Go to Lower Delkfutt's Tower and trade the Delkfutt Key to (or click, if you already hold it as a key item) the door near position 596, 16, -19; watch the cutscene.
Return to Ru'Lude Gardens and click the Bastok embassy door to finish the mission.
Reward: 5,000 gil and Rank 4.

name: Magicite
steps: Requires Bastok Rank 4, enough rank points and no active mission. Click the Bastok embassy door in Ru'Lude Gardens to start; you get the key item Archducal Audience Permit.
Click the Audience Chamber door in Ru'Lude Gardens; after the cutscene you get the key item Letter to Aldo.
Talk to Aldo in Lower Jeuno (Tenshodo); he takes the letter and gives you the key item Silver Bell.
For the Altar Room route: talk to Paya-Sabya in Upper Jeuno, then Muckvix in Lower Jeuno to get the key item Yagudo Torch.
Touch the Magicite in Altar Room, Monastic Cavern and Qulun Dome to get the 3 key items Orastone, Optistone and Aurastone (this script does not cover how to get inside).
Return to the Audience Chamber door in Ru'Lude Gardens with all 3 Magicite; you get the key item Airship Pass (or 20,000 gil if you already own one) and title Have Wings, Will Fly.
Talk to Goggehn at the Bastok embassy in Ru'Lude Gardens to complete the mission.
Reward: Rank 5, 10,000 gil and key item Message to Jeuno (Bastok).

name: Darkness Rising
steps: Requires Bastok Rank 5 and no active mission. Talk to Naji in Metalworks and accept (first option); you get the key item New Fei'Yin Seal. (If you declined, accept later at a gate guard and talk to Naji again.)
Travel to Fei'Yin; a cutscene plays when you enter.
Make your way to Qu'Bia Arena and enter the battlefield: level cap 50, up to 6 players, 30 minutes.
Defeat Archlich Taber'quoan; you win as soon as he dies. His sorcerer allies fight with him (and more warriors may join), but you do not have to kill them.
After winning you receive the key item Burnt Seal (New Fei'Yin Seal is used up).
Return to Naji in Metalworks and watch the cutscene to complete the mission.
Reward: 600 rank points; title Archmage Assassin from the battlefield.

name: Xarcabard, Land of Truths
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'Xarcabard, Land of Truths' from a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc).
Talk to Karst in Metalworks for a cutscene.
Travel through Xarcabard and Castle Zvahl to the Throne Room; click the door there for a cutscene.
Enter the battlefield in the Throne Room: level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30 minutes. Defeat the Shadow Lord (he has two phases).
After the fight you receive the key item Shadow Fragment and are moved to Castle Zvahl Baileys.
Return to Metalworks and click the door to the President's office next to Karst to complete the mission.
Reward: 20,000 gil and Rank 6; title Shadow Banisher from the battlefield; the Zilart mission 'The New Frontier' opens.

name: Return of the Talekeeper
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'Return of the Talekeeper' from a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc).
Talk to Medicine Eagle in Bastok Mines.
Go to Zeruhn Mines and talk to Drake Fang.
Travel to Western Altepa Desert and click the ??? near position -325, 0, -111; Eastern Sphinx and Western Sphinx appear.
Defeat both Eastern Sphinx and Western Sphinx, then click the ??? again to receive the key item Altepa Moonpebble.
Return to Bastok Mines and talk to Tall Mountain to complete the mission.
Reward: 650 rank points.

name: The Pirate's Cove
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'The Pirate's Cove' from a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc).
Talk to Naji in Metalworks.
Travel to Norg and talk to Gilgamesh.
Obtain 1 Chunk of Adaman Ore (this mission's script does not say where).
Go to Ifrit's Cauldron and trade the Adaman Ore to the ??? near position 171, 0, -25. Two monsters appear: Salamander and Magma, which attacks you.
Defeat Magma; it always drops the Frag Rock you need. Salamander appears too, but it does not drop the rock.
Trade the 1 Frag Rock to Gilgamesh in Norg.
Return to Naji in Metalworks to complete the mission.
Reward: 40,000 gil and Rank 7.

name: The Final Image
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'The Final Image' from a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc).
Talk to Cid in Metalworks.
Travel to Ro'Maeve and click the ??? (its position varies; one spot is near 102, -4, -114); Mokkurkalfi appear.
Defeat Mokkurkalfi, then click the ??? again to receive the key item Reinforced Cermet.
Return to Cid in Metalworks to complete the mission.
Reward: 700 rank points.

name: On My Way
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'On My Way' from a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc).
Talk to Karst in Metalworks.
Talk to Hilda in Port Bastok.
Go to Waughroon Shrine and enter the battlefield: level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30 minutes. Defeat all four Quadav led by Kujhu Graniteskin.
After winning you receive the key item Letter from Werei.
Return to Karst in Metalworks to complete the mission.
Afterward, talk to Gumbah in Bastok Mines (twice) to deliver the letter; optionally click the door near Karst in Metalworks for a Cornelia cutscene.
Reward: 60,000 gil and Rank 8.

name: The Chains That Bind Us
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'The Chains That Bind Us' from a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc).
Talk to Iron Eater in Metalworks and agree (first option).
Go to Quicksand Caves and click the ??? near position -469, 0, 620; Centurio IV-VII, Triarius IV-XIV and Princeps IV-XLV appear.
Defeat all three, then click the same ??? again for a cutscene.
Click the other ??? in Quicksand Caves near position -533, -1, -415 for another cutscene.
Return to Iron Eater in Metalworks to complete the mission.
Reward: 1,133 rank points.

name: Enter the Talekeeper
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'Enter the Talekeeper' from a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc).
Go to Zeruhn Mines and talk to Drake Fang.
Travel to Kuftal Tunnel and click the ??? near position -29, -22, -184; choose the first option.
Click the ??? near position -28, -10, -186; Dervo's Ghost, Gizerl's Ghost and Gordov's Ghost appear. Defeat all three.
Click that ??? again to receive the key item Old Piece of Wood.
Return to Drake Fang in Zeruhn Mines; you are moved to Bastok Mines and a final cutscene completes the mission.
Reward: 80,000 gil and Rank 9.

name: The Salt of the Earth
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'The Salt of the Earth' from a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc).
Talk to Alois in Metalworks.
Travel to Rabao and talk to Dancing Wolf.
Go to Gustav Tunnel and click the ??? near position -130, 1, 253; Gigaplasm appears. Defeat it and all the Nanoplasms it becomes.
Click the ??? again to receive the key item Miraclesalt.
Return to Dancing Wolf in Rabao and watch the cutscene.
Return to Alois in Metalworks to complete the mission; optionally talk to Franziska in Metalworks afterward for extra cutscenes.
Reward: 1,500 rank points.

name: Where Two Paths Converge
steps: Requires Bastok citizenship and no active mission. Accept 'Where Two Paths Converge' from a Bastok gate guard (Argus, Cleades, Rashid or Malduc).
Talk to Iron Eater in Metalworks.
Travel to the Throne Room (Castle Zvahl) and enter the battlefield: level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30 minutes. Defeat Zeid (two phases; Volker joins to help).
Return to Iron Eater in Metalworks to complete the mission. If your inventory was full, talk to him again later for the flag.
Reward: Rank 10, 100,000 gil, title Hero Among Heroes, and a Bastokan Flag.

name: The Rites of Life
steps: Requires Chains of Promathia to be enabled on the server (ENABLE_COP = 1).
Travel to Qufim Island and enter Lower Delkfutt's Tower from it. A cutscene plays as you zone in.
In that cutscene, pick the option that continues the story. If you decline, talk to Tales' Beginning inside the tower to see it again.
Watch the chain of cutscenes that follows. The mission then starts.
Go to Upper Jeuno. Another cutscene plays as you enter.
In Upper Jeuno, talk to Monberaux inside the Infirmary (G-10) and watch the cutscenes that follow.
Reward: Key item Mysterious Amulet. Next mission: Below the Arks.

name: Below the Arks
steps: Go to Ru'Lude Gardens and talk to Pherimociel for a cutscene.
Go to a Shattered Telepoint in Konschtat Highlands, La Theine Plateau or Tahrongi Canyon and examine it. Accept to go into the Hall of Transference.
In the Hall of Transference, examine a Large Apparatus. It sends you into Promyvion-Holla, Promyvion-Dem or Promyvion-Mea, depending on which one you use.
Make your way through that Promyvion to its Spire (Spire of Holla, Dem or Mea).
Enter the battlefield Ancient Flames Beckon: level cap 30, up to 6 players, 30 minutes, trusts allowed.
Win the fight. Holla: defeat the 3 Wreakers. Dem: defeat the Progenerators. Mea: defeat the 3 Delvers.
After the win cutscene you get that crag's key item (Light of Holla, Dem or Mea) and are teleported out.
Reward: Next mission: The Mothercrystals.

name: The Mothercrystals
steps: Requires finishing Below the Arks, which gives you one Light key item (Holla, Dem or Mea).
Go back to a Shattered Telepoint (Konschtat Highlands, La Theine Plateau or Tahrongi Canyon) for one of the two crags you have not done yet. Examine it to be sent to that Promyvion.
Make your way to that Promyvion's Spire and win Ancient Flames Beckon (level cap 30, up to 6 players, 30 minutes) to get its Light key item.
For the last crag, use its Shattered Telepoint to enter the Hall of Transference. A cutscene plays and sends you into that Promyvion.
Reach its Spire and win Ancient Flames Beckon again. Holla: defeat the Wreakers. Dem: the Progenerators. Mea: the Delvers.
Once you hold all three Lights, you are teleported to Lufaise Meadows.
Reward: Title Ancient Flame Follower. Next mission: An Invitation West.

name: An Invitation West
steps: Finishing The Mothercrystals teleports you to Lufaise Meadows. Arriving there plays a cutscene in which your Mysterious Amulet is stolen.
Travel from Lufaise Meadows into Tavnazian Safehold. A cutscene plays as you enter.
Reward: Title Dead Body. Next mission: The Lost City.

name: The Lost City
steps: In Tavnazian Safehold, talk to Despachiaire for a cutscene.
In Tavnazian Safehold, examine the Sewer Entrance and watch the cutscene.
Reward: Next mission: Distant Beliefs.

name: Distant Beliefs
steps: Enter Phomiuna Aqueducts and defeat the monster named Minotaur. The script's header comment gives its spot as around x60, z304.
Climb the Wooden Ladder on the west side of the aqueducts (around x-159, z60, upper level) for a cutscene.
Examine the Ornate Gate (around x-99, z60, lower level) for another cutscene.
Return to Tavnazian Safehold and talk to Justinius for the final cutscene.
Reward: Next mission: An Eternal Melody.

name: An Eternal Melody
steps: In Tavnazian Safehold, examine the Walnut Door (around x111, z41) for a cutscene. You get back the key item Mysterious Amulet.
Go to Misareaux Coast and examine the Dilapidated Gate (around x260, z-440) for a cutscene.
Return to Tavnazian Safehold. A cutscene plays when you walk into a certain spot; the script does not say where that spot is.
Reward: Next mission: Ancient Vows.

name: Ancient Vows
steps: In Misareaux Coast, examine the other Dilapidated Gate (around x-260, z280) for a cutscene.
Enter Riverne - Site #A01. A cutscene plays as you zone in.
Travel through Riverne - Site #A01 to Monarch Linn. Do not go in through Riverne-Site B01, or you cannot enter the fight.
Enter the Ancient Vows battlefield in Monarch Linn: level cap 40, up to 6 players, 30 minutes, trusts allowed.
Defeat all the Mammet-19 Epsilon. After the win cutscene you are sent to South Gustaberg.
Reward: Title Tavnazian Traveler (from the battlefield). Next mission: The Call of the Wyrmking.

name: The Call of the Wyrmking
steps: Finish the previous Promathia mission, Ancient Vows, first. This mission then becomes your current one.
Enter South Gustaberg. A cutscene plays automatically the first time you zone in while on this mission.
Go to Port Bastok and walk into the small area at about x-104, z-10 (anywhere from x-112 to -96 and z-17 to -3). The cutscene plays when you step inside. It is not at the Home Point.
Go to the Metalworks and talk to Cid (about x-12, z1) for a cutscene. This completes the mission.
Reward: Next mission: A Vessel Without a Captain.

name: A Vessel Without a Captain
steps: Requires Promathia mission 3-1 to be complete (this mission is next in the chain).
Optional: talk to Cid in Metalworks for a reminder cutscene.
Go to Lower Jeuno and examine the door to Neptune's Spire to watch a cutscene.
Optional: talk to Harnek in Lower Jeuno for extra dialogue.
Go to Ru'Lude Gardens and walk near Home Point 1 to trigger the closing cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and The Road Forks begins.

name: The Road Forks
steps: This mission has two paths (San d'Oria and Windurst); you must finish both, in any order.
San d'Oria path: zone into Northern San d'Oria for a cutscene, talk to Arnau, then talk to Chasalvige.
In Carpenters Landing talk to Guilloud; he spawns Overgrown Ivy. Defeat it, then talk to Guilloud again for a cutscene.
Go to Southern San d'Oria and talk to Hinaree to finish the San d'Oria path.

Windurst path: zone into Windurst Waters for a cutscene, talk to Ohbiru-Dohbiru, then Yoran-Oran in Windurst Walls, then Kyume-Romeh and Honoi-Gomoi in Windurst Waters (key item Cracked Mimeo Mirror).
Talk to Yoran-Oran in Windurst Walls again. Then in Attohwa Chasm stand right on the Loose Sand and click it to spawn Lioumere; defeat it.
Click the Loose Sand again to get the Mimeo Jewel. Within 30 minutes and without leaving the zone, examine the Cradle of Rebirth to receive three Mimeo Feathers.
Return to Yoran-Oran (Windurst Walls), then talk to Yujuju in Port Windurst, Tosuka-Porika in Windurst Waters, and Yoran-Oran once more to finish the Windurst path.
With both paths done, talk to Cid in Metalworks.
Reward: the mission completes and Tending Aged Wounds begins.

name: Tending Aged Wounds
steps: Optional: talk to Cid in Metalworks for a reminder cutscene.
Zone into Lower Jeuno to watch a cutscene.
Examine the door to Neptune's Spire in Lower Jeuno for the closing cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and Darkness Named begins.

name: Darkness Named
steps: Talk to Monberaux in Upper Jeuno; he borrows your Mysterious Amulet key item. (Aldo, Harnek and Sattal-Mansal in Lower Jeuno have optional dialogue.)
Talk to Ghebi Damomohe in Lower Jeuno for a cutscene.
Trade Ghebi Damomohe 1 Carmine Chip, 1 Cyan Chip, or 1 Gray Chip (this script does not say where to get them) to receive the Pso'Xja Pass key item and 500 gil.
Travel to The Shrouded Maw and zone in to watch a cutscene.
Enter the Memento Circle battlefield 'Darkness Named' (level cap 40, up to 6 players, 30 minutes) and defeat Diabolos.
Return to Monberaux in Upper Jeuno for the closing cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and Sheltering Doubt begins.

name: Sheltering Doubt
steps: Zone into Tavnazian Safehold to watch a cutscene.
Talk to Despachiaire in Tavnazian Safehold.
Optional: talk to Justinius in Tavnazian Safehold for more dialogue.
Go to Misareaux Coast and examine the Dilapidated Gate (south-east part of the zone) for the closing cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and The Savage begins.

name: The Savage
steps: In Misareaux Coast, examine the Dilapidated Gate (around !pos -259 -30 276). In the cutscene, choose to go on and you are moved to Riverne - Site B01.
From Riverne - Site B01, travel on into Monarch Linn. You must arrive from the Site B01 side; entry is refused if you came in from Riverne - Site A01.
In Monarch Linn, examine the Spatial Displacement and enter the battlefield 'The Savage' (level cap 50, up to 6 players, trusts allowed, 30 minutes).
Defeat Ouryu to win the battlefield (win grants 1500 XP and the title Mist Melter).
Return to Tavnazian Safehold and talk to Justinius (around !pos 76 -34 68) for the closing cutscene.
Reward: title Nag'molada's Underling; the next mission, The Secrets of Worship, begins.

name: The Secrets of Worship
steps: In Tavnazian Safehold examine the Walnut Door for a cutscene. (Justinius and Parelbriaux have optional dialogue.)
Go to Misareaux Coast, examine the Iron Gate and choose to proceed; you are moved into the Sacrarium.
