In Sacrarium examine the Wooden Gate from its east side for a cutscene.
Search the ??? drawers in Sacrarium (the spot moves); the right one spawns Old Professor Mariselle. Defeat her.
Click the same ??? again to receive the Reliquiarium Key key item.
Examine the Wooden Gate from its east side again for the closing cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and Slanderous Utterings begins.

name: Slanderous Utterings
steps: Walk through Tavnazian Safehold until a cutscene plays (the script does not give the exact spot). Despachiaire has optional dialogue.
Travel to Sealions Den and examine the Iron Gate for the closing cutscene.
Reward: title The Lost One; The Enduring Tumult of War begins.

name: The Enduring Tumult of War
steps: Optional: for extra dialogue, talk to Despachiaire (Tavnazian Safehold), Chasalvige (Northern San d'Oria) and Anoki (Port San d'Oria, talk twice).
Zone into Port Bastok to watch a cutscene.
Go to Metalworks and talk to Cid (around !pos -12 -12 1) for a cutscene.
Go to Beaucedine Glacier and enter Pso'Xja through the Iron Grate at !pos -340 -93 156.7. Zoning in this way plays a cutscene.
In Pso'Xja, examine the nearer Stone Door (around !pos -330 -2 318). A trap spawns the monster Nunyunuwi. Defeat it.
Examine that Stone Door again to pass through (you can skip the cutscene).
Examine the next Stone Door further on (around !pos -380 46 330) and choose to go on. You are moved into Promyvion - Vahzl.
On arrival in Promyvion - Vahzl, watch the cutscene. You receive the key items Mysterious Amulet (drained) and Light of Vahzl.
Reward: the mission completes and the next mission, Desires of Emptiness, begins.

name: Desires of Emptiness
steps: Enter Promyvion-Vahzl through the Stone Door in Pso'Xja (it lets you choose which floor to go to).
Touch the memory flux on floor 1 to spawn Propagator; defeat it, then touch the flux again for a cutscene.
Do the same at the floor 2 flux (Solicitor) and the floor 3 flux (Ponderer).
After all three cutscenes, enter the Spire of Vahzl to watch a cutscene.
Enter the battlefield 'Desires of Emptiness' in Spire of Vahzl (level cap 50, up to 6 players, 30 minutes) and win; you are moved to Beaucedine Glacier.
Watch the cutscene in Beaucedine Glacier. Leigon-Moigon, Potete and Torino-Samarino there have optional dialogue.
Talk to Cid in Metalworks for the closing cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and Three Paths begins.

name: Three Paths
steps: Finish three paths in any order; Cid in Metalworks reports which are done and completes each one.
Louverance: talk to Despachiaire (Tavnazian Safehold), Perih Vashai (Windurst Woods), Warmachine (Bibiki Bay), Yoran-Oran (Windurst Walls), then zone into Oldton Movalpolos for a cutscene.
Win 'A Century of Hardship' at Mine Shaft 2716 (level cap 60, 30 min), talk to Cid, then Tarnotik (Oldton Movalpolos); trade 1 Gold Key (not said where) to the Mine Shaft 2716 door; talk to Cid.
Tenzen: click the ??? in La Theine Plateau, examine a gate in Pso'Xja, then talk to Monberaux in Upper Jeuno (key item Envelope from Monberaux).
Talk to Pherimociel in Ru'Lude Gardens, then click the ??? in Batallia Downs twice to get the Delkfutt Recognition Device.
In Lower Delkfutts Tower click the door (_545) to spawn Disaster Idol; defeat it and click again. Enter Pso'Xja by the Beaucedine Glacier grate (H-10), examine the gate there, and talk to Cid.
Ulmia: talk to Hinaree (Southern San d'Oria), zone into Port San d'Oria, then talk to Chasalvige (Northern San d'Oria), Kerutoto (Windurst Waters) and Yoran-Oran (Windurst Walls).
Win 'Head Wind' at Boneyard Gully (level cap 50, 30 min), then 'Flames for the Dead' at Bearclaw Pinnacle (defeat Snoll Tzar; 30 min), then talk to Cid.
Each path gives a title: Companion of Louverance, Tenzen's Ally, Ulmia's Soulmate.
Reward: title Treader of an Icy Past; For Whom the Verse is Sung begins.

name: For Whom the Verse is Sung
steps: Talk to Pherimociel in Ru'Lude Gardens.
Go to Upper Jeuno and examine the Marble Bridge for a cutscene.
Zone back into Ru'Lude Gardens for the closing cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and A Place to Return begins.

name: A Place to Return
steps: Walk into Ru'Lude Gardens until a cutscene plays.
Go to Misareaux Coast and examine the Dilapidated Gate (south-east part of the zone); this spawns Warder Aglaia, Warder Euphrosyne and Warder Thalia.
Defeat all three Warders.
Examine the Dilapidated Gate again for the closing cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and More Questions than Answers begins.

name: More Questions than Answers
steps: Talk to Pherimociel in Ru'Lude Gardens.
Examine the door marked _6r9 in Ru'Lude Gardens for a cutscene (the script does not name the door).
Travel to Selbina and talk to Mathilde for the closing cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and One to be Feared begins.

name: One to be Feared
steps: Talk to Cid in Metalworks.
Travel to Sealions Den and zone in to watch a cutscene.
Examine the Iron Gate in Sealions Den for a cutscene. (Sueleen has optional dialogue.)
Enter the battlefield 'One to be Feared' through the Iron Gate (level cap 75, up to 6 players, 45 minutes) and defeat the Mammets, then Omega and Ultima.
After winning you are returned to Sealions Den for a cutscene, then moved to Lufaise Meadows.
Reward: the mission completes and Chains and Bonds begins.

name: Chains and Bonds
steps: Zone into Lufaise Meadows to watch a cutscene and receive a Ducal Guard's Ring. If your inventory is full, free a slot and click the ??? in Lufaise Meadows to collect it.
Zone into Tavnazian Safehold to watch a cutscene.
In Tavnazian Safehold examine the Walnut Door for a cutscene.
In Tavnazian Safehold examine the Sewer Entrance for a cutscene.
Zone into Sealions Den for a cutscene. Once all three of these cutscenes are seen, the mission is done.
Reward: the mission completes and Flames in the Darkness begins.

name: Flames in the Darkness
steps: In Misareaux Coast examine the Dilapidated Gate (north-west part of the zone) for a cutscene.
Go to Sealions Den and talk to Sueleen.
Walk into Ru'Lude Gardens until a cutscene plays.
Go to Upper Jeuno and examine the Marble Bridge for the closing cutscene.
Reward: title Eshantarl's Comrade-in-Arms; Fire in the Eyes of Men begins.

name: Fire in the Eyes of Men
steps: Go to Mine Shaft 2716 and examine the Shaft Entrance (around !pos -54 -122 -580) for a cutscene.
Go to Metalworks and talk to Cid (around !pos -12 -12 1) for a cutscene.
Wait until the next Vana'diel day (game day) begins.
Talk to Cid again for the closing cutscene.
Reward: title Prishe's Buddy; the next mission, Calm Before the Storm, begins.

name: Calm Before the Storm
steps: Do these three fights in any order.
Bibiki Bay: click the ??? to spawn Dalham; defeat it, then click the ??? again for a cutscene.
Carpenters Landing: click the ??? to spawn Cryptonberry Executor; defeat it and its three Cryptonberry Assassins, then click the ??? again for a cutscene.
Misareaux Coast: examine the gate (_0p4) to spawn Boggelmann; defeat it, then examine again for a cutscene and the Vessel of Light key item.
Talk to Cid in Metalworks to receive the Letters from Ulmia and Prishe key item.
Go to Sealions Den and talk to Sueleen for the closing cutscene.
Reward: the mission completes and The Warrior's Path begins.

name: The Warrior's Path
steps: In Sealions Den examine the Iron Gate for a cutscene.
Enter the battlefield 'The Warrior's Path' through the Iron Gate (level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30 minutes) and defeat Tenzen and his allies.
After winning you return to Sealions Den for a cutscene, then you are moved to Al'Taieu.
Watch the cutscene in Al'Taieu: the Mysterious Amulet shatters, and the Light of your race's Promyvion is taken; you receive the Light of Al'Taieu.
Reward: title Seeker of the Light; Garden of Antiquity begins.

name: Garden of Antiquity
steps: In Al'Taieu, examine the object _0x0 (script position about x 0, y -10, z -464) and watch the cutscene. This starts the mission.
Go to the Rubious Crystal _0x1 (about x 0, z -737) and examine it. Three Ruaern appear. Defeat all three, then examine the crystal again for a cutscene.
Do not zone or log out between killing the three Ruaern and re-examining the crystal. Kill progress is only stored temporarily, so leaving makes you fight them again.
Repeat the same thing at the Rubious Crystal _0x2 (about x -684, z -222): examine it, defeat the three Ruaern, then examine it again before you leave the zone.
Repeat at the Rubious Crystal _0x3 (about x 684, z -222). After the third crystal you get the final crystal cutscene.
Go back to _0x0 in Al'Taieu and examine it for a cutscene. If you accept the offer at the end, you are moved into the Grand Palace of Hu'Xzoi.

Make sure you have a free inventory slot first. Then, in the Grand Palace of Hu'Xzoi, examine _iya (about x -20, y 0, z -283) to receive a Tavnazian Ring. If the ring could not be given, make room and examine _iya again.
Still in the Grand Palace of Hu'Xzoi, examine _iyb (the script gives no position) and watch the cutscene. The mission is now complete.
Reward: Tavnazian Ring (from _iya). The next mission, A Fate Decided, opens.

name: A Fate Decided
steps: Start this mission after finishing Garden of Antiquity. Go to the Grand Palace of Hu'Xzoi (the gate _iya near the entrance no longer responds).
Go to the object _iyq in the far northeast part of the Grand Palace of Hu'Xzoi and examine it. The monster Ixghrah appears and attacks you.
Defeat Ixghrah (bring a party).
Examine _iyq again to watch the cutscene and complete the mission.
Reward: the next mission, When Angels Fall.

name: When Angels Fall
steps: Start this mission after finishing A Fate Decided. Enter The Garden of Ru'Hmet to watch a cutscene and receive the key item Mysterious Amulet.
In The Garden of Ru'Hmet, examine any Ebon Panel to watch a cutscene.

Go to the Ebon Panel for your race (Hume: _iz2 in the north; Elvaan: east; Tarutaru: south-west; Mithra: west; Galka: south-east). Stand right next to it, examine it and accept to get your race's Light key item and a title.
Go to the door _0z0 in the north of The Garden of Ru'Hmet and examine it to watch a cutscene.
Examine _0z0 again to enter the battle When Angels Fall (level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30 minutes). Defeat all four Ix'zdei inside.
After winning, examine _0zt in the same area to watch a cutscene.
Zone into Al'Taieu to watch the final cutscene; you return the Mysterious Amulet to Prishe and the mission completes.
Reward: the title Warrior of the Crystal (earned at the Ebon Panel) and the next mission, Dawn.

name: Dawn
steps: In Empyreal Paradox, touch the entrance TR_Entrance for a cutscene. Then enter the Dawn battle there: level cap 75, up to 6 players, Trusts allowed, 30 minute limit.

Defeat Promathia in both of its forms. Prishe and Selh'teus fight alongside you. After you win, re-enter or zone into Empyreal Paradox for two cutscenes. You receive the Tear of Altana key item and are moved to Al'Taieu.
Wait until after the next Japan-time midnight. Then view five sets of story cutscenes, in any order (steps 4 to 6).

Louverance: talk to Hinaree in Southern San d'Oria, then enter Uleguerand Range for a cutscene. Go back to Southern San d'Oria and walk into its event area (the script gives no position) for a third cutscene.
Chebukkis: talk to Chipmy-Popmy in Port Windurst, then talk to Warmachine in Bibiki Bay. You receive a random colored drop. If your bags are full, talk to Warmachine again later to collect it.
Shikarees: enter Mhaura for a cutscene. Jabbos: enter Oldton Movalpolos for a cutscene. Tenzen: talk to Cid in Metalworks.
When all five sets are done, walk into the event area in Ru'Lude Gardens (no position given) for a cutscene. Then examine _6s1 in Upper Jeuno (about x -97, z 92).
Optional: examine _6s1 in Upper Jeuno again to choose a Rajas Ring, Sattva Ring or Tamas Ring. If you lose it later, you can get a replacement there.
In Tavnazian Safehold, examine _0qa (about x 111, y -41, z 41). Then walk into the event area in Lufaise Meadows (no position given) for a cutscene and the title Banisher of Emptiness.

To finish, complete Apocalypse Nigh up to its Gilgamesh step (see the next step). In Norg, talk to Gilgamesh and pick one of the four earrings. Any other answer leaves Dawn unfinished, so talk to him again.

Apocalypse Nigh: requires Shadows of the Departed done and nation rank 5. Ru'Lude Gardens event area, Sealion's Den, _iya in Hu'Xzoi, Empyreal Paradox fight vs Kam'lanaut group, Aldo in Lower Jeuno, then wait one Vana'diel day.
Reward: an earring (Static, Magnetic, Hollow or Ethereal Earring), 2000 EXP and the titles Averter of the Apocalypse and Banisher of Emptiness. The next mission, The Last Verse, opens.

name: Rhapsodies of Vana'diel
steps: Requires level 3 or higher, and the server must have Rhapsodies of Vana'diel enabled.

Zone into one of these areas (not your Mog House): Northern, Southern or Port San d'Oria; Bastok Markets, Bastok Mines or Port Bastok; Windurst Waters, Walls, Woods or Port Windurst. The opening cutscene plays when you arrive.
If you are already standing in one of those areas, leave it and come back in to trigger the cutscene.
Reward: unlocks the next mission, Resonance.

name: Resonance
steps: Travel to either Selbina or Mhaura. The town you enter first decides your story path for the next missions.
Watch the cutscene that plays as you enter that town.
Reward: unlocks Emissary from the Seas (on the Selbina or Mhaura path).

name: Emissary from the Seas
steps: Selbina path: talk to Naillina in Selbina and pick the option that agrees to help.
Mhaura path: talk to Numi Adaligo in Mhaura and pick the option that agrees to help.
Reward: unlocks the next mission (Set Free).

name: Set Free
steps: Your route depends on the previous mission (Emissary from the Seas). If you finished it with Naillina in Selbina, use Selbina. If you finished it with Numi Adaligo in Mhaura, use Mhaura. The other port will not respond.
Selbina route: obtain 3 Clump of Bee Pollen (this mission's script does not say where) and trade all 3 to Abelard in Selbina.
Mhaura route: obtain 3 Mandragora Dewdrop (this mission's script does not say where) and trade all 3 to Ekokoko in Mhaura.
Watch the cutscene. If you already have a support job unlocked, you receive an item, so keep 1 inventory slot free. With no free slot, the trade fails and the mission does not complete.
Reward: key item Gilgamesh's Introductory Letter (if you have no support job yet) or a Copper Aman Voucher (if you already have one); unlocks The Beginning.

name: The Beginning
steps: Selbina path: talk to Pacomart in Selbina and pick the option to travel; you are moved to Norg.
Mhaura path: talk to Tonasav in Mhaura and pick the option to travel; you are moved to Norg.
In Norg, examine the Oaken Door (near Comitiolus) to watch the cutscene and complete the mission.
Reward: key item Reisenjima Sanctorium Orb; unlocks Flames of Prayer.

name: Flames of Prayer
steps: In Norg, examine the Oaken Door to watch the cutscene and complete the mission.
Reward: key item Rhapsody in White; unlocks The Path Untraveled.

name: The Path Untraveled
steps: Go to any one Shattered Telepoint: in Konschtat Highlands, La Theine Plateau or Tahrongi Canyon.
Examine the Shattered Telepoint to watch the cutscene and complete the mission.
Reward: unlocks At Heaven's Door.

name: At Heaven's Door
steps: Travel to Qufim Island and find the Undulating Confluence.
Examine the Undulating Confluence to watch the cutscene and complete the mission.
Reward: unlocks The Lion's Roar.

name: The Lion's Roar
steps: Go to the Undulating Confluence on Qufim Island and examine it to spawn the monster Ophiotaurus. If you are told to wait a bit longer, come back later.
Defeat Ophiotaurus to complete the mission.
Reward: unlocks Eddies of Despair (I).

name: Eddies of Despair (I)
steps: Examine the Undulating Confluence on Qufim Island to watch a cutscene; you are teleported to Escha Zi'Tah.
Watch the cutscene that plays as you arrive in Escha Zi'Tah to complete the mission.
Reward: unlocks A Land After Time.

name: A Land After Time
steps: Keep 1 inventory slot free for the reward item.
Examine any Shattered Telepoint (Konschtat Highlands, La Theine Plateau or Tahrongi Canyon) to watch the cutscene and complete the mission.
If your inventory was full, free a slot and examine the Shattered Telepoint again to receive the reward.
Reward: Cipher of Lions Alter Ego II and the key item Rhapsody in Umber; unlocks Fate's Call.

name: Fate's Call
steps: Requires nation Rank 6 or higher (or reaching the later part of your nation's Shadow Lord mission).
Enter any San d'Oria, Bastok or Windurst city area, such as Southern San d'Oria, Bastok Markets or Windurst Waters, to watch the cutscene.
Reward: unlocks What Lies Beyond.

name: What Lies Beyond
steps: Travel to Norg and examine the Oaken Door (near Gilgamesh) to watch the cutscene and finish the mission.
Reward: unlocks The Ties that Bind.

name: The Ties that Bind
steps: Travel to Sea Serpent Grotto and find the ??? (qm7).
Examine the ??? to watch the cutscene and complete the mission.
Reward: unlocks Impurity.

name: Impurity
steps: Travel to Yuhtunga Jungle and find the ??? (qm11).
Examine the ??? to watch the cutscene and complete the mission.
Reward: unlocks The Lost Avatar.

name: The Lost Avatar
steps: Go to Yuhtunga Jungle and find the ??? at about position (-410, 17, -381).
Examine the ??? to spawn the monster Siren. If you see 'now is not the time', Siren is already up (possibly fighting someone else). Wait for her to be gone, then try again.
Defeat Siren.
Examine the same ??? again to watch the cutscene and finish the mission.
Reward: key item Rhapsody in Azure; unlocks Volto Oscuro.

name: Volto Oscuro
steps: Go to Norg and click the Oaken Door (around position 97, -7, -12) to watch the cutscene.
If the mission did not finish after the cutscene (for example your inventory was full), make space and click the Oaken Door in Norg again.
Reward: Cipher of Zeid's Alter Ego II; next mission Ring My Bell.

name: Ring My Bell
steps: Requires Tenzen to be available: you cannot be on a Chains of Promathia mission where Tenzen is busy (such as The Call of the Wyrmking, A Vessel Without a Captain, Desires of Emptiness, The Warrior's Path).
Go to Norg and click the Oaken Door (around position 97, -7, -12) to watch the cutscene. If you only get a short 'cannot proceed' scene, move your Promathia missions forward first.
Reward: next mission Spirits Awoken.

name: Spirits Awoken
steps: Travel to Qufim Island.
From Qufim Island, enter Lower Delkfutts Tower; a cutscene plays automatically as you zone in.
Reward: next mission Crashing Waves.

name: Crashing Waves
steps: Requires completing the Chains of Promathia mission A Vessel Without a Captain, and Tenzen must be available (not on a Promathia mission where he is busy).
Make sure you have at least one free inventory slot.
Go to Ru'Lude Gardens and walk toward the palace entrance (north end of the gardens) to trigger the cutscene.
If your inventory was full, talk to the Mystic Retriever in Ru'Lude Gardens to collect the cipher and finish the mission.
Reward: Cipher of Tenzen's Alter Ego II; next mission Call to Serve.

name: Call to Serve
steps: Requires Tenzen to be available (not on a Chains of Promathia mission where he is busy).
Make sure you have at least one free inventory slot.
Zone into Port Jeuno; a cutscene plays automatically.
If your inventory was full, talk to the Mystic Retriever in Port Jeuno to collect the cipher and finish the mission.
Reward: Cipher of Prishe's Alter Ego II; next mission Numbering Days.

name: Numbering Days
steps: Go to Upper Jeuno and click the door of the Marble Bridge Eatery (around position -96, 0, 92) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: next mission Inescapable Binds.

name: Inescapable Binds
steps: Requires Tenzen and Prishe to be available (not on Chains of Promathia missions where they are busy).
If you do NOT have the Boarding Permit key item: go to Lower Jeuno, talk to Faursel and pick 'Where's Tenzen?'. You receive the Boarding Permit and move on to the mission Desert Winds.
If you already HAVE the Boarding Permit: travel to Aht Urhgan Whitegate; a cutscene plays as you zone in and the mission completes.
Reward: next mission Desert Winds (Faursel route) or Ever Forward (direct Whitegate route).

name: Desert Winds
steps: Use your Boarding Permit to travel to Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
A cutscene plays automatically as you zone into Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Reward: next mission Ever Forward.

name: Ever Forward
steps: Requires Treasures of Aht Urhgan progress at the mission Royal Puppeteer or later. Without it, the gate only says you cannot progress in Rhapsodies of Vana'diel.
Option A (recommended): go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and examine the Imperial Whitegate to watch the cutscene.
Option A finishes Ever Forward and the next mission, Aphmau's Light, together, and starts the mission Reunited.
Option B: zone into Bastok Markets, Bastok Mines, Port Bastok, Northern, Southern or Port San d'Oria, Port Windurst, Windurst Walls, Windurst Waters or Windurst Woods to get a cutscene.
Only those 10 zones trigger Option B. Inner areas such as Chateau d'Oraguille, Metalworks or Heavens Tower do not. Option B completes Ever Forward and starts Aphmau's Light.
Reward: Cipher of Nashmeira's Alter Ego II, given through Option A (the Imperial Whitegate cutscene). The Option B path in the script does not grant it. Next mission: Reunited.

name: Aphmau's Light
steps: Requires reaching the Treasures of Aht Urhgan mission Royal Puppeteer; otherwise you get an 'unable to progress' message.
Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and click the Imperial Whitegate (palace gate) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: Cipher of Nashmeira's Alter Ego II; next mission Reunited.

name: Reunited
steps: Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to Nadeey to watch the cutscene.
Reward: next mission Take Wing.

name: Take Wing
steps: Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and walk into the Shaharat Teahouse area; a cutscene plays automatically.
Reward: next mission Prime Number.

name: Take Wing
steps: Travel to Alzadaal Undersea Ruins (this mission's script does not say the route); a cutscene plays as you zone in and the mission completes.
Optional: the next time you enter The Shrouded Maw, an extra follow-up cutscene plays.
Reward: next mission From the Ruins.

name: Aphmau's Light
steps: Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and click the Imperial Whitegate (palace gate) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: key item Rhapsody in Crimson; next mission Cauterize.

name: Cauterize
steps: Requires Cait Sith to be available in Wings of the Goddess (server notes say this opens around WotG mission 3); you cannot be on Cavernous Maws, Back to the Beginning, Where It All Began, A Token of Troth or Lest We Forget.
Go to a Cavernous Maw in Batallia Downs (near -48, 0, 435), Rolanberry Fields (near -198, 8, 361) or Sauromugue Champaign (near 369, 8, -227), or the same spot in their [S] versions.
Click the ??? next to the Cavernous Maw to watch the cutscene. Uncertain Destinations is completed automatically at the same time.
Reward: key item Lightsworm; next mission Ganged Up On.

name: Uncertain Destinations
steps: The script is intentionally empty: this mission is completed automatically when you finish Cauterize (click the ??? at a Cavernous Maw), which moves you straight to Ganged Up On.

name: Ganged Up On
steps: Requires Lilisette to be available (not on a Wings of the Goddess mission where she is busy).
Make sure you have at least one free inventory slot.
Zone into Southern San d'Oria [S]; a cutscene plays automatically.
If your inventory was full, free a slot and talk to the Mystic Retriever in Southern San d'Oria [S] to finish the mission.
Reward: Cipher of Lilisette's Alter Ego II; next mission Sacrifice.

name: Sacrifice
steps: Requires that Wings of the Goddess progress not block Lillisette or Cait Sith, and that the quests A Forbidden Reunion and Champion of the Dawn not be in progress.
Go to Walk of Echoes. This mission's script does not say how to enter that zone. It only handles events once you are inside.
On zoning in, a cutscene may play if your Wings of the Goddess mission is earlier than Fate in Haze.
Examine the Ornate Door in Walk of Echoes (around position -700, -20, -303) to watch the cutscene. You are then moved to Grauberg [S].
When you arrive in Grauberg [S], a cutscene plays and the mission is complete.
Reward: none listed. Next mission: Somber Dreams.

name: Somber Dreams
steps: Go to Grauberg [S] and click the ??? near position -127, -8, 600 to spawn the monster Cetus.
Defeat Cetus. Warning: the server notes Cetus is a level 150 placeholder that is not fully implemented yet.
Click the same ??? again to watch a cutscene.
Click the conflux ??? in Grauberg [S] and choose to travel to Walk of Echoes.
A cutscene plays when you arrive in Walk of Echoes; agree to finish it and the mission completes.
Reward: title Abyssal Purveyor (on defeating Cetus); next mission Of Light and Darkness.

name: Of Light and Darkness
steps: Go to Norg and click the Oaken Door (around position 97, -7, -12) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: next mission Temporary Farewells.

name: Temporary Farewells
steps: Go to Misareaux Coast and find the ??? (qm_rov2_20) near position (-44, -23, 568).
Examine the ??? to watch the cutscene; the mission completes when it ends.
Reward: the next Rhapsodies mission, Brushing Up, opens.

name: Brushing Up
steps: Return to the same ??? (qm_rov2_20) in Misareaux Coast near (-44, -23, 568) and examine it.

In the cutscene, pick one of the offered choices (not the first/cancel option). Your choice decides which gift you must bring in the next mission: a Beef Stewpot, a Serving of Zaru Soba, or 30 Spicy Crackers.
Reward: the next Rhapsodies mission, Keep On Giving, opens.

name: Keep On Giving
steps: Examine the ??? (qm_rov2_20) in Misareaux Coast near (-44, -23, 568) to be reminded which gift you chose in Brushing Up.
Obtain the gift you chose: 1 Beef Stewpot, 1 Serving of Zaru Soba, or 30 Spicy Crackers (this mission's script does not say where).
Trade exactly that item (and quantity) to the ??? and watch the cutscene; the item is used up when the mission completes.
Reward: the next Rhapsodies mission, Past Imperfect, opens.

name: Past Imperfect
steps: Requires that Tenzen is available: your current Chains of Promathia mission must not be The Call of the Wyrmking, A Vessel Without a Captain, Desires of Emptiness, The Warrior's Path, Garden of Antiquity or When Angels Fall.
Dawn also blocks it until that mission reaches its later stages (status 4 or higher). While blocked, the door only shows an 'unable to make further progress' message.
Go to Norg and examine the Oaken Door near (97, -7, -12).
Watch the cutscene. The mission completes when it ends.
Reward: the next Rhapsodies mission, The Cursed Temple, opens.

name: The Cursed Temple
steps: Requires Rise of the Zilart mission 'The Temple of Uggalepih' completed. If you finish that Zilart mission while on this one, this mission completes automatically and you move on.
If you had already finished it, enter the Temple of Uggalepih to see a zone-in cutscene.
Examine the Granite Door near (340, -2, 331) in the Temple of Uggalepih and watch the cutscene.
Reward: this mission and Wisdom of Our Forefathers are both completed, and Where Divinities Collide opens.

name: Wisdom of Our Forefathers
steps: Go to the Temple of Uggalepih and examine the Granite Door near (340, -2, 331).
Watch the cutscene; the mission completes when it ends. (If you got here by finishing The Cursed Temple at the door, this mission was already completed for you.)
Reward: the next Rhapsodies mission, Where Divinities Collide, opens.

name: Smash the Orcish Scouts
steps: Talk to a San d'Oria gate guard: Ambrotien or Endracion in Southern San d'Oria, or Grilau in Northern San d'Oria, and accept the mission.
Obtain 1 Orcish Axe (this mission's script does not say where).
Trade the Orcish Axe to Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau to finish the mission.
Repeatable: talk to a gate guard and pick this mission from the list to do it again.
Reward: 150 rank points.

name: Bat Hunt
steps: Talk to a gate guard (Ambrotien or Endracion in Southern San d'Oria, or Grilau in Northern San d'Oria) and choose Bat Hunt from the mission list.
Go to King Ranperre's Tomb and examine the upper Tombstone to watch a cutscene.
First time: obtain 1 Orcish Mail Scales (this mission's script does not say where). Repeats: obtain 1 Bat Fang instead.
Trade the item to Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau to finish.
Repeatable from the gate guard's mission list.
Reward: 200 rank points.

name: Save the Children
steps: Talk to a gate guard (Ambrotien or Endracion in Southern San d'Oria, or Grilau in Northern San d'Oria) and choose Save the Children from the mission list.
Talk to Arnau in Northern San d'Oria for a cutscene. This is required the first time you do the mission.
Go to Ghelsba Outpost and examine the Hut Door to enter the battle Save the Children (up to 6 players, 10-minute limit).
Defeat Fodderchief Vokdek and the two other Orcs with him. You get the key item Orcish Hut Key and the title Fodderchief Flayer.
Examine the Hut Door in Ghelsba Outpost again to use the Orcish Hut Key.
Report to Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau to finish. Afterward you can talk to Arnau for an optional cutscene.
Repeatable from the gate guard's mission list (later runs give 250 rank points).
Reward (first time): Rank 2 and 1,000 gil.

name: The Rescue Drill
steps: Talk to a San d'Oria gate guard (Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau) and choose The Rescue Drill from the mission list.
In La Theine Plateau, talk to these soldiers in order: Galaihaurat, then Equesobillot, then Deaufrain, then Vicorpasse, then Laurisse, then Narvecaint.
Go to Ordelle's Caves and talk to Ruillont. He picks one of three soldiers at random to fetch his sword.
Back in La Theine Plateau, talk to Galaihaurat, Equesobillot and Deaufrain. The one Ruillont picked gives you a Bronze Sword.
Trade the Bronze Sword to Ruillont in Ordelle's Caves.
Talk to Vicorpasse in La Theine Plateau to get the key item Rescue Training Certificate.
Report to Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau to finish.
Reward: 300 rank points.

name: The Davoi Report
steps: Talk to a San d'Oria gate guard (Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau) and choose The Davoi Report from the mission list.
Go to Davoi and talk to Zantaviat.
In Davoi, examine the '!' marker near Zantaviat's post to get the key item Lost Document.
Talk to Zantaviat again. He takes the Lost Document and gives you the key item Temple Knights' Davoi Report.
First time: examine the Papal Chambers door in Northern San d'Oria to finish. Repeats: report to Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau instead.
Reward: 350 rank points.

name: Journey Abroad
steps: Talk to a San d'Oria gate guard (Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau) and choose Journey Abroad from the mission list.
Go to Chateau d'Oraguille and talk to Halver to get the key item Letter to the Consuls (San d'Oria). If trust quests are enabled, you also get the Cipher of Halver's alter ego.
Pick a first nation. For Bastok, talk to Savae E Paleade in the Metalworks. For Windurst, talk to Mourices in Windurst Woods. Each starts a sub-mission (Journey to Bastok or Journey to Windurst).
After the first sub-mission, travel to the other nation's envoy (Mourices or Savae E Paleade) to start the second sub-mission.
Finish the second sub-mission to get the key item Kindred Report.
Return to Halver in Chateau d'Oraguille to finish.
Reward: Rank 3, 3,000 gil, key item Adventurer's Certificate, title Certified Adventurer.

name: Journey to Bastok
steps: Starts during Journey Abroad when you talk to Savae E Paleade in the Metalworks (Bastok) with the Letter to the Consuls.
Talk to Pius in the Metalworks.
Talk to Grohm in the Metalworks to receive 3 Pickaxes. Free up inventory space first, or talk to him again to collect them.
Obtain 1 Onz of Mythril Sand (this mission's script does not say where).
Trade the Onz of Mythril Sand to Savae E Paleade in the Metalworks. This returns you to Journey Abroad.
Next, go to Windurst Woods and talk to Mourices to continue (Journey to Windurst, part 2).
Reward: none of its own. It is a step in Journey Abroad.

name: Journey to Windurst
steps: Starts during Journey Abroad when you talk to Mourices in Windurst Woods with the Letter to the Consuls.
Enter Heavens Tower (Windurst Walls) for a cutscene.
Talk to Kupipi in Heavens Tower to get the key item Shield Offering. If trust quests are enabled, you also get the Cipher of Semih's alter ego.
Go to Giddeus and talk to Uu Zhoumo to offer the Shield Offering.
Obtain 2 Parana Shields (this mission's script does not say where).
Trade both Parana Shields to Mourices in Windurst Woods. This returns you to Journey Abroad.
Talk to Mourices again, then go to the Metalworks in Bastok and talk to Savae E Paleade to continue (Journey to Bastok, part 2).
Reward: none of its own. It is a step in Journey Abroad.

name: Journey to Bastok
steps: Starts during Journey Abroad, after you finish Windurst first, when you talk to Savae E Paleade in the Metalworks.
Talk to Pius in the Metalworks.
Talk to Grohm in the Metalworks.
Go to Waughroon Shrine and enter the Burning Circle battle (level cap 25, up to 6 players, 15 minutes).
Defeat the Dark Dragon and the Seeker to get the key item Kindred Crest.
Talk to Savae E Paleade in the Metalworks. She takes the Kindred Crest and gives you the key item Kindred Report.
Return to Halver in Chateau d'Oraguille to finish Journey Abroad.
Reward: none of its own. Gives the Kindred Report needed to finish Journey Abroad.

name: Journey to Windurst
steps: Starts during Journey Abroad, after you finish Bastok first, when you talk to Mourices in Windurst Woods.
Talk to Kupipi in Heavens Tower to get the key item Dark Key.
Go to Balgas Dais and enter the Burning Circle battle (level cap 25, up to 6 players, 15 minutes). You need the Dark Key.
Defeat the Black Dragon and the Searcher to get the key item Kindred Crest.
Optional: talk to Kupipi in Heavens Tower again.
Talk to Mourices in Windurst Woods. He takes the Kindred Crest and gives you the key item Kindred Report.
Return to Halver in Chateau d'Oraguille to finish Journey Abroad.
Reward: none of its own. Gives the Kindred Report needed to finish Journey Abroad.

name: Infiltrate Davoi
steps: Talk to a San d'Oria gate guard (Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau) and choose Infiltrate Davoi from the mission list. Talk to the guard again for a briefing.
In Chateau d'Oraguille, examine the Prince Royal's door.
Enter Davoi for a cutscene, then talk to Quemaricond in Davoi to get the key item Royal Knights' Davoi Report.
Return to the Prince Royal's door in Chateau d'Oraguille to finish (an extra 100 rank points the first time).
Repeats: talk to Zantaviat in Davoi, examine the three '!' markers (east, south and north blocks) for the three block codes, talk to Zantaviat again, then report to a gate guard.
Reward: 300 rank points (400 the first time).

name: The Crystal Spring
steps: Talk to a San d'Oria gate guard (Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau) and choose The Crystal Spring from the mission list.
Obtain 1 Crystal Bass (this mission's script does not say where).
Trade the Crystal Bass to Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau.
First time: walk from Northern San d'Oria into Chateau d'Oraguille for a cutscene, then talk to Chalvatot in the chateau to finish.
Repeats: trading the Crystal Bass to the gate guard finishes the mission right away.
Reward: 400 rank points.

name: Appointment to Jeuno
steps: Talk to a San d'Oria gate guard (Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau) and choose Appointment to Jeuno from the mission list.
Talk to Halver in Chateau d'Oraguille.
In Chateau d'Oraguille, examine the Great Hall door to get the key item Letter to the Ambassador.
Go to Ru'Lude Gardens in Jeuno and talk to Nelcabrit at the San d'Orian embassy.
Obtain a Delkfutt Key (this mission's script does not say where). Trade it to the Cermet Door in Lower Delkfutt's Tower. It turns into a key item.
Return to Ru'Lude Gardens and examine the embassy door near Nelcabrit to finish.
Reward: Rank 4 and 5,000 gil.

name: Magicite
steps: Requires San d'Oria Rank 4 and enough rank points. Talk to Nelcabrit at the San d'Orian embassy in Ru'Lude Gardens to accept.
In Ru'Lude Gardens, examine the embassy door to get the key item Archducal Audience Permit. Then examine the Audience Chamber door to get the key item Letter to Aldo.
Talk to Aldo in Lower Jeuno to get the key item Silver Bell.
Talk to Paya-Sabya in Upper Jeuno, then talk to Muckvix in Lower Jeuno to get the key item Yagudo Torch.
Collect all three magicite key items: in the Altar Room, Monastic Cavern and Qulun Dome, examine the Magicite in each zone.
With all three magicite, examine the Audience Chamber door in Ru'Lude Gardens. You get the key item Airship Pass (20,000 gil instead if you already have one) and the title Have Wings Will Fly.
Talk to Nelcabrit in Ru'Lude Gardens to finish.
Reward: Rank 5, 10,000 gil and the key item Message to Jeuno (San d'Oria).

name: The Ruins of Fei'Yin
steps: Requires San d'Oria Rank 5 and the key item Message to Jeuno (San d'Oria).
Walk from Northern San d'Oria into Chateau d'Oraguille for a cutscene, then accept the mission from a gate guard's mission list (Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau).
Talk to Halver in Chateau d'Oraguille to get the key item New Fei'Yin Seal.
Enter Fei'Yin for a cutscene.
In Qu'Bia Arena, enter the Burning Circle battle (level cap 50, up to 6 players, 30 minutes).
Defeat Archlich Taber'quoan and the two others with him. You get the key item Burnt Seal and the title Archmage Assassin.
Return to Halver in Chateau d'Oraguille to finish.
Reward: 400 rank points.

name: The Shadow Lord
steps: Requires San d'Oria as your nation and no other active mission. Accept 'The Shadow Lord' from a San d'Oria gate guard: Ambrotien or Endracion (Southern San d'Oria) or Grilau (Northern San d'Oria).
Go to Chateau d'Oraguille and talk to Halver (center of the chateau) for a cutscene.
In Chateau d'Oraguille, examine the door to the Prince Royal's chambers for a cutscene with Prince Trion.
Travel to the Throne Room. Examine the door (_4l1) once; this only plays a cutscene and does not start the fight.
Examine the same door a second time to enter the battle. Level cap 75, up to 6 players, trusts allowed, 30-minute limit.
Defeat the Shadow Lord in phase 1; he then reappears for phase 2. Defeat him again to win.
After the win cutscene you receive the key item Shadow Fragment and are moved out to Castle Zvahl Baileys.
Return to Chateau d'Oraguille and talk to Halver with the Shadow Fragment to finish the mission.
Reward: 20,000 gil, San d'Oria Rank 6, and the title Shadow Banisher. The Zilart mission The New Frontier is also added.

name: Leaute's Last Wishes
steps: Talk to a San d'Oria gate guard (Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau) and choose Leaute's Last Wishes from the mission list.
Talk to Halver in Chateau d'Oraguille, then examine the Great Hall door in the chateau.
Go to Western Altepa Desert and examine the Dreamrose. Sabotender Enamorado appears. Defeat it.
Examine the Dreamrose again to get the key item Dreamrose.
Talk to Halver in Chateau d'Oraguille.
Walk to the stairs leading to the garden in Chateau d'Oraguille. A cutscene plays and finishes the mission.
Reward: 600 rank points and the key item Piece of Paper.

name: Ranperre's Final Rest
steps: Talk to a San d'Oria gate guard (Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau) and choose Ranperre's Final Rest from the mission list.
Examine the Prince Royal's door in Chateau d'Oraguille.
In King Ranperre's Tomb, examine the Heavy Stone Door. Defeat all three monsters that appear: Corrupted Yorgos, Corrupted Soffeil and Corrupted Ulbrig.
Examine the Heavy Stone Door again and choose to go through. Then examine the lower Tombstone to get the key item Ancient San d'Orian Book.
Give the book to a San d'Oria gate guard (Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau). Change zones, then talk to the gate guard again.
Examine the Prince Royal's door in Chateau d'Oraguille, then examine the Heavy Stone Door in King Ranperre's Tomb.
Report to Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau to finish.
Reward: Rank 7 and 40,000 gil.

name: Prestige of the Papsque
steps: Talk to a San d'Oria gate guard (Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau) and choose Prestige of the Papsque from the mission list.
Examine the Papal Chambers door in Northern San d'Oria.
In West Ronfaure, examine the ??? (qm4). Marauder Dvogzog appears. Defeat it.
Examine the ??? again to get the key item Ancient San d'Orian Tablet.
Return to the Papal Chambers door in Northern San d'Oria to finish.
Reward: 1,000 rank points.

name: The Secret Weapon
steps: Requires San d'Oria Rank 7, enough rank points, and Prestige of the Papsque finished.
Talk to a gate guard (Ambrotien or Endracion in Southern San d'Oria, or Grilau in Northern San d'Oria) for a cutscene.
Walk into the garden area near Chalvatot in Chateau d'Oraguille for a cutscene.
Accept The Secret Weapon from a gate guard's mission list.
Go to Horlais Peak and enter the battle The Secret Weapon (level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30 minutes). Defeat Darokbok of Clan Reaper and his Orc forces.
After the win you get the key item Crystal Dowser. Report to Ambrotien, Endracion or Grilau to finish.
Reward: Rank 8 and 60,000 gil.

name: Coming of Age
steps: Accept San d'Oria Mission 8-1 'Coming of Age' from a San d'Oria gate guard: Ambrotien or Endracion in Southern San d'Oria, or Grilau in Northern San d'Oria.
Enter Chateau d'Oraguille to watch the opening cutscene.
Talk to Halver in Chateau d'Oraguille for the mission briefing cutscene.
Travel to Quicksand Caves and examine the Fountain of Kings; this spawns two monsters, Valor and Honor.
Defeat both Valor and Honor near the Fountain of Kings.
Examine the Fountain of Kings again to obtain the key item Drops of Amnio.
Return to Halver in Chateau d'Oraguille and give your report in the cutscene; the mission is completed.
Wait at least 1 minute, then enter Northern San d'Oria (outside your Mog House) for a final cutscene; gate guards will not give new missions until you see it.
Reward: 800 San d'Oria rank points.

name: Lightbringer
steps: Requires San d'Oria as your nation and M8-1 Coming of Age finished. After M8-1, wait about 1 minute, then zone into Northern San d'Oria (not your Mog House) to watch a cutscene. Gate guards refuse missions until you see it.
Accept San d'Oria Mission 8-2 'Lightbringer' from a gate guard: Ambrotien or Endracion in Southern San d'Oria, or Grilau in Northern San d'Oria.
In Chateau d'Oraguille, examine the Great Hall door for a cutscene.
Talk to Rahal in Chateau d'Oraguille to receive the key item Crystal Dowser. (Curilla in the Chateau has extra dialogue.)
Go to Temple of Uggalepih and examine the three ??? spots near the Granite Door to get Piece of a Broken Key 1, 2 and 3.
With all three key pieces, examine the Granite Door. This spawns Nio-A and Nio-Hum. While either one is still up, the door just says it cannot be opened.
Defeat the Nios. Progress counts when one Nio dies while the other is already dead or gone (despawned), so make sure both are down.
Examine the Granite Door again for a cutscene. This uses up the three key pieces.
Go back to Chateau d'Oraguille and examine the Great Hall door to finish the mission. Crystal Dowser is removed.
Reward: San d'Oria Rank 9 and 80,000 gil. Optional: examine the two Prince doors in the Chateau for one-time cutscenes.

name: Breaking Barriers
steps: Accept San d'Oria Mission 9-1 'Breaking Barriers' from a gate guard (Ambrotien or Endracion in Southern San d'Oria, or Grilau in Northern San d'Oria).
In Chateau d'Oraguille, examine the Great Hall door for a cutscene. (Halver in the Chateau also has dialogue.)
Go to Valley of Sorrows and examine the ??? (something buried) to receive the key item Figure of Titan.
Go to Xarcabard and examine the ??? (something buried) to receive the key item Figure of Garuda.
Go to Batallia Downs and examine the ???; this spawns Suparna and Suparna Fledgling. Defeat both.
Examine the ??? in Batallia Downs again for a cutscene and the key item Figure of Leviathan.
Return to Chateau d'Oraguille and examine the Great Hall door with all three figures to complete the mission.
Reward: 900 San d'Oria rank points.

name: The Heir to the Light
steps: Accept San d'Oria Mission 9-2 'The Heir to the Light' from a gate guard (Ambrotien or Endracion in Southern San d'Oria, or Grilau in Northern San d'Oria).
Enter Northern San d'Oria to watch a cutscene.
Enter Chateau d'Oraguille to watch the next cutscene.
Travel to Feiyin; a cutscene plays as you enter.
Go to Qu'Bia Arena, enter the Burning Circle and win the 'Heir to the Light' battle (level cap 75, up to 6 players, trusts allowed, 30 minutes). Protect Prince Trion.
Return to Northern San d'Oria for a cutscene as you enter.
In Chateau d'Oraguille, examine the Great Hall door for a cutscene.
Travel to King Ranperres Tomb and examine the Heavy Stone Door for a cutscene.
Return to Chateau d'Oraguille and talk to Halver to complete the mission. Keep 1 inventory slot free for the flag; if full, talk to Halver again later.
Reward: San d'Oria Rank 10, 100,000 gil, a San d'Orian Flag, and the title San d'Orian Royal Heir.

name: Land of Sacred Serpents
steps: Requires Treasures of Aht Urhgan enabled on the server and the Boarding Permit key item.
Travel to Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Walk onto the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to trigger a cutscene with Naja Salaheem.
Reward: Supplies Package key item; next mission Immortal Sentries.

name: Immortal Sentries
steps: Deliver the Supplies Package to any one Immortal: Meyaada (Arrapago Reef), Daswil (Bhaflau Thickets), Nahshib or Nareema (Caedarva Mire), or Waudeen (Mount Zhayolm).
In that cutscene, choose to hand over the package. You gain 150 Imperial Standing.
Return to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to Naja Salaheem at Salaheem's Sentinels.
Reward: PSC Wildcat Badge key item, title Private Second Class, access to your Mog Locker; next mission President Salaheem.

name: President Salaheem
steps: Talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate (cutscene about the Mog Locker).
Leave the zone and come back (zone once).
Talk to Naja Salaheem again for the next cutscene.
Reward: next mission Knight of Gold.

name: Knight of Gold
steps: Talk to Cacaroon in Aht Urhgan Whitegate. Pick the option agreeing to his offer; if you refuse, talk to him again.
Trade Cacaroon either 1000 gil or 1 Imperial Bronze Piece.
Walk into Walahra Temple in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a cutscene.
Walk into the Shaharat Teahouse in Aht Urhgan Whitegate. In the cutscene, ask about all three topics to move on.
Reward: Raillefal's Letter key item; next mission Confessions of Royalty.

name: Confessions of Royalty
steps: Go to Chateau d'Oraguille in San d'Oria with Raillefal's Letter and talk to Halver. Choose the option to hand over the letter.
If you cannot enter the Chateau yet (normally rank 3, or rank 2 for San d'Oria citizens), talk to Guilerme in Northern San d'Oria and accept; he takes you in for the cutscene.
Reward: next mission Easterly Winds.

name: Easterly Winds
steps: Go to Ru'Lude Gardens in Jeuno and walk to the palace entrance to trigger a cutscene.
In the cutscene, accept to receive 10 Imperial Bronze Pieces (needs free inventory space) or decline; either way the mission completes.
Reward: next mission Westerly Winds.

name: Westerly Winds
steps: Make sure you have at least 1 free inventory slot.
Return to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and walk into the Shaharat Teahouse for a cutscene. You get Raillefal's Note, an Imperial Silver Piece and title Agent of the Allied Forces.
Talk to Naja Salaheem at Salaheem's Sentinels in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Reward: Imperial Silver Piece; next mission A Mercenary Life.

name: A Mercenary Life
steps: After finishing Westerly Winds, leave Aht Urhgan Whitegate and come back (zone once).
Walk onto the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to trigger a cutscene.
Reward: next mission Undersea Scouting.

name: Undersea Scouting
steps: Optional: talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for hints.
Go to Alzadaal Undersea Ruins and travel to map 7. Walk into the area just before the large door to trigger a cutscene.
Reward: Astral Compass key item; next mission Astral Waves.

name: Astral Waves
steps: Talk to Naja Salaheem at Salaheem's Sentinels in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a cutscene.
Reward: Astral Compass key item; next mission Imperial Schemes (wait until the next Vana'diel day and zone before continuing).

name: Imperial Schemes
steps: Wait until the next Vana'diel day after Astral Waves, and leave Aht Urhgan Whitegate and come back (zone once).
Walk onto the first platform of Salaheem's Sentinels in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to trigger a cutscene.
Reward: next mission Royal Puppeteer.

name: Royal Puppeteer
steps: Go to Nashmau and talk to Pyopyoroon; he asks for an item.
Obtain 1 Vial of Jody's Acid (this mission's script does not say where).
Trade 1 Vial of Jody's Acid to Pyopyoroon in Nashmau.
Reward: Vial of Spectral Scent key item; next mission Lost Kingdom.

name: Lost Kingdom
steps: Go to Caedarva Mire and examine Jazaraat's Headstone (around position -389, 6, -570) with the Vial of Spectral Scent for a cutscene.
Examine Jazaraat's Headstone again to make Jazaraat appear. Defeat Jazaraat.
Examine Jazaraat's Headstone once more for the final cutscene.
Reward: Ephramadian Gold Coin key item; next mission The Dolphin Crest. If you lose the coin, examine the headstone again for a new one.

name: The Dolphin Crest
steps: Talk to Naja Salaheem at Salaheem's Sentinels in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a cutscene.
Reward: next mission The Black Coffin.

name: The Black Coffin
steps: With the Ephramadian Gold Coin, go to Arrapago Reef and walk up to the Cutter (around position -460, -3, -405) for a cutscene.
Examine the Cutter to enter The Ashu Talif. The coin is used up on entry; you have 30 minutes.
Defeat the first wave of ship crew, then the second wave including the Ashu Talif Captain.
After winning you return to Arrapago Reef for a cutscene, then are sent to Nashmau for the final cutscene.
Reward: next mission Ghosts of the Past.

name: Ghosts of the Past
steps: Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to Naja Salaheem at Salaheem's Sentinels (around 22, -8, -45).
Watch the cutscene; Naja may ask you to pick an outfit style during it. Any choice is fine and the mission completes when the scene ends.
Reward: the next mission, Guests of the Empire, unlocks.

name: Guests of the Empire
steps: Before you start, put on palace-approved body armor (the script's list includes pieces like Aketon or Black Cotehardie) and also wear hands, legs, and feet armor.

In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Naja Salaheem at Salaheem's Sentinels. If your outfit passes, she approves it. If not, you play dress-up, and you must come back properly dressed and talk to her again.
Take off your main weapon and your shield/sub-hand item, but keep the approved armor on.
Go to the Imperial Whitegate (around 152, -2, 0) in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and examine it to watch the cutscene.
Reward: Imperial Mythril Piece and the title Ovjang's Errand Runner. The next mission, Passing Glory, needs one Vana'diel day and a zone change first.

name: Passing Glory
steps: After finishing Guests of the Empire, change zones and wait until the next Vana'diel day.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, walk onto the second platform at Salaheem's Sentinels (near Naja Salaheem) to start the cutscene.
Reward: the next mission, Sweets for the Soul, unlocks.

name: Sweets for the Soul
steps: In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, you can talk to Naja Salaheem at Salaheem's Sentinels for a hint (optional).
Walk into the Shaharat Teahouse in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to start the cutscene.
Reward: the title Karababa's Tour Guide, and the next mission, Teahouse Tumult, unlocks.

name: Teahouse Tumult
steps: You can talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a hint (optional).
Travel to Aydeewa Subterrane. A cutscene plays when you zone in.
Inside Aydeewa Subterrane, find the unnamed spot at about (-298, 36, -38) and examine it to watch the next cutscene.
Reward: the next mission, Finders Keepers, unlocks.

name: Finders Keepers
steps: Return to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and walk onto the second platform at Salaheem's Sentinels (near Naja Salaheem) to start the cutscene.
Reward: the next mission, Shield of Diplomacy, unlocks.

name: Shield of Diplomacy
steps: You can talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a hint (optional).
Travel to Navukgo Execution Chamber. A cutscene plays when you zone in.
Examine the Decorative Bronze Gate (around -601, 10, -100) to watch a second cutscene.
Examine the Decorative Bronze Gate again to enter the battle. Up to 6 players, trusts allowed, 30-minute limit, no level cap below 99.
Defeat the Khimaira. Karababa appears in the arena with you.
Reward: the title Karababa's Bodyguard, and the next mission, Social Graces, unlocks.

name: Social Graces
steps: In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, walk onto the second platform at Salaheem's Sentinels (near Naja Salaheem) to start the cutscene.
Reward: the next mission, Foiled Ambition, unlocks. It needs a zone change and one Vana'diel day first.

name: Foiled Ambition
steps: After finishing Social Graces, change zones and wait until the next Vana'diel day. Until then, Naja Salaheem only gives hint dialogue.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, walk onto the second platform at Salaheem's Sentinels to start the cutscene.
Reward: 5 Imperial Gold Pieces and the title Karababa's Secret Agent. The next mission, Playing the Part, needs a zone change and one Vana'diel day first.

name: Playing the Part
steps: After finishing Foiled Ambition, change zones and wait until the next Vana'diel day.
Talk to Naja Salaheem at Salaheem's Sentinels in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to watch the cutscene. Before the wait is over, she only gives hint dialogue.
Reward: the next mission, Seal of the Serpent, unlocks.

name: Seal of the Serpent
steps: You can talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a hint (optional).
Take off your main weapon and your shield/sub-hand item.
Examine the Imperial Whitegate (around 152, -2, 0) in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to watch the cutscene.
Reward: the next mission, Misplaced Nobility, unlocks.

name: Misplaced Nobility
steps: You can talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a hint (optional).
Travel to Aydeewa Subterrane and examine the unnamed spot at about (-298, 36, -38) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: the next mission, Bastion of Knowledge, unlocks.

name: Bastion of Knowledge
steps: You can talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a hint (optional).
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, walk into the Walahra Temple area to start the cutscene.
Reward: the title Aphmau's Mercenary, and the next mission, Puppet in Peril, unlocks.

name: Puppet in Peril
steps: You can talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a hint (optional).
Travel to Jade Sepulcher and examine the Ornamental Door (around 299, 0, -199) to watch a cutscene.
Examine the Ornamental Door again to enter the battle. Up to 6 players, trusts allowed, 30-minute limit, no level cap below 99.
Defeat Lancelord Gaheel Ja.
Reward: the next mission, Prevalence of Pirates, unlocks.

name: Prevalence of Pirates
steps: You can talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a hint (optional).
Travel to Arrapago Reef. A cutscene plays when you zone in, including when you arrive by Survival Guide.
In Arrapago Reef, walk toward the Cutter (around -460, -2, -405) to watch the next cutscene.
Reward: key item Periqia Assault Area Entry Permit, and the next mission, Shades of Vengeance, unlocks.

name: Shades of Vengeance
steps: You need the key item Periqia Assault Area Entry Permit, which you got from Prevalence of Pirates. The permit is used up when you enter.
Go to Caedarva Mire and examine the Runic Seal (around -353, -3, -20) to enter Periqia.
Inside Periqia, defeat the K23H1-LAMIA enemies until the assault reports that it is complete.
After you leave Periqia, zone into Caedarva Mire to watch the cutscene that completes the mission.

If you fail, wait one Vana'diel day before getting a new permit. The script hands out new permits through an NPC named 'Nashib', but the NPC in Caedarva Mire is named Nahshib, so the script may not give a replacement.
Reward: the title Nashmeira's Mercenary, and the next mission, In the Blood, unlocks.

name: In the Blood
steps: Talk to Naja Salaheem at Salaheem's Sentinels in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to watch the cutscene.
Reward: Imperial Gold Piece. The next mission, Sentinels' Honor, needs a zone change and one Vana'diel day first.

name: Sentinels' Honor
steps: After finishing In the Blood, change zones and wait until the next Vana'diel day.
Talk to Naja Salaheem at Salaheem's Sentinels in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to watch the cutscene. Before the wait is over, she only gives hint dialogue.
Reward: the next mission, Testing the Waters, unlocks.

name: Testing the Waters
steps: You need the key item Ephramadian Gold Coin. If you don't have it, examine Jazaraat's Headstone in Caedarva Mire to get it again (you must have finished Lost Kingdom).
You can talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a hint (optional).
Go to Arrapago Reef and walk toward the Cutter (around -460, -2, -405) to start a cutscene.
In the cutscene, choose the correct answer. A wrong answer means you must change zones and try again.
After the correct answer, you are sent to Talacca Cove, and a cutscene plays when you arrive. The gold coin is used up.
Reward: key item Percipient Eye and the title Treasure Trove Tender, and the next mission, Legacy of the Lost, unlocks.

name: Legacy of the Lost
steps: You can talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a hint (optional).
Go to Talacca Cove and examine the Rock Slab (around -100, -9, -87) to enter the battle. Up to 6 players, trusts allowed, 30-minute limit, no level cap below 99.
Defeat Gessho. His helpers may appear during the fight, but the win depends on defeating Gessho.
Reward: the title Gessho's Mercy, and the next mission, Gaze of the Saboteur, unlocks.

name: Gaze of the Saboteur
steps: Requires Aht Urhgan mission Legacy of the Lost finished; this mission becomes active right after it.
Travel to Caedarva Mire and take the zone line into Hazhalm Testing Grounds; a cutscene plays automatically as you enter.
In Hazhalm Testing Grounds, examine the Entry Gate (near !pos 486 -227.6 -20) to watch the next cutscene; your Percipient Eye key item is taken.
Reward: key item Luminian Dagger and the title Emissary of the Empress; next mission Path of Blood.

name: Path of Blood
steps: In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, walk onto the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels (Naja Salaheem's office) to trigger a cutscene.
After the cutscene you are moved within Aht Urhgan Whitegate; a second cutscene plays automatically on arrival and finishes the mission.
Before the next mission can start you must change zones and wait until the next Vana'diel day.
Reward: next mission Stirrings of War.

name: Stirrings of War
steps: Requires Path of Blood finished, then zoning once and waiting until the next Vana'diel day.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, walk into the Shaharat Teahouse to trigger the mission cutscene.
Reward: key item Allied Council Summons; next mission Allied Rumblings.

name: Allied Rumblings
steps: Travel to Ru'Lude Gardens in Jeuno.
Walk into the palace entrance area of Ru'Lude Gardens to trigger the mission cutscene.
Before continuing you must change zones and wait until the next Vana'diel day.
Reward: next mission Unraveling Reason.

name: Unraveling Reason
steps: Requires zoning and one Vana'diel day passed since Allied Rumblings.
In Ru'Lude Gardens, talk to Pherimociel (near !pos -31.6 1.0 68.0). If he says the ship isn't ready, change zones, wait, and try again.
When he says the ship is ready, accept his offer (choose yes) in the cutscene; you are sent to Wajaom Woodlands.
In Wajaom Woodlands, three cutscenes play one after another automatically as you arrive; just watch them all.
Reward: title Endymion Paratrooper; next mission Light of Judgment.

name: Light of Judgement
steps: In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Rodin-Comidin (near !pos 17.2 -6.0 51.2) and watch the cutscene to the end.
Reward: key item Nyzul Isle Route; next mission Path of Darkness.

name: Path of Darkness
steps: You need key item Nyzul Isle Route (you get it at the end of Light of Judgment). If you lost it, talk to Rodin-Comidin in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to get it again.
Go to Alzadaal Undersea Ruins and examine the blank lamp (near !pos 206.55 -1.5 20.05). Agree in the cutscene.
Examine the Runic Seal (near !pos 125 -2 20) in Alzadaal Undersea Ruins to enter the Nyzul Isle instance. Your party can come too. Nyzul Isle Route is used up, and you have 30 minutes.
Naja Salaheem fights on your side. Keep her alive: if she dies, the mission fails.
Fight Amnaf. He can't be killed: at about 50% HP he retreats. Destroy all 4 Imperial Gears that appear with him.
Amnaf comes back. Fight him until he retreats again at about 20% HP, and destroy the 4 new Imperial Gears.
A door opens and Amnaf Psycheflayer appears. Defeat him to win.
After winning you are sent back to Alzadaal Undersea Ruins, and a cutscene there finishes the mission.
Reward: title Naja's Comrade-in-Arms; next mission Fangs of the Lion.

name: Fangs of the Lion
steps: In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, walk onto the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels to trigger the mission cutscene.
Reward: key item Mythril Mirror and the title Nashmeira's Loyalist; next mission Nashmeira's Plea.

name: Nashmeira's Plea
steps: You need key item Mythril Mirror; if you don't have it, talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate (near !pos 22.7 -8.8 -45.6) to get it.
Go to Alzadaal Undersea Ruins and examine the blank lamp (near !pos 206.55 -1.5 20.05); agree in the cutscene.
Examine the Runic Seal (near !pos 125 -2 20) to enter the Nyzul Isle instance (party allowed); the Mythril Mirror is consumed. There is a time limit.
Fight Raubahn and Razfahd; once that stage ends, a cutscene plays and Alexander appears. Defeat Alexander.
On winning you return to Alzadaal Undersea Ruins and a cutscene finishes the mission.
Reward: title Preventer of Ragnarok; next mission Ragnarok.

name: Ragnarok
steps: In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, walk onto the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels to trigger the mission cutscene.
Reward: next mission Imperial Coronation.

name: Imperial Coronation
steps: Dress for the palace: unequip main and sub weapons, wear a palace-approved body armor (list in Whitegate Shared.lua, e.g. Byrnie, Aketon, Brigandine), and have hands, legs and feet equipped.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, examine the Imperial Whitegate (palace gate) dressed this way; otherwise you are turned away.
In the cutscene you are offered three rings: pick Balrahn's Ring, Ulthalam's Ring or Jalzahn's Ring (or refuse all). You may also be given an Imperial Standard.
After finishing, you can examine the Imperial Whitegate again (dressed properly) to get an Imperial Standard or a ring if you don't have one.
Reward: your chosen ring; next mission The Empress Crowned.

name: The Empress Crowned
steps: In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, walk onto the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels to trigger the mission cutscene.
Reward: Glory Crown and the title Eternal Mercenary; next mission Eternal Mercenary.

name: Eternal Mercenary
steps: This is the final Aht Urhgan mission and has nothing to complete; talking to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate only gives dialogue.
Reward: none (end of the Treasures of Aht Urhgan storyline).
