name: The Horutoto Ruins Experiment
steps: Requires Windurst citizenship.

Accept the mission from a Windurst gate guard: Rakoh Buuma (Windurst Woods), Mokyokyo (Windurst Waters), Janshura-Rashura (Port Windurst) or Zokima-Rokima (Windurst Walls). Each guard also gives a title.
In Port Windurst, go to the Orastery near Home Point #1 and talk to Hakkuru-Rinkuru (E-7) for a cutscene.
Go to East Sarutabaruta and enter Inner Horutoto Ruins through the tower at (J-7). Examine the Gate: Magical Gizmo.
Examine the six Magical Gizmos inside. One of them, chosen at random, is broken and gives you the key item Cracked Mana Orb.
Return to Hakkuru-Rinkuru in the Orastery, Port Windurst.
Reward: 250 rank points.

name: The Heart of the Matter
steps: Requires Windurst citizenship. Accept the mission from any Windurst gate guard (Rakoh Buuma, Mokyokyo, Janshura-Rashura or Zokima-Rokima).
In Windurst Woods, go to the Manustery near Home Point #1 and talk to Apururu (H-9). You receive six Dark Mana Orbs (first through sixth).
Go to Marguerite Tower in East Sarutabaruta (J-11) and talk to Pore-Ohre to receive the Southeastern Star Charm.
In Outer Horutoto Ruins, examine each of the six Magical Gizmos to place one Dark Mana Orb in each.
Next, examine the Gate: Magical Gizmo at the crack in the east outer wall for a cutscene that energizes the orbs.
Examine all six Magical Gizmos again to collect six Glowing Mana Orbs.
Return to Apururu in Windurst Woods. If you walk into East Sarutabaruta on the way, Cardians steal the orbs, but Apururu still completes the mission.
Reward: 250 rank points.

name: The Price of Peace
steps: Requires Windurst citizenship and no other active nation mission. Talk to a Windurst gate guard (Rakoh Buuma, Mokyokyo, Janshura-Rashura or Zokima-Rokima) and choose to accept this mission.
In Windurst Waters, go to the roof of the Rhinostery near Home Point #3 and talk to Leepe-Hoppe. You receive the key items Food Offering and Drink Offering.
Go to Giddeus. Talk to Laa Mozi to offer the Food Offering, then talk to Ghoo Pakya to offer the Drink Offering (either order works).
Return to the Rhinostery roof in Windurst Waters and walk to the spot beside Ohbiru-Dohbiru (a few steps east of Leepe-Hoppe). A cutscene plays when you step there.
Report to any Windurst gate guard: Mokyokyo (Windurst Waters), Rakoh Buuma (Windurst Woods), Janshura-Rashura (Port Windurst) or Zokima-Rokima (Windurst Walls).
Reward: 1,000 gil and Rank 2.

name: Lost for Words
steps: Requires Windurst citizenship. Accept the mission from any Windurst gate guard (Rakoh Buuma, Mokyokyo, Janshura-Rashura or Zokima-Rokima).
In Windurst Waters, go to the Optistery near Home Point #1 and talk to Tosuka-Porika (G-8).
In Windurst Woods, talk to Nanaa Mihgo near Home Point #1 to receive the Lapis Monocle.
In Maze of Shakhrami, examine the Fossil Rocks. One of them, chosen at random, gives you the Lapis Coral.
Return to Nanaa Mihgo and receive the Hideout Key.
Enter Inner Horutoto Ruins from the tower at (J-7) in East Sarutabaruta. Examine the Mahogany Door for a cutscene.
In Windurst Walls, examine the door of the House of the Hero (G-3), near Home Point #1, for a cutscene.
Return to Tosuka-Porika in Windurst Waters.
Reward: 300 rank points.

name: A Testing Time
steps: Requires Windurst citizenship. Accept the mission from any Windurst gate guard (Rakoh Buuma, Mokyokyo, Janshura-Rashura or Zokima-Rokima).
In Windurst Waters North, go to the Aurastery (L-6) and talk to Moreno-Toeno. Agree to the test to receive the Creature Counter Magic Doll. This starts a timer of one Vana'diel day.
Go to Tahrongi Canyon and defeat at least 30 monsters before the timer runs out. Reaching 35 gives a different ending cutscene.
Report to Moreno-Toeno during the last Vana'diel hour of the timer. If you are early, he tells you how many hours remain; come back then.
Arriving too late, or with fewer than 30 kills, fails the mission. You must then accept it again from a gate guard.
Reward: 300 rank points.

name: The Three Kingdoms
steps: Requires Windurst citizenship. Accept the mission from any Windurst gate guard (Rakoh Buuma, Mokyokyo, Janshura-Rashura or Zokima-Rokima).
In Heavens Tower, talk to Kupipi to receive the Letter to the Consuls (Windurst). If trusts are enabled, you also get Cipher: Semih.
Bastok first: talk to Patt-Pott in Metalworks to start The Three Kingdoms (Bastok).
Or San d'Oria first: in Northern San d'Oria, talk to Heruze-Moruze, then to Kasaroro, to start The Three Kingdoms San d'Oria.
After finishing the first nation's part, talk to the other envoy (Patt-Pott in Metalworks or Kasaroro in Northern San d'Oria) to start that nation's second part.
Once both parts are done and you hold the Kindred Report, return to Kupipi in Heavens Tower.
Reward: Rank 3, 3,000 gil, the key item Adventurer's Certificate and the title Certified Adventurer.

name: The Three Kingdoms San d'Oria
steps: Go to Chateau d'Oraguille in San d'Oria and talk to Halver for a cutscene. If trusts are enabled, you get Cipher: Halver.
Go to Ghelsba Outpost and defeat Warchief Vatgit.
Return to Kasaroro in Northern San d'Oria and talk to him.
This part is complete and you are back on The Three Kingdoms. Next, talk to Patt-Pott in Metalworks (Bastok).

name: The Three Kingdoms (Bastok)
steps: In Metalworks (Bastok), talk to Pius for a cutscene.
Still in Metalworks, talk to Grohm to receive 5 Pickaxes. Keep inventory space free; if your bag is full, talk to him again.
Obtain 1 Onz of Mythril Sand (this mission's script does not say where).
Trade the 1 Onz of Mythril Sand to Patt-Pott in Metalworks.
This part is complete and you are back on The Three Kingdoms. Next, talk to Kasaroro in Northern San d'Oria.

name: The Three Kingdoms San d'Oria
steps: In Chateau d'Oraguille, San d'Oria, talk to Halver for a cutscene. If trusts are enabled, you get Cipher: Halver.
Go to Horlais Peak and enter the Burning Circle battlefield 'Rank 2 Final Mission': level cap 25, up to 6 players, 15-minute limit, trusts allowed.
Defeat the Dread Dragon and the Spotter to receive the Kindred Crest.
Return to Kasaroro in Northern San d'Oria. He takes the Kindred Crest and gives you the Kindred Report.
You are back on The Three Kingdoms. Take the Kindred Report to Kupipi in Heavens Tower to finish.

name: The Three Kingdoms Bastok
steps: Continues The Three Kingdoms (Bastok leg); there is no separate accept step. Go to the Metalworks in Bastok.
Talk to Pius in the Metalworks for a cutscene.
Talk to Grohm in the Metalworks for the next cutscene.
Go to Waughroon Shrine and enter the Burning Circle mission battle (level cap 25, up to 6 players, 15 minutes). Defeat the Dark Dragon and Seeker to win and get the Kindred Crest key item.
Return to the Metalworks and talk to Patt-Pott (the Windurst embassy) to finish this leg.
Reward: Kindred Report key item (Kindred Crest is taken); your next mission, The Three Kingdoms, is added.

name: To Each His Own Right
steps: Talk to any Windurst gate guard (Rakoh Buuma in Windurst Woods, Mokyokyo in Windurst Waters, Janshura-Rashura in Port Windurst, Zokima-Rokima in Windurst Walls) and pick To Each His Own Right from the mission list.
Go to Heavens Tower and talk to Kupipi to get the Starway Stairway Bauble key item.
Talk to Rhy Epocan in Heavens Tower.
Go to Port Windurst and talk to Hakkuru-Rinkuru.
Go to Castle Oztroja and pull the handle next to the trap door (around !pos 22 -1 -14). It only opens the trap door on even-numbered Vana'diel days; a cutscene plays when it does.
Return to Heavens Tower and talk to Rhy Epocan again to finish.
Reward: 450 rank points.

name: Written in the Stars
steps: Talk to any Windurst gate guard (Rakoh Buuma, Mokyokyo, Janshura-Rashura or Zokima-Rokima) and pick Written in the Stars from the mission list.
Go to Heavens Tower and talk to Zubaba to get the Charm of Light key item.
Go to Inner Horutoto Ruins and examine the Gate of Light (around !pos -331 0 139). The Charm of Light is used up.
Return to Zubaba in Heavens Tower to finish.
Repeat runs (or after A New Journey): Zubaba instead asks you to trade 3 Rusty Daggers; obtain them (this mission's script does not say where) and trade all 3 to Zubaba.
Reward: 400 rank points (500 on the first completion).

name: A New Journey
steps: Talk to any Windurst gate guard and pick A New Journey from the mission list. You get the Star Crested Summons key item.
Go to Heavens Tower and examine the Vestal Chamber door to trade the summons for the Letter to the Ambassador key item.
Go to Ru'Lude Gardens in Jeuno and talk to Pakh Jatalfih at the Windurst embassy.

Go to Lower Delkfutts Tower and trade 1 Delkfutt Key to the Cermet Door (around !pos 636 16 59); you get the Delkfutt Key key item. Obtain the key item (this mission's script does not say where) if you lack it.
Return to Pakh Jatalfih in Ru'Lude Gardens for a cutscene.
Examine the embassy door in Ru'Lude Gardens to finish.
Reward: 5,000 gil and Rank 4.

name: Magicite
steps: Requires Windurst Rank 4 and no active mission. Talk to Pakh Jatalfih at the Windurst embassy in Ru'Lude Gardens to start.
Examine the embassy door in Ru'Lude Gardens to get the Archducal Audience Permit key item.
Examine the Audience Chamber door in Ru'Lude Gardens for a cutscene and the Letter to Aldo key item.
Go to Lower Jeuno and talk to Aldo; you get the Silver Bell key item.
Talk to Paya-Sabya in Upper Jeuno, then Muckvix in Lower Jeuno to get the Yagudo Torch key item.
Examine the Magicite in the Altar Room, Monastic Cavern and Qulun Dome to collect the Orastone, Optistone and Aurastone key items.
With all three, examine the Audience Chamber door in Ru'Lude Gardens. You get the Airship Pass (or 20,000 gil if you have one) and the title Have Wings, Will Fly.
Talk to Pakh Jatalfih again to finish.
Reward: 10,000 gil, Rank 5 and the Message to Jeuno key item.

name: The Final Seal
steps: Requires Windurst citizenship, Windurst rank 5, and no other nation mission active. You do not need any key item to start.

Optional: the Windurst gate guards (Mokyokyo in Windurst Waters, Janshura-Rashura in Port Windurst, Rakoh Buuma in Windurst Woods, Zokima-Rokima in Windurst Walls) give a short cutscene about the mission.

Go to Heaven's Tower in Windurst Walls and examine the Vestal Chamber door. Accept the mission in the cutscene to get the New Fei'Yin Seal key item. (Any Message to Jeuno key item you carry is removed here.)
Travel to Fei'Yin. A cutscene plays as you enter the zone.
In Fei'Yin, enter Qu'Bia Arena and use its Burning Circle to start the fight. Level cap 50, up to 6 players, 30-minute limit, trusts allowed.
Defeat Archlich Taber'quoan. His Ancient Sorcerers and Ancient Warriors join the fight with him. You win when the Archlich dies. Winning gives the Burnt Seal key item and the title Archmage Assassin.
Return to Heaven's Tower in Windurst Walls and examine the Vestal Chamber door again for the final cutscene.
Reward: 600 Windurst rank points.

name: The Shadow Awaits
steps: Talk to any Windurst gate guard and pick The Shadow Awaits from the mission list. You get the Star Crested Summons key item.
Go to Heavens Tower and examine the Vestal Chamber door for a cutscene and the title Star-Ordained Warrior.
Travel to the Throne Room and examine the door (around !pos -111 -6 0) for a cutscene.
Enter the Shadow Lord battle at that door (level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30 minutes) and defeat both phases of the Shadow Lord.
After the cutscene you are moved to Castle Zvahl Baileys and get the Shadow Fragment key item.
Return to Heavens Tower and examine the Vestal Chamber door to finish.
Reward: 20,000 gil and Rank 6; the Rise of the Zilart mission The New Frontier is unlocked.

name: Full Moon Fountain
steps: Talk to any Windurst gate guard and pick Full Moon Fountain from the mission list.
Talk to Hakkuru-Rinkuru in Port Windurst to get the Southwestern Star Charm key item.
Go to Outer Horutoto Ruins and examine the Magical Gizmo gate (around !pos -291 0 -659). Four guardians appear.
Defeat Jack of Batons, Jack of Coins, Jack of Cups and Jack of Swords.
Examine the gate again for a cutscene; the star charm is used up.
Continue on into Full Moon Fountain; a cutscene plays and the mission finishes.
Reward: 650 rank points.

name: Saintly Invitation
steps: Requires Windurst citizenship and no other nation mission active. Talk to a Windurst gate guard (Rakoh Buuma, Mokyokyo, Janshura-Rashura or Zokima-Rokima) and choose Saintly Invitation from the mission list.
Go to Heaven's Tower in Windurst Walls and examine the Vestal Chamber door. You get the title Hero on Behalf of Windurst and the Holy One's Invitation key item.
Travel to Balga's Dais and enter its Burning Circle. Level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30-minute limit, trusts allowed.

Defeat Buu Xolo the Bloodfaced, Nuu Kofu the Gentle, Juu Zeni the Poisonmist and Chaa Paqa the Profound. Yagudo's Elemental and Yagudo's Avatar can also appear. Winning gives the title Victor of the Balga Contest and the Balga Champion Certificate key item.

Make sure you have at least one free inventory slot. Then go to Castle Oztroja and talk to Kaa Toru the Just. You get the Ashura Necklace and the Holy One's Oath key item. If your bags are full you get nothing, so free a slot and talk to him again.
Return to Heaven's Tower in Windurst Walls and examine the Vestal Chamber door for the final cutscene.
Reward: 40,000 gil and Windurst rank 7. You also keep the Ashura Necklace.

name: The Sixth Ministry
steps: Talk to any Windurst gate guard and pick The Sixth Ministry from the mission list.
Talk to Tosuka-Porika in Windurst Waters to get the Optistery Ring key item.
Go to Toraimarai Canal. Defeat the four Hinge Oils to open the sealed door (around !pos 132 12 -19).
Behind the door, examine the fifth Tome of Magic for a cutscene.
Return to Tosuka-Porika in Windurst Waters to finish.
Reward: the Blank Book of the Gods key item and 700 rank points.

name: Awakening of the Gods
steps: Talk to any Windurst gate guard and pick Awakening of the Gods from the mission list.
In Windurst Waters, talk to Leepe-Hoppe, then to Kerutoto.
Go to Kazham and talk to Romaa Mihgo. Talking to Vanono afterwards gives an extra cutscene.
Obtain 1 Cursed Key (this mission's script does not say where).
Go to the Temple of Uggalepih and, standing on the near (south) side, trade the Cursed Key to the Granite Door (around !pos 340 0 329). You get the Book of the Gods key item.
Return to Leepe-Hoppe in Windurst Waters to finish.
Reward: 60,000 gil and Rank 8.

name: Vain
steps: Talk to any Windurst gate guard and pick Vain from the mission list.
Talk to Moreno-Toeno in Windurst Waters to get the Star Seeker key item and the title Fugitive Minister Bounty Hunter.
Travel to Ro'Maeve and examine Qu'Hau Spring (around !pos 0 -29 64). Entering most outdoor zones on the way shows a Star Seeker direction cutscene.
Go to Davoi and talk to Sedal-Godjal (around !pos 185 -3 -116); the Star Seeker becomes the Magic-Drained Star Seeker.
Obtain 1 Curse Wand (this mission's script does not say where) and trade it to Sedal-Godjal.
Return to Moreno-Toeno in Windurst Waters to finish.
Reward: 750 rank points.

name: The Jester Who'd be King
steps: Talk to any Windurst gate guard and pick The Jester Who'd be King from the mission list.
Talk to Apururu in Windurst Woods to get the Manustery Ring key item.
In any order, get 3 rings: Tosuka-Porika in Windurst Waters (Optistery Ring), Sedal-Godjal in Davoi (Aurastery Ring), and the Cermet Door in Fei'Yin, around !pos -183 0 190 (Rhinostery Ring).
Talk to Apururu again, then talk to Kupipi in Heavens Tower.
Go to Outer Horutoto Ruins and examine the crumbling wall (around !pos -423 0 619). Defeat Queen of Coins and Queen of Swords, then examine the wall again to get the Orastery Ring.
Talk to Apururu, then Shantotto in Windurst Walls to get the Glove of Perpetual Twilight key item.
Talk to Apururu, then examine the Gate of Darkness in Inner Horutoto Ruins (around !pos -228 0 99).
Return to Apururu in Windurst Woods to finish.
Reward: 80,000 gil and Rank 9.

name: Doll of the Dead
steps: Talk to any Windurst gate guard and pick Doll of the Dead from the mission list.
Talk to Apururu in Windurst Woods.
Enter Heavens Tower for a cutscene, then examine the Vestal Chamber door.
Talk to Apururu again. Optional: talk to Yoran-Oran in Windurst Walls for a hint about humus.
Obtain 1 Clump of Goobbue Humus (this mission's script does not say where).
Go to The Boyahda Tree and trade the Clump of Goobbue Humus to the Mandragora Warden (around !pos 81 7 139). You get the Letter from Zonpa-Zippa key item.
Talk to Apururu again; the letter is taken.
Enter Full Moon Fountain; a cutscene plays and the mission finishes.
Reward: the title Guiding Star and 800 rank points.

name: Moon Reading
steps: Talk to any Windurst gate guard and pick Moon Reading from the mission list.
Go to Heavens Tower and examine the Vestal Chamber door.
Collect 3 Ancient Verses: examine Qu'Hau Spring in Ro'Maeve; enter the Chamber of Oracles from Quicksand Caves; examine the ??? in the Temple of Uggalepih (around !pos -239 -1 -18).
Return to the Vestal Chamber door in Heavens Tower with all three verses.
Enter the Full Moon Fountain mission battle (level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30 minutes) and win both phases.
Examine the Vestal Chamber door again for a cutscene.
Make sure you have a free inventory slot, then examine the door once more. You are moved to Windurst Walls, where the final cutscene finishes the mission.
Reward: 100,000 gil, a Windurstian Flag, Rank 10 and the title Vestal Chamberlain.

name: Cavernous Maws
steps: Requires Wings of the Goddess to be enabled on the server.
Find a Cavernous Maw in Batallia Downs, Rolanberry Fields or Sauromugue Champaign and examine it.
Watch the cutscene; the mission completes and you are taken through a maw into the past.
Reward: key item Pure White Feather; unlocks the next mission, Back to the Beginning.

name: Back to the Beginning
steps: Requires finishing one of these Crystal War quests: Claws of the Griffon, The Tigress Strikes or Fires of Discontent.
Examine a Cavernous Maw in Batallia Downs, Rolanberry Fields or Sauromugue Champaign (or their [S] versions).
Watch the cutscene; the mission completes and that maw is added to your maw teleport list.
Reward: key item Lightsworm; unlocks the next mission, Cait Sith.

name: Cait Sith
steps: Go to East Ronfaure [S].
Walk from East Ronfaure [S] into Southern San d'Oria [S]; a cutscene plays on arrival and completes the mission.
If you are on the Rhapsodies of Vana'diel mission Cauterize at that time, you also get the Lightsworm key item.
Reward: title Cait Sith's Assistant; unlocks the next mission, The Queen of the Dance.

name: The Queen of the Dance
steps: Requires finishing one of the Crystal War quests Burden of Suspicion, Wrath of the Griffon, or A Manifest Problem.
Go to Southern San d'Oria [S] and examine the Lion Springs door to watch a cutscene: you cannot get in without a ticket.
Travel to present-day Upper Jeuno and talk to Turlough. After the cutscene you receive the key item Mayakov Show Ticket.
Go back to Southern San d'Oria [S] and examine the Lion Springs door again to use your ticket and watch a cutscene.
Stay put and watch the cutscenes that follow. The game moves you and plays them in order; the ticket is used up at the end.
Reward: you can start the next mission, While the Cat is Away.

name: While the Cat is Away
steps: Leave Southern San d'Oria [S] by walking directly into East Ronfaure [S].
A cutscene plays as you arrive in East Ronfaure [S]. Watch it to the end to finish the mission.
Reward: you can start the next mission, A Timeswept Butterfly.

name: A Timeswept Butterfly
steps: Go to Jugner Forest [S].
Walk from Jugner Forest [S] directly into La Vaule [S]. A cutscene plays as you arrive; watch it to finish the mission.
Reward: you can start the next mission, Purple, The New Black.

name: Purple, The New Black
steps: In La Vaule [S], examine the Reinforced Gateway to watch a cutscene.
Examine the Reinforced Gateway again to enter the battle 'Purple, The New Black'. Up to 6 players, trusts allowed, 30-minute limit.
Inside, defeat Galarhigg. All enemies in the battle must die to win.
After you win, you are moved back into La Vaule [S]. Watch the cutscene that plays to finish the mission.
Reward: you can start the next mission, In the Name of the Father.

name: In the Name of the Father
steps: Requires finishing one of the Crystal War quests Fire in the Hole, In a Haze of Glory, or A Feast for Gnats.
Go to Southern San d'Oria [S] and examine the Lion Springs door. Watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: you can start the next mission, Dancers in Distress.

name: Dancers in Distress
steps: In Southern San d'Oria [S], talk to Raustigne to watch a cutscene.
Go to Jugner Forest [S] and talk to the Elegant Footprints. Answer the quiz in the cutscene however you like.
At the end of the quiz you are asked for one random item: Lynx Meat, a Gold Beastcoin, or a Nyumomo Doll. Talk to the Elegant Footprints again to hear which one.
Obtain 1 of the requested item (this mission's script does not say where).
Leave the area and come back (zone), then trade the requested item to the Elegant Footprints. Watch the cutscene.
Reward: you can start the next mission, Daughter of a Knight.

name: Daughter of a Knight
steps: In present-day Southern San d'Oria, talk to Amaura at (G-6) to watch a cutscene.
Obtain 1 Cernunnos Bulb (this mission's script does not say where) and trade it to Amaura. She gives it back to you.
Go to the Maiden's Spring at (E-6) in Jugner Forest [S]. Trade the Cernunnos Bulb to the Humus-rich Earth to plant it.
Go to the same spot in present-day Jugner Forest and examine the Humus-rich Earth to watch a cutscene.
Examine the Humus-rich Earth again to make the monster Cernunnos appear, then defeat it.
Examine the Humus-rich Earth again to watch a cutscene. You receive the key item Cernunnos Resin.
Go back to Amaura in Southern San d'Oria and talk to her to watch a cutscene.
Wait until the next game day, leave the area and come back (zone), then talk to Amaura again to watch the final cutscene.
Reward: key item Bottle of Treant Tonic. You can start the next mission, A Spoonful of Sugar.

name: A Spoonful of Sugar
steps: In Southern San d'Oria [S], talk to Raustigne. Watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: you can start the next mission, Affairs of State.

name: Affairs of State
steps: You need to talk to two NPCs. They can be done in either order.
In Windurst Waters [S], talk to Velda-Galda at (K-9) and watch the cutscene.
In Bastok Markets [S], talk to Radford at (H-6) and watch the cutscene. The second NPC you visit hands over the letter.
Reward: key item Count Borel's Letter. You can start the next mission, Borne by the Wind.

name: Borne by the Wind
steps: Go to Sauromugue Champaign [S] and examine the Bulwark Gate at (F-6). Watch the long cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: key item Underpass Hatch Key. You can start the next mission, A Nation on the Brink.

name: A Nation on the Brink
steps: You need the key item Underpass Hatch Key. If you lost it, examine the Bulwark Gate in Sauromugue Champaign [S] to get it again.
Go to Batallia Downs [S]. Inside a tower in the top right corner of (J-9), examine the Underpass Hatch to watch a cutscene.
Next comes a battle in Everbloom Hollow. This server's script has no instance for it yet, so this step may not work.
After the battle, you are returned to Batallia Downs [S]. Watch the chain of cutscenes that plays there.
Reward: title Battle of Jeuno Veteran and a Jeunoan Flag. If your bags were full, claim the flag later at the ??? in Batallia Downs [S]. Next mission: Crossroads of Time.

name: Crossroads of Time
steps: Requires finishing one of the Crystal War quests Honor Under Fire, Bonds That Never Die, or The Forbidden Path.
Walk from East Ronfaure [S] directly into Southern San d'Oria [S]. Watch the cutscene that plays as you arrive.
Reward: you can start the next mission, Sandswept Memories.

name: Sandswept Memories
steps: In Southern San d'Oria [S], examine the Lion Springs door. Watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: you can start the next mission, Northland Exposure.

name: Northland Exposure
steps: Travel to Beaucedine Glacier [S]. A cutscene plays as you arrive; watch it to finish the mission.
Reward: key item Shadow Bug. You can start the next mission, Traitor in the Midst.

name: Traitor in the Midst
steps: Go to Beaucedine Glacier [S]. Five Regal Pawprints there each run a minigame, and you must clear all five. Order does not matter.

Examine the Regal Pawprints at (-23.8, -60.1, -72.2), (96.1, -20.0, 127.7) and (-167.7, -40.0, -223.9). Start each minigame and clear it. A clear only counts if at least 20 seconds pass between starting and finishing.
Examine the Regal Pawprints at (272.3, 0.0, -23.8) and (-329.9, -100.1, 130.3) and clear their minigames. These two have no time limit.
If you fail a minigame, examine the same pawprints again to retry. Each set of pawprints stops reacting once you have cleared it.
After all five are cleared, examine the Regal Pawprints at (53.8, 0.3, -299.1) and watch the cutscene. Before that, these pawprints do nothing.
Reward: the mission is complete and the next mission, Betrayal at Beaucedine, opens.

name: Betrayal at Beaucedine
steps: In Beaucedine Glacier [S], examine the Regal Pawprints (near position -15, -40, -217) to watch a cutscene.
Examine the same Regal Pawprints again to make Count Halphas appear, then defeat it.
Examine the Regal Pawprints again to watch a cutscene.
You are moved within the zone and another cutscene plays. Watch it to finish the mission.
Reward: you can start the next mission, On Thin Ice.

name: On Thin Ice
steps: In Southern San d'Oria [S], talk to Raustigne. Watch the cutscene to finish the mission.
Reward: you can start the next mission, Proof of Valor.

name: Proof of Valor
steps: In Southern San d'Oria [S], you need 20 petition signatures. Do not talk to Raustigne (near 4, -2, 44) until you have 20. Checking early makes him ignore you until you leave the zone and come back.
Easy signatures: talk once each to Illeuse, Elnonde, Loillie, Daigraffeaux, Louxiard, Machionage, Andagge, Mailleronce, Aissaville and Remiotte. Each one gives 1 signature (10 in total).

Talk to Rongelouts N Distaud, then trade him 1 Gnole Claw. Accept in the cutscene for 35 signatures. If you decline, talk to him again and accept. Get the Gnole Claw yourself; this script does not say where.

Optional: talk to Eumielle, then trade her 1 Angler's Cassoulet for 12 signatures. Or trade Coucheutand an Orcish Axe (5), an Orc Helmet (10), an Orc Pauldron (10) or a Gold Orcmask (15). Get these items yourself.

Optional: talk to Hauberliond, then trade him 99 or more Crossbow Bolts. You get 9 signatures, plus 1 for each extra full stack of 99, up to 12. Or talk to Sabiliont and trade him Gysahl Greens for 5 to 12 signatures.
Farouel, Vichauxdat, Aurfet and Corseihaut give quizzes. Because of a script bug, a quiz probably gives 0 signatures, so do not count on them.
Once you have 20 or more signatures, talk to Raustigne and accept in the cutscene. If you decline, or you checked with him earlier, leave the zone and come back first.

Reward: the next mission, A Sanguinary Prelude, opens. With 30 or more signatures you also get one item: Oxblood Orb, Square of Foulard, Angel Skin Orb, Orichalcum Ingot or Molybdenum Ingot. Which one is random, so more signatures do not guarantee a better item. Under 30 signatures, you get no item.

name: A Sanguinary Prelude
steps: Travel to Beaucedine Glacier [S]. A cutscene plays as you arrive; watch it to finish the mission.
Reward: key item Aroma Bug. You can start the next mission, Dungeons and Dancers.

name: Dungeons and Dancers
steps: In Beaucedine Glacier [S], examine the Regal Pawprints at (G-9) to watch a cutscene.
If you no longer have the key item Aroma Bug, examine the first Regal Pawprints to get it again (no more than once per game day).
Next comes a battle in Everbloom Hollow. This server's script has no instance for it yet, so this step may not work.
After the battle, you are returned to Beaucedine Glacier [S]. Watch the cutscene that plays to finish the mission.
Reward: key item Umbra Bug. You can start the next mission, Distorter of Time.

name: Distorter of Time
steps: You start this mission already holding the key item Umbra Bug, the reward for the previous mission, Dungeons and Dancers.

If you lost the Umbra Bug, go to Beaucedine Glacier [S] and examine the Regal Pawprints near position (54, -42, 105). Watch the cutscene to get a new Umbra Bug. Other pawprints only show a default message.
BLOCKED: this server has no Ruhotz Silvermines fight for this mission. The completion cutscene needs a fight-cleared event that never fires (TODO in script), so you cannot progress past this point.
(If it is implemented later) After the fight you are returned to Beaucedine Glacier [S]; watch the cutscene on arrival to complete the mission.
Reward: the next mission, The Will of the World.

name: The Will of the World
steps: Go to Southern San d'Oria [S] and talk to Raustigne to watch a cutscene. This completes the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Fate in Haze.

name: Fate in Haze
steps: Requires one of these Crystal War quests finished: What Price Loyalty, Blood of Heroes, or Howl from the Heavens.
Go to Southern San d'Oria [S] and examine the Lion Springs door to watch a cutscene.
You are moved just outside; watch the next cutscene that plays when you arrive.
You are moved again; watch the final cutscene that plays when you arrive to complete the mission.
Reward: the next mission, The Scent of Battle.

name: The Scent of Battle
steps: Go to Sauromugue Champaign [S] and examine the Bulwark Gate to watch a cutscene. This completes the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Another World.

name: Another World
steps: Enter Southern San d'Oria (present day) from East Ronfaure to watch a cutscene.
Go to Chateau d'Oraguille and talk to Halver to watch a cutscene. This completes the mission.
Reward: the next mission, A Hawk in Repose.

name: A Hawk in Repose
steps: Go to Batallia Downs (present day) and examine the Weathered Gravestone to watch a cutscene.
Obtain 1 Lilac (this mission's script does not say where).
Trade 1 Lilac to the Weathered Gravestone in Batallia Downs to watch a cutscene. This completes the mission.
Reward: the next mission, The Battle of Xarcabard.

name: The Battle of Xarcabard
steps: Enter Xarcabard [S] to watch a cutscene on arrival.
Talk to Rally Point: Red in Xarcabard [S] to watch a cutscene. This completes the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Prelude to a Storm.

name: Prelude to a Storm
steps: Go to Xarcabard [S] and talk to Rally Point: Green to watch a cutscene and receive the key item Magelight Signal Flare. If you lose it, talk to Rally Point: Green again for a new one.
Examine the Spell-worked Snow behind Rally Point: Green to enter the fight in Ghoyu's Reverie, and clear it. Note: this server's script marks that instance as not yet implemented (TODO).
After clearing the fight you are returned to Xarcabard [S]; watch the cutscene on arrival to complete the mission.
Reward: one of Elixir, Vile Elixir or Vile Elixir +1 (better reward for more time left in the fight), plus the next mission, Storm's Crescendo.

name: Storm's Crescendo
steps: Go to Xarcabard [S] and talk to Rally Point: Blue to watch a cutscene and receive the key item Alchemical Signal Flare. If you lose it, talk to Rally Point: Blue again (after a game-day wait if the officer is gone).
Examine the Excavated Snow to enter the fight in Ghoyu's Reverie, and clear it. Note: this server's script marks that instance as not yet implemented (TODO).
After the fight you are returned to Xarcabard [S]; watch the cutscene on arrival.
Talk to Rally Point: Red in Xarcabard [S] to watch a cutscene.
Watch the cutscene that plays when you are moved next to Rally Point: Red. This completes the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Into the Beast's Maw.

name: Into the Beast's Maw
steps: Enter Castle Zvahl Baileys [S] (reached through Xarcabard [S]) to watch a cutscene on arrival.
Examine the Peculiar Glint in Castle Zvahl Baileys [S] to watch a cutscene.
Watch the next two cutscenes that play as you are moved nearby; the second gives you the key item Distress Signal Flare.
If you lose the Distress Signal Flare, examine the Ornate Block in Castle Zvahl Baileys [S] and choose to take a new one.
BLOCKED: this server has no Ghoyu's Reverie fight for this mission. Examining the Peculiar Glint again does nothing (TODO in script), so you cannot progress past this point.
(If it is implemented later) After the fight you are returned to Castle Zvahl Baileys [S]; watch the cutscene on arrival to complete the mission.
Reward: the next mission, The Hunter Ensnared.

name: The Hunter Ensnared
steps: Go to Xarcabard [S] and talk to Rally Point: Red to watch a cutscene. This completes the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Flight of the Lion.

name: Flight of the Lion
steps: Go to Sauromugue Champaign [S] and examine the Bulwark Gate to watch a cutscene. This completes the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Fall of the Hawk.

name: Fall of the Hawk
steps: Enter Castle Zvahl Baileys [S] to watch a cutscene on arrival. This completes the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Darkness Descends.

name: Darkness Descends
steps: Enter Throne Room [S] to watch a cutscene on arrival.
Enter and win the Darkness Descends battle in Throne Room [S] (30-minute time limit). Note: this server has no battlefield script for this fight yet (TODO).
After winning you are moved inside Throne Room [S]; watch the cutscene on arrival to complete the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Adieu, Lilisette.

name: Adieu, Lilisette
steps: Requires one of these Crystal War quests finished: Bonds of Mythril, Face of the Future, or At Journey's End.
Go to Southern San d'Oria [S] and examine the Lion Springs door to watch a cutscene. This completes the mission.
Reward: the next mission, By the Fading Light.

name: By the Fading Light
steps: Go to Xarcabard [S] and talk to Rally Point: Red to watch a cutscene. This completes the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Edge of Existence.

name: Edge of Existence
steps: Examine a Cavernous Maw in any of these zones: Batallia Downs, Rolanberry Fields, Sauromugue Champaign, or their [S] versions.
Watch the cutscene; this completes the mission and takes you through the Maw.
Reward: the next mission, Her Memories.

name: Her Memories
steps: This mission has no steps of its own; it is completed by Crystal War 'Her Memories' side quests.
Collect all four Large Memory Fragment key items: #1 from Her Memories: Homecoming Queen, #2 from Her Memories: Of Malign Maladies, #3 from Her Memories: Operation Cupid.
Get Large Memory Fragment #4 from either Her Memories: Azure Footfalls or Her Memories: Carnelian Footfalls.
When you hold all four fragments you are told to report to Cait Sith and the mission completes automatically.
Reward: the next mission, Forget Me Not.

name: Forget Me Not
steps: Examine a Cavernous Maw in Batallia Downs, Rolanberry Fields, Sauromugue Champaign, or one of their [S] versions, and watch the cutscene.
You are taken to Grauberg [S]; watch the cutscene on arrival.
You are then sent out through the other era's version of the Maw zone you used. Example: enter from Batallia Downs and you come out in Batallia Downs [S], and the other way round.
Arriving there completes the mission and removes your four Large Memory Fragments.
Reward: the next mission, Pillar of Hope.

name: Pillar of Hope
steps: Go to Grauberg [S] and examine the Veridical Conflux to watch a cutscene.
When asked, choose to proceed to complete the mission (declining lets you try again later).
Reward: the next mission, Glimmer of Life (available after the next game day and after you change zones).

name: Glimmer of Life
steps: If the previous mission set a wait, wait until the next Vana'diel day and leave/re-enter Grauberg [S] (zone) before continuing.
Go to the Veridical Conflux in Grauberg [S] and talk to it to watch the cutscene. You do not need to remove your weapons.
Reward: the next mission, Time Slips Away, opens.

name: Time Slips Away
steps: Obtain 1 Punch Bug (this mission's script does not say where).
Go to the Veridical Conflux in Grauberg [S] and trade it the Punch Bug (exactly 1) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: key item Bottled Punch Bug; next mission When Wills Collide opens.

name: When Wills Collide
steps: Make sure you have the key item Bottled Punch Bug. If you lost it, trade 1 Punch Bug to the Veridical Conflux in Grauberg [S] to get it again.
Talk to the Veridical Conflux in Grauberg [S] and choose to travel; you are sent to the Walk of Echoes.
In the Walk of Echoes, click the Ornate Door to watch a cutscene.
Enter the battle behind the Ornate Door (needs Bottled Punch Bug, which is used up on entry) and win. This server's script has not finished the battle entry (marked TODO), so it may not start.
After you win, you return to the Walk of Echoes and a cutscene plays that completes the mission.
Reward: the next mission, Whispers of Dawn, opens.

name: Whispers of Dawn
steps: Talk to the Veridical Conflux in Grauberg [S] and watch the cutscene.
When the cutscene gives you a choice, pick the option that agrees to go on. If you pick the other option, nothing happens and you can talk to it again.
Reward: the next mission, A Dreamy Interlude, opens (you must wait until the next Vana'diel day and leave the zone before it continues).

name: A Dreamy Interlude
steps: Wait until the next Vana'diel day after Whispers of Dawn, and leave/re-enter Grauberg [S] once.
Talk to the Veridical Conflux in Grauberg [S] to watch the cutscene. If it's too early, you only get a short reminder scene.
Reward: the next mission, Cait in the Woods, opens.

name: Cait in the Woods
steps: Go to East Ronfaure [S] and find the blank spot where Cait Sith appears (around !pos 221 -49 176). Click it to watch the cutscene.
Reward: key item Ronfaure Dawndrop; next mission Fork in the Road opens.

name: Fork in the Road
steps: Keep your Ronfaure Dawndrop. You must collect a Dawndrop from a blank spot in each of 7 places; you can visit them in any order.
Jugner Forest [S]: click the blank spot (around !pos 46 0 309) to get the Jugner Dawndrop.
La Vaule [S]: click the blank spot (around !pos 295 3 -217) to get the La Vaule Dawndrop.
Southern San d'Oria [S]: click the blank spot (around !pos 89 1 100) to get the San d'Oria Dawndrop.
Beaucedine Glacier [S] (around !pos -70 -40 -193) and Xarcabard [S] (around !pos -108 -26 -53): click the blank spot in each to get their Dawndrops.
Throne Room [S] (around !pos 19 0 -4) and Walk of Echoes (around !pos -702 0 -482): click the blank spot in each to get their Dawndrops.
After the 7th Dawndrop, the Dawndrops merge into Primal Glow.
Reward: key item Primal Glow; next mission Maiden of the Dusk opens.

name: Maiden of the Dusk
steps: Talk to the Veridical Conflux in Grauberg [S] (around !pos -142 -7 585) and pick the option that agrees to go. You are sent to the Walk of Echoes. If you decline, talk to it again later.
A cutscene plays when you arrive in the Walk of Echoes.
Click the Ornate Door in the Walk of Echoes (around !pos -700 -20 -303) to watch another cutscene.
To fight, you need the key item Primal Glow (used up when you enter). Talk to the Veridical Conflux in Grauberg [S] to get it; after the first time you can only get it again once per Vana'diel day.
BLOCKED: this server cannot run the battle. The Ornate Door has no battle entry after its cutscene (marked TODO), and there is no battlefield script for this fight, so the mission stops here.
If the battle were won, more cutscenes would play in the Walk of Echoes, each moving you to a new spot, and the last one would complete the mission.
Reward: key item Moonshade Earring; next mission Where It All Began opens.

name: Where It All Began
steps: Go to Southern San d'Oria [S] and click the Lion Springs door (around !pos 96 0 106) to watch the cutscene.
Reward: key item Wedding Invitation; next mission A Token of Troth opens.

name: Token of Troth
steps: Take off your main-hand and off-hand (sub) weapons. The gate will not let you continue while you hold them.
Go to Sauromugue Champaign [S] and click the Bulwark Gate (around !pos -447 -2 342) to watch the first cutscene.
Click the Bulwark Gate again, still with no weapons, to watch the second cutscene. Your Wedding Invitation is taken.
Reward: the next mission, Lest We Forget, opens.

name: Lest We Forget
steps: Requires finishing A Token of Troth. Free up at least 1 inventory slot.

Talk to the Veridical Conflux in Grauberg [S] (around !pos -142 -7 585). In the cutscene, pick a first bonus: Accuracy, Attack, Ranged Accuracy, Ranged Attack, Magic Accuracy or Magic Attack Bonus +4, or HP or MP +25.
Pick a second bonus (Regain, Refresh, TP-based damage, TP Bonus, magic accuracy, faster casting, Counter or status resistance), then confirm to receive the Moonshade Earring.

Optional reset, only if you no longer have the earring: zone into Grauberg [S] without a Moonshade Earring, then click the ??? (qm_reset) and agree. If you decline, you must leave and re-enter the zone before it responds again.
Agreeing sends you back to Maiden of the Dusk (at the Ornate Door step) with Primal Glow. Note that on this server that mission's battle cannot be started.
Reward: Moonshade Earring with the bonuses you picked. This is the last Wings of the Goddess mission in this script.

name: The New Frontier
steps: Requires your nation rank 6 or higher; this mission is given after the Nation 5-1 Shadow Lord battle.
Travel to Norg and zone in to watch the arrival cutscene; the mission completes when it ends.
Reward: key item Map of Norg; next mission Welcome t'Norg opens.

name: Welcome t'Norg
steps: In Norg, examine the Oaken Door near (97, -7, -12).
Watch the cutscene through to the end (do not cancel it); the mission completes.
Reward: next mission Kazham's Chieftainess opens.

name: Kazham's Chieftainess
steps: Optional: talk to Gilgamesh in Norg near (122, -9, -12) for dialogue about your next goal.
Travel to Kazham and talk to Jakoh Wahcondalo near (101, -16, -115).
Watch the cutscene; the mission completes when it ends.
Reward: key item Sacrificial Chamber Key; next mission The Temple of Uggalepih opens.

name: The Temple of Uggalepih
steps: Have the Sacrificial Chamber Key from the previous mission. Optional dialogue: Gilgamesh in Norg, Jakoh Wahcondalo in Kazham.
Go to Sacrificial Chamber and enter the battle at the Mahogany Door near (299, 0, 349). Level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30-minute limit, trusts allowed.
Defeat Grav'iton, Molyb'iton and Tungs'iton (one group of three); Tonberry's Elemental and Tonberry's Avatar may also appear.
After winning, watch the two cutscenes in Sacrificial Chamber; the mission completes after the second one and the Sacrificial Chamber Key is removed.
Reward: key item Dark Fragment and title Bearer of the Wisewoman's Hope; next mission Headstone Pilgrimage opens.

name: Headstone Pilgrimage
steps: Collect 7 fragments by examining each Cermet Headstone and choosing to touch it. Optional: Gilgamesh in Norg gives hints.
No fight: La Theine Plateau (-170, 39, -504) Water Fragment; Cloister of Frost (566, 0, 606) Ice Fragment; Western Altepa Desert (-108, 10, -216) Earth Fragment.
Behemoth's Dominion (-74, -4, -87): touching it spawns Ancient Weapon and Legendary Weapon. Defeat both, then examine the headstone again to get the Lightning Fragment.
Cape Teriggan (-107, -8, 450): defeat Axesarion the Wanderer, then examine the headstone again for the Wind Fragment (this also starts the quest Wandering Souls).
The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah (235, 0, 280): defeat Doomed Pilgrims, then examine the headstone again for the Light Fragment (this also starts the quest Soul Searching).
Yuhtunga Jungle (491, 20, 301): defeat Tipha and Carthi, then examine the headstone again for the Fire Fragment (this also starts the quest Wrath of the Opo-opos).
The mission completes as soon as you hold all 7 fragments.
Reward: title Bearer of the Eight Prayers; next mission Through the Quicksand Caves opens.

name: Through the Quicksand Caves
steps: Optional: talk to Gilgamesh in Norg for directions.
Reach the Chamber of Oracles and enter the battle at the Shimmering Circle near (-220, 0, 12). Level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30-minute limit, trusts allowed.
Defeat Centurio V-III, Triarius V-VIII and Princeps V-XI.
Win the battle; the mission completes when you leave the battlefield.
Reward: next mission The Chamber of Oracles opens.

name: The Chamber of Oracles
steps: Bring all 8 fragments (Fire, Ice, Wind, Earth, Lightning, Water, Light, Dark) to the Chamber of Oracles.
Examine each of the 8 pedestals (Fire, Ice, Wind, Earth, Lightning, Water, Light, Darkness) to place the matching fragment.
After the eighth fragment a cutscene plays; if it gets interrupted, examine any pedestal again to replay it. The fragments are removed when it ends.
Reward: key item Prismatic Fragment and title Lightweaver; next mission Return to Delkfutt's Tower opens.

name: Return to Delkfutt's Tower
steps: Optional: talk to Gilgamesh in Norg and Aldo in Lower Jeuno near (20, 3, -58) for story cutscenes.
Go through Delkfutt's Tower (entering Lower Delkfutt's Tower plays an optional cutscene) and reach the Stellar Fulcrum.
Zone into the Stellar Fulcrum and watch the pre-battle cutscene.
Enter the battle at the Qe'Lov Gate near (-520, -4, 17). Level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30-minute limit. Defeat Kam'lanaut.
After winning you return to the Stellar Fulcrum; the cutscene there completes the mission.
Reward: next mission Ro'Maeve opens.

name: Ro'Maeve
steps: Optional: talk to Aldo in Lower Jeuno near (20, 3, -58) for a story cutscene.
Go to Norg and examine the Oaken Door near (97, -7, -12).
Watch the cutscene through to the end (do not cancel it); the mission completes.
Reward: next mission The Temple of Desolation opens.

name: The Temple of Desolation
steps: Optional: talk to Gilgamesh and Kamui in Norg, or Aldo in Lower Jeuno, for hints.
Go to the Hall of the Gods and examine the door (_6z0) near (0, -12, 48).
Watch the cutscene; the mission completes when it ends.
Reward: title Sealer of the Portal of the Gods; next mission The Hall of the Gods opens.

name: The Hall of the Gods
steps: Optional: examining the door in the Hall of the Gods only gives a clue, and Aldo in Lower Jeuno has dialogue.
Go to Norg and examine the Oaken Door near (97, -7, -12).
Watch the cutscene through to the end (do not cancel it); the mission completes.
Reward: next mission The Mithra and the Crystal opens.

name: The Mithra and the Crystal
steps: Optional: talk to Aldo in Lower Jeuno and Gilgamesh in Norg for story scenes.
Go to Rabao, talk to Maryoh Comyujah near (0, 8, 73) and agree to help (accept in the cutscene; declining lets you ask again).
In Quicksand Caves, examine the ??? (qm7) near (-504, 20, -419) while standing right next to it; Ancient Vessel appears and attacks.
Defeat Ancient Vessel, then examine the ??? again (stand close) to get the key item Scrap of Papyrus. If the Vessel was just killed by someone else, wait about 5 minutes.
Return to Maryoh Comyujah in Rabao; she takes the Scrap of Papyrus and gives you the key item Cerulean Crystal.
Go to the Hall of the Gods and step on the Shimmering Circle to watch the final cutscene.
Reward: next mission The Gate of the Gods opens.

name: The Gate of the Gods
steps: In the Hall of the Gods, step on the Shimmering Circle near (0, -20, 147) to travel to Ru'Aun Gardens.
Zone into Ru'Aun Gardens and watch the cutscene; the mission completes when it ends.
Reward: next mission Ark Angels opens.

name: Ark Angels
steps: Optional: talk to Gilgamesh in Norg for hints.
In The Shrine of Ru'Avitau, examine the blank_divine_might spot near (-40, 0, -151) and watch the cutscene to unlock the fights.

In La'Loff Amphitheater, five ??? entrances each start a fight (level cap 75, up to 6 players, 30 minutes): qm1_1 Ark Angel HM, qm1_2 Ark Angel TT, qm1_3 Ark Angel MR, qm1_4 Ark Angel EV, qm1_5 Ark Angel GK.
Each win gives one key item: Shard of Apathy (HM), Cowardice (TT), Envy (MR), Arrogance (EV), Rage (GK). You can only enter a fight whose shard you do not have yet.
Alternative: win the Divine Might battle (up to 18 players, cap 99) from any of the five entrances to get all five shards at once.
The mission completes when you hold all five shards.
Reward: next mission The Sealed Shrine opens.

name: The Sealed Shrine
steps: Go to Norg and examine the Oaken Door, then pick the first option in the cutscene to continue.
Optional: talk to Gilgamesh in Norg for an extra cutscene.
Optional: talk to Aldo in Lower Jeuno for a story cutscene.
Travel to The Shrine of Ru'Avitau and enter the zone (main entrance); a cutscene plays on arrival and completes the mission.
Reward: unlocks the next Zilart mission, The Celestial Nexus.

name: The Celestial Nexus
steps: Requires The Sealed Shrine to be finished, so that The Celestial Nexus is your current Rise of the Zilart mission.
Optional: in Norg, talk to Gilgamesh (near !pos 122.5 -9.0 -12.1) for a scene. The script does not require it.
In The Celestial Nexus, enter the battlefield at the entrance door. Level cap 75, up to 6 players, trusts allowed, 30-minute limit, and no experience is lost if you fall.
Phase 1: Eald'narche starts out shielded and cannot be killed. Defeat Exoplates first. It changes form at about 66% and 33% HP and only dies after its third form change near 1%.

Once the fight starts, Eald'narche keeps calling two Orbitals and brings them back right after they die. They vanish when he dies, so do not waste time on them. With Exoplates gone his shields drop: defeat him.
A cutscene plays. When it ends, the phase 2 Eald'narche appears right away and attacks you after about 30 seconds. Defeat him to win the battlefield.
After the victory cutscene you are moved to the Hall of the Gods and the mission is complete.
Reward: title Burier of the Illusion; the next mission, Awakening, opens.

name: Awakening
steps: Zone into Norg to see the opening cutscene (shown once).
Go to Lower Jeuno and examine the door (_6tc) to see a second cutscene (shown once).
Optional: talk to Gilgamesh in Norg for a cutscene.
The script finishes the mission only in Norg cutscenes 232/234 after both scenes above, but nothing in this script starts those cutscenes, so the final step is missing.
Reward: unlocks the next Zilart mission, The Last Verse.

name: Fear of the Dark III
steps: Talk to Secodiand in Abyssea-La Theine and accept the quest (do not decline).
Obtain 3 Clionid Wings (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 3 Clionid Wings to Secodiand in Abyssea-La Theine.
Reward: 200 cruor and Abyssea-La Theine fame. Repeatable: you can trade 3 more Clionid Wings to Secodiand any time.

name: An Eye for Revenge
steps: Requires the Abyssea quest Lost Memories completed; until then Curilla only gives a short talk.
In Abyssea-La Theine, talk to Curilla (near -467,-3,-769) to accept the quest (this removes your Vial of Lambent Potion key item).
Obtain a Filthy Gnole Claw (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to the ??? at about (-85,24,-513) in Abyssea-La Theine to spawn Lugarhoo.
Defeat Lugarhoo to receive the key item Lugarhoo's Eyeball.
Return to Curilla in Abyssea-La Theine and talk to her to hand over the eyeball.
Reward: 800 cruor and the key item Scarlet Abyssite of Furtherance.

name: Lost Memories
steps: Requires Abyssea - La Theine fame level 5. With less fame, Halver only gives a short message.
Talk to Halver in Abyssea-La Theine and choose to accept the request in the cutscene.
Obtain 2 Lambent Scales (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade 2 Lambent Scales to Halver in Abyssea-La Theine.
Reward: 480 cruor and the key item Vial of Lambent Potion.

name: Altepa - Dominion Op #01
steps: Enter Abyssea-Altepa and talk to the Dominion Sergeant at Nanaa Mihgo's Camp; choose Dominion Op #01 from the menu to sign on (only one op can be active at a time).
Defeat 5 Sand Sweeper in Abyssea-Altepa; a message counts each kill (x/5).
Return to a Dominion Sergeant in Abyssea-Altepa and report the completed op (you can also cancel an op through the sergeant).
Reward: 1000 EXP (2% less per level below 75), 200 cruor and 100 Dominion Notes.

Return to a Dominion Sergeant in Abyssea-Uleguerand and report to complete the op.
Reward: 1,000 EXP (2% less for each level you are below 75), 200 cruor and 100 Dominion Notes. You can sign on for this op again.

name: A Journey Begins
steps: Requires main job level 30; the quest is flagged automatically when Abyssea is enabled on the server.
Enter Port Jeuno to watch a cutscene.
Talk to Joachim in Port Jeuno to finish the quest; this also starts The Truth Beckons.
Reward: key item Traverser Stone.

name: The Truth Beckons
steps: This quest is added automatically when you finish A Journey Begins. (Talking to Joachim in Port Jeuno before the next step only plays a reminder scene.)
Enter any Abyssea area: Konschtat, La Theine, Tahrongi, Attohwa, Misareaux, Vunkerl, Altepa, Uleguerand or Grauberg. Simply zoning in counts.
Return to Joachim in Port Jeuno (near position -53, 0, -10) and watch the cutscene to complete the quest. Dawn of Death is added to your log.
Reward: no items; completing it unlocks Dawn of Death.

name: Dawn of Death
steps: Requires finishing The Truth Beckons, which starts this quest.

Complete any 3 of the 9 Abyssea zone quests: A Goldstruck Gigas, To Paste a Peiste, Megadrile Menace, The Beast of Bastore, A Delectable Demon, A Fluttery Fiend, A Beaked Blusterer, A Man-Eating Mite, An Ulcerous Uragnite.
Talk to Joachim in Port Jeuno and watch the cutscene.
Reward: none listed; the quest completes and First Contact begins.

name: A Goldstruck Gigas
steps: Requires at least 1 Traverser Stone and the quest Dawn of Death accepted.
Examine the Cavernous Maw in La Theine Plateau to accept the quest.
Enter Abyssea-La Theine and defeat the notorious monster Briareus to earn the title Briareus Feller.
Zone back into La Theine Plateau; a cutscene plays on arrival and the quest completes.
Reward: one Abyssite key item that depends on how many Cavernous Maw quests you have finished (first one: Lunar Abyssite, then Ivory Abyssite of Fortune, Acumen, the Reaper, and so on).

name: To Paste a Peiste
steps: Requires at least 1 Traverser Stone key item and Dawn of Death already started.
Examine the Cavernous Maw in Konschtat Highlands and watch the cutscene to accept the quest.
Obtain the key items Tattered Hippogryph Wing, Cracked Wivre Horn and Mucid Ahriman Eyeball (this quest's script does not say where).
In Abyssea-Konschtat, examine the ??? spawn point while carrying all three key items to make the monster Kukulkan appear.
Defeat Kukulkan. You earn the title Kukulkan Defanger.
Leave Abyssea and enter Konschtat Highlands. A cutscene plays and the quest completes.
Reward: one abyssite key item, based on how many of the 9 Cavernous Maw quests you have done (1st: Lunar Abyssite, 2nd: Ivory Abyssite of Fortune, 3rd: Ivory Abyssite of Acumen, and so on).

name: Megadrile Menace
steps: Requires at least 1 Traverser Stone key item and Dawn of Death already started.
Examine the Cavernous Maw in Tahrongi Canyon and watch the cutscene to accept the quest. You also receive 50 cruor.
Obtain the key items Luxuriant Manticore Mane, Fat-Lined Cockatrice Skin, Sticky Gnat Wing and Sodden Sandworm Husk (this quest's script does not say where).
In Abyssea-Tahrongi, examine the ??? spawn point while carrying all four key items to make the monster Glavoid appear.
Defeat Glavoid. You earn the title Glavoid Stampeder.
Leave Abyssea and enter Tahrongi Canyon. A cutscene plays and the quest completes.
Reward: one abyssite key item, based on how many of the 9 Cavernous Maw quests you have done (1st: Lunar Abyssite, 2nd: Ivory Abyssite of Fortune, 3rd: Ivory Abyssite of Acumen, and so on).

name: The Forbidden Frontier
steps: Start (flag) any one of these quests: A Goldstruck Gigas, To Paste a Peiste or Megadrile Menace.
Talk to Joachim in Port Jeuno and watch the cutscene to accept The Forbidden Frontier.
Complete all three quests: A Goldstruck Gigas, To Paste a Peiste and Megadrile Menace.
Return to Joachim in Port Jeuno and watch the cutscene to complete the quest.
Reward: none listed in the script.

name: First Contact
steps: Not completable on this server: the ??? (qm3) in La Theine Plateau should play this quest's cutscene at night (18:00-5:00), but the script asks for an hour that is both 18:00 or later and before 5:00. No hour passes that check, so the ??? never plays it and An Officer and a Pirate never starts.

name: An Officer and a Pirate
steps: Flagged automatically on completing the Abyssea quest First Contact.
In Port Jeuno, talk to Joachim (near -52,0,-9) and watch the cutscene.
Reward: no items; completing it flags the quest Heart of Madness.

name: Heart of Madness
steps: This quest is added automatically when you finish An Officer and a Pirate.

Finish any 5 of the 9 Cavernous Maw quests: A Goldstruck Gigas, To Paste a Peiste, Megadrile Menace, The Beast of Bastore, A Delectable Demon, A Fluttery Fiend, A Beaked Blusterer, A Man-Eating Mite, An Ulcerous Uragnite.
Talk to Joachim in Port Jeuno and watch the cutscene to complete the quest. Tenuous Existence is added to your log.
Reward: no items; completing it unlocks Tenuous Existence.

name: Tenuous Existence
steps: Cannot be completed on this server: the ??? step's time check (hour 18 or later AND before 5) can never be true, so Joachim's final cutscene is never reached.
This quest is added automatically when you finish Heart of Madness.
Intended step: examine the ??? in La Theine Plateau (near position -179, 8, 254) between 18:00 and 5:00 Vana'diel time. On this server it will not respond.
Intended step: return to Joachim in Port Jeuno (near position -53, 0, -10) and watch the cutscene; this would complete the quest and add Champions of Abyssea.
Reward: no items; completing it would unlock Champions of Abyssea.

name: Champions of Abyssea
steps: Requires finishing Tenuous Existence, which starts this quest.

Complete any 7 of the 9 Abyssea zone quests: A Goldstruck Gigas, To Paste a Peiste, Megadrile Menace, The Beast of Bastore, A Delectable Demon, A Fluttery Fiend, A Beaked Blusterer, A Man-Eating Mite, An Ulcerous Uragnite.
Talk to Joachim in Port Jeuno and watch the cutscene.
Reward: none listed; the quest completes and A Sea Dog's Summons begins.

name: The Beast of Bastore
steps: Requires at least 1 Traverser Stone key item and Dawn of Death already started.
Examine the Cavernous Maw in Jugner Forest and watch the cutscene to accept the quest.
Defeat the monster Sedna in Abyssea-Vunkerl to earn the title Sedna Tuskbreaker. Server gap: the code that lets Sedna's ??? spawn points summon it is disabled on this server.
Leave Abyssea and enter Jugner Forest. A cutscene plays and the quest completes.
Reward: one abyssite key item, based on how many of the 9 Cavernous Maw quests you have done (1st: Lunar Abyssite, 2nd: Ivory Abyssite of Fortune, 3rd: Ivory Abyssite of Acumen, and so on).

name: A Delectable Demon
steps: Requires at least 1 Traverser Stone and the quest Dawn of Death accepted.
Examine the Cavernous Maw in Valkurm Dunes to accept the quest.
Enter Abyssea-Misareaux and defeat the notorious monster Cirein-croin to earn the title Cirein-croin Harpooner.
Zone back into Valkurm Dunes; a cutscene plays on arrival and the quest completes.
Reward: one Abyssite key item that depends on how many Cavernous Maw quests you have finished (first one: Lunar Abyssite, then Ivory Abyssite of Fortune, Acumen, the Reaper, and so on).

name: A Fluttery Fiend
steps: Requires at least 1 Traverser Stone and the quest Dawn of Death accepted.
Examine the Cavernous Maw in Buburimu Peninsula to accept the quest.
Enter Abyssea-Attohwa and defeat the notorious monster Itzpapalotl to earn the title Itzpapalotl Declawer.
Zone back into Buburimu Peninsula; a cutscene plays on arrival and the quest completes.
Reward: one Abyssite key item that depends on how many Cavernous Maw quests you have finished (first one: Lunar Abyssite, then Ivory Abyssite of Fortune, Acumen, the Reaper, and so on).

name: Scars of Abyssea
steps: Start (flag) any one of these quests: The Beast of Bastore, A Delectable Demon or A Fluttery Fiend.
Talk to Joachim in Port Jeuno and watch the cutscene to accept Scars of Abyssea.
Complete all three quests: The Beast of Bastore, A Delectable Demon and A Fluttery Fiend.
Return to Joachim in Port Jeuno and watch the cutscene to complete the quest.
Reward: none listed in the script.

name: A_Beaked_Blusterer
steps: Requires at least 1 Traverser Stone and the quest Dawn of Death accepted or already completed.
Go to the Cavernous Maw in South Gustaberg (!pos 340 -0.5 -680) and examine it to watch the cutscene and accept the quest.
In Abyssea - Altepa, obtain the key item Resplendent Roc Quill (this quest's script does not say where).
Find one of the ??? spots for Bennu in Abyssea - Altepa (near !pos 91 -1 -140) and use it with the Resplendent Roc Quill to spawn the notorious monster Bennu.
Defeat Bennu. You earn the title Bennu Deplumer.
Return to South Gustaberg (zone in through the Cavernous Maw). A cutscene plays automatically and the quest completes.
Reward: an Abyssite key item. Which one depends on how many Abyssea zone quests you have finished: your first gives Lunar Abyssite, later ones give Ivory Abyssites.

name: A Man-eating Mite
steps: Requires at least one Traverser Stone key item and the Abyssea quest Dawn of Death accepted.
In Xarcabard, examine the Cavernous Maw and watch the cutscene to accept the quest.

Enter Abyssea-Uleguerand and defeat the notorious monster Resheph to earn the title Resheph Eradicator (its ??? spawn points near (433,-51,145) have their spawn code disabled in this server's scripts).
Return to Xarcabard; a cutscene plays as you zone in.
Reward: an Abyssite key item that depends on how many Cavernous Maw quests you have finished (first one: Lunar Abyssite).

name: An Ulcerous Uragnite
steps: Requires at least one Traverser Stone key item and the Abyssea quest Dawn of Death accepted.
In North Gustaberg, examine the Cavernous Maw (near -78,0,600) and watch the cutscene to accept the quest.
Enter Abyssea-Grauberg; obtain the key item Variegated Uragnite Shell (this quest's script does not say where).
Examine one of the ??? near (-147,-31,-220) in Abyssea-Grauberg with the shell to spawn Amphitrite, and defeat it to earn the title Amphitrite Shucker.
Return to North Gustaberg; a cutscene plays as you zone in.
Reward: an Abyssite key item that depends on how many Cavernous Maw quests you have finished (first one: Lunar Abyssite).

name: Heroes of Abyssea
steps: Start (flag) any one of these quests: An Ulcerous Uragnite, A Beaked Blusterer or A Man-Eating Mite.
Talk to Joachim in Port Jeuno and watch the cutscene to accept Heroes of Abyssea.
Complete all three quests: An Ulcerous Uragnite, A Beaked Blusterer and A Man-Eating Mite.
Return to Joachim in Port Jeuno and watch the cutscene to complete the quest.
Reward: none listed in the script.

name: A Sea Dog's Summons
steps: Flagged automatically when you complete the Abyssea quest Champions of Abyssea.

Intended step: zone into Hall of the Gods between 18:00 and 5:00 Vana'diel time to see a cutscene. On this server the time check (hour >= 18 AND hour < 5) can never pass, so the cutscene will not play.
Because of that bug, this quest cannot be completed on this server, and Death and Rebirth is never flagged.
Reward (if fixed): no items; completing it flags the quest Death and Rebirth.

name: Death and Rebirth
steps: Requires finishing A Sea Dog's Summons, which starts this quest.

Complete all 9 Abyssea zone quests: A Goldstruck Gigas, To Paste a Peiste, Megadrile Menace, The Beast of Bastore, A Delectable Demon, A Fluttery Fiend, A Beaked Blusterer, A Man-Eating Mite, An Ulcerous Uragnite.
Talk to Joachim in Port Jeuno and watch the cutscene.
Enter Hall of the Gods between 18:00 and 5:00 Vana'diel time (night) to see a cutscene as you arrive. If it is daytime, leave and come back at night.
Reward: none listed; the quest completes and Emissaries of God begins.

name: Emissaries of God
steps: Requires finishing Death and Rebirth, which starts this quest.

Earn all 6 caturae titles by defeating these notorious monsters: Iratham (Abyssea-Tahrongi), Kutharei (Abyssea-Misareaux), Sippoy (Abyssea-Vunkerl), Yaanei (Abyssea-Attohwa), Rani (Abyssea-Altepa), Raja (Abyssea-Grauberg).
Talk to Joachim in Port Jeuno and watch the cutscene. You receive the key item Abyssite of Discernment.
Enter Hall of the Gods between 18:00 and 5:00 Vana'diel time (night) to see a cutscene as you arrive.
Reward: Abyssite of Discernment (from Joachim's cutscene); the quest completes and Beneath a Blood-red Sky begins.

name: Beneath a Blood Red Sky
steps: Flagged automatically when you complete the Abyssea quest Emissaries of God.
Requires the Crimson Traverser Stone key item, or at least 1 Traverser Stone and 10,000 cruor (this quest's script does not say where to get them). Without them the warp does nothing.
Go to the Transcendental Radiance in Qufim Island (near -259, -21, 220) and talk to it.
In the event, pick the accept option. Any other choice cancels the warp. First time: it takes 10,000 cruor and 1 Traverser Stone and gives you the Crimson Traverser Stone (later trips are free).
You are warped into Abyssea - Empyreal Paradox. Watch the cutscene when you arrive to finish the quest.
Reward: no items; completing it flags the quest The Wyrm God.

name: The Wyrm God
steps: This quest is added automatically when you finish Beneath a Blood Red Sky.
In Abyssea-Empyreal Paradox, examine the TR Entrance and watch the cutscene.
Enter The Wyrm God battle and defeat Shinryu. Server gap: the script marks the battle win as a TODO and has no battlefield ID for it, so a win may not count.
Talk to Prishe in Abyssea-Empyreal Paradox and watch the cutscene to complete the quest. Meanwhile, Back on Abyssea is added to your log.
Reward: no items; completing it unlocks Meanwhile, Back on Abyssea.

name: Meanwhile, Back on Abyssea
steps: This quest is added automatically when you finish The Wyrm God.
Talk to Joachim in Port Jeuno and watch the cutscene.
Enter Hall of the Gods between 18:00 and 5:00 Vana'diel time to trigger a cutscene. If you arrive outside those hours, leave and come back during them.
Go to Abyssea-Empyreal Paradox and talk to Prishe for the final cutscene. A Moonlight Requite is added, which marks the end of the main Abyssea story and cannot be completed.
Reward: key item Abyssite of the Cosmos.

name: Grauberg - Dominion Op #10
steps: In Abyssea-Grauberg, talk to the Dominion Sergeant (DSgt Cornelia, at Cornelia's Camp) and sign on to Dominion Op #10. You can only have one Dominion Op active at a time.
Defeat 5 Glen Crab in Abyssea-Grauberg. A message counts each kill (1/5, 2/5 ...).
Return to the Dominion Sergeant in Abyssea-Grauberg and report in to complete the op. Talking to the sergeant also lets you cancel the op instead.
Reward: 1,000 experience points (2% less for each level below 75), 200 cruor and 100 Dominion Notes. The op can be signed on to again.

name: Grauberg - Dominion Op #11
steps: In Abyssea-Grauberg, talk to the Dominion Sergeant (DSgt Tosuka, at Tosuka-Porika's Camp) and sign on to Dominion Op #11. You can only have one Dominion Op active at a time.
Defeat 5 Seelie in Abyssea-Grauberg. A message counts each kill (1/5, 2/5 ...).
Return to the Dominion Sergeant in Abyssea-Grauberg and report in to complete the op. Talking to the sergeant also lets you cancel the op instead.
Reward: 1,000 experience points (2% less for each level below 75), 200 cruor and 100 Dominion Notes. The op can be signed on to again.

name: Grauberg - Dominion Op #12
steps: In Abyssea-Grauberg, talk to the Dominion Sergeant (DSgt Tosuka, at Tosuka-Porika's Camp) and sign on to Dominion Op #12. You can only have one Dominion Op active at a time.
Defeat 5 Unseelie in Abyssea-Grauberg. A message counts each kill (1/5, 2/5 ...).
Return to the Dominion Sergeant in Abyssea-Grauberg and report in to complete the op. Talking to the sergeant also lets you cancel the op instead.
Reward: 1,000 experience points (2% less for each level below 75), 200 cruor and 100 Dominion Notes. The op can be signed on to again.

name: Grauberg - Dominion Op #13
steps: In Abyssea-Grauberg, talk to the Dominion Sergeant (DSgt Cornelia, at Cornelia's Camp) and sign on to Dominion Op #13. You can only have one Dominion Op active at a time.
Defeat 5 Goblin Plunderer in Abyssea-Grauberg. A message counts each kill (1/5, 2/5 ...).
Return to the Dominion Sergeant in Abyssea-Grauberg and report in to complete the op. Talking to the sergeant also lets you cancel the op instead.
Reward: 1,000 experience points (2% less for each level below 75), 200 cruor and 100 Dominion Notes. The op can be signed on to again.

name: Grauberg - Dominion Op #14
steps: In Abyssea-Grauberg, talk to the Dominion Sergeant (DSgt Cornelia, at Cornelia's Camp) and sign on to Dominion Op #14. You can only have one Dominion Op active at a time.
Defeat 5 Goblin Meatgrinder in Abyssea-Grauberg. A message counts each kill (1/5, 2/5 ...).
Return to the Dominion Sergeant in Abyssea-Grauberg and report in to complete the op. Talking to the sergeant also lets you cancel the op instead.
Reward: 1,000 experience points (2% less for each level below 75), 200 cruor and 100 Dominion Notes. The op can be signed on to again.

name: Flavors of Our Lives (Flavors_of_Our_Lives)
steps: Talk to Berghent near the Big Bridge in Western Adoulin (J-9) and choose to accept (if you refuse, talk to him again to get the offer back).
Talk to Masad inside the Mummers' Coalition in Western Adoulin.
Talk to Dewalt inside the Couriers' Coalition in Western Adoulin.
Go to Rala Waterways and talk to Chalvava at (F-11).
Obtain a Sickle (this quest's script does not say where), go to Yahse Hunting Grounds and trade it to a Harvesting Point to get the key item Blightberry.
Return to Berghent in Western Adoulin to finish.
Reward: 300 bayld, 500 experience points, title Potation Pathfinder.

name: Breaking the Ice
steps: Talk to Traiffeaux in Kamihr Drifts and pick the accept option in the cutscene (the second choice that starts the quest).
Obtain 3 Rabbit Hides and 1 Raaz Tusk (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade Traiffeaux in Kamihr Drifts exactly 3 Rabbit Hides and 1 Raaz Tusk together.
Reward: 500 bayld, Adoulin fame +20, key item Pair of Fuzzy Earmuffs, and you learn Fragmenting (key item).

name: I'm on a Boat
steps: Talk to Choubollet in Foret de Hennetiel (near !pos 380 -2 290) and watch the cutscene to accept the quest.
Obtain 3 Squares of Dhalmel Leather, 1 Umbril Ooze and 1 Twitherym Scale (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade exactly those 5 items to Choubollet. You receive the key item Watercraft.
Go to Castoff Point 5 in Foret de Hennetiel, examine it and choose the option to set off. One ride is enough: the message says you have figured out the boat. Castoff Point 4 is optional.
Return to Choubollet and talk to him. Watch the cutscene; Watercraft is swapped for the key item Watercrafting, which lets you use Castoff Points in Adoulin areas.
Reward: 500 bayld, Adoulin fame, key item Watercrafting.

name: A Stone's Throw Away
steps: Talk to Apolliane in Morimar Basalt Fields to accept the quest.

Mine a Marble Nugget in Morimar Basalt Fields. Note: the script says Morimar Basalt Fields mining (HELM) is not implemented yet, so the progress flag this quest needs is never set and the turn-in cannot currently succeed.
Trade Apolliane in Morimar Basalt Fields exactly one Marble Nugget (only accepted after the mining step has been recorded).
Reward: 500 bayld, Adoulin fame +20, and you learn Demolishing (key item).

name: Hide and Go Peak
steps: Examine the Toppled Tree in Marjami Ravine to start the quest.
Examine the Velkk Cache in Marjami Ravine to get the key item Large Strip of Velkk Hide.
Return to the Toppled Tree in Marjami Ravine and examine it again (the hide is used up).
Examine Scalable Area 2 in Marjami Ravine to finish the quest.
Reward: 500 bayld, Adoulin fame +20, key item Pair of Velkk Gloves, and you learn Climbing (key item), which lets you use Scalable Areas across Adoulin's frontier zones.

name: Hunger Strikes
steps: Talk to Westerly Breeze in Western Adoulin to accept the quest.
Obtain one Bowl of Wisdom Soup (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade Westerly Breeze exactly one Bowl of Wisdom Soup. Note: in this script the turn-in handlers are not attached to Western Adoulin, so the trade may not be recognized on this server.
Reward: 500 bayld, 1,000 experience points, Adoulin fame +20; unlocks The Starving after the next Vana'diel day.

name: A Certain Substitute Patrolman
steps: Requires reaching the Seekers of Adoulin mission Life on the Frontier.
Talk to Rising Solstice in Western Adoulin to accept the quest; you receive the key item Western Adoulin Patrol Route.
Patrol Western Adoulin by talking to these NPCs in this exact order (each only responds when it is their turn): Zaoso, Clemmar, Kongramm, Virsaint.
Continue the patrol in order: Shipilolo, then Dangueubert, then Nylene (all in Western Adoulin).
Return to Rising Solstice in Western Adoulin to finish; the Western Adoulin Patrol Route key item is taken back.
Reward: 500 bayld, 1,000 experience points, Adoulin fame.

name: It Sets My Heart Aflutter (It_Sets_My_Heart_Aflutter)
steps: Requires the key item Pioneer's Badge.
Talk to Saldinor in Rala Waterways and choose to accept the quest.
Obtain 2 Twitherym Wings (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade Saldinor in Rala Waterways exactly 2 Twitherym Wings.
Repeatable: this is part 1 of 3 of an Adoulin fame cycle (then A Good Pair of Crocs with Felmsy and A Shot in the Dark with Pudith in Eastern Adoulin); after the cycle you can repeat it.
Reward: 200 bayld, 500 experience points, Adoulin fame +6.

name: Transporting
steps: Requires Adoulin fame level 2.
Talk to Vaulois in Western Adoulin to accept; you receive the key item Misdelivered Parcel.
Talk to Kongramm in Western Adoulin.
Go to Rala Waterways and examine the sluice gate marker (qm_sluice_gate_6); the Misdelivered Parcel is handed over.
Return to Vaulois in Western Adoulin to finish.
Reward: 300 bayld, 1,000 experience points, Adoulin fame +20.

name: The Starving
steps: If you just finished Hunger Strikes, wait until the next Vana'diel day.
Talk to Westerly Breeze in Western Adoulin to accept the quest.
Obtain one Bottle of Goblin Drink (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade Westerly Breeze exactly one Bottle of Goblin Drink. Note: in this script the turn-in handlers are not attached to Western Adoulin, so the trade may not be recognized on this server.
Reward: 1,000 experience points, 500 bayld, Adoulin fame +20; Always More Quoth the Ravenous opens after zoning and the next Vana'diel day.

name: The Longest Way Round...
steps: Requires reaching the Seekers of Adoulin mission Life on the Frontier.
Talk to Vastran in Eastern Adoulin to accept the quest; you receive the key item Eastern Adoulin Patrol Route.
Patrol Eastern Adoulin by talking to these NPCs in this exact order (each only responds on their turn): Fostaig, Lamaron, Irate Destrier, Nhili Uvolep.
Continue the patrol in order: Ploh Trishbahk, then Cunegonde, then Ndah Tolohjin (all in Eastern Adoulin).
Return to Vastran in Eastern Adoulin to finish; the patrol route key item is taken back.
Reward: 500 bayld, 1,000 experience points, Adoulin fame +20.

name: A Good Pair of Crocs (A_Good_Pair_of_Crocs)
steps: Talk to Felmsy in Eastern Adoulin and choose to accept the quest.
Obtain one Velkk Necklace or one Velkk Mask (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade Felmsy in Eastern Adoulin exactly one Velkk Necklace or one Velkk Mask (nothing else in the trade).
Repeatable: this is part 2 of 3 of an Adoulin fame cycle (It Sets My Heart Aflutter, then this, then A Shot in the Dark); after finishing the cycle you can talk to Felmsy again to repeat it.
Reward: 200 bayld, 500 experience points, Adoulin fame +6.

name: A Shot in the Dark (A_Shot_in_the_Dark)
steps: Talk to Pudith in Eastern Adoulin and choose to accept the quest.
Obtain one Umbril Ooze (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade Pudith in Eastern Adoulin exactly one Umbril Ooze.
Repeatable: this is part 3 of 3 of an Adoulin fame cycle (It Sets My Heart Aflutter, A Good Pair of Crocs, then this); after finishing it the cycle starts over with Saldinor in Rala Waterways.
Reward: 200 bayld, 500 experience points, Adoulin fame +6.

name: Dances with Luopans
steps: Requires main job level 30 or higher.
Talk to Sylvie in Western Adoulin and choose to accept (if you declined, talk to her again to get the offer back).

Go to the Ergon Locus in your home nation's field zone (San d'Oria: La Theine Plateau, Bastok: Konschtat Highlands, Windurst: Tahrongi Canyon) and examine it for the key item Fistful of Homeland Soil.
Obtain a Petrified Log (this quest's script does not say where), then trade it to Sylvie in Western Adoulin while holding the soil; you receive the key item Luopan.
Go to Ceizak Battlegrounds or Yahse Hunting Grounds and walk until you get an 'uncanny sensation' message marking a locus area.
Stay in that spot and rest (/heal); after a random wait of up to 8 minutes you get a 'mystical warmth' message. Leaving the area or standing up resets the wait.
Return to Sylvie in Western Adoulin to finish the quest.
Reward: Geomancer job unlocked, Plate of Indi-Poison, Matre Bell, key item Job Gesture: Geomancer. A lost Matre Bell can be rebought from Sylvie as a Geomancer for 300,000 gil or 150,000 bayld.

name: Lerene's Lament
steps: Talk to Lerene in Outer Ra'Kaznar and pick the accept option in the cutscene (the second choice that starts the quest).
Obtain 2 Squares of Ancestral Cloth (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade Lerene in Outer Ra'Kaznar exactly 2 Squares of Ancestral Cloth.
Reward: 500 bayld, Adoulin fame +20, key item Lerene's Paten, and you learn Pulverizing (key item).

name: Keeping Notes
steps: Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to Ahkk Jharcham (!pos 0.1 -1 -76) to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Sheet of Parchment and 1 Jar of Black Ink (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Sheet of Parchment and the Jar of Black Ink together to Ahkk Jharcham to finish the quest.
Reward: unlocks a new Mog House feature (the script sets a Mog House flag); no item reward is listed.

name: Arts and Crafts
steps: Talk to Hadahda in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and accept the quest (pick the accepting answer).
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to each of these 7 NPCs once: Mhasbaf, Mathlouq, Zabahf, Ekhu Pesshyadha, Qutiba, Balakaf and Matifa.
Return to Hadahda and talk to him to receive a Bowl of Sutlac.
Trade the Bowl of Sutlac back to Hadahda.
Reward: Imperial Silver Piece.

name: Olduum
steps: Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to Dkhaaya (!pos -73 -1 -6) to accept the quest and receive the key item Dkhaaya's Research Journal.
Obtain a Pickaxe (this quest's script does not say where); bring spares.
