Go to Aydeewa Subterrane and trade 1 Pickaxe to the Excavation Site (!pos 390 1 349). It works half the time and the Pickaxe is used up either way; repeat until you get Electrocell, Electropot or Electrolocomotive.
Return to Dkhaaya in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to him to finish the quest.
Reward: Lightning Band.

Optional: in Wajaom Woodlands, trade the Lightning Band to the Leypoint (!pos -200 -8.5 80) to get an Olduum Ring. If you lose the ring, mine a new key item and bring it to Dkhaaya for another Lightning Band.

name: Got It All
steps: In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Tehf Kimasnahya (!pos -89.9 -1 6.2) to accept the quest.
Talk to Ekhu Pesshyadha (!pos -13 1 103.4) in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Talk to Zabahf (!pos -90 -1 10.1), next to Tehf Kimasnahya.
Talk to Ekhu Pesshyadha again to receive the key item Vial of Luminous Water.
Talk to Tehf Kimasnahya and pick the first option in the cutscene to hand over the Vial of Luminous Water.
Walk to the spot around !pos 60 0 -67 in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to trigger a cutscene.
Talk to Tehf Kimasnahya again.
Wait until after the next JST midnight (Japan time) and change zones, then talk to Tehf Kimasnahya to finish.
Reward: Bibiki Seashell.

name: An Empty Vessel (BLU Unlock)
steps: Requires your main job at level 30 or higher.
Talk to Waoud in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a divination test and answer all 10 questions correctly. The script only makes the offer after a perfect score and does not name the right answers.
If you score under 10, you can pay 1,000 gil for the reading. Then wait one Vana'diel day and zone before you try again.
After a perfect score, accept Waoud's offer. Then wait one Vana'diel day, zone, and talk to Waoud again for a hint cutscene.
Talk to Waoud again. He asks for one random item: a Siren's Tear, a Pinch of Valkurm Sunsand or a Dangruf Stone. Obtain it (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade that item to Waoud. He shows it back and keeps nothing.
Carry the item into Aydeewa Subterrane and walk to the cutscene spot to meet Yasfel (the script gives no location). Accept his offer; refusing deletes the quest.
Reward: Blue Mage job unlocked, key items Mark of Zahak and Job Gesture: Blue Mage, title Bearer of the Mark of Zahak. You return to Whitegate; talk to Waoud once more for a follow-up scene.

name: Luck of the Draw
steps: Requires level 30 or higher (Corsair job unlock quest).
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Ratihb (!pos 75.2 -6 -137.2) to accept the quest.
Talk to Mafwahb (!pos 149.1 -2 -2.7) in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Go to Arrapago Reef and examine the ??? on the boat at (H-10) (!pos 468.8 -12.3 111.8) to see a cutscene.
Go to Talacca Cove and examine the ??? (!pos -62.2 -8 -137.1) to receive the key item Forgotten Hexagun.
In Talacca Cove, examine the Rock Slab (!pos -99 -7 -91) to finish the quest.
Reward: Corsair Die, key item Job Gesture: Corsair, title Seagull Phratrie Crew Member, and you can now become a Corsair.

name: No Strings Attached
steps: Requires level 30 or higher (Puppetmaster job unlock quest).
Go to Bastok Markets and talk to Shamarhaan (!pos -285.4 -13 -84.7).
Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to Iruki-Waraki (!pos 101.3 -7 -29) to accept the quest.
Talk to Ghatsad (!pos 34.3 -7.8 57.5) in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Go to Arrapago Reef and examine the ??? (!pos 457.1 -8.2 60.8) to receive the key item Antique Automaton.
Return to Ghatsad in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to him to hand over the Antique Automaton.
Wait one Vana'diel day, then talk to Ghatsad again.
Talk to Iruki-Waraki to finish; in the cutscene you choose your automaton's name.
Reward: Animator, key item Job Gesture: Puppetmaster, title Proud Automaton Owner, and you can now become a Puppetmaster. If you lose the Animator, trade Iruki-Waraki 10,000 gil for a new one.

name: Give Peace a Chance
steps: Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to Mishhar (!pos -12 -6 29) to accept the quest.
Go to Wajaom Woodlands and examine the ??? (qm8, !pos 416 -24 220) during Vana'diel night to see a cutscene.
Return to Mishhar in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to her.
Go to Mamook and examine the ??? (qm4, !pos 347 -12 -256) to see a cutscene.
Return to Mishhar in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to her to finish the quest.
Reward: Imperial Silver Piece. This unlocks the follow-up quest Moment of Truth.

name: A_Taste_of_Honey
steps: Finish the quest Vanishing Act first.
Talk to Qutiba in Aht Urhgan Whitegate. If he only gives a short line, zone out and wait for the Vanishing Act timer to pass, then talk again to accept.
Go to Wajaom Woodlands and examine a Pephredo Hive to get a Pot of White Honey. Each hive gives you one pot per day (resets at JST midnight).
Collect 3 Pots of White Honey from the hives.
Trade exactly 3 Pots of White Honey to Qutiba in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Reward: Irmik Helvasi. Afterward you can trade Qutiba a single Pot of White Honey for a scene, and talking to him shows a recipe.

name: Such Sweet Sorrow
steps: Talk to Dabhuh in Aht Urhgan Whitegate. You are moved to Caedarva Mire for a cutscene, then back to Whitegate, where another cutscene starts the quest.
Trade 1 Merrow Scale to Dabhuh in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to finish (obtain the scale; this quest's script does not say where).
Reward: Merrow No. 17 Locket.

name: Fear of the Dark 2
steps: Talk to Suldiran in Al Zahbi and accept (pick the accepting answer).
Obtain 2 Imp Wings (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade exactly 2 Imp Wings to Suldiran in Al Zahbi.
Reward: 200 gil, title Dark Resistant. Repeatable: trade 2 more Imp Wings to Suldiran for 200 gil each time.

name: Cook-a-roon
steps: Talk to Ququroon in Nashmau and accept (pick the accepting answer).
Obtain one each of Ahtapot, Istakoz, Istavrit, Istiridye and Mercanbaligi (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade exactly those 5 items, one of each, to Ququroon in Nashmau.
Reward: about a 50% chance of a Bowl of Nashmau Stew; the script has no other reward. Repeatable: trade the same 5 items again for another chance at the stew.

name: The Die is Cast
steps: Talk to Ratihb in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to start the quest.
Talk to Ekhu Pesshyadha in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Go to Nashmau and talk to Jijiroon.
Go to Arrapago Reef and examine the ??? (qm9) near position (311, -4, 170) for a cutscene.
Examine the ??? again to make the monster Bukki appear, and defeat it.
Examine the ??? again to get the key item Bag of Gold Pieces.
Return to Ratihb in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to finish.
Reward: Random Ring.

name: Two Horn the Savage
steps: Talk to Milazahn in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and accept (the script needs option 1).
Trade exactly 1,000 gil to Cacaroon in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Go to Mamook and examine the Viscous Liquid near position (-262, 5, -141).
Examine it again to make a Mamool Ja monster appear, and defeat it (progress is kept even if you zone).
Examine the Viscous Liquid again.
Return to Milazahn in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to finish.
Reward: Imperial Mythril Piece.

name: What Friends Are For
steps: Go to Aydeewa Subterrane and walk to the area near position (-389, 13, -445) to see a cutscene.
Go to Nashmau and talk to Tsetseroon to start the quest.
Trade Tsetseroon 1 Chunk of Tin Ore and 1 Cobalt Jellyfish. You receive the key item Pot of Tsetseroon's Stew.
Go to Aydeewa Subterrane and examine the ??? (qm9) near position (-406, 6.5, -440).
Return to Tsetseroon in Nashmau to finish.
Reward: key item Map of Aydeewa Subterrane, or 1 Imperial Bronze Piece if you already have the map.

name: Rock Bottom
steps: Go to Mount Zhayolm and examine the marked spot near position (838, -14, 231) to start the quest.
Trade 1 Pickaxe to the same spot.
Leave Mount Zhayolm and come back (you must zone).
Trade 1 Mythril Pick (normal or high-quality) to the same spot to finish.
Reward: key item Map of Mount Zhayolm, or 2,000 gil if you already have that map.

name: Beginnings (BLU AF1)
steps: Requires Blue Mage as your main job at level 40 or higher. Finish the mission Immortal Sentries and the quest An Empty Vessel, and see Waoud's follow-up scene.
Talk to Waoud in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and accept (pick the accepting answer). Stay Blue Mage for the whole quest.
Arrapago Reef: talk to Meyaada for the key item Brand of the Springserpent.
Bhaflau Thickets: talk to Daswil for the key item Brand of the Skyserpent.
Caedarva Mire: talk to Nahshib for the Brand of the Galeserpent, and to Nareema for the Brand of the Stoneserpent.
Mount Zhayolm: talk to Waudeen for the key item Brand of the Flameserpent.
With all five brands, return to Waoud in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to him.
Reward: Immortal's Scimitar, title Branded by the Five Serpents. Omens becomes available 1 minute later, after you zone.

name: Omens (BLU AF2)
steps: Requires Blue Mage as your main job at level 50 or higher; finish Beginnings first. After it, wait 1 minute and zone.
Talk to Waoud in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to start the quest. You may pay 1,000 gil for his divination, but it is optional.
Go to Navukgo Execution Chamber and enter the battlefield Omens (up to 18 players, 30-minute limit). Defeat every Immortal Flan to win.
Return to Waoud in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to him to receive the key item Sealed Immortal Envelope.
Talk to Lathuya in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Go to Aydeewa Subterrane and examine the blank spot (around position 342, 36, -24) for a cutscene.
Return to Lathuya in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to her.
Reward: Magus Charuqs, title Immortal Lion. Transformations becomes available 1 minute later, after you zone.

name: Transformations (BLU AF3)
steps: Requires Blue Mage as your main job at level 50 or higher; finish Omens first. After it, wait 1 minute and zone.
Talk to Waoud in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and agree to pay 1,000 gil for his divination.
Examine the Imperial Whitegate in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to start the quest.
Go to Alzadaal Undersea Ruins and walk to two cutscene spots in order (the script gives no locations).
Examine the blank spot in Alzadaal Undersea Ruins (around position -529, 0, 649) to spawn Nepionic Soulflayer, then defeat it.
Examine the same blank spot again for the final cutscene.
Reward: Magus Keffiyeh, title Paragon of Blue Mage Excellence. You can now craft Blue Mage armor. The Beast Within opens 1 minute later.

name: Equipped for All Occasions
steps: Requires Corsair as your main job at level 40 or higher.
Go to Arrapago Reef (H-10) and examine the ??? on the boat to start the quest.
Go to Maze of Shakhrami and examine the Iron Door to spawn a Lost Soul, then defeat it.
Examine the Iron Door again to receive the key item Wheel Lock Trigger.
Return to the ??? on the boat in Arrapago Reef (H-10) and examine it.
Finish the quest Luck of the Draw and see Ratihb's follow-up scene. Then talk to Ratihb in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Reward: Trump Gun.

name: Navigating the Unfriendly Seas
steps: Requires Corsair as your main job at level 50 or higher; finish Equipped for All Occasions first.
Go to Arrapago Reef (H-10) and examine the ??? on the boat to start the quest.
Obtain a Hydrogauge (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Hydrogauge to Leleroon in Nashmau. She shows it back and keeps nothing.
Go to Wajaom Woodlands and trade the Hydrogauge to the Leypoint (it is used up).
Wait 1 minute, then examine the Leypoint again for a cutscene.
Return to the ??? on the boat in Arrapago Reef (H-10) and examine it.
Reward: Corsair's Culottes.

name: Against All Odds
steps: Requires Corsair as your main job at level 50 or higher. Finish the quest Navigating the Unfriendly Seas first.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, walk into the Shaharat Teahouse, where Ratihb stands. A cutscene plays, the quest starts, and you receive the key item Life Float.
Go to Arrapago Reef and walk to the Cutter, the ship near the Cutter NPC (around !pos -462 -2 -394). Walking up to it plays two cutscenes in a row.
With the Life Float, talk to Cutter at Arrapago Reef to enter The Ashu Talif. The Life Float is used up when you enter.
Inside The Ashu Talif, defeat Gowam and Yazquhl to complete the instance.
If you fail, the Life Float is gone. After the next JST midnight (Japan time), talk to Ratihb in the Shaharat Teahouse in Whitegate for a new one, then try again at the Cutter.
After you win, a cutscene plays and the quest completes. It also plays when you return to Arrapago Reef from The Ashu Talif, or when you talk to Cutter again.
Reward: Corsair's Tricorne and the title Paragon of Corsair Excellence.

name: Puppetmaster Blues
steps: Requires Puppetmaster as your main job at level 50 or higher; finish the quest Operation Teatime first.
Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to Iruki-Waraki to accept the quest.
Go to Bastok Markets and talk to Shamarhaan to receive the key item Valkeng's Memory Chip.
Go to Mount Zhayolm and examine the ??? (qm8) to receive the key item Toggle Switch.
Go to Talacca Cove and examine the Rock Slab to enter the battlefield Puppetmaster Blues (up to 6 players, 30 minutes). Defeat all three Valkeng enemies.
Return to Shamarhaan in Bastok Markets and talk to him.
Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to Iruki-Waraki.
Go to Nashmau and talk to Sajhra.
Return to Iruki-Waraki in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to him to finish the quest.
Reward: Puppetry Taj and title Paragon of Puppetmaster Excellence.

name: Moment of Truth: Quest 6 30
steps: Finish the quest Give Peace a Chance first.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Mishhar (!pos -12 -6 29) to accept the quest.
Walk into the Shaharat Teahouse area of Aht Urhgan Whitegate to trigger a cutscene.
Talk to Mishhar again.
Go to Mamook and examine the ??? (qm7, !pos 216.9 -26.1 -94.6) to see a cutscene.
Go to Jade Sepulcher and examine the entrance door to see a cutscene.
Examine the door again to enter the battlefield Moment of Truth (up to 6 players, 30 minutes) and defeat the Shadowhand Kajeel-Ja enemies.
Return to Mishhar in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to her to finish.
Reward depends on your main job: e.g. Strength Potion (WAR/MNK/DRK/DRG), Mind Potion (WHM), Intelligence Potion (BLM/SCH), Vile Elixir +1 (RDM/BLU), Hermes Quencher (THF), Vitality Potion (PLD).
Other jobs: Charisma Potion (BST/BRD/DNC), Agility Potion (RNG/NIN/COR), Icarus Wing (SAM), Pro-Ether +1 (SMN), Dexterity Potion (PUP).

name: Three Men and a Closet
steps: Requires Got It All completed.
Talk to Kubhe Ijyuhla in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to start the quest.
Leave Aht Urhgan Whitegate directly into Wajaom Woodlands to see a cutscene.
Return and talk to Kubhe Ijyuhla.
Talk to Ratihb in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Talk to Tehf Kimasnahya in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and agree (the script needs option 1); if nothing changes, talk again and pick another answer.
Talk to Kubhe Ijyuhla to finish.
Reward: Imperial Bronze Piece.

name: The Beast Within (BLU LB)
steps: Requires Blue Mage as your main job at level 66 or higher. Finish the quest Transformations first, then wait 1 minute.
Talk to Waoud in Aht Urhgan Whitegate (around !pos 65 -6 -78) and choose the first option to accept the quest.
Optional: talk to Waoud again to pay 1,000 gil for a divination (a hint). You can skip this.

Obtain a Blue Mage's Testimony (this quest's script does not say where). Trade it to the Imperial Whitegate in Aht Urhgan Whitegate. Choose the first option to be teleported to the Jade Sepulcher. The trade does not use up the Testimony.
When you arrive in the Jade Sepulcher, a cutscene plays.

Trade the Blue Mage's Testimony to the battlefield entrance in the Jade Sepulcher to enter. It is a solo fight with no subjob and a 10-minute limit. The Testimony wears with each entry and can tear apart.
Defeat Raubahn. He has three forms, and you must defeat all three to win.
If you lose, trade the Testimony to the Imperial Whitegate again and pick the first option to return to the Jade Sepulcher. You only need a new Testimony if yours tore.
Reward: the title Master of Ambition, a Scroll of Instant Warp, and your level limit rises from 70 to 75.

name: Breaking the Bonds of Fate
steps: Requires Corsair as your main job at level 66 or higher; finish Against All Odds first.
Go to Arrapago Reef (H-10), examine the ??? on the boat, and accept (first choice).
Obtain a Corsair's Testimony (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Corsair's Testimony to the ??? on the boat and accept to be sent to Talacca Cove.
Enter the Talacca Cove battlefield with the Corsair's Testimony: solo, no subjob, 10-minute limit, Corsair level 66 or higher. Defeat all three forms of Qultada.
Reward: level cap raised to 75 (if it was 70), Scroll of Instant Warp, title Master of Chance.

name: Saga of the Skyserpent
steps: Talk to Fari-Wari in Aht Urhgan Whitegate (near !pos 80 -6 -137) and watch the cutscene to accept the quest.
Travel to Halvung and examine the ??? (qm7) at about !pos -11 8 -185 to get the key item Lilac Ribbon.
Return to Fari-Wari in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to her. After the cutscene you are moved to Wajaom Woodlands, where two more cutscenes play.
After those cutscenes you are sent back to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and the Lilac Ribbon is taken. Talk to Fari-Wari again right away to finish the quest.
Reward: Imperial Gold Piece, the title Skyserpent Aggrandizer, and 1,000 Imperial Standing.

name: Ode to the Serpents
steps: Finish the quest Saga of the Skyserpent first.
Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to Fari-Wari (!pos 80 -6 -137) to accept the quest and receive the key item Biyaada's Letter.
Finish the quests When the Bow Breaks and Fist of the People.
Return to Fari-Wari and talk to him to finish the quest.
Reward: Imperial Gold Piece.

name: When the Bow Breaks
steps: Requires Ode to the Serpents to be in progress (accepted but not finished).
Talk to Gaweesh in Al Zahbi to start the quest.
Go to Wajaom Woodlands and trade 1 Frayed Arrow to the Giwahb Watchtower near position (-339, -37, 654) to finish (obtain the arrow; this quest's script does not say where).
Reward: title Galeserpent Guardian and 500 Imperial Standing.

name: Fist of the People
steps: Requires the quest Ode to the Serpents to be in progress (accepted, not yet finished).
Go to Al Zahbi and talk to Talhaal (!pos -36 -6 107) to accept the quest.
Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to Fari-Wari (!pos 80 -6 -137).
Obtain a Rusty Medal (this quest's script does not say where).
Go to Wajaom Woodlands and trade 1 Rusty Medal to the Leypoint (!pos -200 -10 80) to finish the quest.
Reward: title Stoneserpent Shocktrooper and 500 Imperial Standing.

name: Soothing Waters
steps: Requires Ode to the Serpents completed.
Talk to Fari-Wari in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and accept the quest (first choice).
Talk to Eunheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Talk to Nadeey in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Go to Al Zahbi and talk to Mihli Aliapoh.
Go to Aydeewa Subterrane and trade 1 Tuft of Colorful Hair to the ??? (qm10) near position (352, 2, 376) (obtain the hair; this quest's script does not say where).
Return to Fari-Wari in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to finish.
Reward: Imperial Gold Piece, title Springserpent Sentry and 500 Imperial Standing.

name: Embers of His Past
steps: Finish the quest Soothing Waters first.
Talk to Fari-Wari in Aht Urhgan Whitegate. You are sent to Wajaom Woodlands for two automatic cutscenes, then returned to Whitegate.
Go to Mount Zhayolm at night (18:00-06:00 Vana'diel time) and examine the Sprightly Footsteps.
Still at night in Mount Zhayolm, examine the Withered Petals. You are returned to Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Obtain a Hydrangea (this quest's script does not say where). Trade it to Fari-Wari for more cutscenes in Wajaom Woodlands; the Hydrangea is returned to you.
Go back to Mount Zhayolm at night and trade the Hydrangea to the Withered Petals.
Return to Fari-Wari in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to him.
Reward: Imperial Gold Piece, title Flameserpent Facilitator, 500 Imperial Standing. Zone, then talk to Fari-Wari again for a Mercenary Camp Entry Slip.

name: The Prankster
steps: Talk to Ahaadah in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to start the quest.
Walk around Aht Urhgan Whitegate until a cutscene plays, then keep walking until a second cutscene plays (the script uses two unmarked trigger areas).
Go to Bhaflau Thickets and examine the ??? (qm3) near position (460, -15, 256) to make the monster Plague Chigoe appear.
Defeat Plague Chigoe.
Examine the ??? again to finish.
Reward: key item Map of Caedarva Mire.

name: Delivering the Goods
steps: Talk to Fochacha in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to start the quest.
Talk to Qutiba or Ulamaal, who stand together in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Return to Fochacha in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to her.
Reward: 3 Imperial Bronze Pieces. The follow-up quest opens after JST midnight, once you zone.

name: Vanishing Act
steps: Requires: finish the quest Delivering the Goods first.
Talk to Qutiba (!pos 92 -7.5 -130) or Ulamaal (!pos 93 -7.5 -128) in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and pick the first option to accept. If you get other dialogue, zone out, come back, and try again.
Talk to Fochacha in Aht Urhgan Whitegate (!pos 3 -1 -10.781).
Walk into the area of Aht Urhgan Whitegate between X -96 and -64 and Z 121 and 137 (around !pos -80 -6 129) to trigger a cutscene.
Obtain a Sickle (this quest's script does not say where). Go to Wajaom Woodlands and trade the Sickle to a Harvesting Point to get the key item Rainbow Berry.
Return to Ulamaal or Qutiba in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to them to finish the quest. The Rainbow Berry is taken.
Reward: Imperial Silver Piece.

name: Striking a Balance
steps: Talk to Wazyih in Aht Urhgan Whitegate, then talk to Saliyahf in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to start the quest.
Talk to Wazyih again.
Walk through Aht Urhgan Whitegate until a cutscene plays (the script uses an unmarked trigger area).
Talk to Wazyih again.
Go to Al Zahbi and find the hidden spot (it moves between 7 places in town); examine it to get the key item Munahda's Package.
Enter Aht Urhgan Whitegate to see a cutscene.
Talk to Saliyahf in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to finish.
Reward: 3 Imperial Bronze Pieces.

name: Not Meant to Be
steps: Go to Nashmau and talk to Fhe Maksojha (!pos 19.1 -7 71.3) to accept the quest.
Go to Caedarva Mire and examine the ??? (qm12, !pos 457 -7 -270.8) to see a cutscene.
Return to Fhe Maksojha in Nashmau and talk to her.
Go back to the ??? in Caedarva Mire and examine it to spawn two enemies: Lamia No.27 and Moshdahn.
Defeat both Lamia No.27 and Moshdahn (examine the ??? again to respawn them if needed).
Examine the ??? again to see a cutscene.
Return to Fhe Maksojha in Nashmau and talk to her to finish the quest.
Reward: 3 Imperial Gold Pieces.

name: Led Astry
steps: In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Mhasbaf (!pos 54.7 -7 11.4) to accept the quest.
Walk to the spot around !pos 71 0 9 in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to trigger a cutscene.
Talk to Tohka Telposkha (!pos 22.1 0 22.8) in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Talk to both Rubahah (!pos -96.7 0 -14.7) and Cacaroon (!pos -72 0 -82.3) in Aht Urhgan Whitegate, in any order.
Walk to the spot around !pos 12 2 -94 in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to trigger a cutscene and receive the key item Letter from Bernahn.
Go to Nashmau and talk to Tataroon (!pos -25.2 0 -39) to finish the quest.
Reward: Imperial Silver Piece.

name: Rat Race
steps: Talk to Kakkaroon in Nashmau to start the quest.
Go to Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to Nadee Periyaha.
Trade 1 Imperial Bronze Piece to Cacaroon in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Return to Nashmau and talk to Ququroon.
Trade Ququroon one each of Ahtapot, Istakoz, Istavrit, Istiridye and Mercanbaligi (obtain these; this quest's script does not say where). You receive a Bowl of Nashmau Stew.
Trade the Bowl of Nashmau Stew to Kyokyoroon in Nashmau.
Talk to Kakkaroon in Nashmau to finish.
Reward: 2 Imperial Gold Pieces, 2 Imperial Mythril Pieces and 3 Imperial Silver Pieces.

name: The Prince and the Hopper
steps: Talk to Maudaal in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and pick the third choice (the script needs option 2) to accept.
Enter Wajaom Woodlands through the entrance near position (685, -16, 220) to see a cutscene.
Go to Mamook and examine Toad's Footprint near position (216, -24, -102). You are moved to Wajaom Woodlands for a cutscene, then back to Mamook for another.
Examine the other Toad's Footprint in Mamook near position (-43, 6, -100).
Examine it again to make Poroggo Casanova and its 5 companions appear; defeat Poroggo Casanova.
Examine that Toad's Footprint again.
Return to Maudaal in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to finish.
Reward: Chanoix's Gorget.

name: Waking the Colossus
steps: Requires your current Treasures of Aht Urhgan mission to be Eternal Mercenary.
Walk near the Imperial Whitegate in Aht Urhgan Whitegate for a cutscene, then examine the Imperial Whitegate and accept to get the key item Imperial Missive.
Examine the door (_6r9) in Ru'Lude Gardens for a cutscene.
Get approval letters: talk to Halver in Chateau d'Oraguille, Iron Eater in Metalworks and Kupipi in Heavens Tower, accepting each time.
Examine the door in Ru'Lude Gardens again to get the Jeunoan Approval Letter.
Examine the Imperial Whitegate in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and accept to get the key item Present for Megomak.
In Mount Zhayolm, examine the Acid-Eaten Door near (272, -32, -88) and agree to get Megomak's Shopping List, then trade it 3 Slabs of Plumbago for the Lightning Cell.
In Alzadaal Undersea Ruins, examine the Blank Lamp near (209, 0, 20). The script never moves you to the next step, so the Whisper of Radiance cutscene cannot trigger.
Then examine the Imperial Whitegate, accept, and talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Reward: Imperial Gold Piece, title Heir of the Blessed Radiance, plus your choice: Colossus's Mantle, Earring or Torque, 10,000 gil, or the summon Alexander.

name: Divine Interference
steps: Requires the mission Eternal Mercenary as your current Treasures of Aht Urhgan mission; finish the quest Waking the Colossus first.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, walk to the cutscene spot for a scene (the script gives no location). Then examine the Imperial Whitegate and pick the accepting answer.
Go to Mount Zhayolm and examine the Acid-eaten Door.
Obtain 3 Slabs of Plumbago (this quest's script does not say where). Trade exactly 3 to the Acid-eaten Door to get the key item Lightning Cell.
Go to Alzadaal Undersea Ruins and examine the Blank Lamp.
At the Runic Seal in Alzadaal Undersea Ruins, enter the Nyzul Isle battle while holding the Lightning Cell, then defeat Alexander.
Back in Alzadaal Undersea Ruins, a cutscene gives you the key item Whisper of Radiance.
Talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and pick your reward.

Reward: Imperial Gold Piece, title Heir of the Blessed Radiance, plus one choice: Colossus's Mantle, Earring or Torque, 10,000 gil, or the Alexander summon. Repeatable after JST midnight via the Imperial Whitegate.

name: Promotion: Private First Class
steps: Requires 25+ Assault promotion points (earned by clearing Assault missions).
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Naja Salaheem (!pos 26 -8 -45.5) to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Imp Wing (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Imp Wing to Naja Salaheem to finish the quest.
Reward: key item Private First Class (PFC) Wildcat Badge and title Private First Class.

name: Promotion: Superior Private
steps: Requires: finish Promotion: Private First Class and earn at least 25 Assault promotion points.
Talk to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate (!pos 26 -8 -45.5) and watch the cutscene to accept the quest.
Examine a Warhorse Hoofprint in Bhaflau Thickets, Caedarva Mire, Mount Zhayolm, or Wajaom Woodlands (any one of them) to get the key item Dark Rider Hoofprint.
Return to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to her to finish. She takes your PFC Wildcat Badge and the Dark Rider Hoofprint and resets your promotion points to 0.
Reward: key item SP Wildcat Badge and the title Superior Private.

name: Promotion: Lance Corporal
steps: Requires 25+ Assault promotion points (earned by clearing Assault missions) and the quest Promotion: Superior Private finished.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Abquhbah (!pos 35.5 -6.6 -58) to accept the quest.
Talk to Nafiwaa (!pos -74 -6 126) in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to receive Empty Test Tubes 1-5.
Fill tubes 1-4 at the four Mythralline Wellsprings in Wajaom Woodlands (!pos -92 -15 -339, -218 -15 -388, 181 -23 268, 259 -23 132).
Fill tube 5 at the Mythralline Wellspring in Bhaflau Thickets (!pos 181 -15 373).
Bring all 5 filled tubes to Nafiwaa and mix the mythralline in her mini-game. Accept the result, or throw it out and refill the empty tubes to try again.
Wait one Vana'diel day, then walk onto the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels in Aht Urhgan Whitegate to finish.
Reward: key item Lance Corporal (LC) Wildcat Badge and title Lance Corporal. A Platinum or Luminium-grade mix also gives Imperial Mythril or Gold Pieces.

name: Promotion: Corporal
steps: Requires 25+ Assault promotion points (earned by clearing Assault missions) and the quest Promotion: Lance Corporal finished.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Naja Salaheem (!pos 26 -8 -45.5) to accept the quest and receive the key item Quartz Transmitter.
Find a Warhorse Hoofprint in any one of Wajaom Woodlands, Bhaflau Thickets, Mount Zhayolm or Caedarva Mire and examine it. This uses up the Quartz Transmitter.
Return to Naja Salaheem and talk to her to finish the quest.
Reward: key item Corporal (C) Wildcat Badge and title Corporal.

name: Promotion: Sergeant
steps: Requires 25+ Assault promotion points (earned by clearing Assault missions) and the quest Promotion: Corporal finished.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Naja Salaheem (!pos 26 -8 -45.5) and pick the first option to accept the quest.
Walk to Balrahn Way (around !pos -80 0 0) in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and pick the first option in the cutscene.
Go to Nashmau and walk in front of the boat customs (around !pos 0 0 -40). Pick the third option in the cutscene; any other choice means waiting one game day to retry.
Obtain a Bowl of Sutlac (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Totoroon (!pos -13 0 -24) in Nashmau.
Go to Caedarva Mire and examine the ??? (!pos 195 2 -616) to see a cutscene.
Return to Naja Salaheem in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to her to finish the quest.
Reward: key item Sergeant (S) Wildcat Badge and title Sergeant.

name: Promotion: Promotion Sergeant Major
steps: Requires 25+ Assault promotion points (earned by clearing Assault missions) and the quest Promotion: Sergeant finished.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Naja Salaheem (!pos 26 -8 -45.5) to accept the quest and play the first mini-game.
Talk to Naja Salaheem once per Vana'diel day to play the next test. If you fail, retry the next game day. You must pass three tests in a row.
After passing the third test, wait one more Vana'diel day and talk to Naja Salaheem to finish the quest.
Reward: key item Sergeant Major (SM) Wildcat Badge and title Sergeant Major.

name: Promotion: Chief Sergeant
steps: Requires 25+ Assault promotion points (earned by clearing Assault missions) and the quest Promotion: Sergeant Major finished.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Abquhbah (!pos 35 -6 -58) to accept the quest.
Talk to Hagakoff (!pos 82 0 -74), then Abquhbah, then Hagakoff again.
Go to Aydeewa Subterrane and examine an untouched Mushroom Patch (e.g. !pos 123 37 6) to receive the key item Scourshroom.
Examine a different, untouched Mushroom Patch and pick the first option to plant the Scourshroom.
Wait one Vana'diel day and change zones, then examine the planted patch to harvest sprouts (up to 5 total). Harvesting during game hours 4:00-6:00 can give extra.
Return to Abquhbah in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and talk to him to polish the mushrooms; repeat planting and harvesting if he asks for more, until he accepts.
Reward: Imperial Mythril Piece, key item Chief Sergeant's (CS) Wildcat Badge, title Chief Sergeant; a top result also gives an Imperial Gold Piece.

name: Promotion Second Lieutenant
steps: Requires 25+ Assault promotion points (earned by clearing Assault missions) and the quest Promotion: Chief Sergeant finished.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, talk to Abquhbah (!pos 35.5 -6.6 -58) to accept the quest. Walking onto the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels also starts it.
Trade 3 Imperial Gold Pieces to Abquhbah to receive the key item Officer Academy Manual.
Talk to Abquhbah, then trade him 2 Imperial Mythril Pieces to play the first mini-game. Each try costs 2 more pieces; repeat until you pass.
Talk to Abquhbah, then trade him 2 Imperial Mythril Pieces for the second mini-game.

Trade Abquhbah one beastman item: Macuahuitl -1, Mamool Ja Collar, Mamool Ja Helm, Jadagna -1, Januwiyah -1, Tariqah -1, Troll Pauldron, Troll Vambrace, Lamian Armlet, Lamian Kaman -1 or Qutrub Gorget.
Talk to Abquhbah, then trade him 2 Imperial Mythril Pieces for the third mini-game. Repeat until you pass to finish the quest.
Reward: key item Second Lieutenant (SL) Wildcat Badge and title Second Lieutenant.

name: Promotion First Lieutenant
steps: Requires completing Promotion: Second Lieutenant and at least 25 Assault promotion points.
In Aht Urhgan Whitegate, walk into the small area near x 25-30, z -127 to -123 (south part of town) to trigger a cutscene that starts the quest.
Trade 5 Imperial Gold Pieces to Abquhbah in Aht Urhgan Whitegate (near Salaheem's Sentinels, !pos 35.5 -6.6 -58) to pay the academy tuition.
Wait until the next Vana'diel day, then talk to Abquhbah for the Counterespionage mini-game. If you fail, you must wait another Vana'diel day before each retry.
After passing, talk to Abquhbah again for the Cipher mini-game. You can play it right away, and retry right away if you fail.
After passing the Cipher, talk to Abquhbah for the rock-paper-scissors mini-game. You can play it right away, and retry right away if you fail.
Talk to Abquhbah while the Vana'diel clock reads 15:00-16:59. If you talk outside that time, nothing advances; just try again during that window.
Leave Aht Urhgan Whitegate and come back (zone), then talk to Abquhbah again during any 15:00-16:59 Vana'diel window. Missing a window does not reset your progress.
Reward: Key item FL Wildcat Badge (replaces SL Wildcat Badge), title First Lieutenant, and promotion to First Lieutenant. Your Assault promotion points reset to 0.

name: The Siren's Tear
steps: Talk to Wahid in Bastok Mines to accept the quest.
Optional: talk to Otto and Carmelo in Port Bastok for hints.
Go to North Gustaberg and find the ??? (it moves between spots; one is near !pos 309.6 2.6 324).
Unequip your main and sub weapons, examine the ??? and pick the first option to get a Siren's Tear (needs a free inventory slot).
Trade the 1 Siren's Tear to Wahid in Bastok Mines. He also accepts another tear after the quest is done.
Reward: 150 gil, Bastok fame, title Tearjerker.

name: Beauty and the Galka
steps: Talk to Talib in Port Bastok and accept (if you decline, you can still start it by talking to Parraggoh in Bastok Mines and agreeing).
Obtain 1 Chunk of Zinc Ore (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Chunk of Zinc Ore (exactly 1) to Talib in Port Bastok to get the key item Palborough Mines Logs.
Take the logs to Parraggoh in Bastok Mines and talk to him to finish.
Reward: Bronze Knife and 30 Norg fame.

name: Welcome to Bastok
steps: Talk to Powhatan in Port Bastok and pick the first (accept) option.
Obtain a Shell Shield (this quest's script does not say where) and equip it in your sub (shield) slot.
With the Shell Shield equipped, talk to Bartolomeo in Port Bastok.
Return to Powhatan in Port Bastok and talk to him.
Reward: Spatha, Bastok fame, title Bastok Welcoming Committee.

name: Welcome to Bastok
steps: Requires level 31 and Bastok fame level 3. Finish the quest Welcome to Bastok first. The script runs the follow-up quest Guest of Hauteur.
Talk to Powhatan in Port Bastok and accept the quest (first option).
Equip a Maul or a Replica Maul in your main-hand slot.
With the maul equipped, talk to Steel Bones in Port Bastok to receive the key item Letter from Domien.
Return to Powhatan in Port Bastok to finish the quest.
Reward: Targe and Bastok fame.

name: The Quadav's Curse
steps: Talk to Corann in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Quadav Backplate (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 1 Quadav Backplate to Corann in Port Bastok.
Reward: Bronze Subligar and Bastok fame.

name: Out of One's Shell
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 2; finish the quest The Quadav's Curse first.
Talk to Ronan in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Obtain 3 Shell Bugs (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade 3 Shell Bugs to Ronan in Port Bastok.
Leave Port Bastok (zone out) and come back, then talk to Ronan again.
Reward: Monk's Headgear, Bastok fame, and the title Shell Outer.

name: Hearts of Mythril
steps: Talk to Elki in Bastok Mines and accept the quest (first option). You receive the key item Bouquet for the Pioneers.
Go to the Monument in North Gustaberg and examine it. Pick the first option to leave the bouquet.
Return to Elki in Bastok Mines to finish the quest.
Reward: Sitabaki, Bastok fame, and the title Pursuer of the Past.

name: The Eleventh's Hour
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 3; finish the quest Hearts of Mythril first.
Talk to Elki in Bastok Mines and pick the option that accepts the quest.
Go to Palborough Mines and examine the Old Toolbox; pick the first option to take the key item Old Toolbox.
Return to Elki in Bastok Mines and talk to him.
Talk to Babenn in Bastok Mines to finish.
Reward: Small Sword, Bastok fame, and the title Pursuer of the Truth.

name: Shady Business
steps: Requires finishing the quest Beauty and the Galka first.
Talk to Talib in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Obtain 4 Chunks of Zinc Ore (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade 4 Chunks of Zinc Ore to Talib in Port Bastok.
Repeatable: trade 4 more Chunks of Zinc Ore to Talib any time for the reward again.
Reward: 350 gil and Norg fame.

name: A Foreman's Best Friend
steps: Talk to Gudav in Port Bastok and watch the cutscene to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Dog Collar (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Dog Collar (exactly 1) to Gudav in Port Bastok.
Reward: 20 Bastok fame and the key item Map of the Gusgen Mines (if you already own that map you get 2000 EXP instead).

name: Breaking Stones
steps: Requires Bastok fame 2.
Talk to Horatius in Bastok Markets and accept the quest (first option).
Obtain 1 Dangruf Stone (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Dangruf Stone (exactly 1) to Horatius in Bastok Markets.
Reward: 400 gil and 30 Bastok fame. Repeatable: trade another Dangruf Stone to Horatius.

name: The Cold Light of Day
steps: Talk to Malene in Bastok Markets to accept the quest.
Obtain a Steam Clock (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade 1 Steam Clock to Malene in Bastok Markets.
Repeatable: trade another Steam Clock to Malene for the reward again.
Reward: 500 gil, Bastok fame, and the title Crab Crusher.

name: Gourmet
steps: Talk to Salimah in Bastok Markets to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Sleepshroom, 1 Treant Bulb, or 1 Wild Onion (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade one of them to Salimah at the right Vana'diel time: Sleepshroom from 18:00 to 06:00, Treant Bulb from 06:00 to 12:00, Wild Onion from 12:00 to 18:00.
The right item at the right time pays 200 gil (Sleepshroom or Treant Bulb) or 350 gil (Wild Onion). Any listed item at the wrong time pays 100 gil.
Reward: the gil above, Bastok fame, and the title Mommy's Helper. Repeatable: leave the area and come back before each new trade.

name: The Elvaan Goldsmith
steps: Talk to Michea in Bastok Markets to accept the quest.
Obtain a Copper Ingot (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade 1 Copper Ingot to Michea in Bastok Markets.
Repeatable: while your Bastok fame is level 1, zone out and back, then trade another Copper Ingot to Michea.
Reward: 180 gil and Bastok fame.

name: A Flash in the Pan
steps: Talk to Aquillina in Bastok Markets to start the quest. You can also skip this and trade straight away.
Obtain 4 Flint Stones (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 4 Flint Stones to Aquillina to finish. After any trade she will not accept another for 15 minutes.
Reward: 100 gil and Bastok fame +10. Repeatable: trade 4 more Flint Stones after her 15-minute cooldown.

name: Shady Business
steps: Talk to Hungry Wolf in Metalworks to accept the quest (this script is the quest Smoke on the Mountain).
Obtain a Slice of Giant Sheep Meat (this quest's script does not say where).
Go to South Gustaberg and trade the Slice of Giant Sheep Meat to the ??? campfire.
Wait about 1 minute, then examine the campfire again to receive a Galkan Sausage (keep an inventory slot free).
Return to Metalworks and trade 1 Galkan Sausage to Hungry Wolf.
Repeatable: you can trade another Galkan Sausage to Hungry Wolf for the reward again.
Reward: 300 gil, Bastok fame, and the title Hot Dog.

name: Stamp Hunt
steps: Talk to Arawn in Bastok Markets to accept; you get the key item Stamp Sheet.
In Bastok Markets, talk to Pavel.
In Bastok Mines, talk to Deadly Spider and Tall Mountain.
In Metalworks, talk to Elayne and Romualdo.
In Port Bastok, talk to Ehrhard and Latifah.
With all 7 stamps collected, return to Arawn in Bastok Markets and talk to him.
Reward: Leather Gorget, Bastok fame, and the title Stampeder.

name: Forever to Hold
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 2.
Talk to Qiji in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Brass Hairpin (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Brass Hairpin to Romilda, who stands next to Qiji in Port Bastok. Trading it to Qiji does nothing.
Talk to Qiji again to finish the quest.
Reward: 300 gil, Bastok fame, and the title Qiji's Friend.

name: Till Death Do Us Part
steps: Requires Bastok fame 3; finish Forever to Hold first.
Talk to Romilda in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 pair of Cotton Gloves (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 1 pair of Cotton Gloves to Romilda in Port Bastok.
Reward: 2,000 gil, Bastok fame, title Qiji's Rival.

name: Fallen Comrades
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 2.
Talk to Pavvke in Bastok Mines to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Silver Name Tag (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Silver Name Tag to Pavvke in Bastok Mines.
Reward: 550 gil and Bastok fame. Repeatable: trade him another Silver Name Tag at any time, and repeats give extra Bastok fame.

name: Rivals
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 3.
Talk to Detzo in Bastok Mines to accept the quest.
Obtain a Mythril Sallet (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade 1 Mythril Sallet to Detzo in Bastok Mines.
Reward: Wolf Gorget, Bastok fame, and the title Contest Rigger.

name: Mom, the Adventurer?
steps: Talk to Nbu Latteh in Bastok Markets to accept the quest; she gives you a Fire Crystal.
Obtain a Copper Ring (this quest's script does not say where).
Go to Bastok Mines and trade 1 Copper Ring to Roh Latteh; you receive the key item Letter from Roh Latteh.
Return to Nbu Latteh in Bastok Markets and talk to her. Tip: if you have not opened the letter in your key item list yet, she pays 200 gil instead of 100.
Repeatable: while your Bastok fame is level 1, zone out and back, then talk to Nbu Latteh again to repeat the quest.
Reward: 200 gil (unread letter) or 100 gil, Bastok fame, and the title Ringbearer.

name: The Signpost Marks the Spot
steps: Requires Bastok fame 2; finish Mom, the Adventurer? first and change zones after finishing it.
Talk to Nbu Latteh in Bastok Markets and pick the first (accept) option.
Go to Konschtat Highlands and examine the signpost (third signpost, near !pos -183 65 599) to receive the key item Painting of a Windmill.
Return to Bastok Mines and talk to Roh Latteh while holding the Painting of a Windmill.
Reward: Linen Robe, Bastok fame, title Treasure Scavenger.

name: Past Perfect
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 2.
Talk to Evi in Port Bastok to see a cutscene, then talk to Evi again to accept the quest.
Go to Konschtat Highlands and examine the ??? there to get the key item Tattered Mission Orders.
Return to Evi in Port Bastok and talk to him.
Reward: Scale Mail and Bastok fame.

name: Stardust
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 2.
Talk to Baldric in Metalworks to accept the quest.
Go to Valkurm Dunes and find the ??? (qm1) near position 238, 2, -148. It only appears during certain weather, so wait for the weather to change if you don't see it.
Examine the ??? to get 1 Pinch of Valkurm Sunsand. After that you have to leave the zone and come back before it gives you another one.
Return to Metalworks and trade 1 Pinch of Valkurm Sunsand to Baldric.
Reward: 300 gil and Bastok fame.
Repeatable: zone out, then talk to Baldric again and trade him another Pinch of Valkurm Sunsand for the same reward.

name: Mean Machine
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 2.
Talk to Unlucky Rat in Metalworks to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Vial of Slime Oil (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Vial of Slime Oil to Unlucky Rat in Metalworks.
Reward: Scroll of Warp and Bastok fame.

name: Cid's Secret
steps: Requires Bastok fame 4.
Talk to Cid in Metalworks to accept the quest.
Talk to Hilda in Port Bastok.
Obtain 1 Rolanberry (874 C.E.) (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Hilda to get the key item Unfinished Letter.
Return to Cid in Metalworks and talk to him.
Reward: Ram Mantle and 40 Bastok fame.

name: The Usual
steps: Requires Bastok fame 5; finish Cid's Secret first.
Talk to Hilda in Port Bastok and pick the first (accept) option.
Obtain 1 King Truffle (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Hilda to receive the key item Steaming Sheep Invitation.
Go to Metalworks, talk to Raibaht and pick the first option.
Return to Hilda in Port Bastok and talk to her.
Reward: Speed Bow, Bastok fame, title Steaming Sheep Regular.

name: Blade of Darkness
steps: Requires level 30.
Talk to Gumbah in Bastok Mines to accept the quest.
Walk from Palborough Mines into Zeruhn Mines; a cutscene gives you the Chaosbringer sword. (If you lose it, repeat this to get another.)
Equip Chaosbringer and defeat 100 monsters with it equipped. Dropping the sword resets your count to zero.
After 100 kills, walk from Pashhow Marshlands into Beadeaux to trigger the final cutscene.
Reward: unlocks the Dark Knight job, the title Dark Sider, and 20 Bastok fame.

name: Father Figure
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 2. Finish the quest The Elvaan Goldsmith first.
Talk to Michea in Bastok Markets to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Silver Ingot (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Silver Ingot to Michea in Bastok Markets.
Reward: 2,200 gil and Bastok fame.

name: The Return of the Adventurer
steps: Requires Bastok fame 3; finish the quest Father Figure first.
Talk to Gwill in Bastok Markets to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Stick of Cinnamon (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 1 Stick of Cinnamon to Gwill in Bastok Markets.
Reward: Cotton Headband, Bastok fame, title Kulatz Bridge Companion.

name: Drachenfall
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 2.
Talk to Black Mud in Bastok Mines to accept the quest; he gives you a Brass Canteen.
Go to North Gustaberg and trade the Brass Canteen to the Waterfall Base to receive a Canteen of Drachenfall Water.
If you lose the canteen before filling it, talk to Black Mud again and he gives you another Brass Canteen.
Return to Black Mud in Bastok Mines and trade him the Canteen of Drachenfall Water.
Reward: 2,000 gil, Bastok fame, and the title Drachenfall Ascetic.

name: Vengeful Wrath
steps: Requires Bastok fame 3.
Talk to Goraow in Bastok Mines to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Quadav Helm (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 1 Quadav Helm to Goraow in Bastok Mines. He still accepts the trade after the quest is done.
Reward: 900 gil, Bastok fame, title Avenger.

name: Beadeaux Smog
steps: Requires Bastok fame 4.
Talk to High Bear in Metalworks to accept the quest.
Go to Beadeaux and examine the ??? (qm1) to get the key item Corrupted Dirt.
Return to High Bear in Metalworks and talk to him.
Reward: Chakram, the title Beadeaux Surveyor, and 40 Bastok fame.

name: The Curse Collector
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 4.
Talk to Zon-Fobun in Bastok Markets to accept; you get the key item Cursepaper.
Travel to Beadeaux and talk to The Mute.
In Beadeaux, walk into the cursed areas the script checks (the upper areas need you to be on the high ground) until your progress is recorded.
Return to Zon-Fobun in Bastok Markets and talk to him.
Reward: Poison Cesti and Bastok fame.

name: Fear of Flying
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 3.
Talk to Kurando in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Silkworm Egg (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Silkworm Egg to Kurando in Port Bastok.
Reward: Black Silk Neckerchief, Bastok fame, and the title Airship Denouncer.

name: The Wisdom of Elders
steps: Talk to Benita in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Optional: talk to Tete in Port Bastok for more dialogue.
Obtain 1 Pinch of Bomb Ash (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 1 Pinch of Bomb Ash to Benita in Port Bastok.
Reward: Traveler's Hat and Bastok fame.

name: Groceries
steps: Talk to Tami in Bastok Mines to accept the quest. You receive the key item Tami's Note.
Before you leave, open your Key Items menu and view Tami's Note. If you skip this, Zelman won't take the order and you have to restart the quest.
Go to Zeruhn Mines and talk to Zelman.
Obtain 1 Strip of Meat Jerky (this quest's script does not say where).
Return to Tami in Bastok Mines and trade her the Strip of Meat Jerky.
Reward: Rabbit Mantle and Bastok fame.

name: The Bare Bones
steps: Talk to Degenhard in Bastok Markets to accept the quest.
Obtain a Bone Chip (this quest's script does not say where).
Optional: talk to Biggorf in Bastok Markets for a cutscene.
Trade 1 Bone Chip to Degenhard in Bastok Markets.
Reward: key item Map of the Dangruf Wadi, 2,000 experience points, and Bastok fame.

name: Minesweeper
steps: Talk to Gerbaum in Bastok Mines to accept the quest.
Obtain 3 Pinches of Zeruhn Soot (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade all 3 Pinches of Zeruhn Soot to Gerbaum in Bastok Mines at once.
Reward: 150 gil, Bastok fame, and the title Zeruhn Sweeper. Repeatable: trade another 3 Pinches of Zeruhn Soot at any time.

name: The Darksmith
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 3.
Talk to Mighty Fist in Metalworks to accept the quest.
Obtain 2 Chunks of Darksteel Ore (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade 2 Chunks of Darksteel Ore to Mighty Fist in Metalworks.
Repeatable: trade 2 more Chunks of Darksteel Ore to Mighty Fist for the reward again.
Reward: 8,000 gil and Bastok fame.

name: Buckets of Gold
steps: Talk to Foss in Bastok Markets and accept the quest (first option).
Obtain 5 Rusty Buckets (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade all 5 Rusty Buckets at once to Foss in Bastok Markets.
Reward: 300 gil, the title Bucket Fisher, and 10 Bastok fame. Repeatable: trade another 5 buckets.

name: The Stars of Ifrit
steps: Requires Bastok fame 3 and the key item Airship Pass.
Talk to Agapito in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Ride the San d'Oria-Jeuno Airship. The ??? on board appears only at night during a Full Moon.
Examine the ??? to receive the key item Carrier Pigeon Letter.
Return to Agapito in Port Bastok and talk to him.
Reward: 2,100 gil, Bastok fame, title Star of Ifrit.

name: Love and Ice
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 5, having viewed the key item Carrier Pigeon Letter, and finishing The Siren's Tear first.
Talk to Carmelo in Port Bastok to accept the quest. You receive the key item Carmelo's Song Sheet.
Go to Beaucedine Glacier and examine the Mirror Pond at (J-8). This uses up the song sheet.
Return to Carmelo in Port Bastok to finish the quest.
Reward: Lamia Harp, Bastok fame, and the title Sorrow Drowner.

name: Brygid the Stylist
steps: Talk to Brygid in Bastok Markets to accept the quest.
Obtain a Robe and a Bronze Subligar (this quest's script does not say where).
Equip the Robe on your body and the Bronze Subligar on your legs, then talk to Brygid again.
Reward: Gloves, the title Brygid Approved, and 20 Bastok fame.

name: The Gustaberg Tour
steps: Talk to Izabele in Metalworks to accept the quest.
Form a party of at least 2 players in which every alliance member is level 15 or lower.
Travel together to Hunting Bear in North Gustaberg and talk to him while all party members stand within 15 yalms of you.
Reward: 500 gil, Bastok fame, title Gustaberg Tourist.

name: Bite the Dust
steps: Requires Bastok fame 2.
Talk to Yazan in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Sand Bat Fang (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Sand Bat Fang (exactly 1) to Yazan in Port Bastok.
Reward: 350 gil, the title Sand Blaster, and 10 Bastok fame. Repeatable: trade another fang to Yazan any time.

name: Blade of Death
steps: Requires Bastok fame 3; finish Blade of Darkness first.
Talk to Gumbah in Bastok Mines to accept the quest and get the key item Letter from Zeid.
If you no longer have Chaosbringer, walk from Palborough Mines into Zeruhn Mines; a cutscene gives it back to you.
Equip Chaosbringer. A kill counts only when your own normal melee hit (auto-attack) lands the killing blow while it is equipped.
Kills from weapon skills, spells, or party members do not count. Kills left over from Blade of Darkness still count. Keep going until the total reaches 200.
Do not drop Chaosbringer: dropping it resets the kill count to 0.
Go to Gusgen Mines and trade Chaosbringer (exactly 1) to the ??? (qm2) to see the final cutscene.
Reward: Deathbringer, the title Black Death, and 30 Bastok fame.

name: Silence of the Rams
steps: Requires Norg fame level 2.
Talk to Paujean in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Lumbering Horn and 1 Rampaging Horn (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Lumbering Horn and Rampaging Horn together to Paujean in Port Bastok.
Reward: Purple Belt, Norg fame, and the title Purple Belt.

name: Altana's Sorrow
steps: Requires level 10 and Bastok fame 4.
Talk to Virnage in Bastok Mines and accept the quest (first option).
Go to Garlaige Citadel and examine the ??? (qm1) to get the key item Bucket of Divine Paint.
Return to Virnage in Bastok Mines; he takes the paint and gives you the key item Letter from Virnage.
Take the letter to Eperdur in Northern San d'Oria and talk to him to finish.
Reward: Scroll of Teleport-Dem, the title Pilgrim to Dem, and 40 Bastok fame.

name: A Lady's Heart
steps: Talk to Valah Molkot in Port Bastok; the cutscene starts the quest whatever you answer.
Obtain 1 Amaryllis (this quest's script does not say where). Other flowers are taken but do not finish the quest.
Trade the Amaryllis (exactly 1) to Valah Molkot in Port Bastok and confirm in the cutscene.
Reward: a new Mog House exit is unlocked (no fame).

name: Ghosts of the Past
steps: Requires Monk as your main job at level 40 or higher.
Talk to Oggbi in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Go to Gusgen Mines and trade a Pickaxe to the ??? (qm4) to spawn the Wandering Ghost.
Defeat the Wandering Ghost. It always drops a Miner's Pendant.
Return to Oggbi in Port Bastok and trade him the Miner's Pendant.
Reward: Beat Cesti and Bastok fame.

name: The First Meeting
steps: Requires Monk as your main job at level 50 or higher and finishing Ghosts of the Past first. Leave the area and come back once after finishing it.
Talk to Oggbi in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Enter Feiyin from Qubia Arena. A cutscene plays and you receive the key item Letter from Dalzakk.
Go to Davoi, stand right next to Hide Flap (2) and examine it. Pick the first option. This spawns Bilopdop and Deloknok.
Defeat both Bilopdop and Deloknok, then examine Hide Flap (2) again (first option) to receive the key item San d'Orian Martial Arts Scroll.
Return to Oggbi in Port Bastok with both key items.
Reward: Temple Gaiters and Bastok fame.

name: True Strength
steps: Requires Monk as your main job at level 50 or higher and finishing The First Meeting first.
Talk to Ayame in Metalworks to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Bottle of Yagudo Drink (this quest's script does not say where).
Go to Castle Oztroja and trade the Bottle of Yagudo Drink to the ??? (qm_truestrength) to spawn Huu Xalmo the Savage.
Defeat Huu Xalmo the Savage. It always drops a Xalmo Feather.
Return to Ayame in Metalworks and trade her the Xalmo Feather.
Reward: Temple Hose, Bastok fame, and the title Paragon of Monk Excellence.

name: The Doorman
steps: Requires Warrior (WAR) as your main job at level 40 or higher.
Talk to Phara in Bastok Mines to accept the quest.
Go to Davoi, stand right next to the Hide Flap (near !pos 293 3 -213), examine it and pick the first option to spawn Gavotvut and Barakbok.
Defeat both Gavotvut and Barakbok, then examine the Hide Flap again (first option) to receive the key item Sword Grip Material.
Return to Phara in Bastok Mines and talk to her.
Wait until the next Vana'diel day, then talk to Phara again to receive the key item Yasin's Sword.
Go to Metalworks and talk to Naji.
Reward: Razor Axe and Bastok fame.

name: The Talekeeper's Truth
steps: Requires Warrior (WAR) as your main job at level 50 or higher; finish The Doorman first.
In Bastok Mines, talk to Phara, then talk to Deidogg twice to accept the quest.
Go to Palborough Mines and examine the ??? (near !pos 15 -31 -94) to spawn Ni'Ghu Nestfender; defeat it. It always drops a Mottled Quadav Egg.
Trade 1 Mottled Quadav Egg to Deidogg in Bastok Mines.
Obtain 1 Parasite Skin: Yagudo Parasite in Castle Oztroja drops it (15% chance). Trade it to Deidogg.
Wait until the next Vana'diel day, then talk to Deidogg.
Reward: Fighter's Calligae and Bastok fame.

name: The Talekeeper's Gift
steps: Requires Warrior (WAR) as your main job at level 50 or higher; finish The Talekeeper's Truth, then wait a Vana'diel day and change zones.
In Bastok Mines, talk to Deidogg, then talk to Detzo.
Obtain 1 Ginger Cookie (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Deidogg to accept the quest.
Go to Behemoths Dominion, examine the ??? (near !pos 211 4 -79) and pick the first option to spawn three monsters.
Defeat Picklix Longindex, Moxnix Nightgoggle and Doglix Muttsnout.
Leave Behemoths Dominion into Qufim Island to see a cutscene that finishes the quest.
Reward: Fighter's Lorica, Bastok fame, title Paragon of Warrior Excellence.

name: Dark Legacy
steps: Requires Dark Knight as main job at level 40 or higher.
Talk to Raibaht in Metalworks to accept the quest.
Talk to Mighty Fist in Metalworks to get the key item Letter from the Darksteel Forge.
Take it to Cochal-Monchal in Windurst Waters and talk to him.
Obtain 1 Yagudo Cherry (this quest's script does not say where); go to Giddeus and trade it to the ??? (qm1) to make Vaa Huja the Erudite appear.
Defeat Vaa Huja the Erudite, then examine the ??? again to get the key item Darksteel Formula.
Return to Raibaht in Metalworks and talk to him.
Reward: Raven Scythe and 20 Bastok fame.

name: Dark Puppet
steps: Requires Dark Knight main job level 50; finish Dark Legacy first.
Talk to Cid in Metalworks to accept the quest.
Enter Ordelles Caves to see a cutscene.
Obtain 1 Darksteel Ingot (script does not say where); trade it to the ??? (qm4) in Ordelles Caves and defeat Gerwitz's Axe.
Obtain the Gerwitz's Axe item (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to the ??? (qm5); defeat Gerwitz's Sword.
Obtain the Gerwitz's Sword item (script does not say where) and trade it to the ??? (qm6); defeat Gerwitz's Soul.
Enter La Theine Plateau to trigger the final cutscene.
Reward: Chaos Sollerets and 20 Bastok fame.

name: Blade of Evil
steps: Requires Dark Knight as your main job at level 50 or higher; finish Dark Puppet first.
Walk from Pashhow Marshlands into Beadeaux; the cutscene there starts the quest.
Obtain 1 Vial of Quadav Mage Blood (this quest's script does not say where).
Go to the Sixth Floor of Middle Delkfutts Tower near grid J-6, find the ??? (qm1) and trade it the vial. The fight starts only if no earlier spawn is still alive.
Gerwitz's Scythe (level 60) and two Scythe Victims (level 58) appear and attack you. Defeat Gerwitz's Scythe.
Step onto the nearby J-6 teleporter pad that goes up to the Seventh Floor. A cutscene plays; pick the first option to finish.
Reward: Chaos Burgeonet, the title Paragon of Dark Knight Excellence, and 20 Bastok fame.

name: Ayame and Kaede
steps: Requires level 30.
Talk to Kaede in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Talk to Kagetora in Port Bastok, then talk to Ensetsu in Port Bastok.
Go to Korroloka Tunnel and examine the ??? (qm2); three Korroloka Leech monsters appear. Defeat them.
Examine the ??? again to get the key item Strangely Shaped Coral.
Talk to Ensetsu in Port Bastok.
Go to Norg and talk to Ryoma; he takes the coral and gives you the key item Sealed Dagger.
Return to Ensetsu in Port Bastok to finish.
Reward: unlocks the Ninja job, key item Job Gesture: Ninja, title Shadow Walker, and 20 Norg fame.

name: Trial by Earth
steps: Requires Bastok fame 6.
Talk to Juroro in Port Bastok and accept to receive the key item Tuning Fork of Earth.
Go to the Cloister of Tremors and enter the battlefield at the Earth Protocrystal (up to 6 players, 30-minute limit). Defeat Titan Prime.
Winning gives the key item Whisper of Tremors and the title Heir of the Great Earth. If you lose, talk to Juroro for a new Tuning Fork of Earth.
Return to Juroro in Port Bastok and choose one reward: Titan's Cudgel, Earth Belt, Earth Ring, Dose of Desert Light, 10,000 gil, or the Titan summon spell.
Repeatable: after the next JST midnight, talk to Juroro to start the quest again.
Reward: your chosen item, gil or spell, plus Bastok fame.

name: A Test of True Love
steps: Requires Bastok fame 6; finish Love and Ice first (and change area after it).
Talk to Carmelo in Port Bastok to accept the quest.
Open a Treasure Chest in Castle Zvahl Baileys or Castle Zvahl Keep (trade it a chest key or lockpick; the script does not say which) to get the key item Un Moment.
Open a Treasure Chest in Sea Serpent Grotto the same way to get the key item L'Ephemere.
Open a Treasure Chest in Labyrinth of Onzozo the same way to get the key item L'Ancienne.
With all three pages, talk to Carmelo in Port Bastok for a cutscene.
Leave the zone and come back, then talk to Carmelo again to finish (the three pages are removed).
Reward: 10,000 gil and 70 Bastok fame.

name: Lovers in the Dusk
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 6 and finishing A Test of True Love first. Leave the area and come back once after finishing it.
Talk to Carmelo in Port Bastok to accept the quest. You receive the key item Chanson de Liberte.
Go to The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah and examine the ??? (qm4) during Vana'diel dusk. At any other time of day it does nothing.
Reward: Siren Flute and Bastok fame.

name: Wish Upon a Star
steps: Requires Bastok fame 5.
In Bastok Markets, talk to Zacc, then Malene, then Enu to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Hatchet (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to a Logging Point in Yuhtunga Jungle or Yhoator Jungle to get a Fallen Star.
Return to Enu in Bastok Markets and trade the Fallen Star at night (Night or Midnight) when there is no weather.
Reward: 4 Bags of Cactus Stems and Bastok fame.

name: Eco-Warrior (Bastok)
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 1. You can't be on San d'Oria's or Windurst's Eco-Warrior, and finishing any nation's Eco-Warrior locks all three until the next conquest tally.
Talk to Raifa in Port Bastok and accept the quest (pick the accepting option).
Go to Gusgen Mines, talk to Degga and accept the ointment. This limits you to level 25.
While level-limited, examine the ??? (qm5) in Gusgen Mines. It spawns two Puddings. Defeat both.
Examine the same ??? again to receive the key item Indigested Ore. Talking to Degga afterward is optional, and Degga can remove the level limit.
Return to Raifa in Port Bastok with the Indigested Ore.
Reward: 5,000 gil, Dragon Chronicles, Bastok fame, and the title Cerulean Soldier. You can repeat it after the next conquest tally.

name: The Weight of Your Limits
steps: Requires a job that can equip Axe of Trials, Great Axe skill of at least 240, and no Weapon Training Guide key item (no other trial weapon quest active).
Talk to Iron Eater in Metalworks to receive the Axe of Trials and the key item Weapon Training Guide.
Equip the Axe of Trials and use weapon skills until it has 300 weapon skill points. If you lose it, talk to Iron Eater to get another.
Trade the Axe of Trials to Iron Eater to receive the key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
Go to The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah, examine the ??? (near !pos -324 1 474) to spawn Greenman, and defeat it.
Examine the ??? again to receive the key item Annals of Truth.
Return to Iron Eater in Metalworks and talk to him.
Reward: Bastok fame and the Steel Cyclone weapon skill.

name: Shoot First, Ask Questions Later
steps: Requires a job that can equip the Gun of Trials and Marksmanship skill of 250 or higher.
Talk to Cid in Metalworks to accept; you get the Gun of Trials and the key item Weapon Training Guide.
Equip the Gun of Trials and earn 300 weapon skill points with it (use weapon skills while it is equipped).
Trade the finished Gun of Trials to Cid in Metalworks; you get the key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
Go to The Boyahda Tree and examine the ??? to make Beet Leafhopper appear. Defeat it.
Examine the ??? again to get the key item Annals of Truth.
Return to Cid in Metalworks and talk to him. You learn the weapon skill Detonator.
Reward: Bastok fame and the weapon skill Detonator.

name: Inheritance
steps: Requires a main job that can equip the Sword of Trials, Great Sword skill of 250 or higher, and no Weapon Training Guide key item already in hand.
Talk to Gumbah in Bastok Mines. You receive the Sword of Trials and the key item Weapon Training Guide.
Equip the Sword of Trials and use weapon skills to fill it to 300 weapon skill points. If you lose the sword, Gumbah's menu can give you another.
Trade the finished Sword of Trials to Gumbah to receive the key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
Go to Western Altepa Desert and examine the ??? (qm1) to spawn Maharaja. Defeat it.
Examine the ??? again to receive the key item Annals of Truth.
Return to Gumbah in Bastok Mines to finish the quest.
Reward: you learn the weapon skill Ground Strike and gain Bastok fame.

name: The Walls of Your Mind
steps: Requires a job that can equip Knuckles of Trials, Hand-to-Hand skill of at least 250, and no Weapon Training Guide key item (no other trial weapon quest active).
Talk to Oggbi in Port Bastok to receive the Knuckles of Trials and the key item Weapon Training Guide.
Equip the Knuckles of Trials and use weapon skills until they have 300 weapon skill points. If you lose them, talk to Oggbi to get another pair.
Trade the Knuckles of Trials to Oggbi to receive the key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
Go to Bostaunieux Oubliette, examine the ??? (near !pos 20 17 -140) to spawn Bodach, and defeat it.
Examine the ??? again to receive the key item Annals of Truth.
Return to Oggbi in Port Bastok and talk to him.
Reward: Bastok fame and the Asuran Fists weapon skill.

name: Trial-Size Trial by Earth
steps: Requires Summoner (SMN) as your main job, level 20 or higher, and Bastok fame 2.
Talk to Ferrol in Port Bastok and accept to receive a Mini Tuning Fork of Earth.
As SMN, trade the 1 Mini Tuning Fork of Earth to Ferrol and accept the offer to be teleported to the Cloister of Tremors.
Enter the battlefield at the Earth Protocrystal. It is a solo fight with level cap 20 and a 15-minute time limit; defeat Titan Prime.
If you lose the fork, talk to Ferrol to get another one.
Reward: Titan summon spell, Scroll of Instant Warp, Bastok fame.

name: Faded Promises
steps: Requires Ninja as your main job, level 20 or higher, and Bastok fame level 4.
Talk to Romualdo in the Metalworks to start the quest.
Talk to Ayame in the Metalworks and accept her request in the cutscene (declining does not advance the quest).
Go to Palborough Mines with one Palborough Chest Key (this quest's script does not say where to get it). Thief's tools will not work here because you must be a Ninja.
Stand right next to the Treasure Chest in Palborough Mines and trade it only the Palborough Chest Key. The key always opens it; you receive the key item Diary of Mukunda.
Take the Diary of Mukunda to Kagetora in Port Bastok and talk to him for a cutscene.
Return to Ayame in the Metalworks and talk to her again.
Talk to Alois in the Metalworks to finish the quest; the Diary of Mukunda is taken from you.
Reward: Fukuro, the title Assassin Reject, and Norg fame.

name: Brygid the Stylist Returns
steps: Finish Brygid the Stylist first, and wear at least one piece of your job's artifact armor.
Talk to Brygid in Bastok Markets; she names one body piece and one leg piece she wants to see you wear.
Obtain and equip exactly the body and leg pieces she named (this quest's script does not say where to get them), then talk to her.
In the cutscene, pick the reward body armor you want; she then names the zodiac subligar she wants for it.
Obtain that subligar (e.g. Aries Subligar for Duende Cotehardie; the script does not say where) and trade it (exactly 1) to Brygid.
Reward: the body armor you picked, the title Bastok's Second Best Dressed, and 10 Bastok fame. Repeatable.

name: Out of the Depths
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 3.
Talk to Ayame in Metalworks and pick the option that accepts the quest (the 3rd choice).
Talk to Ravorara in Port Bastok.
Travel to Oldton Movalpolos and talk to Brakobrik; in the cutscene pick the 2nd choice to agree to help.
Obtain Pinches of Hoary Bomb Ash (this quest's script does not say where). Trade 1, 2, 3 or 4 ash to Brakobrik to get the Dusty Tome, Pointed Jug, Cracked Club or Peeling Hairpin key item.
Take each key item to Ravorara in Port Bastok for 100/200/300/400 gil. Repeat until you have turned in all four (1, 2, 3 and 4 ash trades).
After all four are turned in, trade 1 Pinch of Hoary Bomb Ash to Brakobrik and pick the option that gives you the key item Old Nametag.
Give the Old Nametag to Ravorara by talking to him in Port Bastok.
Talk to Pavvke in Bastok Mines to finish.
Reward: 1,200 gil, Bastok fame, and the title Trash Collector.

name: A Question of Faith
steps: Requires Bastok fame 4; finish Out of the Depths first.
Talk to Ayame in Metalworks to accept the quest.
Talk to Virnage in Bastok Mines and accept (pick the agreeing option) to receive the key item Dawn Talisman.
Go to Oldton Movalpolos and examine Rakorok with the Dawn Talisman; the monster Bugallug appears.
Defeat Bugallug.
Examine Rakorok again; a cutscene plays and the Dawn Talisman is taken from you.
Return to Virnage in Bastok Mines and talk to him to finish.
Reward: 3000 gil and 40 Bastok fame.

name: Return to the Depths
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 5; finish the quest A Question of Faith first. Talk to Ayame in Metalworks to accept.

Enter Oldton Movalpolos to see a cutscene. Then obtain a Misareaux Garlic (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Muckvix in Lower Jeuno (you get 2,000 gil and a Letter from Muckvix).
Go to Kazham and talk to Magriffon, then trade him exactly 10,000 gil to receive the Providence Pot and Letter from Magriffon key items.
Return to Muckvix in Lower Jeuno and talk to him; you get the key item Pungent Providence Pot.
Enter Oldton Movalpolos again for a cutscene, then talk to Tarnotik there.
Obtain a Bottle of Ahriman Tears (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Tarnotik; you are moved to Mine Shaft 2716.
Examine the door in Mine Shaft 2716 for a cutscene, then examine it again to enter the battle (up to 6 players, 30 minutes). Defeat Twilotak and the other enemies; you get 10,000 gil.
Talk to Ayame in Metalworks to finish. Optional: afterwards Ravorara in Port Bastok will pay 1,000 gil for the Pungent Providence Pot.
Reward: Bowyer Ring, Bastok fame, and the title Goblin in Disguise.

name: Teak Me to the Stars
steps: Requires Bastok fame level 3.
Talk to Raibaht in Metalworks to accept the quest.
Obtain a Garhada Teak Lumber (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade 1 Garhada Teak Lumber to Raibaht in Metalworks.
Reward: 2,100 gil and Bastok fame.

name: Chips
steps: Requires Chains of Promathia mission One to Be Feared to be completed or in progress (past its first step).
Talk to Ghebi Damomohe in Lower Jeuno and accept (first option). If you decline, change area before asking again.
Obtain 1 Carmine Chip, 1 Cyan Chip and 1 Gray Chip (this quest's script does not say where).
Make sure you have a free inventory slot and do not already hold a CCB Polymer.
Trade all three chips together to Cid in Metalworks.
Reward: CCB Polymer plus 5 San d'Oria and 5 Bastok fame. Repeatable with another set of chips.

name: Lure of the Wildcat (Bastok)
steps: Only available if the server has Treasures of Aht Urhgan content enabled.
Talk to Alib-Mufalib in Port Bastok to accept the quest. You receive the key item Blue Sentinel Badge.
In Port Bastok, talk to Kaede, Patient Wheel, Paujean, Hilda, and Tilian.
In Metalworks, talk to Raibaht, Invincible Shield, Manilam, Kaela, and Ayame.
In Bastok Markets, talk to Harmodios, Arawn, Horatius, Ken, and Pavel.
In Bastok Mines, talk to Griselda, Goraow, Echo Hawk, Deidogg, and Vaghron.
Once you have talked to all 20 NPCs, return to Alib-Mufalib in Port Bastok. He takes back the Blue Sentinel Badge.
Reward: the key item Blue Invitation Card.

name: Achieving True Power
steps: Requires Puppetmaster as your main job at level 66 or higher; finish the Aht Urhgan quest Puppetmaster Blues first.
Talk to Shamarhaan in Bastok Markets to accept the quest.
Obtain a Puppetmaster's Testimony (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Puppetmaster's Testimony to Shamarhaan in Bastok Markets. He sends you to Navukgo Execution Chamber.
In Navukgo Execution Chamber, use the entry door with the Testimony in your inventory to start the fight. You must go alone, as PUP with no subjob, and you have 10 minutes.
Defeat both Shamarhaan and his partner Valkeng. They fight together, and you only win once both are dead.
Reward: the title Master of Manipulation and a Scroll of Instant Warp. If your level cap is 70, it rises to 75.

name: Trust: Bastok
steps: Requires level 5 and Trust quests enabled on the server. Trust: San d'Oria and Trust: Windurst must both be not started, or one of them finished; if one is accepted but unfinished, Clarion Star will not offer this quest.
Talk to Clarion Star in Port Bastok and choose to accept. You receive the key item Blue Institute Card.
Go to Metalworks and talk to Naji.
If you already finished Trust: San d'Oria or Trust: Windurst, the quest completes during this Naji cutscene and you learn the Trust: Naji spell.

If this is your first Trust quest, Naji teaches you Trust: Naji, but this server's scripts never advance the quest past that point, so you cannot finish it yet. Finish another nation's Trust quest first if you need it completed.
Optional: after completing, talk to Ayame, Lucius and Iron Eater in Metalworks to learn more Trusts.
Reward: key item Bastok Trust Permit (the first-time path would also give the title The Trustworthy, but this server cannot reach it).

name: Crest of Davoi
steps: Requires the key item Silver Bell.
Talk to Baudin in Upper Jeuno and accept.
Obtain 1 Slice of Coeurl Meat (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Baudin.
Reward: the key item Crest of Davoi and 7 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Save My Sister
steps: Requires Jeuno fame level 4; finish Crest of Davoi first. This quest only appears in your log after you finish it.
Talk to Mailloquetat in Upper Jeuno (around !pos -31 -1 8).
Talk to Baudin in Upper Jeuno (around !pos -75 0 80).
Talk to Neraf-Najiruf in Rulude Gardens (around !pos -36 2 60) and choose the first option. You receive key item Ducal Guard's Lantern.

Go to The Eldieme Necropolis and light the Braziers in this order: (F-9), (H-7), (F-7), (H-9). Choose the first option at each one. If you use the wrong order, the lantern goes out and you must start over.
Return to Baudin in Upper Jeuno to finish the quest. Later, talk to Neraf-Najiruf to hand back the lantern.
Reward: 3,000 gil, Holy Mace, title Exorcist in Training, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: A Clock Most Delicate
steps: Requires Jeuno fame level 2.
Talk to Collet in Upper Jeuno.
Examine the clock tower door (_6s2) in Upper Jeuno, near Collet, and accept the request. If you decline, examine it again and accept.
Get the key item Clock Tower Oil by doing the Jeuno quest Deal with Tenshodo for Garnev in Lower Jeuno (needs Norg fame 2; trade him 1 Gold Orcmask).
Examine the clock tower door (_6s2) in Upper Jeuno again to finish.
Reward: 1,200 gil, Engineer's Gloves, the title Professional Loafer, and 17 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Save the Clock Tower
steps: Requires Jeuno fame level 5; finish A Clock Most Delicate first.
Talk to Derrick in Lower Jeuno (around !pos -32 -1 -7) and agree to take the petition. You receive a Clock Tower Petition.
Trade the petition to each of these, one at a time (you keep it each time): Teigero-Bangero and Zauko (Lower Jeuno), Pitantimand (Port Jeuno), Radeivepart (Rulude Gardens).
Also trade it to Baudin, Collet, Constance, Monberaux, Souren and Zuber in Upper Jeuno. That makes 10 signatures in total.
If you lose the petition, Derrick will give you a new one, but all your signatures are reset.
Trade the signed Clock Tower Petition to Derrick in Lower Jeuno to finish the quest.
Reward: title Clock Tower Preservationist, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: Chocobo's Wounds
steps: Requires level 20.
Talk to Brutus in Upper Jeuno and pick the option that agrees to help. If you refuse, talk to him again.
Obtain several Clumps of Gausebit Wildgrass (this quest's script does not say where). Do not feed Gysahl Greens, because the chocobo refuses them.
Trade Gausebit Wildgrass to the Chocobo next to Brutus in Upper Jeuno. Wait at least 45 seconds between feedings or it will not eat.
Feed it 6 times in total. The first 2 feedings do not use up the grass. Each of the last 4 must be exactly 1 Clump of Gausebit Wildgrass, which is used up.
Osker, next to the Chocobo, comments on its recovery after each feeding.
Reward: the key item Chocobo License, the title Chocobo Trainer, and 7 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Save My Son
steps: Requires level 30 or higher; finish Chocobo's Wounds first.
In Lower Jeuno, examine the Merchant's House door (around !pos -82 -8 -169) and accept (choose the first option).
Optional: talk to Shalott in Upper Jeuno for a hint.
Go to Qufim Island and examine the Nightflowers (around !pos -265 -4 29) between 21:30 and 5:40 Vana'diel time to watch the cutscene.
Return to the Merchant's House door in Lower Jeuno and examine it to finish the quest.
Reward: 2,100 gil, Beast Whistle, title Life Saver, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: A Candlelight Vigil
steps: Requires Jeuno fame level 4.
Talk to Ilumida in Upper Jeuno and agree to help. If you decline, talk to her again and accept.
Get the key item Holy Candle: with this quest active, start the separate quest Candle Making from Rouliette in Upper Jeuno and trade her 1 Lanolin Cube.
Return to Ilumida in Upper Jeuno with the Holy Candle to finish. The candle is taken from you.
Reward: Flower Necklace, the title Activist for Kindness, and 13 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Your Crystal Ball
steps: Requires Jeuno fame level 2.
Talk to Kurou-Morou in Lower Jeuno and accept the quest in the cutscene.
