Obtain 1 Ahriman Lens (this quest's script does not say where).
Go to the Maze of Shakhrami and trade exactly 1 Ahriman Lens to Rockwell. You will get a message that the lens is submerged. Do not trade him another lens.

Wait at least 2 real-time minutes after the trade, then talk to Rockwell again. If he says to wait a bit longer, wait and try again. Keep a free inventory slot so you can receive the Divination Sphere.
Return to Lower Jeuno and trade the Divination Sphere to Kurou-Morou.
Reward: title Fortune-Teller in Training, plus fame in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Collect Tarut Cards
steps: Requires Jeuno fame level 3.
Talk to Chululu in Lower Jeuno and accept. You get 5 copies of one random Tarut Card.
After each Japan-time midnight (once per real day), talk to Chululu again for another 5 copies of a random card.
Collect at least 1 each of Tarut Card: The Fool, Tarut Card: Death, Tarut Card: The Hermit and Tarut Card: The King.
Trade 1 of each of the 4 cards to Chululu.
Reward: the title Card Collector and 7 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: The Old Monument
steps: Requires level 30 or higher.
Talk to Mertaire in Lower Jeuno (around !pos -17 0 -61).
In Buburimu Peninsula, examine the Song Runes (around !pos -244 16 -280) to watch the cutscene.
Obtain 1 Sheet of Parchment (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Sheet of Parchment to the Song Runes to finish the quest.
Reward: Poetic Parchment, title Researcher of Classics, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: A Minstrel in Despair
steps: Requires finishing the Jeuno quest The Old Monument. There is no separate accept step.
If you no longer have your Poetic Parchment, obtain 1 Sheet of Parchment (this quest's script does not say where). Trade it to the Song Runes in Buburimu Peninsula to get a new Poetic Parchment.
Go to Lower Jeuno and trade the Poetic Parchment to Mertaire.
Reward: 2,100 gil and 7 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Rubbish Day
steps: Requires finishing Collect Tarut Cards.
Talk to Chululu in Lower Jeuno for a compatibility reading. Type the name of another player who is in Lower Jeuno with you. Only your first reading each Vana'diel day counts.
Get readings with a partner on 3 different Vana'diel days.
On a later Vana'diel day, talk to Chululu again and accept the quest (choose the first option). You receive key item Magic Trash.
Go to Garlaige Citadel and talk to Mashira (around !pos 141 -6 138). Agree to hand over the Magic Trash.
Return to Chululu in Lower Jeuno to finish the quest.
Reward: 6,000 gil and a Chain Choker, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: Community Service
steps: Repeatable. Only 1 player per night can take it. Talk to Zauko in Lower Jeuno between 18:00 and 23:00 Vana'diel time and accept.
Light all 12 street lamps in Lower Jeuno: examine each one and choose to light it. The game tells you how many are left.
You must finish before 1:00 the next Vana'diel morning. After that the quest fails and you can talk to Zauko to reset it.
Return to Zauko once all 12 lamps are lit. You may accept the Lamp Lighter's Membership Card.
Reward: the title Torchbearer, 7 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst, and optionally the key item Lamp Lighter's Membership Card.

name: Tenshodo Membership
steps: Requires Jeuno fame level 3. This quest only appears in your log after you finish it.
Talk to Ghebi Damomohe in Lower Jeuno (around !pos 16 0 -5) and pick the option asking how to join (the third choice).
Go to Port Bastok and talk to Jabbar (around !pos -101 -2 23) or Silver Owl. You receive key item Tenshodo Application Form.
Return to Ghebi Damomohe in Lower Jeuno and talk to him to finish. Shortcut: trade him a Tenshodo Invite instead.
Reward: Tenshodo Invite and key item Tenshodo Member's Card.

name: Path of the Beastmaster
steps: Requires level 30 or higher; finish Save My Son first.
Talk to Brutus in Upper Jeuno (around !pos -55 8 95) to watch the cutscene. That finishes the quest right away.
Reward: Beastmaster job unlocked, key item Job Gesture Beastmaster, title Animal Trainer, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: Path of the Bard
steps: Requires finishing A Minstrel in Despair.
Optional: talk to Bki Tbujhja, Mataligeat or Mertaire in Lower Jeuno for story dialogue. The script does not require it.
Go to Valkurm Dunes and examine the Song Runes (around !pos -721 -7 102) to watch the cutscene and finish the quest.
Reward: Bard job unlocked, 3,000 gil, key item Job Gesture Bard, title Wandering Minstrel, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: The Clockmaster
steps: Requires Jeuno fame level 5; finish Save the Clock Tower first.
In Upper Jeuno, examine the house door (around !pos -80 0 104) to watch the cutscene. That finishes the quest right away.
Reward: Time Hammer, title Timekeeper, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: Candle Making
steps: Requires having the Jeuno quest A Candlelight Vigil active (from Ilumida in Upper Jeuno).
Talk to Rouliette in Upper Jeuno to accept.
Obtain 1 Lanolin Cube (this quest's script does not say where) and trade exactly 1 to Rouliette.
Reward: the key item Holy Candle, the title Believer of Altana, and 13 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst. Take the Holy Candle to Ilumida.

name: Child's Play
steps: Requires having the Jeuno quest The Wonder Magic Set active.
Talk to Karl in Port Jeuno to accept.
Obtain 1 White Rock (this quest's script does not say where) and trade exactly 1 to Karl in Port Jeuno.
Reward: the key item Wonder Magic Set, the title Trader of Mysteries, and 7 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Northward
steps: Requires Jeuno fame level 4.
Talk to Radeivepart in Rulude Gardens and agree to help to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Flame Degen (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Flame Degen to Radeivepart in Rulude Gardens to finish the quest.
Reward: 2,000 EXP, 2,000 gil, key item Map of Castle Zvahl, title Envoy to the North, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: The Antique Collector
steps: Requires Jeuno fame level 2.
Talk to Imasuke in Port Jeuno (around !pos -165 11 94) and agree to help to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Kaiser Sword (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Kaiser Sword to Imasuke to finish the quest.
Reward: 2,000 EXP, 2,000 gil, key item Map of Delkfutt's Tower, title Trader of Antiquities, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: Deal with Tenshodo
steps: Requires having the Jeuno quest A Clock Most Delicate active and Norg fame level 2.
Talk to Garnev in Lower Jeuno to accept.
Obtain 1 Gold Orcmask (this quest's script does not say where) and trade exactly 1 to Garnev.
Reward: the key item Clock Tower Oil, 50 Norg fame and the title Trader of Renown. Take the oil to the clock tower door in Upper Jeuno.

name: Mysteries of Beadeaux I
steps: Requires the Silver Bell key item.
Talk to Sattal-Mansal in Lower Jeuno; this starts both Mysteries of Beadeaux I and II.
Obtain 1 Quadav Charm (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Quadav Charm (exactly 1) to Sattal-Mansal in Lower Jeuno.
Reward: Coruscant Rosary key item, +7 fame in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Mysteries of Beadeaux II
steps: Starts together with Mysteries of Beadeaux I: talk to Sattal-Mansal in Lower Jeuno while holding the Silver Bell key item.
Obtain 1 Quadav Augury Shell (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Quadav Augury Shell (exactly 1) to Sattal-Mansal in Lower Jeuno.
Reward: Black Matinee Necklace key item, +7 fame in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: The Goblin Tailor
steps: Requires level 10 and Jeuno fame level 3.
Talk to Guttrix in Lower Jeuno (around !pos -36 4 -140) to accept. He tells you which race and which dungeon the current pattern is for.
Wait until the race he names is your own race. It changes over time, so talk to him again to check.
Go to the dungeon he names (Ordelle's Caves, Gusgen Mines or Maze of Shakhrami). Trade that zone's chest key to its Treasure Chest to get key item Magical Pattern.
Return to Guttrix and choose one piece: body, hands, legs or feet. This first piece completes the quest.
Optional, repeatable: after the quest is done, get another Magical Pattern the same way and trade it to Guttrix for a piece you do not have yet. Once you own all 4 he offers nothing more.
Reward: the race-specific armor piece you chose, title Goblin's Exclusive Fashion Mannequin, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame (first completion only).

name: Pretty Little Things
steps: Go to Port Jeuno and find Zona Shodhun (around !pos -175 -5 -4). Trade him any item to start the quest. Rocks and flowers you trade are used up.
Obtain 1 Yellow Rock (this quest's script does not say where). Other colored rocks do not count.
Trade the Yellow Rock to Zona Shodhun to finish the quest.
Reward: a new Mog House exit is unlocked (no item reward).

name: Axe the Competition
steps: Requires a job that can equip the Pick of Trials, axe skill 240, and not holding the key item Weapon Training Guide.
Talk to Brutus in Upper Jeuno and accept. You get the Pick of Trials and the key item Weapon Training Guide.
Equip the Pick of Trials and build up at least 300 weapon skill points on it.
Trade the Pick of Trials to Brutus. When it is finished you get the key item Map to the Annals of Truth. If it is not finished, he says so and hands it back.
In the Temple of Uggalepih, examine the ??? (qm9, near position 218, -8, 206) to spawn Yallery Brown. Defeat it.
Examine the same ??? again to get the key item Annals of Truth.
Return to Brutus in Upper Jeuno to finish.
Reward: you learn the weapon skill Decimation, plus 7 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Wings of Gold
steps: Requires Beastmaster as main job at level 40 or higher; finish Path of the Beastmaster first.
Talk to Brutus in Upper Jeuno and choose to accept the quest (if you decline, talking to him again offers it once more).
Go to Middle Delkfutts Tower or Upper Delkfutts Tower and trade the chest's key to a Treasure Chest to obtain the key item Guiding Bell (this quest's script does not say where to get the key).
Return to Brutus in Upper Jeuno with the Guiding Bell for the final cutscene.
Reward: Barbaroi Axe, plus fame in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Scattered into the Shadow
steps: Requires Beastmaster as your main job at level 50 or higher; finish Wings of Gold first.
Talk to Brutus in Upper Jeuno (around !pos -55 8 95) and accept. You receive key items Aquaflora 1, 2 and 3.
Go to Feiyin and examine the Underground Pools around !pos 10 0 250 and !pos 10 0 30 to plant two of the sprigs.
In Feiyin, examine the Underground Pool around !pos -170 0 250 to spawn Dabotz's Ghost. Defeat it, then examine the pool again.
Return to Brutus in Upper Jeuno and talk to him.
Go to Castle Oztroja and open the Treasure Chest with an Oztroja Chest Key (the zone's chest key) to get a Beast Collar.
While still on this step, zone into Castle Oztroja to make Tebhi appear (around !pos -136 24 -21). Trade him the Beast Collar.
Return to Brutus in Upper Jeuno to finish the quest.
Reward: Beast Gaiters, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: Painful Memory
steps: Requires Bard as your main job at level 40 or higher; finish Path of the Bard first.
Talk to Mertaire in Lower Jeuno and accept. If you decline, talk to him again to get the offer again. You receive key item Mertaire's Bracelet.
Go to Ranguemont Pass and examine the Waters of Oblivion (around !pos -289 -45 212) while you hold Mertaire's Bracelet. This spawns the monster Tros.
Defeat Tros.
Examine the Waters of Oblivion again to watch the cutscene and finish the quest. Mertaire's Bracelet is taken from you.
Reward: Paper Knife, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: The Requiem
steps: Requires Bard as your main job at level 50 or higher; finish Painful Memory first.
Talk to Bki Tbujhja in Lower Jeuno (around !pos -22 0 -60) and accept (choose the second option).
Obtain 1 Flask of Holy Water (this quest's script does not say where). Trade it to Bki Tbujhja; he blesses it and gives it back.
In The Eldieme Necropolis, trade the Flask of Holy Water to the fourth sarcophagus (around !pos -421 6.5 503). This spawns Yum Kimil, Dog Guardian and Owl Guardian.
Defeat Yum Kimil. If you are wiped out, examine the sarcophagus to spawn them again.
Examine the same sarcophagus and choose the first option. You receive key item Star Ring.
Return to Bki Tbujhja in Lower Jeuno to finish the quest. Keep the Star Ring; you need it for The Circle of Time.
Reward: Choral Slippers, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: The Circle of Time (BRD AF3)
steps: Requires Bard as your main job at level 50 or higher; finish The Requiem first (you keep key item Star Ring from it).
Talk to Mertaire in Lower Jeuno (around !pos -17 0 -61) for his hint.
Talk to Imasuke in Port Jeuno (around !pos -165 11 96) and accept his appraisal (choose the second option).
In Xarcabard, examine the Perennial Snow (around !pos 339 0 -379) and bury the ring. Wait about 30 seconds, then examine it again.
Return to Imasuke in Port Jeuno.
In Chateau d'Oraguille, talk to Chalvatot (around !pos -105 0 72) and accept (choose the second option). You receive key item Moon Ring.
In Monastic Cavern, examine the Altar (around !pos 109 -3 -145) to spawn Bugaboo. Defeat it, then examine the Altar again to place the rings.
Return to Chalvatot in Chateau d'Oraguille to finish the quest.
Reward: Choral Justaucorps, title Paragon of Bard Excellence, plus San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst fame.

name: Ducal Hospitality
steps: Requires finishing the Chains of Promathia mission A Vessel Without a Captain and Jeuno fame level 4.
Talk to Taillegeas in Ru'Lude Gardens and accept. He asks for one random set of items and repeats the list if you talk to him again.
Possible sets: (1) Handful of Counterfeit Gil, Loaf of Goblin Bread, Goblin Doll, Goblin Mushpot, Goblin Pie. (2) Pile of Chocobo Bedding, Set of Kaiserin Cosmetics, My First Magic Kit.

(3) Piece of Eastern Paper, Shuriken, Silver Obi, Tonosama Rice Ball. (4) Dart, Kongou Inaho, Nyumomo Doll, Cone of Snoll Gelato. (5) Copy of Fernan's Diaries, Naphille Pochette, Sphene Earring, Turquoise Ring.
Obtain exactly 1 of each item in your set (this quest's script does not say where) and trade them all together to Taillegeas.
Repeatable: change areas, then talk to Taillegeas again to get a new random set.
Reward: 4,000 gil, the title Ducal Dupe (first time only), and 5 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: In the Mood for Love
steps: Requires Chains of Promathia progress past the mission A Vessel Without a Captain.
Talk to Odasel in Lower Jeuno to start the quest (he wants a Chameleon Diamond).
Obtain 1 Chameleon Diamond (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Chameleon Diamond (exactly 1, nothing else) to Odasel in Lower Jeuno.
Optional: afterwards talk to Matoaka in Lower Jeuno for an extra cutscene.
Reward: 4,800 gil, title Pick-up Artist, +7 fame in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Empty Memories
steps: Requires Chains of Promathia progress: be on the mission The Mothercrystals or later (or have the Below the Arks choice flagged).
Talk to Harith in Ru'Lude Gardens and choose to accept the quest in the cutscene.
Obtain one 'Recollection' item (this quest's script does not say where): Recollection of Pain, Fear, Guilt, Suffering, Anxiety or Animosity.
For Pain, Fear or Guilt: trade the Recollection plus exactly 2,000 gil together to Harith. Trading the wrong gil amount only gets a reminder.
For Suffering, Anxiety or Animosity: trade just the Recollection (no gil) to Harith.
Exchanges: Pain -> Bottle of Hysteroanima, Fear -> Bottle of Psychoanima, Guilt -> Bottle of Terroanima, Suffering -> Hamayumi, Anxiety -> Stone Gorget, Animosity -> Dia Wand.
Repeatable: trade more Recollections to Harith any time after the first.
Reward: the item matching your Recollection; first completion also gives +5 fame in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Hook, Line, and Sinker
steps: Requires Chains of Promathia progress past the mission A Vessel Without a Captain.
Talk to Omer in Lower Jeuno to start the quest (he asks for an Egret Fishing Rod).
Obtain 1 Egret Fishing Rod. The script's comments say it drops from Sea Bishops and Krakens fished up on Qufim Island; no fishing skill is required to hook them.
Trade the Egret Fishing Rod (exactly 1, nothing else) to Omer in Lower Jeuno.
Reward: 3,000 gil, title Rod Retriever, +7 fame in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: A Chocobo's Tale
steps: Requires finishing the Chains of Promathia mission A Vessel Without a Captain.
Talk to Nevela in Upper Jeuno to accept.
Go to Bastok Mines and talk to Wobke.
Go to Pashhow Marshlands and examine the Outpost Gate for a cutscene about Bottles of Warding Oil.
Obtain 3 Bottles of Warding Oil (this quest's script does not say where) and trade all 3 to the Outpost Gate in Pashhow Marshlands.
Return to Wobke in Bastok Mines for a cutscene.
In Batallia Downs, examine the ??? marker (near position -39, -11, 307). Monsters (Badshah) spawn and attack you; defeat them.
Examine the same ??? again to get the key item Silver Comet's Collar.
Return to Nevela in Upper Jeuno to finish.
Reward: 5,200 gil, the title Chocobo Love Guru, and 7 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Beyond the Sun
steps: Requires Shattering Stars completed.
Defeat Maat in the Shattering Stars battlefield on each of the 15 original jobs (WAR through DRG), using that job's Testimony each time. The server remembers every job you have beaten him on.
Rematches: talk to Maat in Ru'Lude Gardens on an original job at level 66+ for the rematch dialog.
Once all 15 jobs are recorded, talk to Maat in Ru'Lude Gardens while on an original job.
Reward: Maat's Cap and title Ultimate Champion of the World.

name: Unlisted Qualities
steps: Talk to Luto Mewrilah in Upper Jeuno and pick a race and a name for your new companion to accept the quest.
Go to Ru'Lude Gardens and talk to Akta; choose your companion's height (Small, Average Height or Pretty Tall).
Go to Lower Jeuno and talk to Kuah Dakonsa; choose your companion's face.
Go to Port Jeuno and talk to Red Ghost; choose a personality that matches your companion's gender (male or female options).
Once size, face and personality are all chosen, talk to Bheem in Upper Jeuno and confirm the details.
Return to Luto Mewrilah in Upper Jeuno for the final cutscene.
Reward: none yet. The server script has quest completion disabled (TODO until companions can be saved), so the quest cannot be finished here; the disabled code would give a Silver Ingot.

name: Storms of Fate
steps: Requires being on Chains of Promathia mission Dawn (progress 8).
Enter Rulude Gardens to trigger a cutscene, and accept the quest. If you decline, change zones and enter again.
In Misareaux Coast, examine the gate at !pos -259 -30 276 to watch a cutscene.
In Riverne-Site B01, examine the Unstable Displacement (around !pos -613 2 693) to watch a cutscene.
Examine the Unstable Displacement again to enter the Storms of Fate battle (up to 18 players, 30-minute limit). Defeat Bahamut.
After you win, you receive key item Whisper of the Wyrmking.
Return to Rulude Gardens. A cutscene plays and the quest is complete.
Reward: title Conqueror of Fate (from the battle). There is no quest reward table. Shadows of the Departed unlocks after 1 Vana'diel day.

name: Shadows of the Departed
steps: Requires finishing Storms of Fate and being on Rise of the Zilart mission Awakening (progress 3). Wait 1 Vana'diel day after Storms of Fate.
In Rulude Gardens, walk to the palace entrance (the area around !pos 0 3 60). Arriving in the zone is not enough. A cutscene plays and you receive key item Note Written by Eshantarl.
In Promyvion-Dem, examine the object at !pos 220 -2.5 340 to get key item Promyvion-Dem Sliver.
In Promyvion-Holla, examine the object at !pos 100 -3 -140 to get key item Promyvion-Holla Sliver.
In Promyvion-Mea, examine the object at !pos 260 -2.5 180 to get key item Promyvion-Mea Sliver.
With all 3 slivers, go back to Rulude Gardens and walk to the palace entrance again. The cutscene plays and you hand over the three slivers.
Reward: no items. Apocalypse Nigh unlocks after 1 more Vana'diel day and a zone change.

name: Apocalypse Nigh
steps: Requires finishing the Jeuno quest Shadows of the Departed, then waiting until the next Vana'diel day and changing areas. Walk into Ru'Lude Gardens for the opening cutscene.
Enter Sealion's Den for a cutscene.
In the Grand Palace of Hu'Xzoi, examine the door (_iya, near position -20, 0, -283). You are teleported onward.
In Empyreal Paradox, examine the Transcendental Radiance entrance for a cutscene, then enter the Apocalypse Nigh battlefield. Limits: up to 6 players, trusts allowed, 30 minutes.
Defeat every enemy in the battlefield (the Kamlanaut group). Afterwards a cutscene gives the title Breaker of the Chains and sends you to Al'Taieu.
Talk to Aldo in Lower Jeuno. Requires rank 5 or higher in your nation.
Wait until the next Vana'diel day. Then talk to Gilgamesh in Norg and choose one earring. If you pick none, talk to him again later.
Reward: choose 1 of Static Earring, Magnetic Earring, Hollow Earring or Ethereal Earring. If you no longer have it, examine the ??? in Empyreal Paradox to reset the fight.

name: Lure of the Wildcat (Jeuno)
steps: Requires Treasures of Aht Urhgan enabled on the server.
Talk to Ajithaam in Upper Jeuno to start the quest and receive the White Sentinel Badge key item.
In Upper Jeuno, talk to Sibila-Mobla, Shiroro, Luto Mewrilah, Renik and Hinda.
In Lower Jeuno, talk to Sutarara, Saprut, Bluffnix, Naruru and Gurdern.
In Port Jeuno, talk to Red Ghost, Karl, Shami, Rinzei and Sagheera.
In Ru'Lude Gardens, talk to Albiona, Crooked Arrow, Muhoho, Adolie and Yavoraile.
After all 20 NPCs, return to Ajithaam in Upper Jeuno; the White Sentinel Badge is taken back.
Reward: White Invitation Card key item.

name: The Road to Aht Urhgan
steps: Requires the Treasures of Aht Urhgan expansion to be enabled on the server.
Talk to Faursel in Lower Jeuno (around !pos 38 3 -45) and listen to him, then talk again to hear his options.
Choose 'Let me think about it' to start the trade route. Then trade all 6 of Damselfly Worm, Magicked Skull, Crab Apron, Bloody Robe, Cup of Dhalmel Saliva and Wild Rabbit Tail.
Instead of the 6 items, you can trade all 3 of Jade Cryptex, Silver Engraving and Thirteen-Knot Quipu.
Or trade all 3 of Carmine Chip, Cyan Chip and Gray Chip, or a single coffer key or job Testimony.
After trading, wait until the next Vana'diel day, change zones, then talk to Faursel to receive key item Boarding Permit.
Gil option: pay 500,000 gil. Wait until the next day, change zones and talk to him. You are teleported to Wajaom Woodlands and get the Boarding Permit and Map of Wajaom Woodlands.
If you paid gil, return to Faursel afterward to close the quest. On Rhapsodies mission Inescapable Binds, his first option finishes it right away.
Reward: key item Boarding Permit. Paying gil also gives key item Map of Wajaom Woodlands.

name: Chocobo on the Loose
steps: Requires level 20 and Treasures of Aht Urhgan content enabled on the server.
Talk to Brutus in Upper Jeuno to accept.
In La Theine Plateau, examine the Chocobo Tracks (near position -556, 0, 523).
Return to Brutus in Upper Jeuno for a cutscene.
Go to Southern San d'Oria and talk to Hantileon.
Return to Brutus in Upper Jeuno for a cutscene.
Change areas, wait until the next Vana'diel day, then talk to Brutus again to finish.
Reward: a Chocobo Egg (faintly warm) and 7 fame each in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: Lakeside Minuet
steps: Requires main level 30+ (server advanced-job level) and Wings of the Goddess enabled on the server.
Talk to Laila in Upper Jeuno and choose to accept.
Talk to Rhea Myuliah, who stands next to Laila in Upper Jeuno.
Go to Southern San d'Oria and talk to Valderotaux.
Return to Upper Jeuno and talk to Rhea Myuliah again.
Go to Jugner Forest [S] and examine the Glowing Pebbles to get the Stardust Pebble key item.
Return to Upper Jeuno and talk to Laila.
Reward: Dancer job unlocked, key item Job Gesture: Dancer, title Troupe Brilioth Dancer, +7 fame in San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst.

name: The Unfinished Waltz
steps: Requires Dancer as your main job at level 40 or higher.
Talk to Laila in Upper Jeuno to accept.
Talk to Rhea Myuliah in Upper Jeuno, next to Laila.
In Grauberg [S], examine the ??? (qm1, near position -157, -8, 597) with Dancer as your main job for a cutscene.
Examine the ??? again to spawn the Migratory Hippogryph. Defeat it.
Examine the ??? once more to get the key item The Essence of Dance.
Return to Laila in Upper Jeuno to finish.
Reward: War Hoop and the title Promising Dancer.

name: The Road to Divadom
steps: Requires finishing The Unfinished Waltz and Dancer as your main job at level 50 or higher. After the previous quest, change areas and wait until the next Vana'diel day.
Talk to Laila in Upper Jeuno to accept, then talk to her again for the next cutscene. Stay on Dancer for the whole quest.
Enter Jugner Forest [S] for a cutscene.
In Jugner Forest [S], examine the Glowing Pebbles (near position 104, 4, 444).
Obtain 1 Block of Yagudo Glue (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to the Glowing Pebbles.
Return to Laila in Upper Jeuno for the final cutscenes. Keep an inventory slot free for the reward.
Reward: Dancer's Tights (male or female version to match your character) and the title Stardust Dancer.

name: Comeback Queen
steps: Requires finishing The Road to Divadom and Dancer as your main job at level 50 or higher. Change areas and wait until the next Vana'diel day after that quest.
Talk to Laila in Upper Jeuno to accept. You receive the key item Wyatt's Proposal.
Go to Bastok Markets and talk to Harmodios.
Return to Laila in Upper Jeuno for a cutscene.
Wait until the next Vana'diel day and talk to Laila again. If the choice you make postpones the show, change areas, wait another day and talk to her again.
When you agree to continue, several cutscenes play in a row in Upper Jeuno. Keep an inventory slot free for the reward.
Reward: Dancer's Casaque (male or female version to match your character) and the title Elegant Dancer.

name: In Defiant Challenge
steps: Requires your main job at exactly level 50 with level cap 50 (server max level must be 55+).
Talk to Maat in Ru'Lude Gardens and choose to accept the challenge.
In Crawlers Nest, examine the three ??? spots (qm10, qm11, qm12) to get 3 Exoray Mold Crumbs; with all three they combine into a Clump of Exoray Mold.
In Garlaige Citadel, examine the three ??? spots (qm18, qm19, qm20) to get 3 Bomb Coal Fragments, which combine into a Chunk of Bomb Coal.
In The Eldieme Necropolis, examine the three ??? spots (qm7, qm8, qm9) to get 3 Ancient Papyrus Shreds, which combine into a Piece of Ancient Papyrus.
Keep a free inventory slot so the combined item can be given. You can also bring the regular items instead of using the ??? spots.
Trade the Clump of Exoray Mold, Chunk of Bomb Coal and Piece of Ancient Papyrus (1 each) together to Maat in Ru'Lude Gardens.
Reward: level cap raised to 55, title Horizon Breaker.

name: Atop the Highest Mountains
steps: Requires level cap 55 (finish In Defiant Challenge) and main job level 51 or higher.
Talk to Maat in Ru'Lude Gardens and choose to accept the quest.
Go to Xarcabard and examine the ??? where the Boreal Tiger lives to get the Round Frigicite key item.
In Xarcabard, examine the ??? for the Boreal Coeurl to get the Square Frigicite key item.
In Xarcabard, examine the ??? for the Boreal Hound to get the Triangular Frigicite key item. (Only if the server's old-school setting is on must each Boreal NM be defeated first.)
Return to Maat in Ru'Lude Gardens with all three Frigicites and talk to him.
Reward: level cap raised to 60, title Summit Breaker.

name: Whence Blows the Wind
steps: Requires level cap 60 (finish Atop the Highest Mountains) and main job level 56 or higher.
Talk to Maat in Ru'Lude Gardens and choose to accept the quest.
In Castle Oztroja, examine the ??? (qm2) to get the Yagudo Crest key item.
In Monastic Cavern, examine the ??? (qm1) to get the Orcish Crest key item.
In Qulun Dome, examine the ??? (qm1) to get the Quadav Crest key item.
Return to Maat in Ru'Lude Gardens with all three crests and talk to him.
Reward: level cap raised to 65, title Sky Breaker.

name: Riding on the Clouds
steps: Requires main job level 61 or higher, a current level cap of exactly 65, and a server max level of 70 or higher.
Talk to Maat in Ru'Lude Gardens and accept (declining resets his picks). He names four NPCs picked at random: one in San d'Oria, one in Bastok, one in Windurst, and one in Selbina or Mhaura.
If you forget who he named, talk to Maat again for a reminder of the four NPCs.
Obtain 4 Kindred's Seals (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade 1 Kindred's Seal (alone) to the San d'Oria NPC Maat named to get the Scowling Stone key item.
Trade 1 Kindred's Seal to the Bastok NPC Maat named to get the Smiling Stone key item.
Trade 1 Kindred's Seal to the Windurst NPC Maat named to get the Spirited Stone key item.
Trade 1 Kindred's Seal to the Selbina/Mhaura NPC Maat named to get the Somber Stone key item.
Return to Maat in Ru'Lude Gardens with all four stones and talk to him; the stones are taken.
Reward: level cap raised to 70, title Cloud Breaker.

name: Shattering Stars
steps: Requires an original job (WAR through DRG) as main job at level 66+, with level cap 70 (finish Riding on the Clouds).
Talk to Maat in Ru'Lude Gardens to start the quest.
Obtain the Testimony for your current main job, e.g. Warrior's Testimony (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Testimony to Maat; in the cutscene accept his offer to be teleported to your job's battlefield.
Arenas: MNK/WHM/SMN Balgas Dais; WAR/BLM/RNG Horlais Peak; PLD/DRK/BRD Qu'Bia Arena; RDM/THF/BST Waughroon Shrine; SAM/NIN/DRG Chamber of Oracles.
Enter the Burning Circle with your Testimony and defeat Maat alone: solo, no subjob, 10-minute limit.
On victory you receive a Scroll of Instant Warp. Return to Maat in Ru'Lude Gardens and talk to him.
Reward: level cap raised to 75, title Star Breaker (title Maat Masher on winning the fight).

name: New Worlds Await
steps: Requires level cap 75 (finish Shattering Stars); the server must allow levels above 75.
Talk to the Nomad Moogle in Ru'Lude Gardens. If you lack the Limit Breaker key item, pick the option to receive it.
At level 75 with Limit Breaker, talk to the Nomad Moogle again and accept this quest.
Earn at least 3 merit points, and obtain 5 Kindred's Seals (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 5 Kindred's Seals to the Nomad Moogle; 3 merit points are spent.
Reward: level cap raised to 80.

name: Expanding Horizons
steps: Requires New Worlds Await completed, level cap 80, the Limit Breaker key item, and a server max level above 80.
Talk to the Nomad Moogle in Ru'Lude Gardens and accept this quest.
Earn at least 4 merit points, and obtain 5 Kindred's Crests (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 5 Kindred's Crests to the Nomad Moogle; 4 merit points are spent.
Reward: level cap raised to 85.

name: Beyond the Stars
steps: Requires Expanding Horizons completed, level cap 85, the Limit Breaker key item, and a server max level above 85.
Talk to the Nomad Moogle in Ru'Lude Gardens and accept this quest.
Earn at least 5 merit points, and obtain 10 Kindred's Crests (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 10 Kindred's Crests to the Nomad Moogle; 5 merit points are spent.
Talk to the Nomad Moogle again for the minigame: pick Maat's moves against Degenhard (Red beats Blue, Blue beats Green, Green beats Red). Script marks this minigame TODO, so it may behave oddly.
Win the minigame to finish; talk to him again to retry.
Reward: level cap raised to 90.

name: Dormant Powers Dislodged
steps: Requires Beyond the Stars completed, level cap exactly 90, main job level above 85, the Limit Breaker key item, and a server max level above 90.
Talk to the Nomad Moogle in Ru'Lude Gardens and agree to sign the contract (refusing leaves the quest unstarted; talk again to retry). He names one item he wants.

The item is one of: Pinch of Valkurm Sunsand, Faded Crystal, Orcish Plate Armor, Magicked Skull, Cup of Dhalmel Saliva, Yagudo Caulk, Siren's Tear, Dangruf Stone, Orcish Axe, Quadav Backscale. Obtain it (this quest's script does not say where).
Have at least 10 merit points and obtain 1 Kindred's Crest (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade exactly the Kindred's Crest plus the requested item (1 each) to the Nomad Moogle; 10 merit points are spent.
Talk to him again for the timing minigame: press at about 9 to 11 seconds (a glowing egg) to win; if you miss, talk to him again to retry.
Reward: level cap raised to 95 and the Soul Gem key item.

name: Beyond Infinity
steps: Requires Prelude to Puissance completed (it usually starts this quest for you) and the Soul Gem Clasp key item. If not started, talk to the Nomad Moogle in Ru'Lude Gardens at level 91+ and accept.
Talk to the Nomad Moogle and choose an arena to warp to: Horlais Peak, Waughroon Shrine, Balgas Dais or Qu'Bia Arena.
Enter the Burning Circle there with the Soul Gem Clasp (consumed on entry). Defeat Atori-Tutori: up to 6 players, trusts allowed, level cap 99, 10-minute limit.
If you lose, return to the Nomad Moogle: trade 5 High Kindred's Crests (source not given in the script) or spend 1 merit point via his menu for a new Soul Gem Clasp, then retry.
On victory you receive a Scroll of Instant Warp. Return to the Nomad Moogle in Ru'Lude Gardens and talk to him.
At level 99, talking to the Nomad Moogle again lets you take the Job Breaker key item.
Reward: level cap raised to 99, title Bushin Aspirant.

name: Martial Mastery
steps: Requires main level 96+ and at least one combat skill (hand-to-hand through marksmanship) at 357 or higher.
Talk to the Nomad Moogle in Ru'Lude Gardens to start the quest.
Earn at least 15 merit points.
Talk to the Nomad Moogle again; 15 merit points are spent.
Reward: Heart of the Bushin key item and title Bushin-Ryu Inheritor.

name: Prelude_to_Puissance
steps: Requires Dormant Powers Dislodged completed, level cap 95, main level above 90, the Limit Breaker key item, and a server max level above 95.
Talk to the Nomad Moogle in Ru'Lude Gardens to start this quest.
Obtain 1 Seasoning Stone (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to the Nomad Moogle.
Watch the following cutscene (its timing minigame is marked TODO in the script) and pick a final option. Most options also start Beyond Infinity, and some warp you to a battlefield.
Reward: Soul Gem Clasp key item.

name: Rycharde the Chef
steps: In Mhaura, talk to Numi Adaligo and pick the option that asks for work.
Talk to Take in Mhaura for the next cutscene.
Talk to Rycharde in Mhaura and choose to accept his request. If you decline, talk to him again later to accept.
Obtain 2 Slices of Dhalmel Meat (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade both Slices of Dhalmel Meat to Rycharde together. Trading only 1 does not count.
Reward: 1,500 gil, 20 Windurst fame, and the title Purveyor in Training.

name: Way of the Cook
steps: Requires Windurst fame 3 and Rycharde the Chef finished. Wait 8 Vana'diel days after finishing it.
In Mhaura, talk to Rycharde and accept the quest. You now have 3 Vana'diel days to finish it.
Obtain 1 Slice of Dhalmel Meat and 1 Beehive Chip (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Slice of Dhalmel Meat and the Beehive Chip to Rycharde together. Talk to him any time to see how many hours you have left.
Reward: 1,500 gil if on time (1,000 gil if late), 20 Windurst fame, and the title One-Star Purveyor.

name: Unending Chase
steps: Requires Windurst fame 3 and Way of the Cook finished. Wait more than 7 Vana'diel days after finishing it.
In Mhaura, talk to Rycharde and accept the quest. If you decline, talk to him again to get the offer back.
Obtain 1 Puffball (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Puffball to Rycharde.
Reward: 2,100 gil, 30 Windurst fame, and the title Two-Star Purveyor.

name: His Name is Valgeir
steps: Requires Windurst fame 3 and Unending Chase finished. Wait more than 2 Vana'diel days after finishing it.
In Mhaura, talk to Rycharde and accept. You get the key item Aragoneu Pizza.
Optional: with the pizza, talk to Felisa at the Mhaura docks for a one-time free ferry ride.
Travel to Selbina and talk to Valgeir to deliver the Aragoneu Pizza.
Return to Mhaura and talk to Rycharde to finish.
Reward: 2,000 gil, 2,000 experience points, 40 Windurst fame, and the key item Map of the Toraimarai Canal.

name: Expertise
steps: Requires Windurst fame 3 and His Name is Valgeir finished. Wait more than 8 Vana'diel days after finishing it.
In Mhaura, talk to Take (not Rycharde) to start the quest.
Travel to Selbina and talk to Valgeir. He asks for ingredients.
Obtain 1 Scream Fungus and 1 Slice of Land Crab Meat (this quest's script does not say where). Trade both to Valgeir together.
Wait 24 Vana'diel hours (about 58 real minutes), then talk to Valgeir again. You get the key item Land Crab Bisque.
Return to Mhaura and talk to Take to hand over the bisque.
Reward: Tableware Set and the title Three-Star Purveyor.

name: The Clue
steps: Requires Windurst fame 5 and Expertise finished. Wait more than 7 Vana'diel days after finishing it.
In Mhaura, talk to Rycharde and accept. If you decline, talk to him again to get the offer back.
Obtain 4 Crawler Eggs (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade all 4 Crawler Eggs to Rycharde at once. Fewer than 4 does not count.
Reward: 3,000 gil, 50 Windurst fame, and the title Four-Star Purveyor.

name: The Basics
steps: Requires Windurst fame 5 and The Clue finished. Wait more than 7 Vana'diel days after finishing it.
In Mhaura, talk to Rycharde and accept. You get the key item Mhauran Couscous.
Travel to Selbina and talk to Valgeir. He takes the couscous and gives you a Baked Popoto.
Return to Mhaura and trade the Baked Popoto to Rycharde.
Reward: Tea Set, 2,000 experience points, 60 Windurst fame, and the title Five-Star Purveyor.

name: The Sand Charm
steps: Requires Windurst fame 2.
In Mhaura, talk to Blandine. Stand on the town side, not in the ferry dock area.
Talk to Zexu in Mhaura.
Talk to Blandine again from the town side.
Talk to Celestina in Mhaura to start the quest.
Obtain a Sand Charm (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Celestina.
Reward: 2,000 gil, 2,000 experience points, 40 Windurst fame, and the key item Map of Bostaunieux Oubliette.

name: The Old Lady
steps: Requires level 18 (server default). You cannot do this quest if you have started the other support-job quest, Elder Memories.
In Mhaura, talk to Vera and accept the quest.
Obtain a Wild Rabbit Tail (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Vera.
Obtain a Cup of Dhalmel Saliva (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Vera.
Obtain a Bloody Robe (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Vera. If you have the key item Gilgamesh's Introductory Letter, just talk to her to skip the items.
Reward: unlocks support jobs (subjobs).

name: Under the Sea
steps: Requires Selbina/Rabao fame level 2 and fishing enabled on the server.
Talk to Yaya in Selbina to start the quest.
Talk to Oswald in Selbina; he tells you he is looking for his lost ring.
Talk to Jimaida in Selbina; she sends you to see Zaldon.
Talk to Zaldon in Selbina; he asks for a Fat Greedie. Obtain a Fat Greedie (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade 1 Fat Greedie to Zaldon. There is only a 20% chance he finds the ring; if not, the fish is used up, so bring another and trade again until you get the Etched Ring key item.
Return to Oswald in Selbina with the Etched Ring to finish.
Reward: Amber Earring, title Lil Cupid, plus San d'Oria and Bastok fame.

name: An Explorer's Footsteps
steps: Talk to Abelard in Selbina and accept (choose to help him). He gives you a Lump of Selbina Clay and hints at which Stone Monument to visit first.
There are 17 Stone Monuments, one each in: West Ronfaure, East Ronfaure, La Theine Plateau, Valkurm Dunes, Jugner Forest, Batallia Downs, North Gustaberg, South Gustaberg, Konschtat Highlands.
...and in Pashhow Marshlands, Rolanberry Fields, West Sarutabaruta, East Sarutabaruta, Tahrongi Canyon, Buburimu Peninsula, Meriphataud Mountains and Sauromugue Champaign.
Go to any monument you have not done yet and trade it 1 Lump of Selbina Clay to get a Clay Tablet. Abelard's hint is only a suggestion; any new monument counts.
Return to Selbina and trade the Clay Tablet to Abelard. Gil paid by zone: 10,000 Batallia/Sauromugue; 3,000 North Gustaberg/Rolanberry; 800 Ronfaure, South Gustaberg, Sarutabaruta; 1,000 the rest.
A tablet from a monument you already turned in pays no gil; Abelard just gives you a new lump of clay.
After each new tablet, choose to continue to get new clay for the next monument, or choose to stop (the quest leaves your log but your finished monuments are remembered; talk to him again to resume).
If you lose your clay and have no tablet, talk to Abelard and he gives you a new Lump of Selbina Clay (this works after you have zoned since he last gave you one).
Reward: gil for each new tablet; turning in the 17th monument's tablet completes the quest and gives the key item Map of the Crawlers' Nest.

name: The Gift
steps: Requires Under the Sea finished and The Sand Charm started or finished. Fishing must be enabled on the server.
In Selbina, talk to Oswald and accept his request.
Obtain a Danceshroom (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Danceshroom to Oswald.
Reward: Sleep Dagger, the title Savior of Love, and 10 San d'Oria and 10 Bastok fame.

name: The Real Gift
steps: Requires Under the Sea and The Sand Charm finished. Fishing must be enabled on the server.
In Selbina, talk to Oswald and accept his request.
Obtain a Shall Shell (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Shall Shell to Oswald.
Reward: Glass Fiber Fishing Rod, the title The Love Doctor, and 10 San d'Oria and 10 Bastok fame.

name: The Rescue
steps: Requires Selbina/Rabao fame 1.
In Selbina, talk to Thunder Hawk and accept the quest.
Obtain a Quadav Charm (this quest's script does not say where).
Go to Beadeaux, find the locked jail door, and trade the Quadav Charm to it. You get the key item Trader's Sack.
Return to Selbina and talk to Thunder Hawk.
Reward: 5,000 gil, 2,000 experience points, the key item Map of the Ranguemont Pass, the title Honorary Citizen of Selbina, and 10 San d'Oria and 10 Bastok fame.

name: Elder Memories
steps: Requires level 18 and that you have NOT started The Old Lady (the two support-job quests exclude each other).
Talk to Isacio in Selbina and accept the quest.
Trade Isacio 1 Magicked Skull (this quest's script does not say where to get it).
Trade Isacio 1 Damselfly Worm (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade Isacio 1 Crab Apron (this quest's script does not say where). If you hold the key item Gilgamesh's Introductory Letter, just talk to him to skip the trades.
Reward: support jobs (subjobs) are unlocked.

name: Test My Mettle
steps: Requires level 10, rank 2 in your nation, and Selbina/Rabao fame 2.
In Selbina, talk to Devean. Bet 1,000, 500, 250, or 100 gil and choose a time limit (24 to 72 Vana'diel hours). Your bet is paid now.
Go to Davoi and find the Jar. It moves between spots such as J-9 by a campfire, I-8 by the lake, K-9, J-8, H-8, and F-6. Examine it to get Power Sandals.
Return to Selbina and trade the Power Sandals to Devean before time runs out. If you are late, you lose your bet.
Reward: your bet times 3.0 (24-hour limit), 2.5 (36h), 2.0 (48h), 1.5 (60h), or 1.2 (72h), plus 5 San d'Oria and 5 Bastok fame. Repeatable after the next JST midnight.

name: Inside the Belly
steps: Requires Fishing skill 30 and that you finished The Real Gift; fishing must be enabled on the server.
Talk to Zaldon in Selbina to accept; he tells you which fish he wants for your fishing skill level.
Trade Zaldon one of the listed big fish (e.g. Giant Catfish, Dark Bass, Ogre Eel, Zafmlug Bass at low skill). Catch it by fishing.
Reward: gil based on the fish (10 to 12,592), sometimes a bonus item found in its belly, 10 San d'Oria and Bastok fame, and a title for certain fish. Repeatable: trade more fish any time.

name: It's Raining Mannequins!
steps: Talk to Fyi Chalmwoh in the Goldsmithing shop in Mhaura (G-8) to accept.
Go to Selbina and talk to Ramona in the Weaver's shop (H-9) to get the key item Ye Olde Mannequin Catalogue.
Go to Northern San d'Oria and talk to Cheupirudaux in front of the Woodworking Guild (F-3) to get the key item Mannequin Joint Diagrams.
Obtain 1 each of Mannequin Head, Mannequin Body, Mannequin Hands, Mannequin Legs and Mannequin Feet (this quest's script does not say where).
Return to Mhaura and trade all five mannequin parts to Fyi Chalmwoh in one trade.
Wait about 1 real-time minute, then talk to Fyi Chalmwoh again. Keep one inventory slot free and do not already own a mannequin of your race, or he cannot give it and the quest stays open.
Reward: a Mannequin of your own race.

name: Recycling Rods
steps: In Mhaura, talk to Keshab-Menjab and accept the quest.
Obtain a Clean Snap Rod (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Clean Snap Rod to Keshab-Menjab.
Reward: 1,500 gil.

name: Waking the Beast
steps: Requires the Ifrit, Garuda, Shiva, Ramuh, Leviathan and Titan summoning spells (all six avatar pacts).
Examine the ??? in La Theine Plateau (around position -179, 8, 254) to start and receive the Rainbow Resonator key item.
With the Rainbow Resonator, win the 'Waking the Beast' battlefield in each Cloister: Flames, Frost, Gales, Storms, Tides and Tremors (30 minutes, up to 18 players each).
Each Cloister win gives an Eye key item: Eye of Flames, Eye of Frost, Eye of Gales, Eye of Storms, Eye of Tides and Eye of Tremors.
With all six Eyes, enter the 'Waking the Beast' battlefield at Full Moon Fountain and defeat Carbuncle Prime and the avatar primes (30 minutes) to get the Faded Ruby.
Return to the ??? in La Theine Plateau with the Faded Ruby to complete the quest.
Repeatable once per week (after each conquest tally) by examining the ??? again.
Reward: Carbuncle's Pole, plus title Disturber of Slumber or Interrupter of Dreams depending on your choice after the final fight.

name: Monstrosity
steps: Requires the server's Monstrosity setting to be on.
Talk to the Suspicious Hume in Pashhow Marshlands to accept.
Go to Northern San d'Oria, Port Bastok or Port Windurst and trade the Suspicious Elvaan, Galka or Tarutaru ONE of: Lizard Tail, Rabbit Hide or Two-Leaf Mandragora Bud (picks your starting monster).
You receive the key item Ring of Supernal Disjunction.
Use the Odyssean Passage in any of those towns or Pashhow Marshlands and choose to enter; you are sent to the Feretory.
Reward: Monstrosity unlocked with starting monsters of the species you chose (quest completes on the Feretory cutscene).

name: A Hard Day's Knight
steps: Talk to Quelveuiat in Tavnazian Safehold and pick the answer that agrees to help (the script only starts the quest on its accepting choice).
Go to Lufaise Meadows and examine the ??? there; the NM Splinterspine Grukjuk appears and is claimed to you.
Defeat Splinterspine Grukjuk.
Return to Quelveuiat in Tavnazian Safehold for the final cutscene.
Reward: 2,100 gil and the title Tavnazian Squire.
Optional afterwards: trade Quelveuiat a Sealion Crest Key and a Coral Crest Key together to receive the key item Temple Knight Key (this quest's script does not say where to get the keys).

name: X Marks the Spot
steps: Requires your Chains of Promathia story to be at the mission Ancient Vows or later.
Talk to Despachiaire in Tavnazian Safehold to start the quest.
Talk to Parelbriaux in Tavnazian Safehold for a cutscene.
Talk to Odeya in Tavnazian Safehold; she asks for a Tavnazian Liver. Obtain a Tavnazian Liver (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade 1 Tavnazian Liver to Odeya in Tavnazian Safehold.
Go to Phomiuna Aqueducts and examine the Ornate Gate (around position 139, -25, 60) for a cutscene.
Return to Odeya in Tavnazian Safehold and talk to her to complete the quest.
Reward: 4000 gil.

name: A Bitter Past
steps: Talk to Frescheque in Tavnazian Safehold to accept the quest.
Talk to Raminey in Tavnazian Safehold.
Talk to Equette in Tavnazian Safehold.
Go to Lufaise Meadows and examine the ??? there; this spawns two Orc NMs, Blackbone Frazdiz and Rainbringer Yjatvot, claimed to you.
Defeat both Blackbone Frazdiz and Rainbringer Yjatvot.
Examine the ??? in Lufaise Meadows again to obtain the key item Tiny Wristlet.
Return to Frescheque in Tavnazian Safehold for the final cutscene.
Reward: Yin-Yang Lorgnette.

name: The Call of the Sea
steps: In Tavnazian Safehold, talk to Equette.
Talk to Anteurephiaux in Tavnazian Safehold to start the quest. Optional: talk to Leporaitceau for an extra cutscene.
Go to Misareaux Coast and examine the ??? (qm_bloody_coffin) to make the monster Bloody Coffin appear. Defeat it.
Examine the same ??? again to get the key item Whispering Conch.
Return to Tavnazian Safehold and talk to Anteurephiaux.
Talk to Equette to finish the quest.
Reward: Memento Muffler.

name: Paradise Salvation and Maps
steps: Requires: finish Chains of Promathia mission The Savage.
Talk to Nivorajean in Tavnazian Safehold to accept.
Go to the Sacrarium and open a Treasure Chest with its key (this quest's script does not say where to get it) to get the key item Piece of Ripped Floorplans.
Return to Nivorajean and pick the coordinates matching the chest you opened.
Wait until the next Vana'diel day, then talk to Nivorajean. If you picked wrong, he resets and you must open a chest again.
Reward: 2,000 EXP, 2,000 gil and the key item Map of the Sacrarium.

name: Go! Go! Gobmuffin!
steps: Requires: finish the Chains of Promathia mission Sheltering Doubt.
Talk to Epinolle in Tavnazian Safehold to accept.
Go to Riverne - Site #B01 and use the Spatial Displacement at about !pos 386 52 692 that takes you to the J-6 island; arriving there spawns three Goblin NMs.
The NMs are Book Browser Bokabraq, Chemical Cook Chemachiq and Spell Spitter Spilospok. They only spawn if none of the three is already out; if they are, wait for them to be gone and use it again.
Defeat all three without zoning (zoning resets your kill count and you must fight them again).
Return to Epinolle in Tavnazian Safehold and talk to her.
Reward: 2,000 EXP, 2,000 gil and the key item Map of Cape Riverne.

name: Unforgiven
steps: Requires Chains of Promathia progress at mission An Invitation West or later.
Talk to Elysia in Tavnazian Safehold to start the quest.
Examine the ??? (qm) in Tavnazian Safehold (around position 110, -40, -53) to get the Alabaster Hairpin key item.
Bring the Alabaster Hairpin back to Elysia in Tavnazian Safehold.
Talk to Pradiulot in Tavnazian Safehold to complete the quest.
Optional: talk to Elysia, then Pradiulot again for the after-quest scenes.
Reward: 2000 experience points and the Map of Tavnazia key item.

name: Spice Gals
steps: Requires the San d'Oria quest Spice Gals finished.
In Tavnazian Safehold, talk to Despachiaire.
Talk to Jonette in Tavnazian Safehold to start the quest.
Find the ??? in the Sacrarium or in Phomiuna Aqueducts and examine it to get the key item Tavnazian Cookbook.
Return to Tavnazian Safehold and talk to Jonette.
Reward: Miratete's Memoirs. Repeatable: talk to Jonette again after the next conquest tally.

name: Petals for Parelbriaux
steps: Requires the Chains of Promathia mission "Darkness Named" to be completed.
In Tavnazian Safehold, talk to Chemioue and watch the cutscene.
Still in Tavnazian Safehold, talk to Parelbriaux for the next cutscene.
Talk to Ondieulix in Tavnazian Safehold; this cutscene starts the quest.
Go to Lufaise Meadows and wait for foggy weather. Examine the ??? (qm_baumesel) to make the monster Baumesel appear, then defeat it.
Right after the kill, examine the same ??? again to get the key item Particularly Poignant Petal and watch the cutscene.
Go back to Tavnazian Safehold and talk to Ondieulix to finish the quest.
Reward: Powerful Rope and the title Putrid Purveyor of Pungent Petals.

name: Elderly Pursuits
steps: Requires: finish the quest Secrets of Ovens Lost first.
Talk to Despachiaire in Tavnazian Safehold to accept; you get the key item Antique Amulet.
Go to Southern San d'Oria and talk to Rouva.
Go to Carpenters' Landing and click the ??? to make the NM Para appear; defeat it (only the original Para counts).
Without zoning, click the same ??? again (no trade needed); your Antique Amulet key item is swapped for the key item Cathedral Medallion. Zoning first means you must fight Para again.
Return to Rouva in Southern San d'Oria and talk to her.
Return to Despachiaire in Tavnazian Safehold and talk to him.
Reward: Elegant Ribbon.

name: Behind the Smile
steps: Requires: finish It's Raining Mannequins! first.
Talk to Enaremand on the upper level of Tavnazian Safehold (J-7) to accept.
Go to Mhaura and talk to Fyi Chalmwoh.
Go to Carpenters' Landing and examine the ??? to spawn the NM Bullheaded Grosvez; defeat it.
Examine the ??? in Carpenters' Landing again to obtain the key item Red Oil.
Return to Enaremand in Tavnazian Safehold.
Reward: Mannequin Pumps.

name: Knocking on Forbidden Doors
steps: Requires: finish Behind the Smile first.
Talk to Enaremand on the upper level of Tavnazian Safehold (J-7) to accept.
Talk to Chemioue in Tavnazian Safehold.
Go to Phomiuna Aqueducts and use the specific Wooden Ladder tied to this quest for a cutscene.
Go to Misareaux Coast and examine the ??? by the end of the river to get the key item Mire Incense.
Examine the other ??? in Misareaux Coast for a cutscene, then examine it again to spawn the NM Alsha; defeat it.
Examine that ??? once more to get the key item Better Humes and Mannequins.
Go to Mhaura and talk to Fyi Chalmwoh.
Reward: key item Better Humes and Mannequins; Fyi Chalmwoh now sells, swaps and poses mannequins for gil.

name: Confessions of a Bellmaker
steps: Examine the Stone Monument in Riverne-Site A01 to start the quest; you receive the key item Ornamented Scroll.
Go to Bastok Markets and talk to Reinberta.
Go to Northern San d'Oria and talk to Mevreauche.
Return to the Stone Monument in Riverne-Site A01 and examine it for a cutscene.
Examine the Stone Monument again to spawn the NM Arcane Phantasm; defeat it.
Examine the Stone Monument once more for the final cutscene.
Reward: Minstrel's Dagger.

name: In Search of the Truth
steps: Requires: be past Chains of Promathia mission Darkness Named.
Talk to Tressia in Tavnazian Safehold to accept.
Talk to Raminey, Zadant, Fouagine and Noam in Tavnazian Safehold (any order).
Talk to Tressia and pick the answer that moves on, then talk to her again (Mengrenaux and Chemioue have optional hints).
Follow the water trail in Tavnazian Safehold in order: examine the first ??? to get the key item Shaded Cruse, then the 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th ???s.
Talk to Tressia, then talk to Ondieulix in Tavnazian Safehold.
Reward: Gramary Cape.

name: Uninvited Guests
steps: Requires finishing the Chains of Promathia mission The Savage.
Talk to Justinius in Tavnazian Safehold and accept the offer to get the Monarch Linn Patrol Permit key item.
Go to Monarch Linn and enter the battlefield 'Uninvited Guests' (up to 18 players, 30-minute limit) using the permit.
Defeat every Mammet-800 in the battlefield. If you lose or leave, Justinius makes you wait until the next conquest tally (weekly) before retrying.
Return to Justinius in Tavnazian Safehold after winning to claim your reward.
Repeatable: after the next conquest tally, talk to Justinius again to get a new permit.
Reward: Miratete's Memoirs and title Monarch Linn Patrol Guard. The script notes the full reward list is not implemented yet (TODO).

name: Tango With a Tracker
steps: Requires the Chains of Promathia mission "A Fate Decided" to be completed.
In Tavnazian Safehold, talk to Despachiaire to get the key item Letter from Shikaree X.
Go to Boneyard Gully and use the battlefield entrance. The player holding the letter must enter "Tango With a Tracker" (up to 6 players, 30-minute limit); entering starts the quest.
Win the battle to finish the quest. If you lose, talk to Despachiaire after the next conquest tally for a new letter.
Reward: 10,000 gil and the title Sin Hunter Hunter.

name: Requiem of Sin
steps: Requires finishing the quest Tango with a Tracker first.
Talk to Despachiaire in Tavnazian Safehold (near !pos 111 -40 -85) to get the key item Letter from Shikaree Y.
Go to Boneyard Gully and touch the battlefield entrance with the letter (up to 6 players, 30-minute limit). Entering starts the quest.
Defeat Shikaree X, Shikaree Y and Shikaree Z. They chain weapon skills together (Evisceration, then Vorpal Scythe, then Impulse Drive), so kill one fast to break up the chains.
Win and leave the battlefield to complete the quest. If you lose the letter, Despachiaire gives a new one after the next conquest tally (weekly).
Reward: title Disciple of Justice. Afterward, Despachiaire gives a Letter from the Mithran Trackers once per conquest tally so you can repeat the fight.

name: Bombs Away!
steps: Talk to Buffalostalker Dodzbraz in Uleguerand Range and choose the option to climb the mountain to accept.
Obtain 2 Cluster Cores (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade exactly 2 Cluster Cores to Buffalostalker Dodzbraz.
Reward: Chunk of Shumeyo Salt.

name: Give a Moogle a Break
steps: Requires fame level 3 in your home nation, in your home nation's Mog House, with your bed placed at least 1 minute earlier.
Talk to the Moogle in your Mog House and accept; it asks for a Power Bow and a Beetle Ring.
Trade the Moogle 1 Power Bow and 1 Beetle Ring together (this quest's script does not say where to get them).
Wait about 1 minute, then talk to the Moogle again.
Reward: title Mog's Kind Master and +10 slots each in your Mog Safe and Mog Safe 2.

name: The Moogle's Picnic!
steps: Requires finishing Give a Moogle a Break and fame 5 in your home nation. You must be in a Mog House in your home nation.
Place a Mahogany Bed in your Mog House. No other bed works. If you remove it, the timer resets.
Leave the Mog House and come back in. Wait at least 1 minute after placing the bed.
Talk to the Moogle and accept the quest. If you decline, leave and re-enter to get the offer again.
Obtain 1 Shrimp Lure and 1 Stick of Selbina Butter (this quest's script does not say where). Trade both to the Moogle at the same time.
Wait 1 minute. Leave and re-enter the Mog House, then talk to the Moogle to finish.
Reward: title Mog's Exceptionally Kind Master. Mog Safe and Mog Safe 2 each grow by 10 slots.

name: Moogles in the Wild
steps: Requires fame level 7 in your home nation and The Moogle Picnic finished; be in your home nation's Mog House with your bed placed at least 1 minute earlier.
Talk to the Moogle in your Mog House and accept; it asks for a Raptor Mantle and a Wool Hat.
Trade the Moogle 1 Raptor Mantle and 1 Wool Hat together (this quest's script does not say where to get them).
Wait about 1 minute, then talk to the Moogle again.
Reward: title Mog's Loving Master and +10 slots each in your Mog Safe and Mog Safe 2.

name: Missionery Moblin
steps: Talk to Koblakiq in Oldton Movalpolos and agree to help to accept.
Trade a Soiled Letter to Koblakiq (this quest's script does not say where to get it).
Reward: 4,000 gil.

name: For the Birds
steps: Requires: finish Missionary Moblin, then zone at least once afterwards.
Talk to Koblakiq in Oldton Movalpolos and agree to help; he asks for an Arnica Root.
Go to Castle Oztroja and trade an Arnica Root to Daa Bola the Seer (this quest's script does not say where to get the root).
Zone, then return to Koblakiq in Oldton Movalpolos to receive the key item Glittering Fragment.
Go to Beadeaux and talk to GeFhu Yagudoeye; four Quadav NMs (two Magnes Quadav, two Nickel Quadav) attack you.
Defeat all four Quadav without zoning (zoning resets the count; talk to GeFhu Yagudoeye to respawn them), then talk to GeFhu Yagudoeye again.
Return to Koblakiq in Oldton Movalpolos.
Reward: Jaguar Mantle.

name: Better The Demon You Know
steps: Requires: finish For the Birds, then zone at least once afterwards.
Talk to Koblakiq in Oldton Movalpolos to accept; he asks for a Demon Pen.
Trade a Demon Pen to Koblakiq (this quest's script does not say where to get it).
Wait about 1 minute, then talk to Koblakiq again; he sends you to Castle Zvahl Baileys.
In Castle Zvahl Baileys, examine the ??? (qm2); Marquis Andrealphus and four other monsters appear. Defeat Marquis Andrealphus.
Without zoning, examine the ??? again to get the key item Zeelozok's Earplug (if you zone first you must refight).
Return to Koblakiq in Oldton Movalpolos.
Reward: Goblin Grenade and the title Apostate for Hire.

name: A Question of Taste
steps: Requires Windurst fame level 6. Angelica only helps after you complete A Pose By Any Other Name and zone once.
Talk to Etteh Sulaej in Kazham to start the quest and get the key item Letter to Angelica.
Go to Windurst Waters and talk to Angelica. You get the key items Final Fantasy and Angelica's Letter.
Return to Etteh Sulaej in Kazham.
Go to Temple of Uggalepih, examine the Stone Picture Frame and agree, which makes the monster Trompe L'Oeil appear. Defeat it (if you fail, wait 15 minutes to try again).
Examine the Stone Picture Frame again to get the key item Ripped Final Fantasy Painting.
Return to Etteh Sulaej in Kazham to finish.
Reward: 3,000 gil and Windurst fame.
Repeatable: zone, then talk to Etteh Sulaej again to get Final Fantasy Part II and repeat the frame fight.

name: Everyone's Grudging
steps: Requires Windurst fame 7, finishing A Question of Taste, and being cursed: trade an Unlit Lantern at an Altar of Rancor in Den of Rancor to get the Rancor Flame and the curse.
In Kazham, talk to Jakoh Wahcondalo (!pos 98 -15 -113) to accept the quest (you also get the title Excommunicate of Kazham).
Go to Den of Rancor and defeat a Rancor Torch (this quest's script does not say how it appears).
Return to Jakoh Wahcondalo in Kazham and talk to him to finish.
Reward: 11,000 gil and Windurst fame.

name: You Call That a Knife
steps: Requires Windurst fame level 6.
Obtain 1 Sandfish (this quest's script does not say where). In Kazham, trade it to Mhebi Juhbily and agree to help in the cutscene. Pula Rhatti in Kazham also talks about the Sandfish.
Still in Kazham, examine the door next to Mhebi Juhbily (NPC _6y9) and accept to start the quest.
Talk to Vah Keshura in Kazham for the next cutscene.
Obtain 1 Tonberry Board (this quest's script does not say where). Go to Chef Nonberry in the Temple of Uggalepih and trade him exactly 1 Tonberry Board to get the key item Nonberry's Knife.
Warning: if you trade Chef Nonberry anything else, it is used up and the hostile Cook monsters can spawn and attack you (at most once every 10 minutes).
Go back to Kazham and talk to Mhebi Juhbily to finish.
Reward: 7,200 gil, 60 Windurst fame and the title Ya Done Good.

name: Trial by Fire
steps: Requires Windurst fame 6. Repeatable once per Japan-time day after completion.
In Kazham, talk to Ronta-Onta (!pos 100 -14 -98) and accept to receive the key item Tuning Fork of Fire.
Go to Cloister of Flames and enter the Trial by Fire battlefield with the Tuning Fork of Fire (up to 6 players, 30 minutes).
Defeat Ifrit Prime to receive the key item Whisper of Flames and the title Heir of the Great Fire. If you lose, talk to Ronta-Onta for a new tuning fork.
Return to Ronta-Onta in Kazham and pick your reward.
Reward: choose one of Ifrit's Blade, Fire Belt, Fire Ring, Egil's Torch, 10,000 gil, or the Ifrit summoning pact (Summoners only); plus Windurst fame.

name: Cloak and Dagger
steps: Requires a job that can equip the Dagger of Trials, dagger skill 230, and no other weapon skill trial in progress (no Weapon Training Guide).
Talk to Jakoh Wahcondalo in Kazham to get the Dagger of Trials and the key item Weapon Training Guide.
Fight with the Dagger of Trials equipped until it has 300 weapon skill points.
Trade the Dagger of Trials to Jakoh Wahcondalo in Kazham to get the key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
Go to Gustav Tunnel and examine the ??? (qm1) near position (53, -1, 20) to make Baronial Bat appear. Defeat it.
Examine the ??? again to get the key item Annals of Truth.
Return to Jakoh Wahcondalo in Kazham to finish.
Reward: you learn the weapon skill Evisceration, plus Windurst fame.

name: Forge Your Destiny
steps: Requires level 30 or higher (any job). This is the Samurai job unlock quest.
In Norg, talk to Jaucribaix (!pos 91 -7 -8) and choose to accept the quest.
In Norg, talk to Aeka (!pos 4 0 -4) to receive a Lump of Oriental Steel (if you lose it, trade her 1 Chunk of Darksteel Ore for another).

In Konschtat Highlands, stand right next to the blackened spot (qm3, !pos -709 2 102), trade the Lump of Oriental Steel, and defeat the Forger that appears. Return to Aeka in Norg for the Lump of Bomb Steel.
In Norg, talk to Ranemaud (!pos 15 0 23) to receive a Sacred Sprig (if lost, trade him 2 Chunks of Gold Ore + 1 Chunk of Platinum Ore).
In The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah at the tree (qm2, !pos 642 -5 -150), while carrying the Sacred Sprig, trade 1 Hatchet and defeat the Guardian Treant that appears.
Trade the Sacred Sprig to the same tree to receive a Sacred Branch.
Trade Jaucribaix in Norg 1 Lump of Bomb Steel + 1 Sacred Branch, then wait 3 Vana'diel days (about 3 real hours) and talk to him again.
Reward: Mumeito, Samurai job unlocked, key item Job Gesture: Samurai, title Bushido Blade, Norg fame.

name: Stop Your Whining
steps: Requires level 10 and Norg fame 4.
In Norg, talk to Washu (!pos 49 -6 15) and accept the quest; you receive the key item Empty Barrel.
In Yhoator Jungle, examine the tree (qm2, !pos -94 -1 22) to fill it and get the key item Barrel of Opo-opo Brew.
Return to Washu in Norg and talk to him.
Reward: Scroll of Hojo: Ichi, title Apprentice Sommelier, Norg fame.

name: Secret of the Damp Scroll
steps: Requires level 10, Norg fame 3, and carrying a Damp Scroll (this quest's script does not say where to get it).
In Norg, talk to Shivivi (!pos 69 -6 -6) to accept the quest.
Go to Horlais Peak and trade the Damp Scroll to the Hot Springs (!pos 444 -37 -18).
Reward: Scroll of Jubaku: Ichi, title Cracker of the Secret Code, Norg fame.

name: The Sahagin's Stash
steps: Requires level 5 and Norg fame 4.
In Norg, talk to Laisrean (!pos -2 -1 22) and choose to accept the quest.
In Sea Serpent Grotto, examine the ??? (qm2, !pos 295 27 213) to get the key item Sea Serpent Statue.
Return to Laisrean in Norg and talk to him.
Reward: Scroll of Utsusemi: Ichi, title Treasure-House Ransacker, Norg fame.

name: Like Shining Subligars
steps: Requires Norg fame 3.
In Norg, talk to Heiji (!pos -1 -5 25) to accept the quest.
Obtain 10 Rusty Subligars (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade Rusty Subligars to Heiji (only subligars in the trade); he keeps count, so you can turn them in a few at a time until you reach 10.
Reward: Scroll of Kurayami: Ichi, title Looks Sublime in a Subligar, Norg fame.

name: Like Shining Leggings
steps: Requires Norg fame 3.
In Norg, talk to Heizo (!pos -1 -5 25) to accept the quest.
Obtain 10 Rusty Leggings (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade Rusty Leggings to Heizo (only leggings in the trade); he keeps count, so you can turn them in a few at a time until you reach 10.
Reward: Scroll of Dokumori: Ichi, title Looks Good in Leggings, Norg fame.

name: The Sacred Katana (SAM AF1)
steps: Requires Samurai main job, level 40+, and finishing Forge Your Destiny.
In Norg, talk to Jaucribaix (!pos 91 -7 -8) and accept the quest. Keep your Mumeito (if you lost it, trade Ranemaud in Norg 30,000 gil for a new one).
Obtain a Sack of Fish Bait (this quest's script does not say where).
In The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah at qm3 (!pos -416 0 46), trade the Sack of Fish Bait and defeat the Isonade that appears.
Examine the same spot right after the kill (without leaving the zone) to get the key item Handful of Crystal Scales.
Return to Norg and trade 1 Mumeito to Jaucribaix.
Reward: Magoroku and Norg fame.

name: Yomi Okuri (SAM AF2)
steps: Requires Samurai main job, level 50+, and finishing The Sacred Katana; change zones and wait 1 minute after that quest.
In Norg, talk to Jaucribaix (!pos 91 -7 -8) and accept the quest, then talk to Washu (!pos 49 -6 15).
Obtain 1 Hecteyes Eye, 1 Bastore Sardine, 1 Slice of Giant Sheep Meat and 1 Frost Turnip (this quest's script does not say where); trade all four to Washu for the key item Washu's Tasty Wurst.
In Labyrinth of Onzozo, examine qm2 (!pos -176 10 -60), choose to use the wurst, and defeat Ubume. Examine qm2 again for the key item Yomotsu Feather.
Give the feather to Jaucribaix in Norg by talking to him, then change zones, wait 1 minute and talk to him again for the key item Yomotsu Hirasaka.
In Valkurm Dunes at qm3 (!pos -767 -4 192), between 18:00 and 5:00 Vana'diel time, examine it, choose to proceed, and defeat both Doman and Onryo.
Examine qm3 again and pick the first option to receive the key item Faded Yomotsu Hirasaka.
Talk to Jaucribaix in Norg.
Reward: Myochin Sune-Ate and Norg fame.

name: A Thief in Norg!? (SAM AF3)
steps: Requires Samurai as your main job, level 50 or higher, and Yomi Okuri finished. After that quest you must change zones and wait 1 minute.
In Norg, talk to Jaucribaix (!pos 91 -7 -8) and choose to accept the quest.
In Port Jeuno, talk to Sanosuke (!pos -63 7 0). Then, in Mhaura, talk to Phoochuchu (!pos -4 -4 69).
In Bastok Mines, examine the door _6i8 (!pos 70 7 2). Then travel into Waughroon Shrine and watch a cutscene when you arrive.
Return to Jaucribaix in Norg to receive a Banishing Charm. If you lose it, talk to him again for a new one.
In Waughroon Shrine, enter the A Thief in Norg!? battlefield (up to 6 players, 30 minutes). Only the person who enters first needs the Banishing Charm, and it is not used up.
Inside, defeat Gaki, Rasetsu and Onki to win. The other enemies (Onibi and Ayakashi) are not needed for the win. You then receive the key item Charred Helm.
Talk to Jaucribaix in Norg. Obtain a Spool of Gold Thread (this quest's script does not say where) and trade 1 to him while you hold the Charred Helm.
Change zones, wait 1 minute, then talk to Jaucribaix again.
Reward: Myochin Kabuto, the title Paragon of Samurai Excellence, and Norg fame.

name: I'll Take the Big Box (NIN AF2)
steps: Requires Ninja as your main job, level 50 or higher, and Twenty in Pirate Years finished. If Ryoma says nothing, change zones and try again.
In Norg, talk to Ryoma (!pos -26 0 -8) to accept the quest.
In Port Bastok, talk to Ensetsu (!pos 32 -7 69).
In Rabao, talk to Leodarion (!pos -50 8 41). Obtain an Oak Pole (this quest's script does not say where), then trade him 1 Oak Pole.
Wait until the next Vana'diel day, then talk to Leodarion again to get the key item Seance Staff. He reminds you to sail the Bastore Sea from east to west at night.
In Mhaura, board the ferry headed for Selbina at the docks (the dock NPC Dieh Yamilsiah says when it arrives). Keep the Seance Staff with you.
On the ship, Enagakure appears only between 20:00 and 4:00 Vana'diel time. It spawns when you arrive aboard, or on the hour if you are already aboard. Defeat it.
Stay on the ship until it docks in Selbina. When you arrive, a final cutscene plays and the Seance Staff is taken back.
Reward: Ninja Hakama and Norg fame.

name: The Potential Within
steps: Requires a job that can equip the Tachi of Trials, Great Katana skill 250+, and not already holding a Weapon Training Guide.
In Norg, talk to Jaucribaix (!pos 91 -7 -8) and accept to get the Tachi of Trials and key item Weapon Training Guide.
Equip the Tachi of Trials and earn 300 weapon skill points with it by fighting.
Trade the finished Tachi of Trials to Jaucribaix to receive the key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
In Kuftal Tunnel, examine qm3 (!pos 200 11 99) to make Kettenkaefer appear and defeat it.
Examine qm3 again to get the key item Annals of Truth, then talk to Jaucribaix in Norg.
Reward: learn the weapon skill Tachi: Kasha, plus Norg fame.

name: Bugi Soden
steps: Requires a job that can equip the Kodachi of Trials, katana skill 250, and no other weapon skill trial in progress (no Weapon Training Guide).
Talk to Ryoma in Norg and accept to get the Kodachi of Trials and the key item Weapon Training Guide.
Fight with the Kodachi of Trials equipped until it has 300 weapon skill points.
Trade the Kodachi of Trials to Ryoma in Norg to get the key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
Go to Labyrinth of Onzozo and examine the ??? (qm1) near position (110, 15, 162) to make Megapod Megalops appear. Defeat it.
Examine the ??? again to get the key item Annals of Truth.
Return to Ryoma in Norg to finish.
Reward: you learn the weapon skill Blade: Ku, plus Norg fame.

name: Wrath of the Opo-Opos
steps: This quest is added automatically during the Zilart mission Headstone Pilgrimage: in Yuhtunga Jungle, the Cermet Headstone hands you the Fire Fragment key item without a fight (this happens while its opo-opo fight is on cooldown).
Obtain 1 Garnet (this quest's script does not say where).
Return to the Cermet Headstone in Yuhtunga Jungle and trade it exactly 1 Garnet. Touching it without the gem only shows a message about a red jewel.
Reward: Opo-opo Necklace and the title Friend of the Opo-Opos.

name: Wandering Souls
steps: This quest starts automatically during the Rise of the Zilart mission Headstone Pilgrimage, when you get the Wind Fragment at the Cermet Headstone in Cape Teriggan.
Obtain a Rain Lily (this quest's script does not say where).
In Cape Teriggan, trade the Rain Lily to the Cermet Headstone (!pos -107 -8 450).
Reward: Flagellant's Rope and title Bearer of Bonds Beyond Time.

name: Soul Searching
steps: This quest starts automatically during the Rise of the Zilart mission Headstone Pilgrimage, when you get the Light Fragment at the Cermet Headstone in The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah.
Obtain the key item Prismatic Fragment (this quest's script does not say where).
Return to the Cermet Headstone in The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah (!pos 235 0 280) and examine it while carrying the Prismatic Fragment.
Reward: Bat Earring and title Guider of Souls to the Sanctuary.

name: Divine Might
steps: Requires being on Rise of the Zilart mission Ark Angels (or later while holding one of the Shard key items from the Ark Angels fights).
Go to The Shrine of Ru'Avitau and examine the blank marker (!pos -40 0 -151) to watch the cutscene and accept the quest.
Obtain a Sheet of Parchment and a Bottle of Illuminink (this quest's script does not say where).

Go to Ro'Maeve, to Qu'Hau Spring (!pos 0 -29 64). During a Full Moon between 18:00 and 6:00 Vana'diel time, trade it exactly 1 Sheet of Parchment + 1 Bottle of Illuminink to receive an Ark Pentasphere.
Go to La'Loff Amphitheater and enter the Divine Might battlefield (up to 18 players, 30-minute limit, level cap 99); the Ark Pentasphere is required to enter.
Inside, defeat all five Ark Angels (HM, MR, EV, TT and GK) to win.
Return to the blank marker in The Shrine of Ru'Avitau and choose one earring: Suppanomimi, Knight's Earring, Abyssal Earring, Beastly Earring or Bushinomimi.
Reward: your chosen earring and the title Pentacide Perpetrator.

name: Divine Might (Repeat)
steps: Requires finishing Divine Might, and you must hold fewer Divine Might earrings than the server allows (default 1), so the earring you already have must be gone first. Repeatable.
In The Shrine of Ru'Avitau, examine the blank marker (!pos -40 0 -151) and watch the cutscene to restart the quest.
Obtain a Sheet of Parchment and a Bottle of Illuminink. If you do not already have the key item Moonlight Ore, also obtain a Chunk of Light Ore (this quest's script does not say where).
Go to Qu'Hau Spring in Ro'Maeve (!pos 0 -29 64). You can only trade there during a Full Moon, between 18:00 and 6:00 Vana'diel time.
Only if you do not already have Moonlight Ore: trade the spring 1 Chunk of Light Ore to get it. The spring refuses the ore if you already have the key item, which stays with you after earlier runs.
At the spring in the same moon/time window, trade exactly 1 Sheet of Parchment + 1 Bottle of Illuminink to receive an Ark Pentasphere.
Enter the Divine Might battlefield in La'Loff Amphitheater using the Ark Pentasphere, and win it while carrying Moonlight Ore.
Go back to the blank marker in The Shrine of Ru'Avitau and choose one earring: Suppanomimi, Knight's Earring, Abyssal Earring, Beastly Earring or Bushinomimi.
Reward: the earring you chose and the title Pentacide Perpetrator.

name: Open Sesame
steps: In Eastern Altepa Desert, talk to Lokpix (!pos -62 4 225) and agree to help to accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Tremorstone plus one of: 1 Meteorite, 1 Soil Gem, or 12 Soil Geodes (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade Lokpix the Tremorstone together with your chosen item(s).
Reward: key item Loadstone, plus San d'Oria and Bastok fame.

name: The Missing Piece
steps: Requires level 10 and Selbina/Rabao fame 4.
In Rabao, talk to Alfesar (!pos 23 9 39) to accept the quest.
In Quicksand Caves, find and examine the ??? (qm5) to get the key item Ancient Tablet Fragment; it moves between spots around !pos 770 0 -419, 657 0 -537, 759 0 -573, 451 -16 -739, 787 -16 -819.
Return to Alfesar in Rabao to receive Tablet of Ancient Magic and Letter from Alfesar.
In Northern San d'Oria, talk to Charlaimagnat (!pos 125 7 112); you get the title Acquirer of Ancient Arcanum.
Wait about 1 minute, then talk to Charlaimagnat again.
Reward: Scroll of Teleport-Altep, plus San d'Oria and Bastok fame.

name: The Kuftal Tour
steps: Requires finishing The Gustaberg Tour and Selbina/Rabao fame 3.
In Rabao, talk to Datta (!pos -44 -10 -2) to accept the quest.
Form a party of at least 2 players where every member is level 40 or lower.
In Kuftal Tunnel, with all party members within 15 yalms of you, examine qm5 (!pos -29 -22 -184) to view the cutscene.
Return to Datta in Rabao and talk to him.
Reward: 8,000 gil, title Kuftal Tourist, San d'Oria and Bastok fame.

name: Chasing Dreams
steps: Talk to Rudolfo in Rabao to start the quest. The script has a TODO for an unconfirmed requirement, so it checks none.
Talk to Zoriboh in Rabao.
Go to Norg, talk to Sohyon, then talk to Washu to get the key item Washu's Flask.
Go to Korroloka Tunnel and examine all four clams: near (104, -5, 17), (-25, -5, 183), (-254, -5, -56) and (-384, -5, 53). You get the key item Flask of Clam Water.
Return to Norg: talk to Sohyon for the Storeroom Key, then talk to Gimb.
Go to Port Bastok, talk to Kagetora, then trade 5 Eastern Gems to the Patient Wheel (obtain the gems; this quest's script does not say where).
Go to Selbina and talk to Abelard.
Enter Lufaise Meadows to see a cutscene.
Return to Zoriboh in Rabao to finish.
Reward: Venerer Ring, 4,000 gil, and San d'Oria and Bastok fame.

name: A Sentry's Peril
steps: Talk to Glenne in Southern San d'Oria and accept. She gives you a Dose of Ointment, and she gives you another if you lose it.
Go to West Ronfaure and find the guard Aaveleon on the road to Ghelsba Outpost (G-6).
Make sure you have a free inventory slot, then trade the Dose of Ointment to Aaveleon. He gives you an Ointment Case, and he gives you another if you lose it.
