Return to Glenne in Southern San d'Oria and trade her the Ointment Case.
Reward: Bronze Subligar, title Ronfaurian Rescuer and San d'Oria fame.

name: Waters of the Cheval
steps: Talk to Miageau in Northern San d'Oria (L-7), just past the entrance to the Cathedral, to start the quest.
Trade 10 gil to Nouveil, standing to Miageau's right, to receive a Blessed Waterskin.
Go to East Ronfaure (H-5), the top of the river, and trade the Blessed Waterskin to the Cheval River to get a Skin of Cheval River Water.
Return to Miageau in Northern San d'Oria and trade him the Skin of Cheval River Water.
Reward: Wing Pendant, title The Pure One, San d'Oria fame.

name: Rosel the Armorer
steps: Talk to Rosel in Southern San d'Oria and accept; you receive key item Receipt for the Prince. Note which prince (Pieuje or Trion) she names.
Go to Guilerme in Northern San d'Oria, talk to him, and choose the prince Rosel named.
Return to Rosel in Southern San d'Oria and talk to her to finish.
Reward: 200 gil and 20 San d'Oria fame if you named the right prince (100 gil and 10 fame if not), plus title Entrance Denied.

name: The Pickpocket
steps: Talk to Miene, the little girl in Port San d'Oria, to watch a thief rob the guard Altiret.
Talk to Altiret in Port San d'Oria; he asks you to recover his wife's glasses (quest starts).
Talk to Miene again (keep an inventory slot free) to receive an Eagle Button.
Go to West Ronfaure, (F-6), and find Esca in the tower; trade her the Eagle Button to receive the Gilt Glasses.
Return to Port San d'Oria and trade the Gilt Glasses to Altiret.
Reward: Light Axe, San d'Oria fame, title Pickpocket Pincher.

name: Father and Son
steps: Talk to Ailbeche in Northern San d'Oria to accept the quest (he is looking for his father).
Go to Southern San d'Oria and talk to Exoroche (his father).
Return to Ailbeche in Northern San d'Oria and talk to him to finish.
Reward: Willow Fishing Rod, 20 San d'Oria fame, title Lost Child Officer.
Optional: trade the Willow Fishing Rod back to Ailbeche to earn the title Family Counselor (needed for the Paladin quest Sharpening the Sword).

name: The Seamstress
steps: Talk to Hanaa Punaa in Southern San d'Oria and accept (first option).
Obtain 3 Sheepskins (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade exactly 3 Sheepskins to Hanaa Punaa.
Reward: Leather Gloves, San d'Oria fame, title Silencer of the Lambs. Repeatable: trade 3 more Sheepskins any time for another pair.

name: The Dismayed Customer
steps: Requires A Taste for Meat completed.
Talk to Gulemont in Port San d'Oria and accept (first option).
Go to West Ronfaure and check the three ??? spots; only one (chosen at random when you accepted) gives the key item Gulemont's Document.
Return to Gulemont in Port San d'Oria and talk to him.
Reward: 560 gil, San d'Oria fame, title Lost & Found Officer.

name: The Trader in the Forest
steps: Talk to Abeaule in Northern San d'Oria and accept (first option); you receive a Supplies Order.
Go to West Ronfaure and trade the Supplies Order to Phairet to receive a Clump of Batagreens (Phairet also sells Batagreens for 50 gil).
Return to Northern San d'Oria and trade the Clump of Batagreens to Abeaule.
Reward: Robe, San d'Oria fame, title Green Grocer.

name: The Sweetest Things
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 2.
Talk to Raimbroy in Southern San d'Oria, then talk to him again and accept (first option).
Obtain 5 Pots of Honey (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade exactly 5 Pots of Honey to Raimbroy.
Reward: 400 gil, San d'Oria fame, title Apiarist. Repeatable: trade 5 more Pots of Honey any time for the same reward.

name: The Vicasque's Sermon
steps: Requires Waters of the Cheval completed.
Talk to Abioleget in Northern San d'Oria to start the quest.
Trade 70 gil to Abioleget to receive a Pod of Blue Peas.
Go to East Ronfaure and trade the Pod of Blue Peas to Andelain.
Return to Abioleget in Northern San d'Oria and talk to him.
Reward: Brass Ring, San d'Oria fame, title The Benevolent One.

name: A Squire's Test
steps: Talk to Balasiel in Southern San d'Oria and accept his test (choose the first option). If you decline, talk to him again and pick the first option.
Balasiel tells you to go to King Ranperre's Tomb and bring back a Revival Tree Root. Go there and obtain one (the script does not say exactly where inside it is found).
Trade the Revival Tree Root to Balasiel in Southern San d'Oria.
Reward: Spatha, title Knight in Training and San d'Oria fame.

name: Grave_Concerns
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 1.
Talk to Andecia in Southern San d'Oria to hear her story, then talk to her again and accept; she gives you a Skin of Well Water.
Travel to King Ranperres Tomb and find the upper tombstone (Tombstone_Upper); trade it the Skin of Well Water to change the water and receive a Tomb Guard's Waterskin.
Return to Andecia in Southern San d'Oria and trade her the Tomb Guard's Waterskin to finish.
If you lose the Skin of Well Water: talk to Andecia, examine the tombstone to take its waterskin, trade it to the Well in Southern San d'Oria to refill it, then go back to the tombstone.
Reward: 560 gil, 20 San d'Oria fame, title Royal Grave Keeper.

name: The Brugaire Consortium
steps: Talk to Fontoumant in Port San d'Oria and accept (first option); you receive a Parcel for the Magic Shop.
Trade the Parcel for the Magic Shop to Regine in Port San d'Oria.
Talk to Fontoumant again to receive a Parcel for the Auction House, then trade it to Apstaule in Port San d'Oria.
Talk to Fontoumant again to receive a Parcel for the Pub, then trade it to Thierride in Port San d'Oria.
Talk to Fontoumant once more to finish. (If a parcel is lost, trade Fontoumant 100 gil to continue.)
Reward: Lauan Shield, San d'Oria fame, title Courier Extraordinaire.

name: Lizard Skins
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 2; finish The Seamstress first.
Talk to Hanaa Punaa in Southern San d'Oria and choose to accept the quest (if you decline, talk to her again to accept).
Obtain 3 Lizard Skins (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade exactly 3 Lizard Skins to Hanaa Punaa.
Reward: Lizard Gloves, 10 San d'Oria fame, title Lizard Skinner. Repeatable: trade 3 more Lizard Skins anytime for another pair and 10 fame.

name: A Squire's Test II
steps: Requires level 10 and A Squire's Test completed.
Talk to Balasiel in Southern San d'Oria to accept the test. Talking to Chanpau in Southern San d'Oria and then Morjean in Northern San d'Oria is optional and gives hints.
In Ordelles Caves, examine the ??? at the pool (around !pos -94 1 273) to put your hands in the water.
Within 30 seconds, examine the second ??? nearby (around !pos -139 0 264) to get the key item Stalactite Dew. If you are too slow, start again at the pool.
Return to Balasiel in Southern San d'Oria.
Reward: key item Squire Certificate, title Spelunker and San d'Oria fame.

name: Tigers Teeth
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame level 3.
Talk to Taumila in Southern San d'Oria and accept the request (first choice in the cutscene).
Obtain 3 Black Tiger Fangs (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade exactly 3 Black Tiger Fangs to Taumila in Southern San d'Oria.
Reward: 2,100 gil, title Fang Finder, San d'Oria fame. Repeatable: trade 3 more Black Tiger Fangs to Taumila any time for 2,100 gil and more fame.

name: A Purchase of Arms
steps: Requires Father and Son completed and San d'Oria fame 2.
Talk to Helbort in Southern San d'Oria and accept. You receive the key item Weapons Order.
Go to Jugner Forest and talk to Alexius. He swaps the Weapons Order for the key item Weapons Receipt.
Return to Helbort in Southern San d'Oria with the Weapons Receipt.
Reward: Elm Staff, title Arms Trader and San d'Oria fame.

name: A Knight's Test
steps: Requires level 30 and A Squire's Test II completed.

Talk to Balasiel in Southern San d'Oria and accept the test by choosing the first option. You receive the key item Book of Tasks. If you pick anything else, talk to him again and choose the first option.
In Southern San d'Oria, talk to Baunise to get the key item Book of the West.
In Southern San d'Oria, talk to Cahaurme to get the key item Book of the East.
With both books, go to Davoi and examine the Disused Well to obtain the key item Knight's Soul.
Return to Balasiel in Southern San d'Oria to finish the test and unlock the Paladin job.
Reward: Kite Shield, key item Job Gesture Paladin, title Tried and Tested Knight, San d'Oria fame, and the Paladin job unlocked.

name: The Medicine Woman
steps: Requires The Trader in the Forest completed and San d'Oria fame 3.
Talk to Abeaule in Northern San d'Oria and accept (first option).
Talk to Amaura in Southern San d'Oria and accept to receive the key item Amaura's Formula.
Obtain 1 Malboro Vine, 1 Chunk of Zinc Ore and 1 Insect Wing (this quest's script does not say where) and trade all three to Amaura to get the key item Cold Medicine.
Return to Abeaule in Northern San d'Oria and talk to him.
Reward: 2,100 gil, San d'Oria fame, title Traveling Medicine Man.

name: Black Tiger Skins
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 3 and Lizard Skins completed.
Talk to Hanaa Punaa in Southern San d'Oria and accept (choose the first option).
Obtain 3 Tiger Hides (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade all 3 Tiger Hides to Hanaa Punaa.
Reward: Tiger Stole, title Cat Skinner and San d'Oria fame.

name: Growing Flowers
steps: Talk to Kuu Mohzolhi in Northern San d'Oria to start the quest (trading him any flower also starts it).
Obtain a Marguerite (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade exactly one Marguerite to Kuu Mohzolhi to finish. Warning: any other flower you trade him before finishing is used up and does not complete the quest.
Reward: 0 San d'Oria fame; a new Mog House exit is unlocked (the script sets a Mog House flag and shows the Mog House exit message).

name: The General's Secret
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 2.
Talk to Curilla in Chateau d'Oraguille and accept; you receive the key item Curilla's Bottle (empty).
Travel to Horlais Peak and examine the Hot Springs to fill the bottle (key item Curilla's Bottle (full)).
Return to Curilla in Chateau d'Oraguille and talk to her.
Reward: Lynx Baghnakhs, San d'Oria fame.

name: The Rumor
steps: Requires level 10 and San d'Oria fame 3.
Talk to Novalmauge in Bostaunieux Oubliette and accept the quest.
Obtain a Vial of Beastman Blood (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Vial of Beastman Blood to Novalmauge.
Reward: Scroll of Drain, San d'Oria fame.

name: Her Majestys Garden
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 4.
Talk to Chalvatot in Chateau d'Oraguille and choose to accept the quest.
Obtain a Chunk of Derfland Humus (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Chunk of Derfland Humus to Chalvatot.
Reward: 40 San d'Oria fame and key item Map of the Northlands Area.

name: Introduction to Teamwork
steps: Requires level 10 and San d'Oria fame 2.
Talk to Vilatroire in West Ronfaure and choose to accept the quest.
Form a party in which at least 2 members (you included) belong to the same nation. Members from other nations are allowed.
Bring every party member to West Ronfaure, standing within 15 yalms of you. If anyone is in another zone or farther away, the check fails.
Talk to Vilatroire again to finish.
Reward: Shell Ring, 20 San d'Oria fame, title Third-Rate Organizer.

name: Intermediate Teamwork
steps: Requires level 10 and San d'Oria fame 3; finish Introduction to Teamwork first.
Talk to Vilatroire in West Ronfaure and choose to accept the quest.
Form a party of at least 2 players who are all the same race as you (Hume, Elvaan, Tarutaru, Galka or Mithra).
With every party member in West Ronfaure and standing close to you (within about 15 yalms), talk to Vilatroire to finish.
Reward: Scroll of Mage's Ballad, 30 San d'Oria fame, title Second-Rate Organizer.

name: Advanced Teamwork
steps: Requires Intermediate Teamwork completed, San d'Oria fame 4 and level 10.
Talk to Vilatroire in West Ronfaure and accept the quest.
Form a party in which exactly 2 members (you and one other) share your main job.
Gather every party member in West Ronfaure within 15 yalms of you, then talk to Vilatroire.
Reward: Horn Ring, title First-Rate Organizer and San d'Oria fame.

name: Grimy Signposts
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 2.
Talk to Maugie in Southern San d'Oria and choose to accept the quest.
Go to Jugner Forest and examine each of the 4 Signposts, choosing to clean each one (they are spread across the zone).
Return to Maugie in Southern San d'Oria and talk to him to finish.
Reward: 1500 gil and 20 San d'Oria fame.

name: A Job for the Consortium
steps: Requires the Tenshodo Members Card key item, San d'Oria fame 5 and Norg fame 1.
Talk to Portaure in Port San d'Oria and accept the job. You receive the key item Brugaire Goods.
Travel to Port Jeuno and go through customs by talking to Haubijoux or the airship gate door. Do it at night (18:00-5:59 Vana'diel time): in daytime there is a 25% chance the goods are confiscated.
If the goods are confiscated, you cannot use the airships until the next midnight in Japan (JST). If you skip customs, the package arrives damaged.
Deliver the package to Yin Pocanakhu in Lower Jeuno.
Return to Portaure in Port San d'Oria to report.
Reward: 1,000 gil and Norg fame, but only if the package arrived intact. If it was damaged or confiscated, the quest ends with no reward.

name: Trouble at the Sluice
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame level 3; finish the quest The Rumor first.
Talk to Belgidiveau in Northern San d'Oria and accept the request (first choice in the cutscene).
Go to Bostaunieux Oubliette and talk to Novalmauge.
Obtain a Dahlia (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Dahlia to Novalmauge in Bostaunieux Oubliette to receive the key item Neutralizer.
Return to Belgidiveau in Northern San d'Oria and talk to him.
Reward: Heavy Axe and San d'Oria fame.

name: The Merchants Bidding
steps: Talk to Parvipon in Southern San d'Oria and accept the quest.
Obtain 3 Rabbit Hides (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 3 Rabbit Hides to Parvipon.
Reward: 120 gil and San d'Oria fame. Repeatable: trade 3 more Rabbit Hides any time for 120 gil.

name: Blackmail
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 3 and rank 3 in your nation.
Talk to Dauperiat in Northern San d'Oria to accept. You receive the key item Suspicious Envelope.
Go to Chateau d'Oraguille and talk to Halver to hand over the envelope.
Return to Dauperiat in Northern San d'Oria and agree to his request.
Obtain a Copy of the Castle Floor Plans (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Dauperiat.
Reward: 900 gil and San d'Oria fame. Repeatable: talk to Dauperiat again, agree, and trade another Copy of the Castle Floor Plans for the same reward.

name: The Setting Sun
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 5 and Blackmail completed.
Talk to Vamorcote in Northern San d'Oria and accept the quest.
Obtain an Engraved Key (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Engraved Key to Vamorcote.
Reward: 10,000 gil, San d'Oria fame.

name: Distant Loyalties
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 4.
Talk to Femitte in Southern San d'Oria and accept. You receive the key item Goldsmithing Order.
Go to Bastok Markets and talk to Michea.
Obtain 1 Mythril Ingot (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Michea.
Leave Bastok Markets and come back (zone), then talk to Michea to receive the key item Mythril Hearts.
Return to Femitte in Southern San d'Oria. Afterward, Michea has one more cutscene for you.
Reward: White Cape and San d'Oria fame.

name: The Rivalry
steps: Requires that you have not started The Competition (you can only do one of the two).
Talk to Gallijaux in Port San d'Oria and accept his challenge.
Fish up or obtain Moat Carp and Forest Carp (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade only carp (Moat Carp and/or Forest Carp, any amount) to Gallijaux; each trade pays 10 gil per Moat Carp, 15 gil per Forest Carp, plus fame.
Keep trading carp until your lifetime total reaches 10,000 fish; talk to Gallijaux any time to hear your count.
Reward: Lu Shang's Fishing Rod, key item Testimonial, San d'Oria fame, title Carp Diem. You may keep trading carp for gil afterward.

name: The Competition
steps: Requires that you have not started The Rivalry (you can only do one of the two).
Talk to Joulet in Port San d'Oria and accept his challenge.
Fish up or obtain Moat Carp and Forest Carp (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade only carp (Moat Carp and/or Forest Carp, any amount) to Joulet; each trade pays 10 gil per Moat Carp, 15 gil per Forest Carp, plus fame.
Keep trading carp until your lifetime total reaches 10,000 fish; talk to Joulet any time to hear your count.
Reward: Lu Shang's Fishing Rod, key item Testimonial, San d'Oria fame, title Carp Diem. You may keep trading carp for gil afterward.

name: Starting a Flame
steps: Talk to Legata in Southern San d'Oria and accept the quest.
Obtain 4 Flint Stones (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 4 Flint Stones to Legata.
Reward: 100 gil and San d'Oria fame. Repeatable: trade 4 more Flint Stones to Legata any time for the same reward.

name: Fear of the Dark
steps: Talk to Secodiand in Northern San d'Oria and choose to accept the quest.
Obtain 2 Bat Wings (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 2 Bat Wings to Secodiand.
Reward: 200 gil and 10 San d'Oria fame. Repeatable: trade 2 more Bat Wings anytime for the same reward.

name: Warding Vampires
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame level 3.
Talk to Maloquedil in Northern San d'Oria and accept his request (pick the accepting answer in the cutscene).
Obtain 2 Bulbs of Shaman Garlic (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade 2 Bulbs of Shaman Garlic to Maloquedil in Northern San d'Oria.
Reward: 900 gil, title Vampire Hunter D-Minus, San d'Oria fame. Repeatable: trade 2 more Bulbs of Shaman Garlic to Maloquedil for 900 gil and more fame.

name: Sleepless Nights
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 2.
Talk to Paouala in Southern San d'Oria and accept her request.
Obtain a Jug of Mary's Milk (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Jug of Mary's Milk to Paouala.
Reward: 5,000 gil, San d'Oria fame, title Sheep's Milk Deliverer.

name: Lufets Lake Salt
steps: Talk to Nogelle in Port San d'Oria and choose to accept the quest.
Obtain 3 Chunks of Lufet Salt (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 3 Chunks of Lufet Salt to Nogelle.
Reward: 600 gil, 10 San d'Oria fame, title Bean Cuisine Salter.

name: The Crimson Trial
steps: Requires Red Mage as your main job at level 40.
Talk to Sharzalion in Southern San d'Oria and choose to accept (if you decline, talk to him again).
Enter Davoi; the Orc Purpleflash Brukdok appears. Defeat it; it always drops a Davoi Storage Key.
Trade the Davoi Storage Key to the Storage Hole in Davoi to get key item Orcish Dried Food.
Return to Sharzalion in Southern San d'Oria and talk to him to finish.
Reward: Fencing Degen and 20 San d'Oria fame.

name: Enveloped in Darkness (RDM AF2)
steps: Requires Red Mage as your main job at level 50. Finish The Crimson Trial first.
Talk to Curilla in Chateau d'Oraguille and choose to accept. You receive key item Old Pocket Watch. If you decline, talk to her again for another offer.
Obtain a Square of Velvet Cloth (this quest's script does not say where). Trade it to Pagisalis in Northern San d'Oria to receive key item Old Boots.
After the Pagisalis trade, go to Crawlers' Nest and trade a Nest Chest Key to a Treasure Chest. You receive key item Crawler Blood. It only drops while you don't already hold it.
A main-job Thief can use Thief's Tools, a Living Key or a Skeleton Key instead, but they can fail or set off a trap. The Nest Chest Key always opens the chest.
In Crawlers' Nest, examine the ??? (qm8) and choose to bury the Old Boots and Crawler Blood.
Wait about 30 seconds, then examine the same ??? again to finish.
Reward: Warlock's Boots and 20 San d'Oria fame.

name: Messenger From Beyond
steps: Requires White Mage as your main job at level 40.
Talk to Narcheral in Northern San d'Oria to accept the quest.
Go to Valkurm Dunes and examine the ??? (qm2) to make the monster Marchelute appear.
Defeat Marchelute; it always drops a Tavnazia Pass.
Return to Narcheral in Northern San d'Oria and trade him the Tavnazia Pass.
Reward: Blessed Hammer and 20 San d'Oria fame.

name: Prelude of Black and White
steps: Requires White Mage as your main job at level 50; finish Messenger From Beyond first.
In Chateau d'Oraguille, examine the door (_6h1) to start the quest.
Obtain a Canteen of Yagudo Holy Water and a pair of Moccasins (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Canteen of Yagudo Holy Water and the Moccasins together to Narcheral in Northern San d'Oria.
Reward: Healer's Duckbills and 20 San d'Oria fame.

name: Sharpening the Sword
steps: Requires Paladin as your main job at level 40 and the title Family Counselor (from Father and Son).
Talk to Ailbeche in Northern San d'Oria and choose to accept (if you decline, talk to him again).
Go to Ordelles Caves and examine the Stalagmite to make Polevik appear; defeat it.
Examine the Stalagmite again to obtain key item Ordelle Whetstone.
Return to Ailbeche in Northern San d'Oria and talk to him to finish.
Reward: Honor Sword and 20 San d'Oria fame.

name: Eco-Warrior (San d'Oria)
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 1. You cannot be on Bastok's or Windurst's Eco-Warrior at the same time.
Talk to Norejaie in Southern San d'Oria and accept the quest.
In Ordelles Caves, talk to Rojaireaut and accept his ointment. It restricts you to level 25.
While restricted, examine the ??? at !pos -90 30 156 in Ordelles Caves to make Necroplasm appear, then defeat it.
Examine the same ??? again to obtain the key item Indigested Stalagmite. Talking to Rojaireaut again is optional and can remove the level restriction.
Return to Norejaie in Southern San d'Oria.
Reward: 5,000 gil, Dragon Chronicles, title Vermillion Venturer and San d'Oria fame. Repeatable after the next conquest tally, which also locks all three nations' Eco-Warrior until then.

name: Methods Create Madness
steps: Requires a job that can equip the Spear of Trials and Polearm skill 240; you must not already hold a Weapon Training Guide.
Talk to Balasiel in Southern San d'Oria and accept; you receive the Spear of Trials and key item Weapon Training Guide.
Equip the Spear of Trials and use weapon skills on monsters that give EXP until the spear has 300 weapon skill points (its latent bonus disappears).
Trade the Spear of Trials back to Balasiel; you receive key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
Go to Sea Serpent Grotto and examine the ??? (qm1) to make Water Leaper appear; defeat it.
Examine the ??? again to obtain key item Annals of Truth.
Return to Balasiel and talk to him to finish.
Reward: you learn the weapon skill Impulse Drive and gain 20 San d'Oria fame.

name: Souls in Shadow
steps: Requires a job that can equip the Scythe of Trials, Scythe skill 240+, and no other weapon-skill trial in progress (no Weapon Training Guide key item).
Talk to Novalmauge in Bostaunieux Oubliette and accept; you receive the Scythe of Trials and the key item Weapon Training Guide.
Equip the Scythe of Trials and fight with it until it has earned 300 weapon skill points.
Trade the finished Scythe of Trials to Novalmauge to receive the key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
Go to Den of Rancor and examine the ??? (qm) to spawn Mokumokuren; defeat it.
Examine the ??? again after the kill to obtain the key item Annals of Truth.
Return to Novalmauge in Bostaunieux Oubliette and talk to him.
Reward: learn the weapon skill Spiral Hell, San d'Oria fame.

name: A Taste for Meat
steps: Talk to Antreneau in Port San d'Oria.
Talk to Thierride, who stands next to Antreneau in Port San d'Oria.
Obtain 5 Slices of Hare Meat (this quest's script does not say where). Trade all 5 to Thierride to accept and complete the quest in one step.
Reward: 150 gil, title Rabbiter and San d'Oria fame. Afterward, talk to Antreneau to receive a Slice of Grilled Hare.

name: Exit the Gambler
steps: Talk to Aurege or Guilberdrier in Northern San d'Oria (both stand near each other) to see the opening cutscene.
Go to Varchet in Southern San d'Oria and trade him 5 gil to play his dice game.
Keep trading Varchet 5 gil per round until you win a round (higher dice total); a win pays 10 gil and he promises to keep his word.
Return to Northern San d'Oria and talk to Aurege or Guilberdrier to finish the quest.
Reward: 2000 EXP, 20 San d'Oria fame, key item Map of King Ranperre's Tomb, title Daybreak Gambler.

name: Old Wounds
steps: Requires a job that can equip the Sapara of Trials and Sword skill 240. You must not already hold the key item Weapon Training Guide.
Talk to Curilla in Chateau d'Oraguille and accept. You receive the Sapara of Trials and key item Weapon Training Guide.
Use the Sapara of Trials until it has 300 weapon skill points. The script only checks the point total, not how you earn them. If you lose the sword, Curilla can give you a new one.
Trade the Sapara of Trials to Curilla. You receive key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
Go to Quicksand Caves and examine the ??? (qm3) to make Girtablulu appear, then defeat it.
Examine the same ??? again before you leave the zone or log out to get key item Annals of Truth. If you zone or log out first, the kill is lost and you must fight it again.
Return to Curilla in Chateau d'Oraguille and talk to her to finish.
Reward: you learn the weapon skill Savage Blade and gain 20 San d'Oria fame.

name: A Timely Visit
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 4. Talk to Deraquien in Southern San d'Oria and agree to help. If you decline, talk to him again to get another chance.
Go to La Theine Plateau and talk to Narvecaint, then return and talk to Deraquien in Southern San d'Oria.
In Chateau d'Oraguille, talk to Halver, then return and talk to Deraquien again.
In Southern San d'Oria, talk to Phillone, then talk to Deraquien one more time.

At night (18:00-5:59 Vana'diel time), examine the ??? in Jugner Forest (around !pos -310 0 407). Giollemitte B Feroun and a Skeleton Esquire appear. After they despawn, the ??? needs 3 minutes before they can be called again.
Defeat either monster. Before examining the ??? again, the other must be gone too: defeat it or wait for it to leave (about 3 minutes idle).
Examine the ??? again for a cutscene. Do not zone or log out between the kill and this step, or the kill credit is lost and you must fight again.
Talk to Phillone in Southern San d'Oria, then talk to Narvecaint in La Theine Plateau.
Return to Phillone in Southern San d'Oria to finish the quest.
Reward: Medieval Collar, title Obsidian Storm and San d'Oria fame.

name: Signed in  Blood
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 3.
Talk to Sobane in Southern San d'Oria and accept her request (pick the accept option) to bring her a Cathedral Tapestry.
Obtain a Cathedral Tapestry (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Sobane.
Travel to Selbina and talk to Abelard; he mentions a diary with missing pages.
In Ordelles Caves, obtain an Ordelle Chest Key and trade it to a Treasure Chest there to receive the key item Torn-out Pages.
Return to Selbina and talk to Abelard again with the Torn-out Pages.
Go back to Sobane in Southern San d'Oria and talk to her to finish the quest.
Reward: Cunning Earring, 3,500 gil, San d'Oria fame. (Zone out and back in to Southern San d'Oria to unlock Tea with a Tonberry?.)

name: Tea with a Tonberry?
steps: Requires Signed in Blood completed and San d'Oria fame 4 (zone once after finishing Signed in Blood).
Talk to Sobane in Southern San d'Oria to start the quest.
In Attohwa Chasm, defeat Gallinipper, Ogrefly or Monarch Ogrefly until one drops a Piece of Attohwa Ginseng.
Go to Carpenters Landing, talk to Anguenet at the South Landing docks, then trade him the Attohwa Ginseng to get the key item Tonberry Blackboard.
Ride the barge (Phanauet Channel) and talk to Riche, the Tonberry on board, before the ride ends (about 7 minutes); he takes the Blackboard.
In Fei'Yin, defeat Shadow until one drops an Ingot of Royal Treasury Gold.
In Davoi, trade the Ingot of Royal Treasury Gold to the ??? at (J-11) to spawn Hematic Cyst; defeat it, then examine the ??? again for a cutscene.
Return to Sobane in Southern San d'Oria and talk to her.
Reward: Willpower Torque, San d'Oria fame, title Talks with Tonberries.

name: Spice Gals
steps: Requires completing Chains of Promathia mission Ancient Vows.
Talk to Rouva in Southern San d'Oria to start the quest.
Go to Riverne - Site A01 or Riverne - Site B01 and examine the ??? there to obtain the key item Rivernewort.
Return to Rouva and talk to her to hand over the Rivernewort.
Reward: Miratete's Memoirs. Repeatable: talk to Rouva again after the next conquest tally to repeat.

name: Lure of the Wildcat (San d'Oria)
steps: Requires Treasures of Aht Urhgan to be enabled on the server.
Talk to Amutiyaal in Southern San d'Oria to accept; you receive key item Red Sentinel Badge.
In Southern San d'Oria, talk to Daggao, Authere, Rouva, Femitte and Deraquien.
In Northern San d'Oria, talk to Giaunne, Anilla, Maloquedil, Phairupegiont and Bertenont.
In Port San d'Oria, talk to Perdiouvilet, Pomilla, Cherlodeau, Parcarin and Rugiette.
In Chateau d'Oraguille, talk to Curilla, Halver, Rahal, Perfaumand and Chalvatot.
After all 20 conversations, return to Amutiyaal in Southern San d'Oria; the Red Sentinel Badge is taken.
Reward: key item Red Invitation Card.

name: Atelloune's Lament
steps: Requires San d'Oria fame 2 and the Crystal War quest Seeing Spots completed.
Talk to Atelloune in Southern San d'Oria (L-6) to start the quest.
Obtain a Ladybug Wing (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Atelloune.
Reward: Trainee Gloves and San d'Oria fame.

name: Making Amends
steps: Requires Windurst fame 2.
In Port Windurst, talk to Hakkuru-Rinkuru and accept his request for animal glue.
Obtain 1 Block of Animal Glue (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Block of Animal Glue to Hakkuru-Rinkuru.
Reward: 1,500 gil, Windurst fame, and the title Quick Fixer.

name: Making the Grade
steps: Requires Windurst fame 3; finish Teacher's Pet first; you cannot have Let Sleeping Dogs Lie in progress.
In Windurst Waters, talk to Fuepepe and accept.
Obtain a Pile of Answer Sheets (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Fuepepe; he gives it back.
Go to Windurst Walls and trade the Pile of Answer Sheets to Koru-Moru to receive the key item Tattered Test Sheet.
Optional: talk to Chomoro-Kyotoro in Windurst Waters to hand over the test sheet.
Return to Fuepepe in Windurst Waters and talk to him.
Reward: Scroll of Aspir and Windurst fame.

name: Wondering Minstrel
steps: Requires Windurst fame 5.
Talk to Jatan-Paratan in Windurst Waters. When he asks about his playing, say you have no recollection of it at all.
Talk to Jatan-Paratan again and accept the quest.
Go to Lower Jeuno, talk to Ruslan and agree to his request.
Obtain 1 Piece of Rosewood Lumber (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Piece of Rosewood Lumber to Jatan-Paratan in Windurst Waters to finish.
Reward: Faerie Piccolo, title Down Piper Pipe-Upperer, Windurst fame +50.

name: A Pose By Any Other Name
steps: No level or fame needed. IMPORTANT: when you first talk to Angelica you must NOT be wearing your job's body piece (WAR/PLD/DRK/DRG/COR/RUN Bronze Harness; MNK/BRD/BLU Robe; WHM/BLM/RDM/SMN/PUP/SCH/GEO Tunic; THF/BST/RNG/DNC Leather Vest; SAM/NIN Kenpogi). If you are, she won't offer the quest.
Talk to Angelica in Windurst Waters and pick the option that accepts. If you decline, talk to her again for another chance to accept.
Talk to Angelica again. She names the body piece for your main job (see the list in step 1). A 1-hour real-time timer starts now.
Obtain that body piece (this quest's script does not say where) and equip it on the same main job.

Within 1 real hour, talk to Angelica while wearing it. If the hour runs out, the quest fails: it is removed, you get the title Lower than the Lowest Tunnel Worm, and you must change zones before you can start it again.
Reward: Copy of Ancient Blood, key item Angelica's Autograph, title Super Model, and Windurst fame.

name: Star Struck
steps: Requires a Torn Epistle in your inventory (this quest's script does not say where to get it).
Talk to Koru-Moru in Windurst Walls and accept the quest.
Optional: trade the Torn Epistle to Koru-Moru for 50 gil.
Obtain 1 Meteorite (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Meteorite to Koru-Moru in Windurst Walls to finish.
Reward: Compound Eye Circlet and Windurst fame +20.

name: Blast from the Past
steps: Requires Windurst fame 3. Finish Star Struck first, and do not have Class Reunion active.
Talk to Koru-Moru in Windurst Walls and choose the first option to accept.
Talk to Tokaka in Port Windurst.
Talk to Yoran-Oran in Windurst Walls.
In Maze of Shakhrami, examine the correct Fossil Rock to make Ichorous Ire appear. Defeat it to get a Burnite Shell Stone (100% drop).
Trade the Burnite Shell Stone to Koru-Moru in Windurst Walls to finish the quest.
Reward: 30 Windurst fame, Great Club, title Fossilized Sea Farer.

name: A Smudge on One's Record
steps: Requires Windurst fame 4. Finish Chasing Tales first.
Talk to Hariga-Origa in Windurst Waters and choose the first option to accept.
Obtain a Vial of Slime Oil and a Frost Turnip (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Vial of Slime Oil and the Frost Turnip together to Hariga-Origa.
Reward: 5,000 gil, 2,000 experience points, 40 Windurst fame, key item Map of Feiyin.

name: Chasing Tales
steps: Requires Windurst fame 3. Finish Early Bird Catches the Bookworm first. Windurst citizens cannot be on the mission The Jester Who'd Be King.
Talk to Tosuka-Porika in Windurst Waters and choose the first option to accept.
Talk to Furakku-Norakku in Windurst Waters to get the key item Overdue Book Notification.
Talk to Hae Jakkya in Windurst Woods.
Talk to Hae Jakhya in Southern San d'Oria to get the key item A Song of Love.
Return to Furakku-Norakku in Windurst Waters to finish the quest.
Reward: 2,800 gil, 30 Windurst fame, title Savior of Knowledge.

name: Food for Thought
steps: In Windurst Waters, talk to Ohbiru-Dohbiru to learn the researchers are hungry (skip if 'Say It with Flowers' is active; he won't talk about it then).
Talk to Kerutoto in Windurst Waters and accept (first choice) to start the quest.
Kenapa-Keppa (Windurst Waters): optionally talk to him a few times to hear his order, then trade him 1 Hard-Boiled Egg (120 gil).
Kerutoto: trade 1 Slice of Grilled Hare (440 gil).
Ohbiru-Dohbiru: trade 1 Cup of Windurstian Tea, 1 Tortilla and 1 Clump of Pamtam Kelp together (440 gil).
Obtain those foods yourself (this quest's script does not say where); the quest completes after the last of the three deliveries.
Reward: Windurst fame and the title Fast Food Deliverer (plus 1,000 gil total from the three deliveries).

name: Overnight Delivery
steps: Requires Windurst fame 2; finish Food for Thought first and zone once afterward.
In Windurst Waters, talk to Kenapa-Keppa four times between 7:00 and 24:00 Vana'diel time; on the fourth talk accept (first choice).
Go to Mhaura and talk to Kotan-Purutan between 18:00 and 6:00 Vana'diel time to receive the key item Small Bag.
Hurry back to Kenapa-Keppa in Windurst Waters and talk to him before 6:00 the next Vana'diel morning.
If you are late the quest fails; talk to Kenapa-Keppa again to restart.
Reward: Power Gi and Windurst fame.

name: Water Way to Go
steps: Requires Windurst fame 3 and Overnight Delivery completed; zone once after finishing it.
Talk to Ohbiru-Dohbiru in Windurst Waters and accept to receive a Rhinostery Canteen.
Go to Giddeus and trade the Rhinostery Canteen to the Giddeus Spring to get a Canteen of Giddeus Water.
Trade the Canteen of Giddeus Water to Ohbiru-Dohbiru in Windurst Waters to finish. If you lose the canteen, talk to him for a new one.
Reward: 900 gil and Windurst fame +16. Repeatable while your Windurst fame is below 5: zone, then talk to Ohbiru-Dohbiru again.

name: Blue Ribbon Blues
steps: Requires Windurst fame level 5. Finish the quest Water Way to Go first, then change zones once before this quest appears.
Talk to Kerutoto in Windurst Waters.
Talk to Roberta in Windurst Woods and pick the option that accepts. She gives you a Purple Ribbon.
Trade the Purple Ribbon to Kerutoto. You get 3,600 gil and the quest starts.
Wait about 1 minute, then talk to Kerutoto again. She gives you the Purple Ribbon back. Do not trade it to her again, or the 1-minute wait starts over.
Go to The Eldieme Necropolis and find Hume Bones (around position 299, 0, 19). Trade the Purple Ribbon to the Hume Bones. This spawns Lich C Magnus.
Defeat Lich C Magnus, then examine the Hume Bones right away (before you leave the zone) to get the Blue Ribbon. You need a free inventory slot.
Go back to Kerutoto in Windurst Waters and talk to her to finish.
Reward: Windurst fame and the title Ghostie Buster (plus the 3,600 gil you got earlier).

name: Early Bird Catches the Bookworm
steps: Requires Windurst fame 2; finish Glyph Hanger first and zone once afterward. Windurst citizens cannot be on the missions Lost for Words or The Sixth Ministry.
In Windurst Waters, talk to Tosuka-Porika and accept (first choice).
Talk to Furakku-Norakku in Windurst Waters to receive the key item Overdue Book Notifications.
Talk to Orn in Windurst Waters to hand over the notifications.
Go to Giddeus and talk to Quu Bokye, then trade him 1 Silver Beastcoin (obtain it; this quest's script does not say where) to receive the key item Art for Everyone.
Optional: talk to Orn in Windurst Waters again.
Return to Furakku-Norakku in Windurst Waters and talk to him to finish.
Reward: 1,500 gil, Windurst fame, and the title Savior of Knowledge.

name: All at Sea
steps: Requires Windurst fame 3. Obtain a Ripped Cap (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Ripped Cap to Paytah in Port Windurst to accept the quest. You keep the cap.
Trade the Ripped Cap to Baren-Moren in Windurst Waters. This trade uses up the cap.
Obtain 4 Dhalmel Hides (this quest's script does not say where) and trade all 4 to Baren-Moren. Choose the first option to get a Sailor's Cap and a Dhalmel Mantle.
Trade the Sailor's Cap to Paytah in Port Windurst to finish the quest.
Reward: 30 Windurst fame and a Leather Ring.

name: Mihgo's Amigo
steps: You cannot start this while The Tenshodo Showdown or As Thick as Thieves is in progress.
In Windurst Woods, talk to Nanaa Mihgo to start the quest.
Optional: Bopa Greso and Cha Lebagta in Windurst Woods give hints.
Obtain 4 Yagudo Bead Necklaces (this quest's script does not say where) and trade all 4 to Nanaa Mihgo.
Reward: 200 gil, Norg fame, and the title Cat Burglar Groupie. Repeatable: trade 4 more necklaces any time for 200 gil and a little Norg fame.

name: Rock Racketeer
steps: Requires Windurst fame 3; finish Mihgo's Amigo first and zone once afterward.
In Windurst Woods, talk to Nanaa Mihgo and accept to receive the key item Sharp Gray Stone.
Go to Bastok Markets and talk to Ardea; pick the first choice to hand over the stone (you get 10 gil).
Return to Nanaa Mihgo in Windurst Woods and talk to her.
Obtain a Sharp Stone (the script header points to a Mythril Seam in Palborough Mines).
Trade the Sharp Stone to Varun in Windurst Woods.
Reward: 2,100 gil and Windurst fame.

name: Teacher's Pet
steps: Talk to Moreno-Toeno in Windurst Waters, then talk to him again and accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Bird Feather and 1 Two-Leaf Mandragora Bud (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Bird Feather and the Two-Leaf Mandragora Bud together to Moreno-Toeno to finish and receive 250 gil.
Reward: 250 gil and Windurst fame +10. You can keep trading the same pair afterwards for another 250 gil each time.

name: Glyph Hanger
steps: In Windurst Waters, talk to Hariga-Origa and accept (first choice) to receive the key item Note from Hariga-Origa.
Optional: Serukoko and Sohdede in Windurst Waters give hints.
Go to West Sarutabaruta and talk to Ipupu to swap the note for the key item Note from Ipupu.
Return to Hariga-Origa in Windurst Waters and talk to him.
Reward: key item Map of the Horutoto Ruins, 2,000 experience points, and Windurst fame.

name: The Fanged One
steps: Requires level 30.
Talk to Perih Vashai in Windurst Woods to start the quest.
Go to Sauromugue Champaign and examine Tiger Bones. This spawns Old Sabertooth.
Do NOT attack Old Sabertooth. Stay close; poison kills it in about 3.5 minutes. If anyone damages it, wait 5 minutes and try again.
Within 3 minutes of its death, examine Tiger Bones again to get the Old Tiger's Fang key item.
Return to Perih Vashai in Windurst Woods to finish.
Reward: Ranger job unlocked, Ranger's Necklace, the Job Gesture: Ranger key item, title The Fanged One, Windurst fame +20.

name: Curses, Foiled Again! (1)
steps: Talk to Shantotto in Windurst Walls and pick the accepting answer (option 3).
Obtain 1 Pinch of Bomb Ash and 2 Bone Chips (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Pinch of Bomb Ash and the 2 Bone Chips together to Shantotto.
Reward: 20 Windurst fame and a Brass Rod. Curses, Foiled Again! (2) opens after one Vana'diel day and a zone change.

name: Curses, Foiled Again!? (2)
steps: Requires Windurst fame 2; finish Curses, Foiled Again!? (1) first, then wait until the next Vana'diel day and change areas (zone).
In Windurst Walls, talk to Hiwon-Biwon.
Talk to Shantotto in Windurst Walls, then leave the area (zone) and come back.
Talk to Shantotto again and accept her request (the script starts the quest only on the accepting choice; you also get the title Tarutaru Murder Suspect).
Talk to Hiwon-Biwon in Windurst Walls to receive a Lock of Hiwon's Hair.
Obtain 2 Bomb Arms and 1 Revival Tree Root (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade Shantotto exactly 2 Bomb Arms, 1 Revival Tree Root and 1 Lock of Hiwon's Hair together.
Reward: Misery Staff, Windurst fame, and the title Hexer Vexer.

name: Truth, Justice, and the Onion Way
steps: Talk to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst and accept the quest in the cutscene.
Obtain 1 Rarab Tail (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 1 Rarab Tail to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst to finish the quest.
Reward: Justice Badge, title Star Onion Brigade Member, Windurst fame +20. Zone out before starting Know One's Onions.

name: Scooped!
steps: Requires the quest Making Headlines completed.
Talk to Naiko-Paneiko in Windurst Waters to start the quest.
Obtain 1 Bronze Box (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the Bronze Box to Naiko-Paneiko in Windurst Waters to finish.
Reward: 1,500 gil and Windurst fame +20.

name: Know One's Onions
steps: Requires level 5 and Truth, Justice, and the Onion Way completed; zone once after finishing it.
Talk to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst to start the quest. He asks for Wild Onions.
Obtain 4 Wild Onions (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 4 Wild Onions to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst.
If your Windurst rank is below 3: go to Windurst Walls and examine the House of the Hero door for a cutscene.
Return to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst to finish. If you are rank 3 or higher, the onion trade (or talking to him) finishes the quest directly.
Reward: Scroll of Blaze Spikes, title SOB Super Hero, Windurst fame +20.

name: Inspector's Gadget!
steps: Requires level 5, Windurst fame 2 and Know One's Onions completed; zone once after finishing it.
Talk to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst and accept the quest.
Talk to Pichichi in Port Windurst.
Go to Windurst Waters and talk to Chamama. She asks for Saruta Cotton.
Obtain 4 Balls of Saruta Cotton (this quest's script does not say where) and trade all 4 to Chamama to receive the Fake Moustache key item.
Return to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst.
Reward: Heko Obi, title Fake-Moustached Investigator, Windurst fame +20.

name: Onion Rings
steps: Requires level 5, Windurst fame 3 and Inspector's Gadget! completed; zone once after finishing it.
Talk to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst. If you do not have the Old Ring key item, this starts a timer of one Vana'diel day.
Obtain the Old Ring key item (the quest script does not say where; the Castle Oztroja door script _47d gives it).
Return to Kohlo-Lakolo. If you are back with the ring before the timer runs out, he starts the quest; if you are late, the quest completes at once.
If you made it in time: go to Windurst Walls and examine the House of the Hero door before the timer ends. If the timer runs out first, talk to Kohlo-Lakolo instead.
Reward: title Star Onion Brigadier, Windurst fame +30 (the Old Ring is taken). Kohlo-Lakolo gives a Bouncer Club when you next talk to him.

name: In a Stew
steps: Requires Windurst fame 2; finish Chocobilious first and zone once afterward.
In Windurst Woods, talk to Kuoh Rhel to start the quest.
Go to Windurst Waters and talk to Ranpi-Monpi (she won't help while 'A Crisis in the Making' is active); she asks for Woozyshrooms.
Obtain 3 Woozyshrooms (this quest's script does not say where) and trade all 3 to Ranpi-Monpi to receive the key item Ranpi-Monpi's Special Stew.
Return to Kuoh Rhel in Windurst Woods and talk to him.
Reward: 900 gil and Windurst fame. Repeatable after the next conquest tally (talk to Kuoh Rhel and accept).

name: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
steps: Requires Windurst fame level 4.
Talk to Paku-Nakku in Windurst Waters (near 127, -6, 165) and accept the quest.
Talk to Maabu-Sonbu in Port Windurst (near -107, -3, 108). His cutscene names the items you need: a Remedy or Blazing Peppers.

Get a Remedy or Blazing Peppers. The quest script does not say where. Its header marks a ??? harvesting point in Pashhow Marshlands near (-430, 25, 473), which takes a Sickle. The script never confirms that point gives peppers.
Trade either the Blazing Peppers or one Remedy to Paku-Nakku in Windurst Waters.
Talk to Pechiru-Mashiru in Windurst Waters (near 164, -1, 158).
Talk to Paku-Nakku again. In the cutscene, pick the second option. That is the only choice that moves the quest forward, and it also gives you the title Spoilsport.
Talk to Pechiru-Mashiru once more to finish the quest.
Reward: Hypno Staff and Windurst fame (40).

name: Say it with Flowers
steps: Requires Windurst fame 2.
Talk to Moari-Kaaori in Windurst Waters and agree to help.
Go to Tahrongi Canyon and examine the Tahrongi Cacti to pick a Tahrongi Cactus (free, and you can take more than one).
Trade the Tahrongi Cactus to Moari-Kaaori. The first time you get an Iron Sword; on later repeats you get 400 gil instead.
Alternative: buy a flower from Ohbiru-Dohbiru in Windurst Waters (100-300 gil) and trade it to Moari-Kaaori for 100 gil.
Reward: title Cupid's Florist and Windurst fame +10. Repeatable: zone, then talk to Moari-Kaaori to restart.

name: Curses, Foiled A-Golem!?
steps: Requires level 10 and Windurst fame 4. Finish Curses, Foiled Again! (2) first.
Talk to Shantotto in Windurst Walls and accept. Declining gives the title Total Loser.
Go to Beaucedine Glacier, talk to Torino-Samarino and accept to get the key item Shantotto's New Spell.
Travel to Feiyin and examine the Cermet Door. Avoid defeating Feiyin monsters on the way, because a kill turns the spell into the ruined Shantotto's Ex Spell.
If the spell is ruined, give it back to Torino-Samarino, wait one Vana'diel day and talk to him again for a new spell.
Return to Shantotto in Windurst Walls to finish the quest.
Reward: 40 Windurst fame, Scroll of Warp II, title Doctor Shantotto's Flavor of the Month (also Total Loser).

name: Acting in Good Faith
steps: Requires level 10 and Windurst fame 4.
Talk to Gantineux in Windurst Waters and choose the first option to accept. You get the key item Spirit Incense.
Go to The Eldieme Necropolis and examine the ??? there. Its position moves among grids D-5, I-7, I-10 and M-6.
Return to Gantineux in Windurst Waters to get the key item Gantineux's Letter.
Take the letter to Eperdur in Northern San d'Oria to finish the quest.
Reward: 40 Windurst fame, Scroll of Teleport-Mea, title Pilgrim to Mea.

name: Flower Child
steps: Go to Windurst Walls and talk to (or trade any flower to) Ojha Rhawash to start the quest.
Obtain 1 Lilac (this quest's script does not say where). Other flowers are accepted and used up but do not finish the quest.
Trade exactly 1 Lilac to Ojha Rhawash.
Reward: unlocks a new Mog House exit (no fame, items or gil).

name: The Tenshodo Showdown
steps: Requires Thief as your main job at level 40 or higher.
Talk to Nanaa Mihgo in Windurst Woods to start the quest and get the Letter from the Tenshodo key item.
Go to Lower Jeuno and talk to Harnek. He takes the letter and gives you the Tenshodo Envelope key item.
Go to Selbina and talk to Elfriede. She asks for Quadav Stew.
Obtain 1 Bowl of Quadav Stew (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Elfriede to receive the Signed Envelope key item.
Return to Harnek in Lower Jeuno to finish.
Reward: Marauder's Knife and Windurst fame +20.

name: As Thick as Thieves
steps: Requires Thief as your main job at level 50+ and The Tenshodo Showdown completed.
Talk to Nanaa Mihgo in Windurst Woods and accept. You get the Gang Whereabouts Note and the First and Second Forged Envelope key items.
Sauromugue Champaign tower: examine the ??? spots. One spawns Climbpix Highrise. Defeat it for a Grapnel. Hints: Bopa Greso and Cha Lebagta in Windurst Woods.
Remove ALL equipment, then trade the Grapnel to the ??? (qm2) at the tower to get the First Signed Forged Envelope.
Go to Lower Jeuno, talk to Sniggnix and accept his challenge.
Dangruf Wadi: trade 1 Chunk of Rock Salt to Saltvix's ???, then 1 Clump of Gausebit Wildgrass to Grasswix's ???, then 1 Lizard Egg to Eggblix's ???. Each loss uses up the item, so retry.
North Gustaberg: examine the ??? (qm2) to spawn Gambilox Wanderling. Defeat it, then examine the ??? again for a Regal Die.
Trade the Regal Die to Sniggnix in Lower Jeuno to get the Second Signed Forged Envelope.
Return to Nanaa Mihgo in Windurst Woods with both signed envelopes.
Reward: Rogue's Bonnet and Windurst fame +20.

name: Hitting the Marquisate
steps: Requires Thief (THF) as your main job at level 50 or higher; finish the quest As Thick as Thieves first.
Talk to Nanaa Mihgo in Windurst Woods to accept the quest. You receive the key item Cat Burglar's Note.
In Lower Jeuno, talk to Yatniel, then trade him 4 Quake Grenades (this quest's script does not say where to get them).
In Mhaura, talk to Hagain. He gives you the key item Bomb Incense.

In Garlaige Citadel, examine six ??? spots on the ceiling in order. At each one choose to use the Bomb Incense; the message then says which direction the presence moved, so head that way to the next ???.
After the sixth ???, find the seventh ??? (where the presence moved). Choose to use the Bomb Incense; about 5 seconds later the Chandelier monster flies out.

Attack the Chandelier yourself right away. If it attacks you before you hit it, it self-destructs and drops nothing, and you must wait 10 minutes to try again. Defeat it for a Lump of Chandelier Coal.
Go back to Hagain in Mhaura and trade him the Lump of Chandelier Coal.
Talk to Nanaa Mihgo in Windurst Woods again.
In La Theine Plateau, trade a Pickaxe to the ??? to finish the quest. Reward: Rogue's Poulaines and the title Paragon of Thief Excellence.

name: Sin Hunting
steps: Requires Ranger (RNG) as your main job at level 40.
In Windurst Woods, talk to Perih Vashai and accept (first choice) to receive the key item Chieftainness's Twinstone Earring.
Go to Ranguemont Pass and talk to Perchond; agree to help (first choice).
Obtain 1 Pinch of Glittersand (script note: dropped by the Evil Weapons around the Waters of Oblivion) and trade it to Perchond for the key item Perchond's Envelope.
Go to Jugner Forest and talk to Alexius (first choice).
Examine the ??? in Jugner Forest (first choice).
Return to Perih Vashai in Windurst Woods and talk to him.
Reward: Sniping Bow and Windurst fame.

name: I Can Hear a Rainbow
steps: Requires level 30 and a Carbuncle's Ruby in your inventory (this quest's script does not say where to get it).
In Windurst Walls, examine the door of the House of the Hero to start the quest.
Keep the ruby in your inventory and enter outdoor zones (e.g. Ronfaure, Gustaberg, Sarutabaruta, La Theine, Jugner, Valkurm) during different weather; each new weather type lights the ruby once.
You need all 7: clear/sunny, fire (hot spell/heat wave), water (rain/squall), earth (dust/sand storm), wind (wind/gales), ice (snow/blizzards), thunder.
Go to La Theine Plateau and trade the Carbuncle's Ruby to the ???.
Reward: Summoner job unlocked, the Carbuncle summon, Windurst fame, and the title Rainbow Weaver.

name: Crying Over Onions
steps: Requires Onion Rings completed. Zone, then talk to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst to receive the Bouncer Club (the reward from Onion Rings).
Zone again. With level 5 and Windurst fame 5, talk to Kohlo-Lakolo to start the quest.
Go to Windurst Waters and talk to Honoi-Gomoi. He asks for a Star Spinel.
Optional: talk to Nanaa Mihgo in Windurst Woods for extra dialogue.
Obtain 1 Star Spinel (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Honoi-Gomoi to receive a Star Necklace.
Return to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst for a cutscene.
Go back to Honoi-Gomoi in Windurst Waters to finish.
Reward: Windurst fame +50.

name: Wild Card
steps: Requires level 5, Windurst fame 5 and Crying Over Onions completed; zone once after finishing it.
Talk to Honoi-Gomoi in Windurst Waters to start the quest.
Talk to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst.
Go to Windurst Walls and examine the House of the Hero door. You meet Joker (below Windurst rank 9) or Apururu (rank 9 or higher).
Go to Toraimarai Canal and trade a Toraimari Coffer Key to a Treasure Coffer to get the Joker Card key item.
Hand in the Joker Card for 8,000 gil: below rank 9, examine the House of the Hero door again; at rank 9+, talk to Apururu in Windurst Woods.
Return to Honoi-Gomoi in Windurst Waters to finish.
Reward: title Dream Dweller, Windurst fame +60 (plus the 8,000 gil from the Joker Card).

name: The Promise
steps: Requires level 5, Windurst fame 5 and Wild Card completed; zone once after finishing it.
Talk to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst to start the quest.
Go to Windurst Waters and talk to Chamama. She asks for Shoalweed.
Obtain 1 Shoalweed (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to Chamama to receive the Invisible Man Sticker key item.
Return to Kohlo-Lakolo in Port Windurst to finish.
Reward: Promise Badge, Windurst fame +60.

name: Toraimarai Turmoil
steps: Requires Windurst fame 6 and Blue Ribbon Blues completed.
Talk to Ohbiru-Dohbiru in Windurst Waters and accept to receive the Rhinostery Certificate key item.
Obtain 3 Starmite Shells (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade the 3 Starmite Shells to Ohbiru-Dohbiru to finish.
Reward: 4,500 gil, title Certified Rhinostery Venturer, Windurst fame +16. Repeatable: talk to him again, accept, and trade 3 more shells.

name: The Puppet Master
steps: Requires Summoner (SMN) as your main job at level 40.
In Windurst Walls, examine the door of the House of the Hero to start the quest.
Go to Port Bastok and talk to Juroro to receive an Earth Pendulum.
Go to the Cloister of Tremors and enter the Earth Protocrystal battlefield 'The Puppet Master' with the Earth Pendulum (kept); 30-minute limit.
Defeat all three Galgalim inside to win.
Return to Juroro in Port Bastok and talk to him.
Go to Koru-Moru in Windurst Walls and talk to him.
Reward: Kukulcan's Staff and Windurst fame.

name: Eco-Warrior (Windurst)
steps: Requires Windurst fame 1; you cannot be on San d'Oria's or Bastok's Eco-Warrior at the same time.
In Windurst Waters, talk to Lumomo and accept (the script needs the accepting choice).
Go to Maze of Shakhrami and talk to Ahko Mhalijikhari; agree to have the ointment applied (this restricts you to level 25).
While level-restricted, examine the ??? in Maze of Shakhrami to make 3 Wyrmflies appear; defeat all 3.
Examine the ??? again to receive the key item Indigested Meat.
Optional: talk to Ahko Mhalijikhari to have the level restriction removed.
Return to Lumomo in Windurst Waters and talk to her.
Reward: 5,000 gil, Dragon Chronicles, Windurst fame, and the title Emerald Exterminator. Repeatable after the next conquest tally (finishing any nation's Eco-Warrior locks all three until then).

name: From Saplings Grow
steps: Requires a job that can equip the Bow of Trials and Archery skill 250, and you must not already hold a Weapon Training Guide (from another weapon-skill quest).
Talk to Perih Vashai in Windurst Woods (near 117, -3, 92). Accept the quest to receive the Bow of Trials and the Weapon Training Guide key item.
Equip the Bow of Trials and fight with it until it has 300 weapon skill points. If you lose the bow, talk to Perih Vashai and pick the first option for a new one. The third option cancels the quest.
Trade the Bow of Trials to Perih Vashai. If it has fewer than 300 points he gives it back. If it has 300, he keeps it and gives you the Map to the Annals of Truth key item.
Go to Cape Teriggan and examine the ??? near (-157, -8, 198). The monster Stolas appears. Defeat it.
Right after Stolas dies, examine the ??? again to get the Annals of Truth key item. Kill credit is lost if you zone or log out first, so you would have to fight Stolas again.
Return to Perih Vashai in Windurst Woods with the Annals of Truth to finish the quest.
Reward: you learn the weapon skill Empyreal Arrow, plus Windurst fame (20).

name: Orastery Woes
steps: Requires a job that can equip the Club of Trials and Club skill 230, and you must not already hold a Weapon Training Guide (from another weapon-skill quest).
Talk to Kuroido-Moido in Port Windurst (near -112.5, -4.2, 102.9). Accept the quest to receive the Club of Trials and the Weapon Training Guide key item.

Equip the Club of Trials and fight with it until it has 300 weapon skill points. If you lose the club, talk to Kuroido-Moido and pick the first option for a new one. The third option cancels the quest.
Trade the Club of Trials to Kuroido-Moido. If it has fewer than 300 points he gives it back. If it has 300, he keeps it and gives you the Map to the Annals of Truth key item.
Go to Ro'Maeve and examine the ??? near (197, -8, -27.5). The monster Eldhrimnir appears. Defeat it.
Right after Eldhrimnir dies, examine the ??? again to get the Annals of Truth key item. Kill credit is lost if you zone or log out first, so you would have to fight Eldhrimnir again.
Return to Kuroido-Moido in Port Windurst with the Annals of Truth to finish the quest.
Reward: you learn the weapon skill Black Halo, plus Windurst fame (20).

name: Blood and Glory
steps: Requires a job that can equip the Pole of Trials and staff skill 230.
Talk to Shantotto in Windurst Walls to accept. You get a Pole of Trials and the key item Weapon Training Guide.
Equip the Pole of Trials and earn 300 weapon skill points with it. If you lose the pole, talk to Shantotto to get another one.
Trade the finished Pole of Trials to Shantotto to get the key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
In Ifrit's Cauldron, examine the ??? (qm3) to make Cailleach Bheur appear, then defeat it.
Examine the ??? (qm3) again to get the key item Annals of Truth.
Return to Shantotto in Windurst Walls to finish the quest.
Reward: 20 Windurst fame and the weapon skill Retribution.

name: One Good Deed?
steps: Requires Windurst fame 5.
In Port Windurst, talk to Chipmy-Popmy and accept.
Go to Bibiki Bay and examine the ???; it is a trap and 6 Peerifools appear.
Defeat all 6 Peerifools without leaving the area (zoning resets the count), then examine the ??? again for the key item Deed to Purgonorgo Isle.
Return to Chipmy-Popmy in Port Windurst and talk to him.
Enter Boneyard Gully to see a cutscene and receive the key item Map of the Attohwa Chasm.
Return to Chipmy-Popmy and talk to him to finish.
Reward: 3,200 gil, 2,000 experience points, Windurst fame, the title Deed Verifier, and key item Map of the Attohwa Chasm.

name: Waking Dreams
steps: Requires the Chains of Promathia mission Darkness Named completed.
Talk to Kerutoto in Windurst Waters to start the quest and get the Vial of Dream Incense key item.
Obtain the Whisper of Dreams key item (this quest's script does not say where).
Return to Kerutoto. Pick one reward: Diabolos's Pole, Earring, Ring or Torque (one you don't own), 15,000 gil, or the Diabolos summon spell.
Reward: your chosen item, gil or spell, plus Windurst fame +60. Repeatable after the next JST midnight and a zone; talk to Kerutoto again.

name: Lure of the Wildcat (Windurst)
steps: Requires Treasures of Aht Urhgan to be enabled on the server (it is by default).
In Windurst Woods, talk to Ibwam to start and receive the key item Green Sentinel Badge.
Windurst Woods: talk to Soni-Muni, Etsa Rhuyuli, Cayu Pensharhumi, Umumu and Nanaa Mihgo.
Windurst Walls: talk to Yoriri, Shantotto, Moan-Maon, Chomomo and Naih Arihmepp.
Windurst Waters: talk to Npopo, Lago-Charago, Amagusa-Chigurusa, Funpo-Shipo and Kyume-Romeh.
Port Windurst: talk to Kunchichi, Yaman-Hachuman, Choyi Totlihpa, Three of Clubs and Yujuju.
After all 20 people, return to Ibwam in Windurst Woods (the badge is taken back).
Reward: key item Green Invitation Card.

name: Lost in Translocation
steps: Talk to Thorben in Batallia Downs [S] to accept the quest.
Go to The Eldieme Necropolis [S] and talk to Erik to get key item Left Map Piece.
In The Eldieme Necropolis [S], examine the Gravestone to get key item Middle Map Piece.
In The Eldieme Necropolis [S], examine the Sarcophagus to get key item Right Map Piece.
Return to Thorben in Batallia Downs [S] with all three map pieces.
Reward: 2,000 gil, 2,000 experience points and key item Map of Grauberg.

name: Message on the Wind
steps: Requires main job level 20 or higher.
Talk to Romualdo at the Cannonry in the Metalworks (second floor, K-9).
Travel to the past and talk to Romualdo in Batallia Downs [S] (I-7) to accept the quest.
Go to Grauberg [S] and talk to Childerich at the west side of the house at (E-12).
In Grauberg [S], examine the ??? at (J-9).
Talk to Childerich again.
Return to Romualdo in Batallia Downs [S] for the final cutscene.
Reward: Smart Grenade and Bastok fame. Afterwards talk to Romualdo in the Metalworks, then Childerich in Grauberg [S], to earn the title Windtalker.

name: The Weekly Adventurer
steps: Talk to Naiko-Paneiko in Crawlers Nest [S] to accept the quest and get key item Scoop-Dedicated Linkpearl.
Go to Rolanberry Fields [S] and talk to Rakula-Motakula.
Answer the quiz in the cutscene. The script's answers are choice 4, then 4, then 5.
Return to Naiko-Paneiko in Crawlers Nest [S]. If you got the quiz wrong, talk to Rakula-Motakula again and retry.
Reward: 2,000 gil, 2,000 experience points and key item Map of Fort Karugo-Narugo.

name: The Dawn of Delectability
steps: Talk to Ranpi-Monpi in Windurst Waters [S] (E-9, north side) to accept the quest.
Go to present-day Windurst Waters and talk to Ranpi-Monpi there.
Obtain 1 Pepperoni, 1 Walnut, 1 Dragon Fruit and 1 Bastore Sweeper (this quest's script does not say where) and trade all four to Ranpi-Monpi in Windurst Waters.
Wait until the next Vana'diel day, then talk to Ranpi-Monpi in Windurst Waters to get key item Ranpi-Monpi Specialty.
Go to Windurst Waters [S] and talk to Ranpi-Monpi to get key item Culinary Knife.
Return to Ranpi-Monpi in Windurst Waters for the final cutscene.
Reward: Trainee Knife.

name: A Little Knowledge
steps: Requires main job level 30 or higher.
Talk to Erlene in The Eldieme Necropolis [S] and accept the quest.
Go to Crawlers Nest [S] and talk to Tucker.
Trade Tucker only Rolanberries: every 12 gives 1 Sheet of Vellum (up to 48 berries/4 vellum per trade, 3 trades max). Gather 12 Sheets of Vellum.
Return to Erlene in The Eldieme Necropolis [S] and trade her exactly 12 Sheets of Vellum.
Talk to Erlene while under Manafont, Chainspell, Astral Flow or Azure Lore (the BLM, RDM, SMN or BLU special ability) for the final cutscene.
Reward: Scholar job unlocked, key items Grimoire and Job Gesture: Scholar, title Schultz Scholar. Later, as a level 5+ Scholar, talk to Erlene to learn Embrava and Kaustra.

name: The Fighting Fourth (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 0)
steps: In The Eldieme Necropolis [S], talk to Turbulent Storm and pick the first option to receive the key item Blue Recommendation Letter.
Go to Bastok Markets [S] and talk to Adelbrecht; agree to enlist (the second choice) to accept the quest. He takes the letter and gives you the key item Battle Rations.
In North Gustaberg [S], talk to Gebhardt and hand over the Battle Rations.
Still in North Gustaberg [S], talk to Roderich.
Check the Barricade in North Gustaberg [S] for a cutscene.
Return to Adelbrecht in Bastok Markets [S]. Do not pick the quit option in his earlier reminder talks, because that cancels the quest.
Reward: title Fourth Division Soldier, and you become allied with Bastok. If this is your first allegiance, you also get Sprinter's Shoes and the key item Bronze Ribbon of Service.

name: Snake on the Plains (WOTG Nation Quests - Windurst 0)
steps: You need the key item Green Recommendation Letter (this quest's script does not say where to get it), unless you already used one or already joined a Crystal War side. You can't have Steamed Rams or The Fighting Fourth active.
Talk to Miah Riyuh in Windurst Waters [S] and choose the first option to accept. You get the key item Zonpa-Zippa's All-Purpose Putty.
Go to West Sarutabaruta [S] and seal all three Sealed Entrances by examining each one.
Return to Miah Riyuh in Windurst Waters [S] and choose the first option to finish the quest and side with Windurst.
Reward: title Cobra Unit Mercenary. On your first Crystal War side choice you also get Sprinter's Shoes and the key item Bronze Ribbon of Service.

name: Steamed Rams (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 0)
steps: In Garlaige Citadel [S], talk to Randecque and pick the first option to receive the key item Red Recommendation Letter.
In Southern San d'Oria [S], talk to Mainchelite and pick the first option to accept the quest.
In East Ronfaure [S], examine the three ??? spots to get the key items Charred Propeller, Piece of Shattered Lumber and Oxidized Plate.
Return to Mainchelite in Southern San d'Oria [S]. Do not pick the quit option in his reminder talk, because that cancels the quest.
Reward: title Knight of the Iron Ram, and you become allied with San d'Oria. If this is your first allegiance, you also get Sprinter's Shoes and the key item Bronze Ribbon of Service.

name: Seeing Spots
steps: Talk to Wyatt in Southern San d'Oria [S] to accept the quest.
Obtain 4 Ladybug Wings (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade all 4 Ladybug Wings to Wyatt.
Reward: 3,000 gil and title Lady Killer.

name: The Flipside of Things
steps: Talk to Rarcasmeault in Garlaige Citadel [S] and choose to accept the quest.
In Garlaige Citadel [S], examine the ??? to get key item Firepower Case.
Return to Rarcasmeault and talk to him for the final cutscene.
Reward: 2,000 gil, 2,000 experience points and key item Map of Vunkerl Inlet.

name: Better Part of Valor (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 1)
steps: Requires finishing your first Wings of the Goddess nation quest (Steamed Rams, Snake on the Plains or The Fighting Fourth).
Go from Bastok Markets [S] into North Gustaberg [S]. A cutscene starts the quest and gives you the key item Clump of Animal Hair.
Talk to Engelhart in Bastok Markets [S].
In North Gustaberg [S], examine the ??? for a cutscene.
In Vunkerl Inlet [S], talk to Leadavox.
Trade 1 Gnole Claw to Leadavox to receive the key item Xhifhut. This quest's script does not say where to get the claw.
Return to Engelhart in Bastok Markets [S].
Reward: 10,000 gil and the key item Warning Letter.

name: Fires of Discontent (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 2)
steps: Requires finishing Better Part of Valor.
Talk to Engelhart in Bastok Markets [S] to accept the quest.
Talk to Pagdako in Bastok Markets [S].
Talk to Iron Eater in the Metalworks.
Return to Engelhart in Bastok Markets [S].
In Grauberg [S], examine the ??? for a cutscene.
Talk to Engelhart, then Gentle Tiger, then Engelhart again, all in Bastok Markets [S].
Reward: 10,000 gil.

name: Hammering Hearts
steps: Talk to Scarred Shark in Bastok Markets [S] at (G-5) and accept the quest.
Obtain 1 Heavy Quadav Chestplate and 1 Heavy Quadav Backplate (this quest's script does not say where).
Trade both plates together to Scarred Shark.
Leave the zone and come back, then talk to Scarred Shark again for the final cutscene.
Reward: Trainee Hammer.

name: Gifts of the Griffon (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 1)
steps: Requires finishing your first Wings of the Goddess nation quest (Steamed Rams, Snake on the Plains or The Fighting Fourth).
In Southern San d'Oria [S], talk to Louxiard. Change zones, then talk to Louxiard again.
Talk to Rholont to accept the quest and receive 7 Plumes d'Or.
In Southern San d'Oria [S], trade 1 Plume d'Or to each of these 7 people: Elnonde, Illeuse, Loillie, Louxiard, Machionage, Rongelouts N Distaud and Sabiliont.
If you lose your plumes, tell Rholont. After the next conquest tally he gives you new ones.
After all 7 trades, return to Rholont.
Reward: Deathstone.

name: Claws of the Griffon (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 2)
steps: Requires finishing Gifts of the Griffon, then waiting until the next Vana'diel day.
Talk to Rholont in Southern San d'Oria [S] to accept the quest. Change zones, then talk to Rholont again.
Go from East Ronfaure [S] into Jugner Forest [S] for a cutscene.
In Jugner Forest [S], examine the ???. Examine it again to make Fingerfilcher Dradzad appear.
Defeat Fingerfilcher Dradzad.
Examine the ??? once more to finish the quest.
Reward: Angelstone.

name: The Tigress Stirs (WOTG Nation Quests - Windurst 1)
steps: Requires finishing one first nation quest: Steamed Rams, Snake on the Plains or The Fighting Fourth.
Talk to Dhea Prandoleh in Windurst Waters [S] to accept the quest.
Go to West Sarutabaruta [S] and examine the ??? (qm4) to get the key item Small Starfruit.
Return to Windurst Waters [S] and examine the downstairs door of the Acolyte Hostel to finish the quest.
Reward: Hi-Elixir.

name: The Tigress Strikes (WOTG Nation Quests - Windurst 2)
steps: Requires The Tigress Stirs. Talk to Dhea Prandoleh in Windurst Waters [S] to accept the quest.
Go to Fort Karugo-Narugo [S] and talk to Rotih Moalghett.
Examine the ??? (qm4) in Fort Karugo-Narugo [S] for a cutscene.
Examine the ??? (qm4) again to make a War Lynx appear, then defeat it.
Examine the ??? (qm4) once more for a cutscene.
Return to Dhea Prandoleh in Windurst Waters [S] to finish the quest.
Reward: Star Globe and the title Ajido-Marujido's Minder.

name: Light in the Darkness (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 3)
steps: Requires finishing the Wings of the Goddess mission Back to the Beginning and the quest Fires of Discontent.
Talk to Gentle Tiger (H-6) in Bastok Markets [S] to accept the quest, then talk to Pagdako (H-9), then Blatherix (F-8).
Trade Blatherix either 30 Chunks of Goblin Chocolate or 5,000 gil to receive the key item Mine Shaft Key.
Go from Grauberg [S] into Pashhow Marshlands [S] for a cutscene.
Examine the Corroded Door (F-5) in Pashhow Marshlands [S] to enter the fight in Ruhotz Silvermines. Defeat any 7 of the Quadav there.
If you lose the fight, Blatherix gives you a new key for 10 Chunks of Goblin Chocolate or 1,000 gil.
After you win, you return to Pashhow Marshlands [S] for a cutscene. Then talk to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S].
Reward: Adaman Ingot.

name: Burden of Suspicion (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 4)
steps: Requires finishing Light in the Darkness. Wait until the next Vana'diel day and change zones first.
Talk to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S] to accept the quest. She takes your Warning Letter.
Talk to Engelhart in Bastok Markets [S].
In The Eldieme Necropolis [S], examine the Sarcophagus.
Return to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S].
Reward: title Assistant Detective.

name: The Fumbling Friar
steps: Requires main job level 30 or higher and key item Bronze Ribbon of Service.
Talk to Fondactiont in Garlaige Citadel [S] to accept the quest.
Go to Grauberg [S] and examine the ??? to get key item Ornate Package.
Return to Fondactiont in Garlaige Citadel [S] for the final cutscene.
Reward: Scroll of Recall-Pashh.

name: Boy and the Beast (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 3)
steps: Requires finishing the Wings of the Goddess mission Back to the Beginning and the quest Claws of the Griffon.
In Southern San d'Oria [S], talk to Raustigne, then Rholont.
In Vunkerl Inlet [S], examine the ??? to accept the quest and receive the key item Vunkerl Herb Memo.
Examine the Leafy Patch in Vunkerl Inlet [S] to get the key item Vunkerl Herb. The cutscene asks you to choose, and only one specific choice counts.
Bring the herb back to the ???. If you picked the wrong herb, it is taken away; go back to the Leafy Patch and choose again.
Reward: Carbon Fishing Rod.

name: Wrath of the Griffon (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 4)
steps: Requires finishing the Crystal War quest Boy and the Beast first.
Talk to Rholont in Southern San d'Oria [S] to accept the quest.
Go to Jugner Forest [S] and examine the ??? (qm8) to see a cutscene.
Examine the ??? (qm8) again to make the Orc Cobraclaw Buchzvotch appear, then defeat it.
Examine the ??? (qm8) once more after the fight to see the follow-up cutscene.
Return to Rholont in Southern San d'Oria [S] to finish the quest.
Optional: talk to Wyatt in Southern San d'Oria [S] to exchange the Military Scrip for 20,147 gil.
Reward: key item Military Scrip (Wyatt trades it for 20,147 gil).

name: The Lost Book
steps: Requires main job level 30 or higher and key item Bronze Ribbon of Service.
In Windurst Waters [S], examine the south Rhinostery door (J-9 of the second map) to start the quest.
Obtain 1 Mythril Beastcoin (this quest's script does not say where), go to present-day Giddeus and trade it to Quu Bokye to get key item Leather-bound Book.
Return to Windurst Waters [S] and examine the south Rhinostery door again.
Examine the Optistery door in Windurst Waters [S] (F-8 on the first map).
Go to Castle Oztroja [S] and examine the ??? at (G-8) on the first map to get key item Lynx Pelt.
Obtain 1 Sheet of Vellum (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to the Optistery door in Windurst Waters [S].
Wait until the next Vana'diel day, then examine the Optistery door again.
Reward: Scroll of Retrace.

name: Knot Quite There (WOTG Nation Quests - Windurst 3)
steps: Requires The Tigress Strikes and the Wings of the Goddess mission Back to the Beginning.
Examine the downstairs door of the Acolyte Hostel in Windurst Waters [S] to accept the quest.
Go to Sauromugue Champaign [S] and examine the Bulwark Gate for a cutscene.
Get a 108-Knot Quipu (this quest's script does not say where) and trade one to the Bulwark Gate.
Walk on foot from East Ronfaure [S] into Southern San d'Oria [S] for a cutscene.
Examine the house door (_6eo) in Southern San d'Oria [S] to finish the quest.
Reward: Platinum Beastcoin.

name: On Sabbatical
steps: Requires Scholar as main job at level 40 or higher.
Talk to Erlene in The Eldieme Necropolis [S] to accept the quest and get key item Ulbrecht's Sealed Letter.
Go to Bastok Markets [S] and talk to Gentle Tiger.
Go to Pashhow Marshlands [S] and examine the Indescript Markings to get key item Schultz's Sealed Letter.
Return to Erlene in The Eldieme Necropolis [S] for the final cutscene.
Reward: Klimaform Schema.

name: Downward Helix
steps: Requires Scholar as main job at level 50 or higher; finish On Sabbatical, then wait until the next Vana'diel day and change zones.
Talk to Erlene in The Eldieme Necropolis [S] to accept the quest.
Enter Southern San d'Oria [S] from East Ronfaure [S] for a cutscene.
Return to Erlene in The Eldieme Necropolis [S] and talk to her.
Enter Sauromugue Champaign [S] from Rolanberry Fields [S] for a cutscene.
In Sauromugue Champaign [S], examine the Indescript Markings to get key item Ulbrecht's Mortarboard.
Return to Erlene in The Eldieme Necropolis [S] for the final cutscene.
Reward: Scholar's Bracers.

name: Storm on the Horizon (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 5)
steps: Requires finishing Burden of Suspicion.
Talk to Blatherix in Bastok Markets [S]; he gives you an Elixir.
Wait until the next Vana'diel day and change zones. Then go from North Gustaberg [S] into Bastok Markets [S] for a cutscene that starts the quest.
Talk to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S].
In North Gustaberg [S], examine the Monument.
In Grauberg [S], examine the ??? to finish the quest.
Reward: Icarus Wing.

name: Fire in the Hole (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 6)
steps: Requires finishing Storm on the Horizon, with Wings of the Goddess missions at least as far as In the Name of the Father.
Go from North Gustaberg [S] into Bastok Markets [S]. Two cutscenes start the quest and give you the key item Silvermine Key.
In North Gustaberg [S], examine the Stonehoused Adit.
Clear the fight in Ruhotz Silvermines. This server has not implemented that fight yet, so you may not be able to go past this step.
If you lose the Silvermine Key after the fight starts, talk to Solitary Ant in North Gustaberg [S] to get a new one.
After the fight, go from Ruhotz Silvermines into North Gustaberg [S] for a cutscene. Then go into Bastok Markets [S] for another one.
Talk to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S] twice.
Reward: Republican Silver Medal and title Mythril Musketeer No. 6.

name: Perils of the Griffon (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 5)
steps: Requires Wrath of the Griffon and the Wings of the Goddess mission Purple, the New Black. After Wrath of the Griffon, wait one Vana'diel day and change zones.
Talk to Rholont in Southern San d'Oria [S] for a cutscene, then talk to him again for a second cutscene.
Talk to Daigraffeaux in Southern San d'Oria [S].
Talk to Rholont again to accept the quest.
Go to Jugner Forest [S] and examine the ??? (qm6) to get the key item Orcish Warmachine Body.
Return to Rholont in Southern San d'Oria [S] to finish the quest.
Reward: Elixir and the title Knight of the Swiftwing Griffin.

name: In a Haze of Glory (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 6)
steps: Requires Perils of the Griffon. Rholont in Southern San d'Oria [S] gives a hint that sends you to Garlaige Citadel [S].
In Garlaige Citadel [S], talk to Diordinne to accept the quest and get the key item Number Eight Shelter Key.
Examine the Wooden Crates in Garlaige Citadel [S] for a cutscene.
Clear the fight in Ghoyu's Reverie. The script only guesses at its finish event, and the instance is not in this server's instance list, so this step may not work.
Once back in Garlaige Citadel [S], a cutscene plays when you zone in.
If you lost the shelter key, talk to Diordinne, wait one Vana'diel day, then talk to her again for a new one.
Return to Rholont in Southern San d'Oria [S] after 18:00 Vana'diel time to finish the quest. Earlier in the day he only gives a reminder.
Reward: Fullmetal Bullet.

name: Quelling the Storm (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 7)
steps: Requires finishing Fire in the Hole, with Wings of the Goddess missions at least as far as Crossroads of Time.
Go from North Gustaberg [S] into Bastok Markets [S]; a cutscene starts the quest. Then talk to Gentle Tiger.
In Bastok Markets [S], talk to Paul, Biggorf and Wilhelmina (any order).
Talk to Gentle Tiger, then Blatherix, in Bastok Markets [S].
Trade Blatherix 1 Goblin Mess Tin, 1 Goblin Mushpot and 1 Pinch of Twinkle Powder. This quest's script does not say where to get them.
