Talk to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S].
In Vunkerl Inlet [S], examine the ???.
Return to Blatherix in Bastok Markets [S].
Reward: Goblin Belt.

name: Honor Under Fire (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 8)
steps: Requires finishing Quelling the Storm, with Wings of the Goddess missions at least as far as Crossroads of Time.
Talk to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S] to accept the quest.
In Vunkerl Inlet [S], examine the ???, then talk to the Beastman Ensign.
Return to Gentle Tiger to receive the key item Flare Grenade. If you lose it, she gives you another.
Talk to the Beastman Ensign in Vunkerl Inlet [S] again.
Clear the fight in Everbloom Hollow. This server has not implemented that fight yet, so you may not be able to go past this step.
After the fight, return to Vunkerl Inlet [S] for a cutscene. Then talk to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S].
Reward: Elixir Tank.

name: The Price of Valor (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 7)
steps: Requires In a Haze of Glory. Afterward, wait one Vana'diel day and change zones.
Talk to Rholont in Southern San d'Oria [S] for a cutscene.
In Southern San d'Oria [S], examine the Tree Hollow to get Long-Life Biscuits, then the Well to get a Flask of Kingdom Water.
Use logging points in East Ronfaure [S] until you get the key item Ronfaure Maple Syrup. Each successful logging has about a 50% chance.
Return to Rholont to trade the three key items for the key item Biscuit a la Rholont.
Go to Jugner Forest [S] and examine the Felled Trees to accept the quest.
In Vunkerl Inlet [S], examine Toppled Cresset 1, then Toppled Cresset 2, then the Underbrush.
Examine the Underbrush again to make Madthrasher Zradbodd appear and defeat it. Without changing zones, examine the Underbrush once more.
Go to Pashhow Marshlands [S] and examine the Shimmering Pondweed to finish the quest.
Reward: Peiste Skin.

name: Bonds That Never Die (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 8)
steps: Requires: finish the quest The Price of Valor first.
Talk to Rholont in Southern San d'Oria [S] to receive the key item Letter to Count Aurchiat.
Go to Pashhow Marshlands [S] and examine the Shimmering Pondweed. The cutscene accepts the quest and uses up the letter.
In Jugner Forest [S], examine the Overgrown Mushrooms. You receive a Hatchet.
Use logging (trade a Hatchet to a logging point) in Jugner Forest [S]. Each successful, unbroken log has a 50% chance to give the key item Length of Jugner Ivy.
With the Length of Jugner Ivy, examine the Overgrown Mushrooms again, then examine the Mossy Stump in Jugner Forest [S].

BLOCKED on this server: after the Mossy Stump, the next step happens in the Everbloom Hollow instance, but this server has no Everbloom Hollow instance enabled and no script that sends you there. You cannot go past this step.
(Not reachable here) The script would next send you back to Jugner Forest [S] for a cutscene, then have you talk to Rongelouts N Distaud in Southern San d'Oria [S] to finish.
Reward (not reachable on this server): Behemoth Horn.

name: Beneath the Mask (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 9)
steps: Requires finishing Honor Under Fire, with Wings of the Goddess missions at least as far as Fate in Haze.
Talk to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S] to accept the quest.
Enter Beadeaux [S] for a cutscene, then return to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S].
In The Eldieme Necropolis [S], talk to Red Axe.
In Vunkerl Inlet [S], trade Leadavox 1 Lump of Beeswax and 1 Jar of Red Textile Dye to receive the key item Wax Seal. This quest's script does not say where to get them.
Bring the Wax Seal to Red Axe in The Eldieme Necropolis [S].
Talk to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S].
In Beaucedine Glacier [S], talk to Hoarfang to finish the quest.
Reward: Super Reraiser.

name: What Price Loyalty (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 10)
steps: Requires finishing Beneath the Mask, with Wings of the Goddess missions at least as far as Fate in Haze.
Talk to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S] to accept the quest and receive the key item Sack of Victuals.
Bring the Sack of Victuals to Roderich in North Gustaberg [S].
Return to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S].
Enter Xarcabard [S] for a cutscene and receive the key item Commander's Endorsement.
Check the Forbidding Portal in Xarcabard [S]. If you lose the endorsement, Gentle Tiger gives you a new one.
Clear the fight in Everbloom Hollow. This server has not implemented that fight yet, so you may not be able to go past this step.
After you return to Xarcabard [S] for a cutscene, report to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S].
Reward: Fourth Staff.

name: Songbirds in a Snowstorm (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 9)
steps: Requires Bonds That Never Die and the Wings of the Goddess mission The Will of the World. Afterward, wait one Vana'diel day and change zones.
Talk to Rholont in Southern San d'Oria [S], then talk to Daigraffeaux in the same zone to accept the quest.
Enter Beaucedine Glacier [S] for a cutscene, then examine the Colossal Footprint.
Examine the Rocky Perch in Beaucedine Glacier [S] to get a Goliath Worm.
Fish the key items Lance Fish, Paladin Lobster and Scutum Crab. Script comments say they come from specific ponds, but no code on this server gives them.
With all three key items, examine the Colossal Footprint again.
Trade one Flint Stone to the Charred Firewood in Beaucedine Glacier [S].
Examine the Compressed Snow, then examine it again to make the Orcish Bloodletter appear. The script says this enemy is set very high and is not yet verified. Defeat it.
Examine the Compressed Snow once more to finish the quest.
Reward: Icarus Wing.

name: Blood of Heroes (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 10)
steps: Requires finishing Songbirds in a Snowstorm.
In Xarcabard [S], examine the Animal Spoor to accept the quest.
Examine the Wheel Rut, then the Animal Spoor again, to receive the key item Vial of Military Prism Powder.
Examine the Forbidding Portal in Xarcabard [S].

Clear the fight in Ghoyus Reverie. This server has not implemented that fight yet, so you may not be able to go past this step. If you need more powder, the Animal Spoor gives another once per Vana'diel day.
After the fight, enter Xarcabard [S] for a cutscene. Then examine the Wheel Rut.
Reward: Ram Staff and title House Aurchiat Retainer.

name: The Truth Lies Hid (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 11)
steps: Requires finishing What Price Loyalty, with Wings of the Goddess missions at least as far as Adieu, Lilisette.
Talk to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S] to accept the quest.
Enter Castle Zvahl Baileys [S] for a cutscene.
In Castle Zvahl Keep [S], talk to the three imps Rikke, Rakke and Rokke. Only one of them tells the truth, and which one changes each Vana'diel day.
Trade 1 Elixir to the imp you think is honest. You only get one try per Vana'diel day; if you guess wrong, try again the next day.
Once you have guessed right, examine the ??? in Castle Zvahl Keep [S].
Examine the Displaced Block in Castle Zvahl Keep [S].
Reward: Sanctus Rosary.

name: Bonds of Mythril (WOTG Nation Quests - Bastok 12)
steps: Requires finishing The Truth Lies Hid, with Wings of the Goddess missions at least as far as Adieu, Lilisette.
Go from Castle Zvahl Keep [S] into Castle Zvahl Baileys [S]; a cutscene starts the quest.
In Castle Zvahl Keep [S], examine the ??? for a cutscene.
Defeat 4 Keep Imps, then examine the ??? again to make the Gargouille Warden appear. Defeat it.
Examine the ??? once more to receive the key item Zvahl Passkey.
In Throne Room [S], examine the door for a cutscene, then win the Bonds of Mythril fight. This server has not implemented that fight yet.
Talk to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets [S]. Cutscenes then play in the Metalworks and in North Gustaberg [S].
Reward: Excelsis Ring and title Temperer of Mythril.

name: Chasing Shadows (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 11)
steps: Requires finishing Blood of Heroes. The script is meant to make you wait a day after that, but on this server the wait is not set, so you can start right away.
In Southern San d'Oria [S], talk to Rongelouts N Distaud to accept the quest.
Go from Beaucedine Glacier [S] into Xarcabard [S] for a cutscene.
In Xarcabard [S], examine in this order: the Backfilled Pit, the Compact Footprint, the Sunken Footprint, then the Compact Footprint again.
Go from Beaucedine Glacier [S] into Batallia Downs [S] for a cutscene. Then examine the Fresh Snowmelt.

Examine the Fresh Snowmelt again to make Menechme appear, and defeat it. On this server Menechme is a level 150 placeholder and the helper character does not appear, so this fight may not be winnable.
Examine the Fresh Snowmelt once more. You are moved to present-day Batallia Downs (not [S]), and the next quest, Face of the Future, starts automatically.
Reward: Darksteel Sheet.

name: Face of the Future (WOTG Nation Quests - San d'Oria 12)
steps: This quest starts automatically when you finish Chasing Shadows.
Go from Batallia Downs into Jugner Forest for a cutscene. Then examine the Metallic Hodgepodge.
Enter Ghelsba Outpost for a cutscene. Examine the Clandestine Marking to get the key item Orcish Infiltration Kit.
In Yughott Grotto, examine the Scrape Mark.
Clear the fight in Everbloom Hollow. This server has not implemented that fight yet, so you may not be able to go past this step.
After the fight, return to Yughott Grotto for a cutscene.
In Batallia Downs, use the Cavernous Maw (it must already be unlocked). Watch the cutscenes in Batallia Downs and Xarcabard [S] until the quest finishes.
Reward: Griffon Ring and title Fangmonger Forestaller.

name: Her Memories: Homecoming Queen
steps: Requires the Wings of the Goddess mission Her Memories to be your current mission.
Enter Southern San d'Oria from East Ronfaure for a cutscene that starts the quest. It has three parts, each giving a Tiny Memory Fragment.
Old Bean: talk to Thierride in Port San d'Oria for Thierride's Bean Creation, show it to Amaura in Southern San d'Oria, then talk to Thierride again.
The Faux Pas: in Northern San d'Oria talk to Abioleget, then talk to Bertenont.
The Grave Resolve: talk to Halver in Chateau d'Oraguille, then examine the Weathered Gravestone in Batallia Downs.
Obtain 1 Lilac (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to the Weathered Gravestone in Batallia Downs.
When the third part is done, the three fragments merge. Reward: key item Large Memory Fragment 1.

name: Her Memories: Operation Cupid
steps: Requires the Wings of the Goddess mission Her Memories to be your current mission.
Enter Batallia Downs [S] from Jugner Forest [S] for a cutscene that starts the quest.
Go to Sauromugue Champaign [S] and examine the Bulwark Gate.
Obtain 1 Bottle of Rice Vinegar, 1 Jar of Ground Wasabi and 1 Sprig of Holy Basil (this quest's script does not say where).
Go to Vunkerl Inlet [S] and trade all three items together to Leadavox to get key item Pot of Martial Relish.
Return to the Bulwark Gate in Sauromugue Champaign [S] and examine it to hand over the relish.
Enter Batallia Downs [S] from Rolanberry Fields [S] for the final cutscene.
Reward: key item Large Memory Fragment 3.

name: Her Memories: Carnelian Footfalls
steps: Requires the Wings of the Goddess mission Her Memories to be your current mission and San d'Oria as your Campaign allegiance.
Enter Southern San d'Oria [S] from East Ronfaure [S] for a cutscene.
Talk to Mainchelite in Southern San d'Oria [S] to start the quest.
Leave Southern San d'Oria [S] into East Ronfaure [S] for a cutscene.
In East Ronfaure [S], examine all three ??? spots (one cutscene at each).
Return to Mainchelite in Southern San d'Oria [S] for the final cutscene.
Reward: key item Large Memory Fragment 4.

name: Her Memories: Azure Footfalls
steps: Requires the Wings of the Goddess mission Her Memories to be your current mission and Bastok as your Campaign allegiance.
Enter Bastok Markets [S] from North Gustaberg [S] for a cutscene.
Talk to Adelbrecht in Bastok Markets [S] to start the quest.
Go to North Gustaberg [S] and talk to Gebhardt.
In North Gustaberg [S], talk to Roderich next.
In North Gustaberg [S], examine the Barricade.
Return to Adelbrecht in Bastok Markets [S] for the final cutscene.
Reward: key item Large Memory Fragment 4.

name: Her Memories: Of Malign Maladies
steps: Requires the Wings of the Goddess mission Her Memories to be your current mission.
Talk to Amaura in Southern San d'Oria to start the quest.
Go to Upper Jeuno and talk to Monberaux.
Go to Windurst Waters and examine the library book.
Obtain 1 Philosopher's Stone (this quest's script does not say where) and trade it to the Fey Blossoms in Grauberg [S].
Wait until the next Vana'diel day, then examine the Fey Blossoms again to get key item Fey Stone.
Go to Southern San d'Oria [S] and talk to Raustigne for the final cutscene.
Reward: key item Large Memory Fragment 2.
